Kan de regering aangeven wat het verwachte liquiditeitsvoordeel is van de incidentele intensivering van de WBSO?
Requests evaluation of the innovation box, clarity on budgetary effects, and a second opinion on the BPM reform cost-benefit analysis, pressing for scrutiny of the proposals.
Is the government willing to evaluate the innovation box, and if so, when?
Is de regering bereid de innovatiebox te evalueren, en zo ja wanneer?
Objects that too many regulations are placed in the Belastingplan that should be treated separately, and notes the Raad van State's repeated criticism being ignored.
These members object to the increasing number of rules placed in the Belastingplan that would actually require separate treatment.
Deze leden maken er bezwaar tegen dat er steeds meer regels in het Belastingplan worden gestopt die eigenlijk een aparte behandeling zouden behoeven.

Criticizes the bundling of unrelated measures and the careless parliamentary decision-making on the youngtimer amendment, supporting more orderly parliamentary deliberation while backing many tax incentives.
These members share the Council of State's view that this places unnecessary pressure on careful parliamentary decision-making.
Die leden delen de opvatting van de Raad van State dat dit onnodige druk legt op een zorgvuldige parlementaire besluitvorming.
Warns that the flood of bills and time pressure make careful parliamentary treatment nearly impossible and questions the consistency of the CO2-based BPM reform with simplification goals.
The great time pressure and enormous scope with very many far-reaching measures make careful parliamentary treatment nearly impossible.
De grote tijdsdruk en de enorme omvang met zeer veel ingrijpende maatregelen maken zorgvuldige parlementaire behandeling bijna onmogelijk.
Raises a large number of questions on fiscal greening, the werkkostenregeling, and small jobs without a check-related focus.
These members still have mainly a large number of questions regarding the amendment of the Belastingplan.
Er resten bij deze leden vooral nog een groot aantal vragen aangaande de wijziging van het Belastingplan.
Welcomes the government's direction on entrepreneurship and fiscal greening, asking mainly for clarifications and further steps.
They note with satisfaction that the cabinet continues the line set out in the crisis agreement.
Zij constateren tot hun tevredenheid dat het kabinet de ingezette lijn in het crisisakkoord doortrekt.
Welcomes the many positive elements for entrepreneurs and asks technical questions about the zelfstandigenaftrek and administrative workings.
According to these members, the Belastingplan 2010 contains many positive elements for entrepreneurial Netherlands.
Het Belastingplan 2010 bevat volgens deze leden veel positieve elementen voor ondernemend Nederland.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the Belastingplan 2010 draft bill, raising objections on the budget-bill scope, the koopkracht package information, the zelfstandigenaftrek and MKB-winstvrijstelling, the KIA for zuinige personenauto's, successierechtschulden, bestuurlijke boeten, and the VAT book rate, and advised revision. The government's nader rapport accepted several points (heffingsrente, buitenlandse successieschulden, redactional comments) but rejected others, including the budget-bill scope, KIA cumulation, the book definition, and the boete increases.
concerns: The Raad questioned whether minor measures (greening and VAT) belong in the Belastingplan rather than the Overige fiscale maatregelen, since their budget effect is under €10 million; the government rejected this and kept them in the plan.

The Raad found the tax-rate and koopkracht package explanation inadequate and asked for a fuller justification of the fiscal measures; the government argued the existing tables and paragraph 4.4 suffice.

The Raad doubted the equal treatment of entrepreneurs and employees in income tax, asking for justification of the zelfstandigenaftrek and MKB-winstvrijstelling; the government addressed this only partly by noting a possible future study of an rechtsvormneutrale winstbelasting.

The Raad had serious doubts about the proportionality of combining the KIA with the zero BPM and motor-vehicle tax for zeer zuinige personenauto's and advised reconsidering; the government kept the cumulation to stimulate purchases.

The Raad advised that heffingsrente on successierechtschulden be calculated on the same basis as the material debt, and that foreign inheritance-tax debts be taken into account; the government adopted both.

The Raad asked for a stronger justification of the fourfold increase in the maximum verzuimboete for late tax returns and of the new penalty for late payment of aanslagbelastingen; the government revised the justification for the return penalty but defended the payment penalty as necessary.
The Raad noted that the book definition in the VAT table goes beyond Directive 2009/47/EG and advised strict implementation; the government deliberately deviated and kept the wider wording.
The Raad gave several redactional comments in its annex, most of which the government adopted, with one not followed on the monument exemption amendment.

32137.s: The bill enacts a new Book 10 of the Dutch Civil Code consolidating private international law, opening with general provisions (applicable law, public policy, overriding mandatory rules, renvoi exclusion) followed by rules on names, marriage and registered partnership, matrimonial property, divorce, and parentage. It largely codifies existing conflict-of-laws rules and recognition criteria rather than granting new executive powers.
q: The present bill is the result of a long and intensive collaboration between the State Commission and the Ministry of Justice.
Het voorliggende wetsvoorstel is daarmee het resultaat van een langdurige en intensieve samenwerking tussen de Staatscommissie en het ministerie van Justitie.

parties: Asks whether the bill is more a handbook for legal users than a law, and why some conflict rules are included and others not.
These members have the impression that this is not so much a law as a handbook for the legal user.
Deze leden hebben de indruk dat het hier niet zozeer een wet betreft maar meer een handboek voor de rechtsgebruiker.

Asks on what basis some treaties are incorporated into the statute and others not, and whether EU regulations and future treaty changes will require direct amendment of Book 10, touching on democratic control of incorporated international rules.
On what basis has this been done for some treaties and not for others?
Op grond waarvan is dit bij sommige verdragen wel en bij andere niet gedaan?
Requests a short summary of which material changes to conflict rules the bill proposes, for transparency.
They have one question about this.

32146.s: The bill temporarily extends the earmark (oormerking) for adult education and the spending obligation of municipalities toward regional vocational colleges (roc's), postponing their abolition from 1 January 2011 to a date set by general administrative order. It also makes related amendments to the Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs, including limiting admission to adult education courses for certain integration-obligated groups until a date set by order in council.
32146.j: The memorandum justifies the temporary postponement by the financial and policy pressures on vocational education from the crisis, the new competence-based qualification structure, and the effects of the new Wet inburgering, with the postponement limited to three years and extendable only in case of force majeure.
q: The market introduction in education (abolition of the earmark and ending of the spending obligation) will be postponed by 3 years (also the maximum) until and including 31 December 2012.
De marktwerking in de educatie (vervallen oormerking en beëindigen bestedingsverplichting) zal met 3 jaar (tevens maximum) worden uitgesteld tot en met 31 december 2012.
d: I.B.1 (Wet participatiebudget art. 9, onderdelen C, D, I, K, P)
date on which the vervallen of the earmark and spending obligation takes effect
I.B.2 (Wet participatiebudget art. 9, onderdelen J en O)
date on which the earmark and spending obligation end
I.C (Wet participatiebudget art. 14, eerste en tweede lid)
end date of the temporary earmark and spending obligation for education
termination of the transitional provision on the amount provided by the minister for housing
II.A (Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs art. 1.3.1, eerste lid)
date from which roc's are obliged to provide educatie courses ends
deadline for municipal decisions on education amounts
II.C (Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs art. 8.1.1, zesde lid)
date until which admission to educatie courses is closed to certain integration-obligated adults

parties: Asks why the three-year limit is not written into the law itself and deferred to a general administrative order, questioning the legislative safeguard on the deadline.
If it is correct that the term may only exceed three years in case of force majeure, what is the government's reason, these members ask, for not including the term in the law?
Als het juist is, dat alleen in geval van overmacht de termijn langer wordt dan drie jaar, wat is dan de overweging van de regering, zo vragen deze leden, om de termijn niet in de wet op te nemen.
Supports the temporary extension but asks in which force majeure cases the extension is granted and how municipalities and agreements with providers are affected.
The PvdA members ask in which cases of force majeure the aforementioned extension of a maximum of three years is granted.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen in welke gevallen van overmacht de voornoemde verlenging van maximum drie jaar wordt verleend.
Opposes market competition in education and asks whether the government shares concerns about its effects on accessibility, and questions the 35 million euro cut's impact on learners and quality.
In addition, market competition may undermine the accessibility of adult education, these members believe.
Daarnaast kan marktwerking de toegankelijkheid van de volwasseneneducatie aantasten, zo menen deze leden.
Accepts the savings in principle but objects strongly to using them to delay market competition and extend earmarking, arguing municipalities are left in uncertainty and may have to abort tendering.

The members, however, have serious objections to the way the government uses the savings to postpone the planned market competition in spending education funds and to extend the earmarking of these funds.

De leden hebben echter grote bezwaren tegen de wijze waarop de regering de bezuiniging aangrijpt voor het uitstellen van de geplande marktwerking bij het besteden van de educatiemiddelen en voor het verlengen van de oormerking van deze middelen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises on a bill postponing the removal of earmarking for adult education funds and the spending obligation for regional vocational colleges (roc's), supporting its aim but asking for clear deadlines and better treatment of contracts already entered into. The government's reply largely accepts the remarks: it keeps the transitional exception with stricter wording, adds clarifications to the explanatory memorandum, and sets the 31 December 2012 deadline, while retaining the choice of an AMvB for market introduction.
concerns: Transitional rules should give clarity; the Afdeling asks for fixed deadlines for de-earmarking and the end of the spending obligation, while the government keeps the date to be set by AMvB with a target of 31 December 2012.

Great restraint is needed when changing transitional law, and parties may have invested in preparing for market introduction; the government accepts the exception rationale but only partly accepts that these effects were insufficiently considered.
The transitional exception in article 14(3) applies only to the first paragraph and should also cover the spending obligation in the second paragraph; the government adopted this.
The term 'contractuele verplichtingen' suggests signed contracts only; it was replaced by 'juridische verplichtingen' so that late-stage tender procedures are covered.
Redactional comments on article I, part C and article II, part B were adopted in the bill.

32191.s: The bill amends the Kieswet to raise the preference threshold for Eerste Kamer elections, restrict list combinations so they are fixed before provincial elections, and fix the voting time at 15:00. It also adjusts several technical provisions on list submission, corrections and seat allocation.

parties: Asks how the government weighs the Kiesraad advice on central candidacy and the Raad van State's position on the interpretation of the election timing under Article 55.
The CDA members ask the government to give its view on the advice of the Kiesraad.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering haar mening te geven over het advies van de Kiesraad.
Questions whether the 50% criterion for list combinations still allows calculated behaviour and whether alternatives were considered.
The PvdA members further ask whether the proposed model for list combinations may still allow calculated behaviour.
Voorts vragen deze leden of het niet zo is dat met het voorgestelde model voor lijstverbindingen er nog steeds sprake kan zijn van calculerend gedrag.
Supports the changes as reflecting the wish of the Eerste Kamer expressed in motions, with no further questions.
These are adjustments flowing from the wish of the Eerste Kamer as expressed in three broadly supported motions.
Het betreft aanpassingen die voortvloeien uit de wens van de Eerste Kamer zoals die tot uitdrukking is gekomen in drie breed ondersteunde moties.

Supports a higher threshold but asks whether a statutory ban on combinations after provincial elections would be possible and whether the constitutional interpretation should be referred to a commission or the Raad van State.
The VVD members ask the government to address with reasons the possibility of legally banning list combinations after the provincial elections.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering gemotiveerd in te gaan op de mogelijkheid van het wettelijk verbieden van lijstcombinaties na de verkiezingen van de provinciale staten.
Opposes indirect democracy and any higher threshold, but agrees voters need clarity on list combinations before provincial elections.
Every threshold that makes it possibly harder to be elected is one too many in the eyes of the PVV members.
Elke drempel die het mogelijkerwijze moeilijker maakt om gekozen te worden is er één teveel in de ogen van de leden van de PVV-fractie.
Asks for justification of the majority-of-provinces threshold and whether the BES islands count as a province.
On this point the members would like to receive a justification of the proposed threshold.
Graag ontvangen de leden op dit punt een verantwoording van de voorgestelde drempel.
Has doubts about the list-combination rules, questioning whether the seven-province requirement is too high and whether it forces parties into provincial combinations.
Does the proposed system not implicitly pressure political groupings to also form a list combination for the provincial elections?
Gaat er van het voorgestelde systeem niet impliciet dwang uit op politieke groeperingen om ook voor de statenverkiezingen een lijstverbinding aan te gaan?

v.summary: The Council of State advised on a bill amending the Kieswet to raise the preference threshold, restrict list combinations, and set the Eerste Kamer voting time, endorsing its aim but asking for alignment with the Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba reform on list combinations and voting time. The government's reply accepts the points and states that the Kieswet reform bill already contains the required provisions and that the explanatory memorandum has been clarified.
concerns: The Council asks that the bill be aligned with the pending bill on the new status of Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, including treating the public bodies as one province for list combinations.
The Council asks that the voting time of 15.00 be specified as local time in the European part of the Netherlands, aligned with the public bodies.
The Council asks that the explanatory memorandum address the alignment of voting times and list combinations with the public bodies.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised against the draft amendment to the Kieswet on list combinations for Eerste Kamer elections, finding that the permanent registration scheme still amounts to an election act barred by article 55 of the Constitution and departs from the list-based electoral system. The government's nader rapport accepts the advice and states that the possibility of list combinations for Eerste Kamer elections will be abolished, with the amendment adjusted accordingly.
concerns: The Raad holds that the registration scheme, like early candidacy, constitutes an election act barred before provincial elections under article 55 of the Constitution, and advises abolishing list combinations for Eerste Kamer elections.
The Raad finds the scheme introduces a new element that abandons the list-based foundation of the Dutch electoral system and advises reconsidering the proposal.
The explanatory memorandum does not explain how the scheme affects voters' knowledge of list combinations when casting their provincial votes.
Article S 8(5) may allow a party bound in the register to join a third party by merging designations, contrary to Q 7(2)(b); the Raad advises clarifying the explanatory memorandum.

32209.s: The bill amends the Gemeentewet and Provinciewet to let aldermen and provincial executive members (gedeputeerden) take leave of up to sixteen weeks for pregnancy, childbirth or illness, with the college or Gedeputeerde Staten granting leave on medical advice and the council or provincial states appointing a temporary replacement. It excludes appeal against leave decisions from judicial review and exempts appointed temporary replacement gedeputeerden from the pension scheme for political office holders.
32209.j: The memorandum justifies excluding appeal because a procedure would delay the replacement and could put the illness itself in question, and because the decision is bound to medical advice.
q: No appeal can be lodged against the decision on the request for leave.
Tegen de beslissing op het verzoek tot verlof kan geen beroep worden ingesteld.
p: The leave decision is bound to the medical advice and cannot be appealed, removing judicial review of leave refusals or grants.

parties: Objects to the long replacement period of up to nearly a year and asks why leave rather than dismissal and why the Chamber presidents hold the binding decision.
The VVD members did not consider this a good thing for the performance of a representative function.
Dat vonden de leden van de VVD-fractie geen goede zaak voor de vervulling van een volksvertegenwoordigende functie.
Supports uniformity with the regime for representatives and the leave construction, while stressing quality of administrators over positive discrimination.
These members however acknowledge the problem that can arise in case of pregnancy leave or illness.
Deze leden erkennen echter het probleem dat kan optreden wanneer er sprake is van zwangerschapsverlof of ziekte.
Asks whether replacement is needed in practice, how the college's collegial cooperation is affected, and whether leave requests require a reasonable expectation of recovery.

32222-X.s: This bill amends the 2009 departmental budget statute (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Defence, shifting appropriations across articles and totalling a small net change in expenditure. The bill itself contains no delegation of rule-making power and no explanatory memorandum excerpts were provided.

32245.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Margraten and Eijsden into a new municipality called Eijsden-Margraten, abolishing the two existing municipalities as of the date of reorganisation. It also sets transitional rules on council elections, tax and utility transfers, and updates references in the judicial district, police and safety region statutes.
32245.j: The memorandum justifies the merger by noting that the municipal councils unanimously adopted the reorganisation advice and that the provincial executive gave a positive opinion.
q: The reorganisation advice was unanimously adopted by the councils concerned on 24 March 2009 and received a positive opinion from the Limburg provincial executive.
Het herindelingsadvies is op 24 maart 2009 unaniem vastgesteld door de betrokken gemeenteraden en is voorzien van een positieve zienswijze van gedeputeerde staten van Limburg.

parties: Asks about population growth, expected consequences of the new municipality falling below 25,000 inhabitants, and the causes of failed cooperation.
What will be the consequences for the new municipality of the fact that on 1 January 2010 there will not be 25,000 or more inhabitants?
Wat zullen de consequenties voor de nieuw te vormen gemeente zijn van het feit dat er per 1 januari 2010 niet 25 000 of meer inwoners zullen zijn?
Welcomes unanimous support of both councils but questions the sustainability of the merger given the new municipality's relatively limited size and its relations with neighbours such as Maastricht.

However, they wonder how the government assesses the sustainability of the proposed merger, in light of the expected administrative capacity of the new municipality and the balance between the municipalities and their neighbours.

Wel leeft bij hen de vraag hoe de regering de duurzaamheid van de voorgestelde herindeling beoordeelt, in het licht van de te verwachten bestuurskracht van de nieuwe gemeente en het evenwicht tussen de gemeenten en haar buren.
Stresses that mergers should proceed only with popular support and asks about the level of consultation and turnout at information meetings.

Important criteria for assessing the need for a merger are, for these members, the administrative capacity of municipalities, internal cohesion and, first and foremost, popular support among the population.

Belangrijke criteria ter beoordeling van de noodzaak van herindeling zijn voor deze leden de bestuurskracht van gemeenten, de interne samenhang en, in de eerste plaats, het draagvlak onder de bevolking.
Welcomes the bill and raises no questions in the written preparation.
The bill gives these members no reason to ask questions in the written preparation of the parliamentary debate.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft deze leden geen aanleiding tot het stellen van vragen in de schriftelijke voorbereiding van de parlementaire behandeling.
Argues that such far-reaching changes must always be backed by a majority of residents and that binding referenda should be held, which was not adequately done here.
In the view of the PVV members, municipal mergers should always be subject to binding referenda.
In de visie van de leden van de PVV-fractie dienen er bij gemeentelijke herindelingen altijd bindende referenda te worden gehouden.
Notes local support as an important condition and asks why past cooperation failed yet a merger would succeed.
These members would like to know how the government became convinced that the municipal merger of the same municipalities will remove these obstacles.
Deze leden vernemen graag op welke wijze de regering ervan overtuigd is geraakt dat de gemeentelijke herindeling van dezelfde gemeenten deze belemmeringen wel weg zal nemen.

32254.s: The bill amends article 5.10(1) of the Crisis- and Recovery Act so that the act enters into force on a date set by royal decree and lapses on 1 January 2014, with articles 3.6 and 3.25 applying retroactively. It also provides that the amendment takes effect together with the Crisis- and Recovery Act itself if that act is enacted.
q: This act enters into force on a date to be set by royal decree and lapses with effect from 1 January 2014.
Deze wet treedt in werking op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip en vervalt met ingang van 1 januari 2014.
d: fixing the entry-into-force date of the Crisis- and Recovery Act by royal decree

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the Crisis- en herstelwet's entry into force should be set by royal decree, with at least two weeks between publication and entry into force, rather than fixed at 1 January 2010, because appellants and administrative bodies need time to adapt, particularly to the ban on pro forma appeals. The government's reply states it adopted this advice and will take the Council's recommendations into account when setting the decree.
concerns: The Council objects that a fixed entry-into-force date of 1 January 2010 risks being missed and that the proposed short transition would surprise appellants and administrative bodies, and advises entry into force by royal decree with at least two weeks' notice.

Because the law removes the possibility of pro forma appeals, the Council argues that a sudden entry into force would catch appellants unaware and fails to give a clear reference point for those affected.

32263.s: The bill amends the Student Finance Act 2000 and the Education Cost Contribution Act to suspend indexation of statutory norm amounts for 2011 and 2012, shorten the study-period and grant-timing rules, and adjust the supplementary grant. The memorandum excerpt shows it affects parents, pupils and adult learners, who must absorb price increases themselves.
32263.j: The memorandum justifies the non-indexation by stating that affected groups must themselves absorb any price developments.
q: For these categories of persons too, they must themselves absorb any price developments.
Ook voor deze categorieën van personen geldt dat zij de eventuele prijsontwikkelingen zelf dienen op te vangen.

parties: Accepts the crisis measures and the 3-of-6 clarification, asks whether other EU states have similar arrangements and whether the government would raise the matter in Brussels.
Since every ministry had to contribute to reducing the financing deficit, including the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, these members can agree to the proposed crisis measures.

Aangezien ieder ministerie een bijdrage aan de reductie van het financieringstekort moest leveren, dus ook het ministerie van Onderwijs Cultuur en Wetenschap, kunnen deze leden instemmen met de voorgestelde crisismaatregelen

Sees the freeze and performance-based supplementary grant as light interventions and supports the bill, while noting the risk to the portable student finance if the European Court rules against the government.
They realise this follows from the need for cuts within the crisis package and that cutting is not always easy.
Zij beseffen dat dit voortvloeit uit de noodzaak van bezuinigingen binnen het kader van het pakket crisismaatregelen en dat bezuinigen niet altijd makkelijk is.
Objects that students, pupils and parents bear the costs of the economic crisis and asks for the cost per recipient and the logic of the supplementary grant change.
After all, these people are not to blame for the economic crisis.
Deze mensen hebben immers geen schuld aan de economische crisis.
Accepts the 3-of-6 fix and the freeze as understandable but argues the savings should be invested in quality and a social loan system, and asks about the 2010 error.
However, these members find that cuts to transfer spending in higher education are undesirable if the proceeds are not invested in education quality.
Echter, deze leden vinden dat bezuinigingen op overdrachtsuitgaven in het hoger onderwijs onwenselijk zijn als de opbrengsten niet in de kwaliteit van het onderwijs worden geïnvesteerd.
Recognises the need for the crisis package and supports the aim of limiting spending without harming accessibility; asks no further questions at this stage.
These members acknowledge the need for the crisis package to curb the government deficit.
Deze leden onderkennen de noodzaak van het pakket van crisismaatregelen om het overheidstekort terug te dringen.

32290.s: The bill creates a cross-sectoral legal basis for reference levels (referentieniveaus) in Dutch language and arithmetic, to be fixed by general administrative order (AMvB). It amends the primary, special, secondary and vocational education acts to take these levels into account, require data collection on pupils' attainment, and make an arithmetic test mandatory in secondary and adult secondary exams.
32290.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to an AMvB by saying the reference-level descriptions are too detailed and extensive to be written into the statute itself, and that a cross-sectoral regulation guards content coherence.
q: the level descriptions are so detailed and extensive that they are not suitable for inclusion in the statute itself.
de niveaubeschrijvingen zijn dermate gedetailleerd en omvangrijk, dat zij zich er niet voor lenen in de wet zelf te worden opgenomen.
d: set coherent reference levels for Dutch language and arithmetic
Artikel 9, lid 9 (WPO, as amended by art. 3)
further rules on objective and valid pupil attainment data in primary education
Artikel 13, lid 11 (WEC, as amended by art. 4)
further rules on attainment data in special education
optional diagnostic tests in Dutch and arithmetic in secondary education, timing and rules
further rules on the mandatory arithmetic test in secondary exams
further rules on arithmetic test in state examinations
optional diagnostic tests in Dutch and arithmetic in vocational education, timing and rules
rules on vocational examinations and designation of parts for central examination
extent of partial central examination for designated parts
how Dutch and arithmetic sub-qualification results count toward vocational diploma
p: Reference levels are fixed by general administrative order rather than in the statute, with the bill stating a cross-sectoral coherence aim.

Vocational qualifications are amended by operation of law without ministerial revision of the existing qualification documents, and sub-qualification results may be set by ministerial regulation, deviating from the existing statutory rule on exam results.`

parties: Asks whether the wat/hoe boundary is respected and why diagnostic testing powers are placed in the law now, raising delegation and discretion questions.
For that reason these members want to know why this statutory provision is already included in the law now.
Om die reden willen deze leden weten waarom deze wettelijke voorziening reeds nu in de wet is opgenomen.
Supports standards but asks about consultation of subject associations, the zak/slaagregeling and whether the referentieniveaus are workable.
Were the LVVN, the Sectiebestuur Nederlands, NVORWO and NVvW also heard during the preparation of this bill?

Zijn de Landelijke Vereniging van Neerlandici (LVVN), het Sectiebestuur Nederlands van Levende Talen, de Nederlandse Vereniging tot Ontwikkeling van het Reken Wiskunde Onderwijs (NVORWO) en de Nederlandse Vereniging van Wiskundeleraren (NVvW) ook gehoord bij de totstandkoming van dit wetsvoorstel?
Refers to the Raad van State advice and asks why the law is anchored before pilots are evaluated.
Why does the government not choose to first evaluate the results of the pilots and introduction of the reference framework after several years, before legal anchoring, these members ask.

Waarom kiest de regering er niet voor om eerst de resultaten van de pilots en invoering van het referentiekader na een aantal jaren te evalueren, voordat sprake is van een wettelijke verankering, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks practical questions about effects on strong and weak schools and on pupils with dyslexia.
In what way are pupils who are already above the desired level not unnecessarily burdened or slowed down, the members ask.
Op welke manier worden leerlingen die al boven het gewenste niveau zitten niet onnodig belast of afgeremd, zo vragen de leden.
Warns that standardisation may entrench education, questions the legal basis in the existing framework and the regulatory mode chosen.
These members ask whether the government recognises this danger.
Deze leden vragen of de regering dit gevaar onderkent.

v.summary: The Council of State advised against a cross-sector framework law on Dutch language and arithmetic reference levels, arguing existing education laws already cover coherence and the reference levels lack binding force in primary and special education. The government's reply accepts most points, anchoring reference levels in the WPO and WEC, adding teacher competence requirements, and rejecting mandatory diagnostic tests while keeping a separate arithmetic exam.
concerns: Council questions the need for a separate cross-sector law since sector laws already require coherence; government keeps the cross-sector law but links reference levels to sector laws.
Reference levels lack binding status and enforcement in primary and special education; government adds a statutory link to the kerndoelen so inspection can supervise.
Council notes a numbering conflict with an existing article 28a WVO, which is renumbered.
Council asks for a justified choice of two reference levels and for safeguards against early selection; government adds explanation but keeps two levels.
Council advises mandatory diagnostic tests in VO and MBO and a uniform, end-of-year final test; government declines mandatory diagnostic tests and keeps the final test timing under pilot review.
Council advises clarifying how realistic it is that schools will teach basic arithmetic without dedicated lessons; government explains school approaches and support.
Council advises that the arithmetic test must take the reference level for the school type into account; government adopts this and clarifies the relationship with the mathematics exam.

32416.s: The bill amends the Ambtenarenwet and the Militaire Ambtenarenwet 1931 to allow the government, by general administrative measure, to specify cases where messages on civil servants' legal position may be sent exclusively electronically, departing from the default in the Algemene wet bestuursrecht. It also sets the bill's entry into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
32416.j: The memorandum gives no substantive justification beyond the stated aim of making electronic-only messaging possible.
q: the cases in which messages concerning the legal position of the civil servant, departing from article 2:14(1) of the General Administrative Law Act, need only be sent electronically, and the conditions observed

de gevallen waarin berichten inzake de rechtspositie van de ambtenaar in afwijking van artikel 2:14, eerste lid, van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht uitsluitend elektronisch verzonden behoeven te worden
d: I (Artikel 125, eerste lid, onderdeel n, Ambtenarenwet)
cases where messages on civil servant legal position may be sent only electronically, and conditions
cases where messages on military civil servant legal position may be sent only electronically, and conditions
p: Executive may, by decree, depart from the statutory default of written delivery for civil servants' legal-position messages, limiting the form of notice they receive, with conditions to be set out in the delegated rules.

parties: Asks how the privacy of civil servants is guaranteed when employment-related messages are sent electronically, since legal status is a personal matter.
How is the privacy of the civil servants concerned guaranteed when messages are sent electronically?
Hoe is bij het elektronisch verzenden van berichten de privacy van betrokken ambtenaren gewaarborgd?
Supports efficiency but questions why civil servants have less control over electronic information about their legal status than other employees who must give explicit consent.
Why do employees of the government have less control over the provision of information about their legal position in this way than other employees?
Waarom hebben de medewerkers bij de overheid op deze wijze minder zeggenschap over de informatieverstrekking omtrent hun rechtspositie dan andere medewerkers?
Supports the bill but asks for safeguards that electronic documents reach the recipient, and whether the list of decisions is exhaustive and who is responsible for correct email addresses.
There must be guarantees that the electronically sent document actually reaches the recipient.
Er moeten waarborgen zijn dat het elektronisch toegezonden document ook inderdaad bij de ontvanger belandt.
Supports the goal but worries about data security and misdirected privacy-sensitive data in the P-Direkt system, and asks for a sharper delineation of which decisions may be sent electronically.
They therefore ask whether the security of privacy-sensitive data can be sufficiently protected digitally.
Zij vragen daarom of de veiligheid van privacygevoelige gegevens digitaal voldoende beschermd kan worden.
Endorses the bill in principle and raises no questions.
They endorse the starting point of the bill and have no questions arising from it.
Zij onderschrijven het uit gangspunt van het wetsvoorstel en hebben naar aanleiding daarvan geen vragen.

32434.s: The bill amends the Dutch North Sea incident-combating act and the ship pollution prevention act to implement EU Directive 2009/17/EC on the maritime traffic monitoring and information system. It extends intervention powers to stranded, sunk or grounded ships, applies the wreck act in certain cases, allows the minister to request insurance certificates, and updates cargo and information obligations by reference to the directive.
32434.j: The memorandum justifies the expanded powers as needed to meet the directive's requirements for effective handling of incidents and notes that the minister acts independently and autonomously under the directive.
q: To this end, the bill extends the description of harmful consequences of an accident in article 3, and thereby the scope of articles 5 and 6 of the North Sea Incident Combating Act.

Hiertoe strekt het voorstel de omschrijving van schadelijke gevolgen van een ongeval in artikel 3 en daarmee ook de reikwijdte van de artikelen 5 en 6 van de Wet bestrijding ongevallen Noordzee, uit te breiden
d: Artikel II, onderdeel A (Wet voorkoming verontreiniging door schepen, art. 1 z)
designating the applicable EU monitoring and information directive
p: Artikel I, onderdeel A and C (Wet bestrijding ongevallen Noordzee, art. 3 and art. 6 lid 5)
Extends the scope of the minister's intervention powers to cover stranded, sunk or grounded ships and applies wreck-act provisions to measures taken in such cases.
Artikel I, onderdeel D (Wet bestrijding ongevallen Noordzee, art. 7 lid 3-5)
Allows the minister to request an insurance certificate from the operator of a ship directed to a Dutch port, while stating that absence of the certificate cannot be a ground to refuse assistance.
Artikel I, onderdeel E (Wet bestrijding ongevallen Noordzee, art. 18)
Makes the Wrakkenwet inapplicable in the Dutch territorial sea for accidents with the listed harmful effects, removing a procedural protection regime.

parties: Asks whether the distinction between harmful and non-harmful consequences is clear in practice, and what the consequences are of expanded ministerial powers in case of harmful consequences, especially for the division of competences with the water manager.
The definition of "harmful consequences" is decisive for the division of powers between the chair of the Regional North Sea Disaster Management Team and the water manager.
De definitie van «schadelijke gevolgen» is bepalend voor de verdeling van bevoegdheden tussen de voorzitter van het Regionaal Beheersteam Noordzeerampen en de waterbeheerder.

Asks about the consequences of shifting the power to act on stranded or sunk ships from the water manager to the minister, and asks for justification of an added clause making future directive amendments applicable before formal implementation.

The PvdA members ask the government what the consequences are of shifting the power to take measures for stranded, sunk or grounded ships with harmful consequences from the water manager to the Minister of Transport, Public Works and Water Management.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering wat de consequenties zijn van de verplaatsing van de bevoegd heid om maatregelen te nemen bij gevallen van gestrande, gezonken of aan de grond geraakte schepen met schadelijke gevolgen van de waterbeheerder naar de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat.
Asks whether authorities may refuse a ship entry to a Dutch port for lacking proof of maritime liability insurance, and whether the government will admit every ship in distress in the North Sea.
The SP members ask whether the absence of such proof could give Dutch authorities grounds to refuse the ship entry to a Dutch port.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of het ontbreken daarvan voor de Nederlandse autoriteiten aanleiding kan zijn het schip te weigeren in een Nederlandse haven.

32470.s: The bill writes into the Electricity Act 1998 and the Gas Act that ownership of grids and grid operator shares must remain, directly or indirectly, with the state, provinces, municipalities or other public bodies, thereby ending the earlier ministerial power to permit privatisation by decree. It also repeals the existing approval requirement and makes a transitional provision for existing grid ownership arrangements.
32470.j: The memorandum justifies the change by a Court of Appeal ruling that the privatisation ban in a ministerial decree could be changed by the government, so the ban is anchored directly in the law.
q: It was chosen to let the current consent right lapse and to include government ownership – and with it the privatisation ban – directly in the law.
Er is gekozen om het huidige instemmingsrecht te laten vervallen en de overheidseigendom – en daarmee het privatiseringsverbod – rechtstreeks in de wet op te nemen.
p: Removes the government's former power, via an algemene maatregel van bestuur, to permit partial privatisation of grid operator shares and ownership, moving the decision into statute.

parties: Agrees with the amendment given the need for repair, while noting it forecloses minority stakes for pension funds and others, and prioritises the absolute character of the prohibition.

The VVD members agree with this amendment given the current need for repair, although it makes it impossible for them to wish to give pension funds or other parties the possibility of becoming minority shareholders.

De leden van de VVD-fractie gaan akkoord met deze wijziging gezien de huidige noodzaak van reparatie, hoewel dit de wens van de deze leden onmogelijk maakt om bijvoorbeeld pensioenfondsen of andere partijen de mogelijkheid te geven om minderheidsaandeelhouder te worden.
Received the bill with interest and approval and has no further questions.
The PvdA members have taken note of the bill with interest and approval and have no further questions.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie hebben met belangstelling en instemming kennisgenomen van het wetvoorstel en hebben geen nadere vragen.
Asks the government to confirm that a statutory anchoring in formal law secures that network shares and ownership cannot leave government hands.

These members would like the government to confirm that anchoring the privatisation prohibition at the level of a formal statute provides certainty that the shares in the network operators, and the networks owned directly or indirectly by the Dutch government, cannot be taken outside government.

Deze leden vernemen van de regering graag de bevestiging dat het verankeren van het privatiseringsverbod op het niveau van een wet in formele zin de zekerheid brengt dat de aandelen in de netbeheerders, en het eigendom van de netten die direct of indirect in handen van de Nederlandse overheid zijn, niet buiten de overheid kunnen worden gebracht.

Supports keeping gas and electricity networks in public hands and prefers integrated public energy companies, asks whether Delta and Eneco can remain integrated until cassation, and asks whether the ruling's analysis extends to the Warmtewet where framework rules sit in lower regulation.
Does the government endorse this analysis and, if so, what conclusions does it draw from it?
Onderschrijft de regering deze analyse en zo ja, wat voor conclusies verbindt zij daaraan?
Asks for the status of the government's cassation appeal against the Court of Appeal's ruling on the group prohibition and when the cassation hearing will take place.

The GroenLinks members ask, in light of the government's intention to appeal in cassation against the Court of Appeal's ruling on the group prohibition, whether further information can be given on this.

De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks vragen naar aanleiding van het voornemen van de regering om in cassatie te gaan tegen de uitspraak van het Gerechtshof inzake het groepsverbod of daar reeds nadere informatie over kan worden gegeven.

Supports statutory anchoring of the privatisation ban for public-interest reasons but considers the 2006 forced unbundling premature, and questions whether forced unbundling is still necessary for security of supply given the court ruling that it conflicts with EU free movement of capital.

From the standpoint of the public interest they agree with statutorily anchoring the prohibition on privatising networks and network operators, but they do consider the forced unbundling chosen in 2006 an unwise and premature decision.

Zij stemmen vanuit het oogpunt van publiek belang in met het wettelijk verankeren van het verbod op privatisering van netten en netbeheerders, maar menen wel dat de in 2006 gekozen dwang tot splitsing een onverstandig en te vroegtijdig besluit was.

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill entrenching the privatisation ban in formal law for gas and electricity grid operators, but asks the government to add its own justification, since the ruling of the Gerechtshof did not invalidate the ban and the government had decided against minority privatisation. The minister's reply states that the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented and the bill is sent to the Tweede Kamer.
concerns: The justification of the bill needed an additional, independent reason for changing the statutory starting point, given the Gerechtshof ruling and the government's decision against minority privatisation.
Several redactional improvements to the title, preamble and explanatory memorandum were made.

32533.s: The bill sets out a statutory basis for a pension register under the Pensioenwet and the WVB, requiring pension providers and the Svb to supply data and a designated institution to develop and manage the register. It adds that the institution adopts a regulation subject to ministerial approval and makes AFM enforcement powers applicable to it.
32533.j: The memorandum justifies the designation and approval powers by the need to fulfil the statutory duty to operate a pension register by 2011 and to give the AFM the full set of enforcement instruments.
q: In order to exercise its supervisory task optimally, it is necessary that the AFM is given the full set of instruments.
Teneinde haar toezichtstaak optimaal te kunnen uitoefenen is het noodzakelijk dat de AFM de beschikking krijgt over het volledige pakket aan instrumenten.
d: designation of institution to develop and manage pension register
institution's regulation on register data, delivery, funding and security
designation of institution to develop and manage pension register
institution's regulation on register data, delivery, funding and security
p: Artikel I, A, lid 9 and Artikel II, A, lid 9
Applies the AFM's supervisory and enforcement instruments, including binding instructions and administrative fines, to the designated institution running the register.

parties: Asks how the register's functioning and budget are overseen, who approves its budget and grants discharge, and how accountability to the Chamber is ensured.
Can this be provided for, and with what frequency?
Kan hierin worden voorzien en met welke periodiciteit?
Asks which body checks participation of pension providers and what sanctions can enforce it, and asks for a warning about uncertainties in the register.
Which body checks participation and what sanction options exist to enforce participation if it is not mandatory?
Welke instantie controleert deelname en welke sanctiemogelijkheden zijn er om deelname af te dwingen indien deze niet verplicht is?
Supports the bill in principle but questions whether uncertainties are communicated, and asks about AFM sanction powers and the adequacy of its enforcement tools.
What sanction powers does the AFM have if pension providers supply incorrect information?
Over welke sanctiemogelijkheden beschikt de AFM indien de pensioenuitvoerders onjuiste informatie aanleveren
Takes the Raad van State's critical remarks seriously, asks about incorrect information and data security oversight, and asks how AFM fines would be imposed.
On this, among other things, they have questions, which are included in this report.
Hierover hebben zij, naast andere, vragen, die in dit verslag zijn opgenomen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill extending the statutory basis of the Dutch pension register to include AOW state pension data, raising concerns about the Stichting Pensioenregister's legal status, delegation to an AMvB, and supervision, and recommending a warning on pension uncertainties. The government's reply (nader rapport) largely accepted the remarks on drafting, supervision and the Stichting's status, but rejected anchoring the Stichting in law and partly adjusted the delegation and definition points.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that the AMvB delegation in the sixth paragraph gives regulatory power to the Stichting in effect, and asked that the rules be set in the AMvB itself, which the government adopted by moving the rules to a Stichting regulation with binding standards.

The Afdeling asked for clarity on the Stichting's powers, including exclusion of pension funds and sanctions, and whether it is a zelfstandig bestuursorgaan; the government clarified the Stichting is a private-law beheersstichting.
The Afdeling advised anchoring the Stichting Pensioenregister explicitly in the law instead of an designated institution; the government declined, citing flexibility for a management foundation.
The Afdeling advised clarifying supervision of the SVB's data supply relative to the IWI and AFM; the government added explanation in the memorie van toelichting.
The Afdeling advised a warning in the register about uncertainties in future pension entitlements; the government said such communication is the pension providers' responsibility, not the register's.
The Afdeling made several drafting remarks on the title, considerans, terminology and the inwerkingtreding article, which the government largely adopted.

32551.s: The bill adds a new standalone judicial measure to the Dutch Criminal Code allowing courts to impose area bans, contact bans or reporting obligations for up to two years, to protect society or prevent offences. It sets substitute detention for non-compliance, allows immediate enforceability pending appeal, lets the public prosecutor order arrest and the investigating judge decide on enforcement, and provides compensation for unlawful deprivation of liberty.
32551.j: The memorandum justifies the new measure by the need to prevent repeat offences and protect residents, victims and witnesses, and by gaps in existing conditional sentencing that leave some cases without an effective sanction.
q: To protect society or prevent criminal offences, a measure restricting liberty may be imposed in the court's judgment.
Ter beveiliging van de maatschappij of ter voorkoming van strafbare feiten kan een maatregel strekkende tot beperking van de vrijheid worden opgelegd bij de rechterlijke uitspraak
p: Courts may order the measure immediately enforceable pending appeal, so appeal no longer suspends it, subject to a requirement of serious risk of reoffending and appellate lifting.
The public prosecutor may order arrest for non-compliance and seek enforcement before the investigating judge, with a right of appeal to the sentencing court.

parties: Asks what happens if the measure is overturned on appeal, the risk of damages claims, and whether the area ban merely displaces nuisance elsewhere.
What is the position of the person concerned if on appeal it turns out the measure cannot stand?
Wat is de positie van de betrokkene als in hoger beroep blijkt dat de maatregel geen stand kan houden?
Finds the absence of suspensive effect of appeal and of a damages right for wrongly imposed measures unfair, and questions the subjective standard of victim fear.
It seems to the PvdA members that both the absence of suspensive effect of appeal and the absence of a damages right is unfair to the person wrongly subjected to a measure.
Het komt de leden van de PvdA-fractie voor dat zowel het ontbreken van een schorsende werking van het hoger beroep als ook het ontbreken van een recht op schadevergoeding onbillijk is.
Supports the bill and asks only whether police capacity suffices to enforce the measures.
The PVV members have taken note of the bill with approval.
De leden van de PVV-fractie hebben met instemming kennisgenomen van bovengenoemd wetsvoorstel.
Supports the approach but questions why the judge rather than the public prosecutor should impose and supervise the measure, arguing this burdens the judiciary.

Since the public prosecutor is also charged with executing and supervising compliance with the proposed measures under article 38x Sr, these members find it more logical that the judge stays out of it too.

Nu het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) ook bij de voorgestelde maatregelen wordt belast met de uitvoering en het toezicht op naleving van de maatregel in het voorgestelde artikel 38x Sr, lijkt het deze leden logischer dat de rechter ook hier buiten blijft.

Supports victim protection but insists on minimal restriction of fundamental rights, asks how precise prohibitions must be and how convicted persons can challenge overly broad measures; also asks for an evaluation clause.
They consider it very important that the aim is the smallest possible restriction of the suspect's fundamental rights.
Zij benadrukken het van groot belang te vinden dat gestreefd wordt naar een zo gering mogelijke beperking van de grondrechten van de verdachte.

Doubts proportionality and effectiveness, questions the evidence base (citing the abolition of the British ASBO), warns against eroding the ultimum remedium principle and against restricting judges' sentencing freedom.
In doing so, the members are wary of the erosion of the ultimum remedium character of criminal law.
Daarbij zijn de aan het woord zijnde leden op hun hoede voor de uitholling van het ultimum remedium karakter van het strafrecht.
Asks whether the measure achieves its aim or merely displaces the problem, how it relates to existing sanctions, and how immediate execution fits the presumption of innocence.
How do these provisions relate to the appeal the convicted person can lodge against the imposed measure and to the principle that the suspect is presumed innocent until proven otherwise?

Hoe verhouden deze bepalingen zich tot het beroep dat de veroordeelde kan indienen tegen de opgelegde vrijheidsbeperkende maatregel en het principe dat de verdachte onschuldig is tot het tegendeel bewezen is?

v.summary: The Council of State advises on a bill introducing a judicial area or contact ban and reporting duty as a criminal measure, finding it does not clearly fit the sanctions system, raising concerns about overlap with existing measures, unclear conditions for imposition, missing compensation rules, and inconsistency with related bills. The government's reply largely accepts the advice on conditions, compensation and cumulative sanctions, while maintaining its choice of wording and its stance on the measure's distinct character.
concerns: The Council found it not unambiguously clear that conviction is a precondition for imposing the measure, and the government clarified this in article 38v in line with the advice.

The Council asked for a broader view of how the new measure relates to existing civil, administrative and criminal interventions and the need for it; the government added explanation but kept the measure as a distinct ordermeasure.

The Council questioned whether a criminal measure with a punitive character fits, given it may be harsher than a special condition for lighter offences, and called for reflection on the distinction between penalties and measures; the government added a justification in the explanatory memorandum.
The Council advised that the measure be combinable with other penalties and measures, and the bill was amended to allow this.

The Council advised including in the bill a right to damages for wrongly imposed restrictions; the government did not do so but added a description of civil-law compensation routes to the explanatory memorandum.

The Council advised aligning the wording and maximum duration with the related bill on conditional sentences and excluding combinations with special conditions; the government kept its wording referring to article 509hh Sv and declined the explicit statutory exclusion.

32614.s: The bill creates statutory exceptions to the positive fictitious decision (lex silencio positivo) of the General Administrative Law Act, under the Services Directive, for a range of permit, exemption and registration procedures across several ministries. It also adds exemption clauses in various sector laws and transitional provisions linked to other pending bills.
32614.j: The memorandum justifies the exceptions by overriding public interests such as environmental protection, public safety, public health, animal welfare and the integrity of professions, arguing that after-the-fact controls are insufficient.
q: Controls after the fact are insufficient to limit these risks.
Controles achteraf zijn onvoldoende om deze risico's te beperken.
d: temporary exceptions to lex silencio positivo via general administrative measure
p: Artikel I, Artikel II, Artikel III-XX (cumulative)

Removes the automatic-approval safeguard for many permit and exemption applications across numerous statutes, leaving applicants without a timely deemed-granted outcome and requiring them to seek remedies such as a penalty payment for late decisions instead.

32641.s: The bill amends the Book Price Act to allow discounts on single copies sold to the Royal Library and to employees, narrows the scope of the fixed price for books, removes fixed prices for foreign-imported music publications, and extends the Act to foreign online sellers targeting Dutch consumers. It also makes several technical corrections and tightens conditions for clearance sales.
32641.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the evaluation of the Act, requests from the book trade, and the Commissariaat voor de Media's experience as supervisor, and notes that EU case law does not allow invoking EU rules to evade national law.
q: In the judge's view, a foreign (internet) seller must be treated as a Dutch seller if the sales activities take place mainly in the Netherlands.
Naar het oordeel van de rechter moet een buitenlandse (internet-) verkoper worden beschouwd als een Nederlandse verkoper als de verkoopactiviteiten hoofdzakelijk in Nederland plaatsvinden.

parties: Argues the fixed book price is an unnecessary market intervention and questions the government's reading of the evaluation's conclusions.
Partly on the basis of the evaluation, the members maintain their position that the Fixed Book Price Act is a superfluous instrument.
De leden blijven mede op basis van de evaluatie bij hun standpunt dat de Wet op de vaste boekenprijs een overbodig instrument is.
Welcomes the proposed amendments as a sound improvement following the evaluation showing the law functions well.
These members are pleased with the finding that the evaluation research shows the law functions well.
Deze leden zijn verheugd over de constatering dat op grond van de onderzoeksresultaten in de evaluatie blijkt dat de wet goed functioneert.

Asks whether the fixed price remains tenable in a globalising digital market, asks about the timing of a new evaluation, and doubts enforceability of the clearance-sale exception and of rules on foreign websites.
The members find it difficult to enforce fixed book prices in the case of a clearance sale and via websites operating from both inside and outside the Netherlands.
Het handhaven van vaste boekenprijzen achten de leden moeilijk in het geval van een opheffingsuitverkoop 12 en via websites, opererend vanuit zowel binnen- als buiten Nederland.
Supports the fixed price for preserving a plural market and small shops, and asks about its effects on prices and whether the same arguments apply to imported sheet music.
The members ask whether the arguments for introducing a fixed price do not also apply to these sheet music publications.
De leden vragen of de argumenten van de invoering van een vaste prijs niet ook gelden voor deze uitgaven van bladmuziek.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised the bill amending the Book Price Act (Wet op de vaste boekenprijs) to proceed, but asked the government to explain in the explanatory memorandum how contact with the European Commission took place, given EU-law aspects of the proposed article 6(4). The government's reply states that the Commission did not consider a formal opinion necessary because the anti-circumvention provision mirrors an existing one and follows settled Court of Justice case law.
concerns: The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to elaborate on how contact with the European Commission took place regarding the EU-law aspects of article 6(4), and the government explains the Commission did not deem a formal opinion necessary.

32710-V.s: This bill amends the 2010 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the budget statement for its baten-lastendienst (CBI agency), with the adjusted amounts shown in the attached tables in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V)
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V)

32713.s: The bill connects non-funded education (artikel 56 WVO schools, WEB beroepsopleidingen and educatie courses) to the personal student number, the basic education register (bron) and the relative absence reporting register, so that these providers must supply student data and fall under the regional reporting and coordination function. It also adds information duties and lets the minister withdraw designations or recognitions for non-compliance.
32713.j: The memorandum justifies the data duties and minister's powers by the need to combat truancy and early school leaving, to address gaps between school and central exam grades, and to reduce administrative burden.
q: The bill aims first of all to connect this non-publicly funded education to the system of the personal number and the basic education register (bron).

Het wetsvoorstel strekt er in de eerste plaats toe dat dit niet uit 's Rijks kas bekostigd onderwijs wordt aangesloten op de systematiek van het persoonsgebonden nummer en het basisregister onderwijs (bron).
d: designation of schools or school groups, with conditions
Artikel II, onderdeel A (art. 1.4.1 WEB, zevende lid)
specification of data to be supplied and rules on timing and manner of supply for beroepsopleidingen
Artikel II, onderdeel B (art. 1.4a.1 WEB, negende lid)
specification of data and rules on timing and manner of supply for educatie opleidingen
Artikel IV, onderdeel A (art. 58 WVO, achtste lid)
specification of data and rules on timing and manner of supply for artikel 56 schools
p: Artikel II, onderdelen C en D (art. 6.2.2 and 6a.1.2 WEB)
The minister may withdraw recognition of non-funded vocational and educatie programmes when information duties are not met, extending existing withdrawal powers.
The minister may withdraw designation of an artikel 56 school for failure to meet the newly added information duties.

parties: Asks whether the government's target of 25,000 early school leavers by 2016 will be lowered, and points to the Dutch data-protection regulator's warning that the personal number may not lawfully be processed for people over 23 and outside compulsory schooling.
The bill provides no legal basis for processing the personal number of education participants who do not belong to that category, according to the CBP.
Het wetsvoorstel biedt geen grondslag voor de verwerking van het persoonsgebonden nummer van onderwijsdeelnemers, die niet tot die categorie behoren, aldus het CBP.

Supports the bill's registration of non-funded education and asks whether the minister can take measures against non-funded schools that systematically inflate school-exam marks, excluding the funding sanction.

Can the minister then, with the exception of the funding sanction, take the same measures available to her if she finds that a non-funded school systematically compensates poor central exam results with overly lenient school exams?

Kan de minister dan – uiteraard met uitzondering van de bekostigingssanctie – dezelfde maatregelen treffen als haar ter beschikking staan, mocht zij constateren dat een niet-bekostigde school systematisch beroerde resultaten voor de centrale examens compenseert door al te soepel beoordeelde toetsen van de schoolexamens?
Has read the explanatory memorandum and sees no reason to ask questions about the bill.
They see no reason to ask questions about the bill.
Zij zien geen aanleiding tot het stellen van vragen over het wetsvoorstel.

Asks why absolute truancy cannot yet be dropped from reporting for technical reasons, how the concept of too little education is quantified, and whether the bill will be enough to bring central exam results within acceptable margins.
What technical problems underlie this, these members ask, and to what extent does that hinder the aim of this law?
Welke technische problemen liggen hieraan ten grondslag, zo vragen deze leden en in hoeverre belemmert dat de doelstelling van deze wet?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill extending the persoonsgebonden nummer and basisregister onderwijs to non-funded education, but raises objections on the difference in state authority over non-funded education, the purpose and justification for processing data of students over 23 or outside truancy/rmc rules, and the missing VNG consultation under the Code Interbestuurlijke Verhoudingen. The minister's reply (nader rapport) addresses these by clarifying the legal and substantive parallels with funded education, adding justification in the explanatory memorandum, and explaining that the VNG did not consider a formal advice necessary.
concerns: The Council questions whether processing personal data of students over 23 or outside Lpw/rmc scope is necessary for the stated goals and asks for justification, which the minister addressed by amending the explanatory memorandum.

The Council says the reach of state authority over non-funded education is narrower than over funded education and asks the explanatory memorandum to explain this difference, which the minister addressed by clarifying the legal parallels.
The Council advised formal consultation of the VNG under the Code Interbestuurlijke Verhoudingen, which the VNG declined as not controversial, with ambtelijke afstemming considered sufficient.
The Council made a redactional remark on the explanatory memorandum, which the minister incorporated.

32722.s: The bill amends the Postal Act 2009 to make the delegation power in article 8 unconditional, allowing an AMvB to regulate the legal relationship between postal carriers and postal delivery workers, and extends the sunset of that power from 1 April 2013 to 1 January 2017 or earlier by royal decree. It replaces the conditional article 8 and its temporary decree, so that the executive can set working-condition rules for postal delivery workers.
32722.j: The memorandum justifies the unconditional delegation by giving social partners more time to improve working conditions and by noting that the earlier conditions and preliminary-relief challenges raised doubts about the basis of the temporary decree.
q: Therefore, for article 8 of the Postal Act 2009 this bill proposes a different text, providing an unconditional basis to set by general administrative order rules on the nature of the legal relationship between a postal carrier and postal delivery workers.

Derhalve wordt voor artikel 8 Postwet 2009 met dit wetsvoorstel een andere tekst voorgesteld, waarmee wordt voorzien in een ongeclausuleerde grondslag om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur regels te stellen over de aard van de rechtsverhouding tussen een postvervoerbedrijf en postbezorgers.
d: legal relationship between postal carriers and postal delivery workers
early termination of article 8 power by royal decree
p: The conditional article 8 is replaced by an unconditional delegation allowing an AMvB to set rules on the legal relationship between postal carriers and delivery workers, removing the earlier stringent preconditions.
The sunset date is extended to 1 January 2017, with an earlier termination by royal decree subject to a four-week voorhang before both chambers.

parties: The bill omits the employment-relationship requirement the House requested, and the scope limitation in article 8 lacks stated criteria; the party proposes a conditional clause keeping article 8 in force after 2017.
The PvdA members note that this amendment of the Postwet 2009 does not yet contain an employment-relationship requirement, although the House requested one through the adopted Gesthuizen motion.

Er moet door de leden van de PvdA-fractie worden opgemerkt dat deze mutatie van de Postwet 2009 nog geen eis van dienstbetrekking bevat, terwijl de Kamer daar wel om heeft verzocht middels de aangenomen motie van het lid Gesthuizen c.s.
The CDA asks the government to justify the cumulative definition of postal deliverer and to clarify EU context and the risk of technical functional separation evading rules.
Does the government share the CDA members' view that it cannot be intended that postal companies escape the agreements and rules of the CAO or AMvB through a technical separation of functions?

Is de regering met de leden van de CDA-fractie van mening dat het niet de bedoeling kan zijn dat postvervoersbedrijven door een technische functiescheiding niet gebonden zouden zijn aan de afspraken en regels van respectievelijk de collectieve arbeidsovereenkomst (CAO) of AMvB?
The SP regrets the option to limit the AMvB's scope via a turnover threshold, fears circumvention through subcontracting, and questions the cumulative definition and the 2017 sunset.
Does the government acknowledge that this approach carries the risk that companies could circumvent the law through subcontracting?
Erkent de regering dat deze benadering het risico in zich heeft dat met onderaanneming de wet door bedrijven kan worden omzeild?
The D66 asks why the interpretation of the current article 8 basis differs and how likely postal companies are to successfully invoke the invalidity of the Tijdelijk besluit postbezorgers 2011.

How does the government assess the possibility that postal companies successfully invoke the invalidity of the Tijdelijk besluit postbezorgers 2011 during the period before article 8 of the Postwet 2009 is amended?

Hoe schat de regering de mogelijkheid in dat postbedrijven zich met succes beroepen op het niet rechtsgeldig zijn van het Tijdelijke besluit postbezorgers 2011, in de periode dat artikel 8 van de Postwet 2009 nog niet is gewijzigd?

GroenLinks worries that the cumulative definition may exclude current deliverers, misses the employment-relationship requirement, and fears that the 2017 horizon removes the AMvB power and could lead to a return to undesirable conditions.
Can the government reconsider the employment-relationship requirement and the 1 January 2017 horizon together, to prevent a return to the current undesirable situation after 1 January 2017?

Kan de regering de eis van dienstbetrekking en de horizon van 1 januari 2017 nogmaals in samenhang bezien, om te voorkomen dat na 1 januari 2017 weer een terugkeer plaatsvindt richting de huidige onwenselijke situatie?

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the bill amending articles 8 and 89 of the Postal Act 2009, allowing an AMvB to require postal carriers to conclude employment contracts with postal workers, needed reconsideration on purpose, necessity, delegation scope, sunset clause, the definition of postal worker, and supervision by OPTA. The government's reply accepted most points, adding justification, narrowing the delegation, setting a 1 January 2017 sunset date, defining postbezorger, and noting OPTA–Arbeidsinspectie cooperation, while rejecting the objection to article II.
concerns: The Council found no evidence that wages/working conditions in the postal sector fell short or why government intervention was needed; the government added justification of purpose and necessity.
The delegated power in article 8 was too open-ended and was narrowed to the nature of the legal relationship.
The temporary measure could become permanent; a concrete sunset date (1 January 2017) was added to article 89.
The term 'postverspreider' is not standard and was too vague; it was replaced by 'postbezorger' with a statutory definition.
Supervision of employment conditions by OPTA is not a regular task; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on OPTA's role and cooperation with the Arbeidsinspectie.
Article II was considered without function because the draft decree lacked a sufficient legal basis; the government disagreed and kept it.

32812.s: The bill reforms special and secondary special education by adding three exit profiles (further education, labour-market, day-care), new individual development plans, leaving certificates, and related changes to the WEC, WVO, WEB, Leerplichtwet and WRNTR. It shifts many details to general administrative orders (AMvB) and ministerial regulations, with the aim of improving quality and labour-market outcomes for pupils.
32812.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations by saying that schools need room for professional, tailored education and that the specifics of special education require rules differing from regular secondary education.
q: For special secondary education there is the possibility to set rules deviating from regular lower secondary regulations (general administrative orders and ministerial regulations) when the distinctive character of the education makes this necessary.

Voor het vso is er de mogelijkheid afwijkende regels ten opzichte van reguliere lagere vo-regelgeving (algemene maatregelen van bestuur en ministeriële regelingen) vast te stellen wanneer het eigen karakter van het onderwijs dit noodzakelijk maakt.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 14a, tweede lid WEC)
deviating core objectives and examination programmes for secondary special education
Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 14b, derde lid WEC)
which pupils may take adult secondary education exams and under what conditions
Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 14c, tweede en vijfde lid WEC)
core objectives for labour-market exit profile
Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 14c, negende lid WEC)
which pupils may deviate from programme elements in labour-market profile
further rules on transition document for labour-market profile
Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 14f, tweede en vijfde lid WEC)
core objectives for day-care exit profile
Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 14f, achtste lid WEC)
which pupils may deviate from programme elements in day-care profile
further rules on transition document for day-care profile
Artikel I, onderdeel H / Artikel I, onderdeel I (artikel 17 WEC)
rules on internships in secondary special education
Artikel I, onderdeel R (artikel 41a, vijfde lid WEC)
rules on content of the individual development plan
Artikel I, onderdeel AA / Artikel I, onderdeel BB (artikel 162f, derde lid onder b, zevende lid WEC)
designating vocational subjects open to zij-instromers with practitioner qualifications
Artikel II, onderdeel A (artikel 59a, vierde lid WVO)
deviating rules for designated secondary special schools
information duties on exam results for secondary special education
Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 26 WEC, as amended by Stb. 2011 bill)
holiday and non-teaching day rules for labour-market and day-care profiles
p: Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 14a, tweede lid WEC)
Allows general administrative orders to set rules departing from the WVO for secondary special education, moving curriculum detail away from statute.
Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 14c, negende lid WEC)
Lets the school board deviate from programme requirements for eligible pupils under criteria set by general administrative order.
Designation of vocational subjects open to zij-instromers is delegated to a general administrative order, subject to a parliamentary laying procedure with a four-week window.
Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 14c, zevende lid onder a WEC, as amended)
Removes the requirement for a separate programme component specification, reducing formal checks on school curriculum content.

parties: Asks how the ministry assesses who qualifies for the dagbesteding profile and how the government reconciles its views with practitioners' preference for the handelingsplan.
Who assesses this and how is it assessed, ask these members.
Wie beoordeelt dit en hoe wordt dit beoordeeld, zo vragen deze leden.
Worries that parents lose consent rights over the development perspective and that quality frameworks are set after rather than before the law.
The members are concerned about the position of parents in this bill.
De leden maken zich zorgen over de positie van ouders in dit wetsvoorstel.
Welcomes the exit profiles but argues parents' instemmingsrecht over the handelingsplan should be preserved.
The members are of the view that the role of parents and this right must be continued.
De leden zijn van mening dat de rol van de ouders en dit recht moet worden voortgezet.
Asks why parents would only be consulted rather than consenting, and whether the development perspective is testable.
Does this bill not place primacy with the school because parents get less influence over the development perspective than before?
Legt dit wetsvoorstel niet het primaat bij de school omdat ouders minder invloed op het ontwikkelingsperspectief krijgen dan voorheen?
Doubts quality improves given budget cuts, the short implementation period, and the risk that schools set goals too low out of fear of inspection.
The members have concerns about the tight implementation period for this bill.
De leden hebben zorgen over de krappe invoeringstijd voor het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.
Asks about the lack of scientific basis for mandating exit perspectives and about perverse incentives for schools to set exit levels too low.
Why does the cabinet want to make this exit perspective legally mandatory now rather than waiting until a positive relationship has been scientifically demonstrated?
