Waarom wil het kabinet dit uitstroomperspectief nu al wettelijk verplichten en niet eerst wachten tot een positieve relatie wetenschappelijk is aangetoond?
Asks how students aged 16 and over in the dagbesteding and labour profiles keep access to a suitable educational place and funding.
The said members warn of the risk that vso students aged 16 and over fall through the cracks because they are not subject to the qualification obligation.
Genoemde leden waarschuwen voor het risico dat vso-leerlingen van 16 jaar en ouder buiten de boot vallen, omdat zij niet kwalificatieplichtig zijn.
Asks why the government wants a legal basis to set further requirements on the development perspective later and how it reduces accountability burdens.
The members ask why the government wants to include a legal basis to be able to set further requirements on the development perspective in the future.
De leden vragen waarom de regering een grondslag wil opnemen om op termijn nadere eisen aan het ontwikkelingsperspectief te kunnen stellen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill improving quality in special and secondary special education, mainly questioning whether mandatory development perspectives, pupil tracking systems and the three exit profiles will actually raise quality, and whether the labour-market and day-care profiles are feasible. The government's reply largely accepts the concerns, adds clarifications and explanations, but does not adopt the request to codify characteristic elements of the development perspective in law.
concerns: The Council doubts that the mandatory development perspective, pupil tracking and exit profiles adequately raise quality and asks for the necessity of these measures to be convincingly motivated; the government explains the added value but keeps the measures.

The Council asks the explanatory memorandum to clarify the difference between the handelingsplan and the ontwikkelingsperspectief, including the differing parental consultation requirements; the memorandum was supplemented.
The Council's suggested renumbering of subsections in article 22 WEC and alignment of article VII and VIII are only partly addressed or left as technical issues.

The Council questions whether enough internships and labour-market guidance will be available for the labour-market exit profile and whether the school guide reference to labour-market outcomes is appropriate; the government adds explanation but relies on existing structures.
The Council questions the rationale and feasibility of the day-care exit profile, which largely mirrors the labour-market profile; the government explains differing levels and adjusts the memorandum.

The Council asks that characteristic elements of the development perspective be written into the law; the government declines, preferring flexible regulation via general administrative order if needed.

32821.s: The bill amends the Wet ruimtelijke ordening so that national and provincial spatial rules can be elaborated by provincial regulation (provincial medebewind) and so that exemptions from such general rules can be granted by provincial authorities or the minister on request of municipalities or provinces. It also extends related procedure, appeal routing and cross-references in the Wabo and Crisis- en herstelwet.
32821.j: The memorandum justifies provincial medebewind and exemptions by the need for tailored, regionally adapted implementation of national spatial policy and to avoid rigid rules causing many case-by-case deviations.
q: Detailed restrictions in general rules, combined with a broad possibility to allow deviations, could lead to numerous further weighing moments for concrete cases.

Gedetailleerde beperkingen in algemene regels, gecombineerd met een ruime mogelijkheid om een afwijking daarvan toe te staan, zouden dan immers kunnen leiden tot talrijke nadere afwegingsmomenten voor concrete gevallen
d: provincial regulation elaborating national and provincial spatial rules, including exemption powers
provincial exemption from provincial spatial rules on municipal request
national general administrative order setting rules on content of zoning plans and permits, with provincial regulation possible
minister may grant exemptions from national spatial rules on request of municipality or province
p: Authorities gain discretion to exempt projects from general spatial rules, limited to cases where implementation is disproportionately hindered and conditions may be attached.
National rules may be set by general administrative order and the minister may decide on exemptions, extending central steering over provincial and municipal planning.

parties: Asks for practical examples and frequency of exemption cases, the meaning of disproportionality, and how the multi-level exemption procedure fits the two-tier principle.
Can the government give an indication of the number of applications expected, for example annually, and the number of exemptions that will be granted?
Kan de regering een indicatie geven van het aantal aanvragen dat – bijvoorbeeld jaarlijks – wordt verwacht en het aantal ontheffingen dat zal worden verleend?

Agrees with the bill's aim but worries about its exact scope; asks whether provinces can be compelled to perform tasks and what safeguards exist, and proposes distinguishing hard national rules from softer guidelines.
Can provinces be forced under this amendment to carry out certain tasks? If not, what safeguards are there?
Kunnen provincies op basis van deze wetswijziging worden gedwongen om bepaalde taken uit te voeren? Zo nee, welke waarborgen zijn daarvoor?
Supports the aim of creating a legal basis for a provincial role in implementing national spatial policy.
These members endorse the aim of the amendments, namely creating a legal basis for a role for provinces in implementing national spatial policy.
Deze leden onderschrijven het doel van de wijzigingen, namelijk een wettelijke grondslag creëren voor een rol van provincies bij de uitvoering van het nationaal ruimtelijk beleid.

Follows the Council of State in arguing the Wet ruimtelijke ordening provides no adequate basis and the instrument does not fit its governance philosophy; asks the government for a principled justification and reconciliation with the coalition agreement's two-tier limit.

The Council of State clarified in its advice on this general administrative measure that the Wet ruimtelijke ordening 'does not provide an adequate basis' for achieving the government's objective through a general administrative measure.

De Raad van State heeft vervolgens in het advies bij deze algemene maatregel van bestuur duidelijk gemaakt, dat de Wet ruimtelijke ordening «geen toereikende grondslag biedt» voor realisering van de doelstelling van de regering via een algemene maatregel van bestuur.

Asks whether the governance philosophy is changing, whether resources accompany delegated tasks, why municipalities are not included, and suspects the exemption clause recreates an escape route removed in the reform.
The SP members strongly get the impression that this proposal again creates an escape clause for spatial projects that was precisely removed during the revision of the Wet Ruimtelijke Ordening.

De leden van de SP-fractie krijgen sterk de indruk dat er met dit voorstel weer een ontsnappingsclausule wordt gecreëerd voor ruimtelijke projecten, die er juist bij de herziening van de Wet Ruimtelijke Ordening uit is gehaald.

Wants the specific rules for medebewind set out in the general administrative measure, submitted to both chambers via a pre-consultation procedure, and asks about consequences for citizen participation and appeal rights in exemption cases.

These members also ask whether this general administrative measure can be submitted to both chambers of the States General in a pre-consultation procedure, so that both chambers have insight into the matters to be regulated by medebewind.

Ook vragen deze leden of deze algemene maatregel van bestuur in een voorhangprocedure aan beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal kan worden voorgelegd, zodat beide Kamers zicht hebben op de bij medebewind te regelen zaken.
Received the bill with interest; no specific points recorded in the report.
The ChristenUnie members have taken note of the bill with interest.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het genoemde wetsvoorstel.
The PVV has no further remarks or questions for this nader verslag.
The PVV members have taken note of the memorandum in response to the report and currently have no need to make remarks or ask questions for this nader verslag.

De leden van de PVV-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van de genoemde nota naar aanleiding van het verslag en hebben thans geen behoefte aan het maken van opmerkingen en het stellen van vragen ten behoeve van dit nader verslag.

The CDA agrees with the Raad van State that provincial medebewind does not fit the steering philosophy of the Wet ruimtelijke ordening and finds the government's reply procedural rather than substantive; it also questions when three government layers are truly necessary.
The CDA members, as indicated earlier, agree with the Raad van State that the way provincial medebewind is designed is not in line with the steering philosophy of the Wet ruimtelijke ordening.

De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn – zoals eerder aangegeven – met de Raad van State van mening dat de manier waarop het provinciaal medebewind is vormgegeven niet in overeenstemming is met de sturingsfilosofie van de Wet ruimtelijke ordening.

The SP objects that three overwegende bezwaren of the Raad van State were not addressed in amendments, asks the government to amend the bill on provincial medebewind, legal bindingness of national rules, and exemption powers, and asks for integrated advice from the Raad van State.
The SP members request the government not only to respond to the remarks made by the Raad van State, but also to amend the bill on this point in consultation with the Raad van State.

De leden van de SP-fractie verzoeken de regering niet alleen om te reageren op de door de Raad van State gemaakte opmerkingen, maar ook om het wetsvoorstel op dit punt in overleg met de Raad van State te wijzigen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised against the proposed provincial medebewind and the general-rule derogation powers in the Wet ruimtelijke ordening, finding them inconsistent with the Wro's governance philosophy and principles of selectivity and concreteness. The government's nader rapport largely accepts the objections, reformulating the derogation mechanism as an ontheffing, deleting the reporting duty and the beheersverordening derogation, and narrowing voorschriften, while maintaining provincial medebewind with added justification.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that provincial medebewind conflicts with the Wro's sturingsfilosofie of exclusive responsibility per government layer; the government disagreed but added justification and selectivity in the draft Barro.

The Afdeling found the government's indirect-rule approach fails the selectivity criterion; the government reduced the number of indirect rules to a minimum and kept medebewind only for Ecologische Hoofdstructuur and Erfgoederen.

The Afdeling said indirect rules needing further provincial elaboration are not concrete enough for legal certainty; the government argued specific provisions addressed to provinces remain sufficiently concrete.

The Afdeling objected that the ontheffing ground for derogation was too broad and resembled a hardheidsclausule; the government changed the terminology and narrowed the rationale to unforeseeable circumstances.
The Afdeling advised dropping the reporting duty (meldingsplicht) for provincial derogation powers because it conflicts with one-time data provision and proportionality; the government deleted it.
The Afdeling advised against derogation from general rules for beheersverordeningen because it conflicts with their character and creates legal uncertainty; the government removed this option.
The Afdeling advised replacing the term toestemming with verklaring van geen bezwaar or ontheffing; the government adopted ontheffing.
The Afdeling advised a transitional regulation for existing provincial derogation possibilities; the government added one.

The Afdeling found that conditions attached to ontheffing risk excessive influence and lack a purpose limit; the government limited voorschriften to cases where provincial or national interests require them for good spatial planning.
The Afdeling flagged that the two-step procedure with Awb time limits may cause delays and dwangsom exposure; the government addressed this in the memorie van toelichting.

32830.s: The bill amends the Wegenverkeerswet 1994 and the Wet rijonderricht motorrijtuigen 1993 to implement EU Directive 2006/126/EC on driving licences, adding new licence categories (A1, A2, C1, D1 and related E categories), changing minimum ages, and creating an EU licence information exchange. It shifts age and licence-validity rules to general administrative orders and includes transitional rules for existing licences.
32830.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying it has become impractical to set minimum ages and licence rules at statutory level given their volume and technical nature, so they are set by general administrative order instead.
q: As a result, it has become impractical to set at statutory level the minimum age for driving motor vehicles, for taking practical driving lessons and for issuing driving licences.
Daarmee is het ondoenlijk geworden om op wetsniveau de minimumleeftijd voor het besturen van motorrijtuigen, voor het nemen van praktijklessen en voor het afgeven van rijbewijzen vast te stellen.
d: minimum driving age and learner-instruction age
data exchange rules for licence issuing and validity checks
conditions for issuing licence despite foreign suspension or restriction
directive or parts thereof to be observed by CBR in driving ability assessment

parties: Asks when information exchange via an EU licence network will exist so that people with withdrawn licences cannot automatically obtain a licence in another country.

These members ask when information exchange will be possible and when it will be assured that people with, for example, a withdrawn driving licence/driving entitlement do not automatically obtain a licence again in another country.

Deze leden vragen wanneer informatie-uitwisseling mogelijk zal zijn en wanneer verzekerd zal zijn dat mensen met bijvoorbeeld een ingetrokken rijbewijs/rijbevoegdheid niet in een ander land automatisch weer een rijbewijs verkrijgen.
Asks about the age limit for category A1, consultation with drivers and driving schools, and whether the CBR has enough time to train examiners.
The PvdA members ask whether drivers and driving school owners have been consulted on the introduction of licence categories A1 and A2.](#)
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen of chauffeurs en rijschoolhouders over de invoering van de rijbewijscategorieën A1 en A2 zijn geconsulteerd.

Objects to EU interference and asks whether member states' divergent examination practices and dubious licences from other states can be filtered out, and about privacy if other states add data to the licence chip.
These members emphatically ask whether something will also be done about this with the introduction of the third driving licence directive or through another arrangement.
Deze leden vragen daarom met nadruk of hier bij de invoering van de derde rijbewijsrichtlijn of middels een andere regeling ook nog wat aan gedaan wordt.
Asks for evaluation of the second directive, expected effects on road casualties, and justification for the shorter five-year validity period.
Before discussing the implications of implementing the third driving licence directive, the CDA members ask to what extent the second driving licence directive has been evaluated and applied.
Alvorens te spreken over de implicaties van de implementatie van de derde rijbewijsrichtlijn, vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie in hoeverre de tweede rijbewijsrichtlijn geëvalueerd en toegepast is.
Asks how cooperation between member states works, whether the state can verify prior bans for serious offences, and whether privacy of licence holders is affected by a central database.
How can the government establish with certainty that the person concerned has not in fact had a driving licence ban in another country because of, for example, one or more serious offences?

Hoe kan de regering met zekerheid vaststellen of de betreffende persoon niet in een ander land juist een ontzegging van het rijbewijs heeft gekregen vanwege bijvoorbeeld één of meerdere zware overtredingen?
Asks why the B-licence option of a heavier B examination was not chosen for trailers up to 4,250 kg, and whether 'designed and built' wording has consequences for converted vehicles.
These members therefore ask why the option of a heavier B examination was not chosen, under which the endorsement for combinations up to 4,250 kg could be obtained immediately.
Deze leden vragen daarom waarom er niet is gekozen voor de optie van een verzwaard B-examen waarbij meteen de aantekening voor combinaties tot 4 250 kg kan worden verkregen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the bill implementing the third driving licence directive, raising points on the legal level of validity periods and minimum ages, the handling of licences restricted or withdrawn in another member state, and the late implementation deadline, and made editorial remarks. The minister's reply moved validity periods to an AMvB, added a delegation basis and implementation-deadline discussion, adopted the editorial remarks, and dropped the restriction on recognising third-country licences exchanged in another member state.
concerns: The Afdeling asked why validity periods are set by statute while minimum ages are set by AMvB, though both are of equal legal rank; the government moved validity periods to an AMvB with a delegation basis.

The Afdeling questioned how the Dutch provision refusing a licence where a licence was restricted, suspended or withdrawn elsewhere fits the directive's obligatory wording; the government explained its interpretation and added a delegation basis for conditions.
The Afdeling asked for explanation of the consequences of the missed implementation deadline; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented with a separate paragraph on this.
The Afdeling made editorial remarks on articles I-C, I-J and I-K, which the government adopted.

33028.s: The bill approves on behalf of the Netherlands the 2010 Framework Agreement between the European Union and its member states and the Republic of Korea, a mixed agreement covering political dialogue, trade, investment and cooperation. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: Thus it is that We, having heard the Advisory Division of the Council of State and in common consultation with the States General, have resolved and decreed
Zo is het, dat Wij, de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State gehoord, en met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan

parties: Asks whether South Korea's National Security Law, used to prosecute dozens of people, will be abolished or suspended, and whether the government will press for it given rule-of-law and democratic concerns.
Does the government share the view that this legislation does not comply with the principles of a democratic constitutional state, and will this legislation be abolished or suspended?
Deelt de regering de opvatting dat deze wetgeving niet strookt met de beginselen van een democratische rechtsstaat en wordt deze wetgeving afgeschaft of buiten werking gesteld?
Asks how human rights conditionality works, in particular when and how the agreement is actually suspended in case of human rights violations.
To what extent, in case of human rights violations, is the agreement actually suspended?
In hoeverre wordt, in geval van mensenrechtenschendingen, het verdrag werkelijk opgeschort?

v.summary: The Council of State advised on a bill approving the 2010 EU-Korea framework agreement, supporting its aim but asking for more explanation of its broader context, its consequences for the Netherlands (competences, existing bilateral treaties, the EU declaration on Article 12 tax cooperation) and a Dutch translation error in Article 36. The Minister's reply states that the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on each point, that the treaty has no consequences for Dutch legislation, and that the drafting error is noted.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should address the broader context of the framework agreement, which was added.
The explanatory memorandum should list the areas in which the Netherlands has competence and the consequences for Dutch law, which were added.
The explanatory memorandum should include an overview of existing bilateral treaties with Korea and their relation to the framework agreement, which was added.
The explanatory memorandum should explain the significance of the EU unilateral declaration on Article 12 for the Netherlands, which was added.
The Dutch version of Article 36 contains an error (corruption instead of terrorism financing) that should be noted in the explanatory memorandum, and the redactional remark was followed.

33064.s: The bill amends Article 5 of the Dutch Wet bestrijding ongevallen Noordzee to clarify that directions to assisting parties of a towed ship under a salvage contract may cover the listed subjects, and otherwise may only prohibit agreed assistance or continuing started assistance. It implements EU Directive 2011/15/EU on the maritime traffic monitoring and information system and takes effect on 16 March 2012.
33064.j: The explanatory memorandum says the existing powers in Article 5 already provided the necessary authority, so the change mainly clarifies scope for implementation, with no new discretionary powers explained.
q: Directions to those providing assistance to a ship may only consist of a prohibition on carrying out agreed assistance or on continuing assistance already begun.
Aanwijzingen aan degenen die hulp verlenen aan een schip slechts een verbod tot het uitvoeren van overeengekomen hulpverlening of tot het voortzetten van reeds aangevangen hulpverlening inhouden.
p: Artikel I (art. 5, lid 3 Wet bestrijding ongevallen Noordzee)

Directions to salvage and assistance providers are limited to listed subjects or a prohibition on assistance, which narrows the executive's power over private assistance firms compared with the general directions power.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill extending the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment's power to give directions to salvage providers under the North Sea incident act, implementing EU Directive 2011/15, and found the extension broader than the Directive allows, advising adaptation. The government's reply accepted the point, removed the proposed change to paragraph 2 and instead limited the extension of the directive-giving power to what the Directive requires, with minor drafting corrections.
concerns: The proposed extension of directive powers to salvage providers goes beyond what Directive 2011/15 and its Annex IV require, which the Afdeling advised be adapted.

Several editorial suggestions on the wording of the bill and cross-references in the North Sea incident act were made, and the government adopted some and the rest fell away with the deleted provision.

33090-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget statute for the other High Councils of State and the Governors' cabinets (IIB) to reflect the supplementary budget (Najaarsnota), changing expenditure and revenue figures for the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale Ombudsman and governors' offices. It sets the amended budget in thousands of euros and makes it effective from 1 December 2011.
33090-IIB.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to the supplementary budget and higher case inflows at the Raad van State, not by any claim to new powers.
q: Thus it is that We, in common consultation with the States General, have resolved and decreed: Article 1 The budget statute for the other High Colleges of State and the Governors' cabinets for 2011 is amended as shown in the attached statute.

Zo is het, dat Wij, met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze: Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat inzake de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat en de Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs voor het jaar 2011 wordt gewijzigd

33109.s: The bill sets rules strengthening the self-determination of clients receiving AWBZ care, including mandatory care plan discussions covering daily life, hygiene, nutrition and dignity, with a right to enforce agreements. It also introduces protections against violence in care relationships: screening of staff, certificates of good conduct, mandatory internal procedures and a duty to report to the Inspectorate, which may investigate and act, with enforcement powers, fines, and detailed rules delegated to general administrative orders.
33109.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the need to break patterns of abuse and protect clients, and says the Inspectorate must be able to act where public health is at stake.
q: To be able to break situations of abuse and ensure they are stopped, the additional instruments regulated by this bill are therefore necessary.
Om situaties van mishandeling te kunnen doorbreken en ervoor te zorgen dat de daaraan een halt toe wordt geroepen, zijn dan ook de met dit wetsvoorstel geregelde aanvullende middelen noodzakelijk.
d: content and recording of care plans
elements of internal procedure on violence in care
manner of reporting and investigating complaints
p: Inspectorate officials may enter homes without consent and inspect client files, overriding normal access limits, while also being bound by confidentiality.
Confidential client information may be shared with the Inspectorate and judicial authorities without consent when investigating violence.
The minister may issue binding instructions and the inspector immediate orders with a seven-day validity, extendable by the minister.
Appeals against decisions under this section are assigned to a single court, the Rotterdam district court.

parties: Asks how zorgplan enforcement works in practice, whether the IGZ supervises home care, and what happens when providers or clients repeatedly fail to honour agreements.
How does the process of drawing up a care plan work at home? Does the IGZ also supervise compliance with the statutory obligations arising from this bill in the home setting?

Hoe verloopt het proces van het opstellen van een zorgplan in de thuissituatie? Houdt de IGZ ook in de thuissituatie toezicht op het naleven van de wettelijke verplichtingen die voortvloeien uit dit wetsvoorstel?

Questions whether a separate law is needed before the evaluation of the existing care-plan decree is available, and fears the law creates an illusion that legal rights solve staffing and culture problems.
The PvdA members ask why it was not decided to await the evaluation of the Besluit zorgplanbespreking before legally anchoring the care plan.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen waarom niet is besloten de evaluatie van het Besluit zorgplanbespreking af te wachten, alvorens het zorgplan wettelijk te verankeren.
Welcomes enforceable legal rights for AWBZ clients and measures against violence in care relationships, while raising questions about the gap before care plans are drawn up.
With this the government implements an important agreement from the gedoogakkoord and legally enforceable rights for clients in AWBZ care finally arrive.
Hiermee voert de regering een belangrijke afspraak uit het gedoogakkoord uit en komen er eindelijk wettelijk afdwingbare rechten voor cliënten in de AWBZ-zorg.

Sees value in the care plan and client rights but worries the bill elevates self-determination above mutual rights and duties and legislates soft cultural norms; asks how the separate law differs from other care laws.
These members would like further explanation of the role of self-determination, mutual rights and duties, and the collective nature of the AWBZ in this bill.
Graag horen deze leden een nadere toelichting op de rol van het zelfbeschikkingsrecht, de wederzijdse rechten en plichten, en de collectiviteit van de AWBZ in dit wetsvoorstel.

Fears the law is a paper reality given understaffing and the Wet zorg en dwang, questions whether vulnerable clients can realistically go to court, and asks about cost barriers and independent client advocates.
These members consider the risk that the law becomes a paper reality, out of step with a reality in which rights are hard to fulfil and enforce, to be very high.
Deze leden vinden het risico dat de wet een papieren werkelijkheid behelst ten opzichte van de realiteit waarin rechten moeilijk in te vullen en af te dwingen zijn erg groot.

Judges the bill insufficient on effectiveness, feasibility and coherence; warns that juridifying care creates a claims culture, adds inspection and court workload, and erodes trust, echoing the Raad van State.
These members conclude with the Raad van State that the proposed strengthening of client rights in long-term care does not address the problems that actually exist there.
Deze leden concluderen met de Raad van State dat de voorgestelde versterking van de rechten van cliënten in de langdurige zorg niet tegemoet komt aan de problemen die daar daadwerkelijk spelen.
Doubts the necessity of the bill given earlier measures, argues it should have been part of the Wet cliëntenrechten zorg, and asks whether it creates more problems than it solves.
These members ask whether this law creates more problems than it solves.
Deze leden vragen of deze wet meer problemen creëert dan oplost.
Asks why sector self-regulation such as general terms and conditions is insufficient, why extra norms are needed given deregulation goals, and warns of a one-sided focus on rights and claims.
Can the government argue why these guidelines developed in practice would not suffice, so that this bill is necessary?
Kan de regering beargumenteren waarom deze in de praktijk ontwikkelde richtlijnen niet zouden voldoen, zodat dit wetsvoorstel noodzakelijk is?
Asks whether the client control and violence provisions should instead be handled integrally in the forthcoming kern-AWBZ bill.
Does the government agree with these members that it is obvious to treat all aspects of the (future) AWBZ care in an integrated way?
Is de regering het met deze leden eens dat het voor de hand ligt alle aspecten rondom de (toekomstige) AWBZ-zorg in integraliteit te behandelen?

Supports strengthening client control and protection against violence but worries about juridisering of the client-provider relationship and overlap with the Wkkgz, and asks for integration into the kern-AWBZ.
The juridification of the relationship between client and care provider is therefore not desirable for these members.
De juridisering van de relatie tussen cliënt en hulpverlener is voor deze leden dan ook niet gewenst.

Views the act as a paper reality hard to enforce in practice, criticises lack of action against executives and budget cuts, and asks why the act does not cover all care regimes; also questions VOG scope and the rechtbank Rotterdam venue.
these members still see that the act is a paper reality and that in practice it will be difficult to enforce rights in daily care.
deze leden zien echter nog steeds dat de wet een papieren werkelijkheid behelst en dat het in de realiteit moeilijk zal worden om rechten af te dwingen in de dagelijkse praktijk in de zorg.
Asks why the act is not treated together with the AWBZ reform, questions administrative burden and VOG costs, and asks for an Actal regulatory-burden review.
These members therefore ask for an explanation of the decision to proceed with the Beginselenwet in its current form rather than treating it simultaneously with the AWBZ reform proposals.

Deze leden vragen derhalve om een toelichting op het besluit om de Beginselenwet toch in de huidige vorm door te zetten, en niet gelijktijdig met de voorstellen voor de hervormingen van de AWBZ te behandelen.
Has big doubts about the added value of the bill and asks what 'redelijkerwijs vermoeden' means and how arbitrariness is prevented in VOG requirements.
what is understood by a 'reasonable suspicion'. When is that the case, how is it established, and how does the government prevent this from opening the door to arbitrariness?
wat wordt verstaan onder een «redelijkerwijs vermoeden». Wanneer is daarvan sprake, hoe wordt dat vastgesteld en hoe voorkomt de regering dat dit de deur openzet naar willekeur?
Questions the necessity of the bill given self-regulation, regulatory burden, and how it relates to municipal policy freedom after 2015 when municipalities and insurers take over extramural care.
If the government intends to also apply this act to extramural care after 2015, the SGP members would like the government's view on how this relates to the policy freedom of municipalities.

Indien de regering voornemens is deze wet ook te laten gelden voor de extramurale zorg na 2015, dan ontvangen de leden van de SGP-fractie graag de visie van de regering hoe zich dit verhoudt met de beleidsvrijheid van gemeenten

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the proposed Beginselenwet zorginstellingen, strengthening self-determination of AWBZ care clients, needs further consideration because it does not address the real problems (staff shortages, privacy, autonomy) and risks bureaucratic checklists, and that there is insufficient reason for a separate bill ahead of the Wcz. The government's nader rapport accepts most remarks, adds justification, changes terminology, and maintains the enforceable-rights approach and the mandatory VOG and abuse-reporting provisions.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the proposal addresses real problems in long-term care (staff time, privacy, autonomy) and advises reconsidering strengthening self-determination; the government accepts the problems are not solved by this law alone but maintains it as a necessary complement.

The Afdeling finds insufficient reason to regulate self-determination of AWBZ clients in a separate bill ahead of the Wcz and advises amending the Besluit zorgplanbespreking instead; the government rejects this and keeps a separate law with added justification.

The Afdeling warns that enforceable fixed discussion topics may turn the care plan into a bureaucratic checklist and encourage claim behaviour; the government responds that agreements must be enforceable and that topics provide guidance.
The Afdeling asks that the word 'doorslaggevend' be replaced because client wishes are bounded by limits; the government changes the terminology.
Redactional remarks on alignment with the Wcz, definitions, cross-references and the Wmo are largely adopted in the revised bill.
The Afdeling asks that voluntary workers be required to hold a VOG and that existing staff get a transition period; the government declines both and adds explanatory text on its reasoning.
The Afdeling asks for explanation of how VOG validity is updated and whether board members must hold a VOG; the government adds explanatory text and notes the board is covered by the wording.

33127.s: The bill amends the Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo) to transfer responsibility for extramural begeleiding (guidance/support) and short-term residential care for people under permanent supervision from the AWBZ to municipalities, with municipalities setting quality, complaints, participation and incident-reporting rules by ordinance. It also moves quality supervision from the IGZ to municipalities, with a temporary IGZ reporting role until 2016 and possible extension.
33127.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the principle that problems should be solved at the level closest to citizens, the decentralised steering and local knowledge, and the aim of avoiding double supervision and administrative burden.
q: For this reason the applicability of the Kwaliteitswet zorginstellingen to municipal social support is ended.
Daarom wordt de toepasselijkheid van de Kwaliteitswet zorginstellingen op de maatschappelijke ondersteuning beëindigd
d: municipal policy on quality, complaints, participation and incident reporting
municipal choice of support measures to compensate limitations
municipal ordinance on entitlement to in-kind support, allowances or personal budgets and enforcement rules
rules on information given to clients about choice of support form
p: Removes national inspectorate (IGZ) direct supervision of municipal support quality and shifts it to municipalities, with temporary IGZ oversight of the municipalities reported to parliament and a sunset in 2016 (extendable to 2019).
Gives municipalities discretion to decide in which cases in-kind support or personal budgets are provided, while preserving a right to a personal budget where in-kind support is not adequate.

parties: Supports the transfer but stresses municipalities need the greatest possible policy freedom and asks about feasibility of the 1 January 2013 timeline.
For this it is crucial that municipalities receive as much policy freedom as possible in carrying out their (new) tasks.
Hiervoor is het wel cruciaal dat gemeenten een zo groot mogelijke beleidsvrijheid krijgen bij de uitvoering van hun (nieuwe) taken.
Warns that removing the statutory right to care creates inequality between municipalities and asks who decides whether an in-kind provision is reasonably sufficient.

For these members, guarantees must be in place that with the lapse of the statutory right to care under the AWBZ, no inequality arises between what people in different municipalities can receive in care and support.

Daarbij dienen voor deze leden wel garanties aanwezig te zijn dat met het vervallen van het wettelijke recht op zorg, zoals dat in de AWBZ is geregeld, geen ongelijk heid gaat ontstaan tussen wat mensen in verschillende gemeenten aan zorg en begeleiding kunnen ontvangen.
Asks whether the 1 January 2013 transfer date is maintained given the one-year preparation period agreed with municipalities.
Does the state secretary maintain the transfer as of 1 January 2013?
Houdt de staatssecretaris vast aan de overheveling per 1 januari 2013?
Sees large opportunities for municipal maatwerk but worries about specialised care and asks whether the 5% budget cut will be maintained.
Despite these risks, for these members it is beyond doubt that municipal policy freedom on arranging support must be as large as possible.
Ondanks deze risico's staat voor deze leden als een paal boven water dat de beleidsvrijheid van de gemeente rond het regelen van begeleiding zo groot mogelijk moet zijn.
Fears erosion of the right to care, possible exclusion of groups, budget uncertainty and disregard of adopted parliamentary motions, asking why the IGZ supervision motion is not implemented.
These members also want to ask the state secretary why she disregards the motions adopted in the House.
Ook willen deze leden de staatssecretaris vragen waarom zij lak heeft aan de aangenomen moties in de Kamer.
Supports municipal responsibility for efficiency and personal strength but insists the transfer be prepared with great care because support is essential for participation.
Support and short-term residential care are essential for citizens who cannot fully participate in society without help.
Begeleiding en kortdurend verblijf zijn essentieel voor burgers die zonder hulp niet volwaardig in de samenleving kunnen participeren.
Sees benefits of decentralisation but raises concerns about the effect on personal autonomy of dependent people and specific vulnerable groups such as people with dementia.
They do, however, place various caveats on this bill, such as the consequences for the personal control of people who depend on this care.
Zij plaatsen echter ook verschillende kanttekeningen bij dit wetsvoorstel, zoals de gevolgen voor de eigen regie van mensen die op deze zorg zijn aangewezen.
Doubts the 1 January 2013 timeline is realistic, asks for alternative phased scenarios, and seeks exemptions for specialised care groups.
These members ask the state secretary to come with two alternative scenarios.
Deze leden vragen de staatssecretaris te komen met twee alternatieve scenario's.
Doubts that the claimed benefits will be realised and questions the real freedom of choice of clients and municipalities' knowledge of specific client groups.
These members are concerned about the actual freedom of choice of the client.
Deze leden maken zich zorgen over de daadwerkelijke keuzevrijheid van de cliënt.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the draft bill shifting extramural begeleiding (guidance) and short-stay care from the AWBZ into the Wmo, raising concerns about impacts on care recipients, municipal capacity, financing, carers, and EU law, and advised further consideration. The government's nader rapport responds point by point, largely accepting additions such as quality, complaints and participation provisions while rejecting carve-outs for specific groups.
concerns: The Council questioned whether shifting extramural begeleiding to municipalities is justified and cost-saving, and whether the 5% efficiency assumption is supported; the government added a cost analysis but kept the policy.

The Council doubted whether all municipalities are equipped in time for indication-setting and expertise, particularly for small and complex target groups; the government expanded the explanatory note.
The Council advised assessing whether certain intensive, chronic care categories should be excluded from the transfer; the government rejected carving out specific groups.

The Council raised concerns about loss of entitlements for care recipients and transitional arrangements; the government clarified transitional law, while stating the Wmo compensation duty offers safeguards.
The Council asked for clarification of the consultation with the VNG and other stakeholders under the Code Interbestuurlijke Verhoudingen; the government supplemented the explanatory note.
The Council asked the explanatory note to address EU and international social security and patient rights rules; the government added this analysis.
The Council made redactional remarks in an annex, which were incorporated.

33145.s: The bill introduces a social loan system for master's students, extends the repayment period for study loans from 15 to 20 years, shortens the student travel right, and abolishes the partner supplement and the unreachable/refusing-parents procedure for supplementary grants. It also simplifies study-cost deduction rules in the income tax act.
33145.j: The memorandum justifies removing the parent-relationship assessment and related procedures by simplification and the bill's cost neutrality, arguing students retain loan access.
q: This means DUO no longer needs to assess the relationship between the student and one or both parents. The objection and appeal procedures arising from that also disappear.
Dit betekent dat DUO de relatie tussen de studerende en één of allebei de ouders niet meer hoeft te beoordelen. Eveneens verdwijnen de bezwaar- en beroepsprocedures die daaruit voortkomen.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel D (art. 2.14, derde lid WSF 2000)
duration and form of study finance for foreign programmes
further rules for implementing the repayment choice
Artikel II, onderdeel B (art. 7.45b WHW, vijfde lid)
extension of study years on medical grounds granted by the minister
designation of programmes eligible for one-year extension
p: Artikel I, onderdeel K en O (art. 3.9, 3.14, 3.17)

Removes the statutory assessment of the parent-student relationship and the related objection and appeal procedures, so DUO no longer adjudicates such disputes and students lose a legal avenue against refusal of supplementary grants.

parties: Supports the social loan system as fairer cost-sharing and asks technical questions about complexity and loan procedures.
The members are in favour of introducing a social loan system.
De leden zijn voorstander van het invoeren van een sociaal leenstelsel.
Opposes the bill as damaging to accessibility for low-income students, especially removal of the regime for students with unreachable parents.
The PvdA members have noted with displeasure the amendment of the Student Finance Act 2000.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie hebben met ongenoegen kennisgenomen van de Wijziging van onder meer de Wet studiefinanciering 2000.
Warns that the bill reduces accessibility and increases debt, and asks why the Council of State's warnings on cumulative effects are not addressed.
They point out that the accessibility of higher education is deteriorating.
Zij wijzen erop dat de toegankelijkheid van het hoger onderwijs achteruit gaat.
Values accessibility highly and asks for monitoring and evidence from other countries, citing Council of State criticism.
For the CDA members the preservation of accessibility of higher education weighs very heavily.
Voor de leden van de CDA-fractie weegt het behoud van de toegankelijkheid van het hoger onderwijs zeer zwaar.
Worries about financial accessibility for lower-class students and the cumulative effects of measures, and asks how the government will respond if its expectations fail.
The members are concerned about the effects of the bill on the financial accessibility of higher education.
De leden maken zich zorgen over de gevolgen van het wetsvoorstel voor de financiële toegankelijkheid van het hoger onderwijs.
Has serious concerns about accessibility of multi-year masters and asks for evidence on student behaviour, as the Onderwijsraad advised.
These members have great concerns about the accessibility of higher education with the introduction of a social loan system.
Genoemde leden hebben grote zorgen over de toegankelijkheid van het hoger onderwijs bij introductie van een sociaal leenstelsel.
Asks how the measure contributes to quality improvement and how the government will monitor effects on low-SES students and part-time students.
The members ask the government how it will monitor the effects of the measures on students from such backgrounds.
De leden vragen de regering op welke wijze zij de gevolgen van de maatregelen voor studenten met een dergelijke achtergrond gaat monitoren.
Supports stepwise increase of student responsibility but wants safeguards for capable students and asks for data on student numbers and debt.
They attach value to good safeguards to guarantee accessibility of higher education for students with the required abilities.
Zij hechten aan goede waarborgen om de toegankelijkheid van het hoger onderwijs te garanderen voor studenten die de vereiste capaciteiten bezitten.
Questions the unsupported behavioural expectations underpinning the bill, and asks whether the government would reverse measures if predictions fail.
All kinds of behavioural effects are "expected", but nowhere are these assumptions backed by evidence.
Er worden allerlei gedragseffecten «verwacht», maar nergens worden deze veronderstellingen geladen met bewijs.
Accepts the proposed adjustments provided access for lower-income students and students with disabilities is preserved; asks no questions.
The members can agree with the proposed adjustments, provided access to education for students with lower-income parents and provisions for students with disabilities remain in place.

De leden kunnen zich vinden in de voorgestelde aanpassingen, mits de toegankelijkheid van het onderwijs voor studenten met ouders uit de lagere inkomensgroepen en de voorzieningen voor studenten met functiebeperkingen blijven bestaan.
Demands justification for the assumptions, the treatment of refusing and untraceable parents, and the risks of growing student debt and inequality.
Most of the funds released only become available in the next cabinet period.
Het grootste deel van de vrijgekomen middelen komt pas beschikbaar in de volgende kabinetsperiode.
No principled objection to a social loan system if access is guaranteed and proceeds are reinvested in quality, but the government has not answered concerns and must substantiate its expectations.

The concerns raised by these members, namely that the proposed introduction of the social loan system will not lead to a quality boost in education, have not been resolved by the government's answers.

De zorgen die voorgenoemde leden hebben geuit, namelijk dat de voorgestelde invoering van het sociaal leenstelsel niet zal leiden tot een kwaliteitsimpuls in het onderwijs, zijn door de beantwoording van de regering niet weggenomen.
Questions the bill's reliance on expectations, asks what the government will do if they fail, and challenges the treatment of students with refusing parents and the monitoring of work and debt.
Is that not a rather shaky structure, these members ask. And what will the government do if the expectations do not materialise?
Is dat niet een beetje een wankel bouwwerk, zo vragen deze leden. En wat gaat de regering doen als de verwachtingen niet uitkomen?
Asks whether transitional arrangements are fair to students in three-year degrees and whether the profit principle fits students training for faith-based or caring professions.
Why has no account been taken in the transitional provisions of the distinction between two-year and three-year master's programmes, they ask.
Waarom is in het overgangsrecht geen rekening gehouden met het onderscheid tussen tweejarige en driejarige masters, zo vragen zij.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion on the bill cutting student finance (abolishing the master's basic grant in favour of a social loan, removing partner and parental supplements, and restricting tax deductions for training costs) asks for an explanation of cumulative effects on financial accessibility, justification for applying the tax restriction to all students, and better grounding of the CPB evidence. The government reply rejects compensating cumulative effects, keeps the restriction for all students with reasoning, explains the flat-rate deduction and the diploma term, and makes several drafting changes.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for an explanation of cumulative effects of the measures on students in long master's programmes and for compensation of disadvantaged cases; the government mapped the cumulative effects but declined to compensate them.

The Afdeling asked whether the measures could deter students from lower socio-economic backgrounds from enrolling, and asked for the CPB evidence to be reported more accurately; the government added a more precise account of the international evidence.

The Afdeling asked for justification of why the tax-deduction restriction applies to all students rather than only master's students; the government explained the choice and amended the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling raised a series of drafting comments on the bill text, most of which the government adopted, with a few not adopted for stated reasons.
The Afdeling asked to shorten the diploma term to increase pressure on students to finish quickly; the government declined, citing flexibility for students and sufficient incentives.

33208.s: The bill amends the Medicines Act to implement EU Directive 2010/84 on pharmacovigilance, strengthening drug safety monitoring, risk management plans, adverse reaction reporting and post-authorisation studies. It expands delegation to ministerial regulations, lets the College impose conditions on marketing authorisations, and sets transitional rules.
33208.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to implement the directive's requirements on conditions, safety studies and reporting, and to streamline existing delegation provisions.
q: By ministerial regulation, further rules are laid down on the pharmacovigilance tasks and powers of the College.
Bij ministeriële regeling worden nadere regels gesteld omtrent de geneesmiddelenbewakingstaken en -bevoegdheden van het College.
d: conditions and requirements attached to marketing authorisation
detailed rules on conditions for marketing authorisation
content of assessment report and access to decisions and documents
pharmacovigilance tasks and powers of the College
pharmacovigilance tasks of marketing authorisation holder
public communications and national web portal rules
registration and reporting of adverse reactions and periodic safety reports
conduct of non-interventional post-authorisation safety studies
College decisions on renewal and suspension or withdrawal of authorisation
p: The College may attach binding conditions to marketing authorisations and grant conditional authorisations in exceptional circumstances, with details left to ministerial regulation and notice to the Bureau.
The College may suspend or withdraw authorisations on new grounds, including non-compliance with conditions and pharmacovigilance obligations or a coordination group decision.
The College may renew authorisations for unlimited or five-year periods after weighing benefits and risks, subject to safety monitoring findings.
Inspection reports must be shared with inspected parties for comment before finalisation, and findings are notified to other states and the Bureau.
The College may delegate or transfer pharmacovigilance tasks to a competent authority of another Member State with written consent and notice.

parties: Asks whether industry interests could unduly influence guidelines and protocols, and how the IGZ's role and the CBG's suspension powers will work in practice.

The PvdA members ask whether the government agrees that guidelines and protocols can be influenced by various interests, and that government must be alert to these interests, such as those of the pharmaceutical industry?

De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen of de regering het met hen eens is dat richtlijnen en protocollen beïnvloed kunnen worden door verschillende belangen, en dat de overheid alert moet zijn op de belangen die spelen, zoals die van de farmaceutische industrie?
Raises overlap and possible conflicting judgments between the CBG and the IGZ, and asks how coordination and reporting duties will be streamlined.
Where is there overlap, and what happens if there are conflicting judgements?
Waar is sprake van overlap, wat gebeurt er als er sprake is van tegenstrijdige oordelen?
Broadly positive on the bill but asks how independence of industry-run monitoring is guaranteed, presses for an independent fund for studies, and wants publication of research data.
They ask the government how independence can be guaranteed if this monitoring is carried out by the industry itself, as is the case.
Zij vragen de regering hoe de onafhankelijkheid kan worden gewaarborgd indien deze bewaking door de industrie zelf wordt uitgevoerd, zoals het geval is.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises on a draft amendment to the Geneesmiddelenwet implementing Directive 2010/84/EU on pharmacovigilance, largely endorsing its aim but objecting to broad delegation to the minister and missing substantive norms in several articles. The minister's nader rapport accepts some points (artikel 45a, 77a, 78) while defending the broad delegation approach for the others.
concerns: The Afdeling objects that key elements of conditional licences, study obligations and other rules are left to ministerial regulation without sufficient statutory norms, and the minister partly adapts art. 45a but keeps general delegation for art. 45a and 45b.

The Afdeling advises placing duties of the marketing authorisation holder and the College's pharmacovigilance tasks, which can lead to administrative fines, in the statute itself, and the minister declines, delegating them to ministerial regulation.
The Afdeling notes missing statutory grounds for study obligations and publication of assessment reports, and the minister partly addresses this by revising the delegation grounds.

The Afdeling flags incomplete implementation of Directive provisions on registration, publication and the College's data duties, and the minister amends articles 77a and 78 and clarifies the registration duty.
The Afdeling makes redactional remarks on cross-references and databank terminology, which the minister follows in the amended text.

33217.s: The bill amends Book 8 of the Dutch Civil Code to implement the 1974 Athens Convention on carriage of passengers and luggage by sea (as amended in 2002) and Regulation (EC) 392/2009 on carrier liability for accidents, including liability limits, insurance obligations and certification by the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment. It also sets a two-year limitation period, designates the Rotterdam district court for appeals against certificate decisions, and routes higher appeals to the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven.
33217.j: The memorandum justifies the fee delegation by saying that amending the statute would take time, so detailed fee rules are better set by general administrative order for faster adjustment.
q: It was chosen to set further rules on the fees owed by general administrative order, so that changes can be made more quickly.
Gekozen is voor nadere regelgeving van de verschuldigde vergoedingen bij algemene maatregel van bestuur waardoor wijzigingen sneller zullen kunnen worden doorgevoerd.
d: Artikel I, B (art. 500a, lid 3 region) / Artikel I, K (art. 529j)
fees for issuing or certifying insurance certificates
p: The Minister may withdraw an insurance certificate after consulting the Minister of Finance if the insurer's financial capacity is judged insufficient, with suspension pending appeal.

33235.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2011/61/EU on alternative investment fund managers into the Wft, redefining 'beleggingsinstelling' and 'beheerder' and introducing licensing, prudential, organisational, risk-management and reporting rules for AIFM managers. It also amends the rules for icbe's, third-country (derdelanden) regimes, and the supervisory roles of the AFM, DNB and ESMA.
33235.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for detailed, uniform technical rules implementing the EU directive and ESMA level-2 measures.
q: In several places the directive grants the European Commission power to adopt implementing measures for certain paragraphs in order to ensure uniform application of the provision.

Op meerdere plaatsen in de richtlijn is er aan de Europese Commissie een bevoegdheid verleend om uitvoeringsmaatregelen te nemen ten aanzien van bepaalde leden van het artikel teneinde een uniforme toepassing van de betreffende bepaling te garanderen.
d: definitions of alternative fund and management terms via implementing rules
rules for designating third countries whose supervision is adequate
further rules on exemption for small managers
rules on information provision and procedure for third-country manager licences
procedure for changing reference member state
licensing requirements and conditions for managers of icbe's
p: The AFM may temporarily ban offering of participation rights in certain funds or impose restrictions on managers at the request of ESMA.
The AFM may grant exemptions allowing managers to perform activities beyond the core fund-management scope.

parties: Asks why the directive's scope was broadened beyond hedge funds, why certain entities are excluded, and what ESMA's powers and reporting duties toward national supervisors will be.
Why has the scope of the directive been broadened to all managers of investment funds when the G20 agreement focused only on hedge funds?
Waarom is de reikwijdte van de richtlijn verbreed naar alle beheerders van beleggingsinstellingen terwijl de G20-afspraak zich alleen toespitst op hedgefondsen?

Worries that banks could evade Basel III leverage and capital rules by placing portfolios in investment funds, and asks for clarity on capital requirements, depositary liability and outsourcing limits; also asks the government to inform parliament about AFM and DNB implementing rules.
The PvdA members therefore call on the government to inform the House of Representatives about the adoption of the implementing rules of the AFM and DNB on this matter.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie roepen de regering dan ook op de Tweede Kamer te informeren over de vaststelling van de uitvoeringsregels van de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM) en de Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) hieromtrent.
Supports the directive because registration and supervision will allow supervisors to better assess systemic risk and oversee risk management.
Through this law, systemic risks can be better assessed by supervisors and appropriate risk management can be monitored.
Door middel van deze wet kunnen systeemrisico’s beter worden beoordeeld door toezichthouders en kan worden toegezien op een passend risicobeheer.

Welcomes registration and supervision of hedge funds but asks how global rules apply, how the regime curbs speculation, which national choices were made under minimum harmonisation, and how supervisors are involved in setting leverage limits.
It is a good thing that hedge funds and their managers are now being registered and placed under supervision.
Het is een goede zaak dat hedgefondsen en hun beheerders nu worden geregistreerd en onder toezicht worden gesteld.
Welcomes tighter supervision but asks whether DNB can intervene and set leverage ceilings, whether non-EU fund licences can be withdrawn, and how ESMA oversees third-country managers.
What are the criteria for DNB to intervene and, where necessary, set upper limits on leverage financing?
Wat zijn de criteria voor DNB om in te grijpen en indien noodzakelijk bovengrenzen te stellen aan de hefboomfinanciering?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill implementing the EU AIFM Directive, raising remarks on third-country policy, the activities of managers, and capital requirements, plus drafting comments. The government's nader rapport accepted the third-country point and the activities point (amending articles 1:13b and 2:67a Wft), explained why no additional capital requirement applies to internal managers, and added clarifications.
concerns: Interpretation of article 42 on third-country managers and funds needed clarification and adjustment of articles 1:13b and 2:66 Wft, which the government adopted.
Article 2:67a Wft did not fully reflect the conditions of article 6(5) of the Directive; the government adjusted the article and definition but disputed the need for a separate licence.
The Afdeling asked for a motivation of why internal managers face no additional own-funds requirement under article 9(3); the government added this reasoning to the explanatory note.
The term beleggingsinstelling could cause confusion with icbe's; the explanatory note was supplemented and numerous consistency and drafting corrections were made.

33244.s: The bill amends the Working Hours Act (Arbeidstijdenwet) by adding definitions of 'working time' and 'rest time' drawn from the EU Working Time Directive, following a Council of State ruling that the Act lacked a legally certain definition. It also renames the responsible minister, and allows supervisory officials of provinces, municipalities and water boards to be designated only in agreement with those authorities.
33244.j: The memorandum justifies the definitions as restoring legal certainty and full enforcement after the Council of State's Mandemakers ruling, and the designation rule as aligning with existing practice in the Inland Shipping Act.
q: It is desirable to also designate officials other than national civil servants for supervision of compliance with the Atw.
Het is het wenselijk ook andere ambtenaren dan rijksambtenaren voor het toezicht op de naleving van de Atw aan te wijzen.
d: ARTIKEL I, onderdeel C (artikel 8:1, tweede lid)
p: ARTIKEL I, onderdeel C (artikel 8:1, tweede lid)
The minister may designate provincial, municipal and water board officials for supervision only in agreement with those authorities, which strengthens subnational involvement.

parties: Asks how generally formulated legal norms can actually be sanctioned, given the risk that no sanctions can be imposed where it is unclear when travel time counts as working time.
If it is not established in which cases travel time must count as working time, how can a general sanction then be imposed?
Als bijvoorbeeld niet vaststaat in welke gevallen reistijd tot de arbeidstijd gerekend moet worden, hoe kan er dan een algemene sanctie worden opgelegd?
Asks what the Raad van State ruling means for current enforcement, whether the amendment affects past fines, and how the bill fits with EU case law (Jaeger).
To what extent is the proposed amendment consistent with the case law of the European Court of Justice?
In hoeverre is de voorgestelde wetswijziging in overeenstemming met de jurisprudentie van het Europese Hof van Justitie?
Agrees with the goal of enabling full enforcement by the Inspectie SZW but asks about enforcement problems arising from the Mandemakers ruling and effects on past fines.
They agree with the aim of the bill to enable full enforcement by the Inspectie SZW.
Zij zijn het eens met het doel van het wetsvoorstel om een volledige handhaving door de Inspectie SZW mogelijk te maken.
Notes the bill leaves unclear when travel time must be paid as working time, asks how this uncertainty will be addressed and whether it will increase litigation.

Is it correct that as a result it remains unclear for employer and employee when travel hours must be paid as working hours, if no mutual arrangement has been agreed or a collective agreement provides clarity?

Is het juist dat daardoor voor werkgever en werknemer onduidelijk blijft wanneer reisuren als arbeidsuren moeten worden uitbetaald, indien er geen onderlinge regeling hieromtrent is afgesproken of een cao van toepassing is, die hieromtrent duidelijkheid verschaft?
Asks whether the ruling affects enforcement, whether night work health risks justify strict norms, and calls for sanctions on break rules applying to all age groups rather than only young workers.
They ask the government to provide in this bill for a sanction on failing to allow breaks that applies to all age groups.
Zij vragen de regering om in het onderhavige wetsvoorstel te voorzien in een sanctie op het niet laten opnemen van pauzes, die van toepassing is op alle leeftijdsgroepen.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the bill defining labour, working time and rest time in the Working Hours Act does not resolve the Mandemakers question on whether commuting/travel time counts as working time, and that clear legal rules are needed to satisfy legal certainty before sanctions can apply. The Minister's reply rejects the call for specific rules, arguing that European definitions leave no room for national specification and that general norms are acceptable for punitive enforcement, while redrafting the working time definition and adding a transposition table.
concerns: Council of State held that the absence of clear rules on travel time versus working time conflicts with Article 5:4(2) Awb and the legal certainty principle, a point the Minister rejected as general norms being acceptable for punitive enforcement.

Council of State suggested a national rule that travel time is not working time unless otherwise agreed, which the Minister rejected because the Jaeger judgment bars national specification of working time under the Directive.
Council of State's redactional remark on the term Raad van State and a transposition table was partly followed, with the table deemed unnecessary but the bill's working time definition reworded.

33253.s: The bill amends the Dutch health market ordering law and related acts to require prior approval by the Dutch health care authority (zorgautoriteit) for concentrations of health care providers, and to let the minister impose structural organisational changes on providers for quality reasons. It also requires the zorgautoriteit to set rules on timely signalling of continuity risks for designated essential care.
33253.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by pointing to poor care quality at some large care conglomerates and to the need to protect continuity and accessibility of care, and it adds safeguards such as a prior report and proportionality requirements.
q: With the instruction power in this bill it is provided that the organisational structure of the care provider may be changed if that structure is the cause of substandard quality and no less intrusive means are available.

Met de aanwijzingsbevoegdheid uit het onderhavige wetsvoorstel wordt geregeld dat de organisatiestructuur van de zorgaanbieder kan worden gewijzigd, indien deze structuur de oorzaak is voor de ondermaatse kwaliteit en er geen minder ingrijpende middelen voor handen zijn.
d: further requirements for the concentration effects report
rules on when information about continuity risks must be provided
p: The zorgautoriteit may refuse approval of a concentration or attach conditions, based partly on a broad test of careful involvement of clients and staff and on continuity of designated care.
The minister may impose structural changes to a provider's organisational structure for quality reasons, subject to a prior zorgautoriteit report and a least-restrictive-measure test.

parties: Asks whether mandatory agreements and the NZa's notification scheme shift responsibility from insurers to the state, and what criteria define a continuity risk.
If so, what allocation of responsibility applies if continuity risks arise despite existing agreements being kept by both parties?
Zo nee, welke verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling geldt er, indien continuïteitsrisico’s ontstaan ondanks het bestaan/het houden aan de bestaande afspraken door beide partijen?
Opposes market-driven healthcare and questions the government's refusal to prevent provider bankruptcies, and asks whether patients and staff should have consent rights in concentrations.

These members consider the government's stance, that care providers must be aware they can actually go bankrupt if they perform poorly, and that the government no longer sees a role for itself in preventing bankruptcies, incomprehensible.

Deze leden zijn van mening dat de houding van deze regering, dat zorgaanbieders zich «ervan bewust moeten zijn dat zij daadwerkelijk failliet kunnen gaan indien zij slecht presteren», en dat de «de regering niet langer een rol voor de overheid in het voorkomen van faillissementen van zorgaanbieders ziet» dan ook onbegrijpelijk.
Welcomes the concentration test and early signalling but insists the power to order structural changes be used only as ultimum remedium with careful procedure, a last warning, and clear criteria.
In the view of the CDA members, it should count as an ultimum remedium.
Het mag naar het oordeel van de leden van de CDA-fractie als ultimum remedium gelden.
Supports the intervention powers but questions why the power to intervene in organisational structure was moved from the IGZ to the minister, and criticises letting providers go bankrupt.
These members are curious why, departing from the original intention to give the IGZ this power, it was chosen to assign it to the minister.
Deze leden zijn wel benieuwd waarom, in afwijking van het oorspronkelijke voornemen om de IGZ deze bevoegdheid te geven, ervoor is gekozen deze aan de minister toe te kennen.
Supports guaranteeing continuity of care by law but questions whether the concentration test may hinder efficient mergers and asks how proportionality of the intervention power is determined.
The D66 members point out that the directive power must be in reasonable proportion to the seriousness of the situation; the so-called proportionality requirement.
De leden van de D66-fractie wijzen erop dat de aanwijzingsbevoegdheid in redelijke verhouding moet staan tot de ernst van de situatie; het zogenaamde proportionaliteitsvereiste.
Asks how incidents and harmful scale growth can be prevented, how the IGZ split power is feasible, and how conflicting public interests are weighed.
These members ask the government to clarify how it weighs conflicting public interests.
Deze leden vragen de regering te verduidelijken hoe zij een afweging maakt wanneer er sprake is van conflicterende publieke belangen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised against proceeding with a bill on early signalling of continuity-of-care risks, a care-specific concentration review, and a power for the minister to order changes to a care provider's organisational structure, citing overreach, weak workability, and property-rights concerns. The government's reply accepts several points (dropping the ex ante quality test, adding statutory grounds, framing the structural order as ultimum remedium) while maintaining the concentration review and the continuity signalling regime.
concerns: The advisory division questioned the necessity of the continuity-risk signalling and reporting regime, which it found could lead the state to intervene more than its system responsibility requires; the government kept the regime but reframed its purpose.
The advisory division found no adequate statutory basis in article 62 Wmg for requiring insurers to report risks, and the government accepted the need for a sufficient legal basis.

The advisory division said the ex ante quality test lacked workable criteria and the broad quality ground was not implementable; the government dropped the ex ante quality test but kept the accessibility test.

The advisory division considered the structural-change order potentially very intrusive and insufficiently specified, and urged that it be a last resort; the government stated it is an ultimum remedium and specified when it is proportionate.

The advisory division warned that a forced divestment could amount to deprivation of property under article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR without compensation; the government clarified the proportionality reasoning but did not provide compensation.

The advisory division doubted the proportionality of ex ante concentration review under free movement of capital and establishment, and questioned the effect of the Commission's notification; the government explained the notification and justification in the explanatory memorandum.

The advisory division questioned why the NZa rather than the IGZ should hold the concentration review, and asked for justification; the government expanded the explanatory memorandum on the allocation.
The advisory division asked whether the minister must follow the NZa's report; the government agreed the report need not be binding and that deviations must be reasoned.

The advisory division noted an overlap between the transitional provision for the structural-change power and the Wet cliëntenrechten zorg, and the government restructured the transitional provisions.
The advisory division listed redactional comments in an annex, which the government incorporated into the text and explanatory memorandum.

33262.s: The bill inserts a new article 25a into the Invorderingswet 1990 allowing taxpayers who move to another EU/EEA state to defer payment of exit tax on transferred assets, provided adequate security is given, following a CJEU ruling in National Grid Indus. The deferral ends on emigration outside the EU/EEA, non-compliance with ministerial rules, loss of security, or realisation of the gain, and the taxpayer may opt to pay in ten annual instalments.
33262.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by stating that detailed conditions, mainly administrative obligations and changed circumstances ending the deferral, will be set by ministerial regulation.
q: Detailed rules will be set by ministerial regulation.
Bij ministeriële regeling zullen nadere regels worden gesteld.
d: rules for deferral of payment of exit tax
Artikel I (art. 25a, eerste lid, tweede volzin)

parties: The VVD welcomes the bill and raises no check-related concern in the report.
The members of the VVD group have noted the bill with approval.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met instemming kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel.
The PVV asks whether the rules on exit tax deferral and interest, and differences between schemes, are consistent with the National Grid Indus ruling and whether they should be harmonised.
Can the government indicate what the differences are between the National Grid Indus and N cases, the members of both the PVV and CDA groups ask.
Kan de regering aangeven wat de verschillen zijn tussen de arresten National Grid Indus en de N-zaak, zo vragen zowel de leden van de PVV-fractie als de leden van de CDA-fractie.
The CDA doubts the bill resolves the conflict with EU law, since domestic and emigrating taxpayers are still treated differently and interest is charged on the deferred amount.
The members of the CDA group doubt whether the government thereby adequately resolves the current conflict with European law.
De leden van de CDA-fractie betwijfelen of de regering hiermee de huidige situatie van strijd met het Europese recht afdoende oplost.

33280-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2012 budget statement of the Dutch States General (House of Representatives and Senate), adjusting appropriations and receipts for the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer and related parliamentary articles, in line with the spring memorandum. It contains no delegation of rule-making power to the executive and no changes to oversight or judicial review.
q: Article 1 The budget statement for the States General for 2012 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat inzake de Staten-Generaal voor het jaar 2012 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33316.s: The bill amends article 16(2) of the Dutch Code of Civil Procedure so that the court of appeal may refer any appeal from a cantonal court (kantonrechter) case to a single-judge chamber when it considers the case suitable, rather than only the Book 1 Civil Code cases previously covered. The explanatory memorandum justifies this as a way to speed up appeals and relieve the courts of appeal, while leaving the assessment of suitability to the court itself.
33316.j: The memorandum justifies the single-judge option by efficiency and flexibility gains for the courts of appeal and by the expectation that simpler cases suit single-judge handling, and notes that the court keeps the option to sit as a panel.
q: It is obvious that the (more) simple cantonal cases will also be handled by a single judge on appeal. However, the court of appeal retains the possibility to decide cases on appeal in a panel.

Het ligt voor de hand dat de (meer) eenvoudige kantonzaken ook in hoger beroep enkelvoudig zullen worden behandeld. Het gerechtshof houdt echter de mogelijkheid om zaken in hoger beroep meervoudig af te doen.
p: The court of appeal gains discretion to decide, case by case, whether an appeal from a cantonal court is heard by a single judge instead of a panel, with the possibility of reverting to a panel.

parties: Asks how courts will choose which cases go to a single judge, who holds that power, what review exists, and whether appellants can challenge the decision, to protect quality of justice.
Only cases that the court of appeal deems suitable will be referred to a single judge (unusrechter).
