Alleen zaken die naar het oordeel van het gerechtshof daarvoor geschikt zijn, zullen worden verwezen naar een unusrechter.
Supports the principle that cases decidable by a single judge should be heard by one, provided quality is guaranteed, and questions the claimed savings and the Raad's criticism.
These members share the government's view that cases that can be decided by a single judge should also be heard by a single judge.
Deze leden delen de mening van de regering dat zaken die enkelvoudig afgedaan kunnen worden ook enkelvoudig behandeld moeten worden.
Asks for the government's ambitions on single-judge appeals in criminal and administrative law and how the proposal relates to the Supreme Court's role in cassation.
The PVV members ask the government about its further ambitions regarding single-judge disposal of appeals in criminal and administrative law.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen de regering naar de nadere ambities ten aanzien van het enkelvoudig afdoen van hoger beroep in het strafrecht en het bestuursrecht.

Critical that the proposal is insufficiently substantiated, questions whether speed and quality really improve, and asks about selection criteria, uniformity of case law, and budget pressure on the judiciary.
It has not become clear why the government believes that disposal will become quicker and simpler.
Niet is duidelijk geworden waarom de regering precies van mening is dat de afdoening sneller en eenvoudiger wordt.

Supports single-judge handling where possible but asks whether the selection by the court and the absence of a party right to request a panel are adequately safeguarded, and whether savings drive the choice.
These members ask whether the parties in the case should not be able to request, with reasons, a panel hearing instead.
Deze leden vragen of de partijen in de betreffende zaak niet de mogelijkheid zouden moeten kunnen krijgen om, met redenen omkleed, toch om meervoudige behandeling te vragen.
Has some questions about the bill without specifying further concerns.
They have some questions about it.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports a bill allowing single-judge appeal handling of suitable cantonal cases, but warns that the cost savings (EUR 4-5 million) could make single-judge handling the rule and asks for reasoning and harmonised selection by appeal courts. The government's reply states that complex cases stay with multi-judge panels, that courts decide suitability, and that the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling asks the government to justify that the budget savings will not make single-judge appeal handling of cantonal cases the rule rather than the exception.
The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to set out how appeal courts will harmonise the selection of cases suitable for single-judge handling, for legal certainty and uniform application.

33334.s: The bill replaces the Pandhuiswet 1910 by inserting a new title 2D on pawn loan agreements into Book 7 of the Civil Code, setting rules on loan terms, disclosure and the maximum monthly pawn fee. The maximum fee is to be fixed by general administrative order (AMvB) and the Consumentenautoriteit is given supervision and enforcement powers.
33334.j: The memorandum states the maximum fee must be set by AMvB because the factors underlying it change over time, similar to the approach in the consumer credit rules.
q: The setting of the maximum permitted pawn fee should be regulated in a general administrative order.
De vaststelling van de hoogte van de hoogst toegelaten pandbeleningsvergoeding dient te worden geregeld in een algemene maatregel van bestuur.

parties: Asks whether differentiated rates, separate administration and appraisal costs, and the two-month term are appropriate, and what the consequences are of breaching information duties.
Can the government indicate whether the pledge term is expected to often exceed two months, or whether a two-month term will be chosen quite structurally?

Kan de regering in het algemeen aangeven of de verwachting is dat de duur van de beleentermijn vaak de twee maanden zal overstijgen of dat vrij structureel gekozen zal gaan worden voor een beleentermijn van twee maanden?
Finds the bill too narrow, wants stricter fee caps aligned with consumer credit rules, a longer pledge term, a minimum age of eighteen, and controls on the in- and sale of stolen goods.
They would like the bill to also address supervision of pawnshops regarding the buying and selling of stolen goods.
Zij zouden graag zien dat het wetsvoorstel ook zou ingaan op het toezicht op pandhuizen als het om de in- en verkoop van gestolen goederen gaat.
Asks why licensing is dropped, whether pawnshops can be required to refer customers to debt assistance, and why the 4.5% cap is far above municipal rates of 1.33%.
Can the government explain why not maintaining a licensing requirement does not, in its view, disregard the consumer's interest?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom het niet in stand houden van een vergunningsplicht volgens haar niet het belang van de consument miskent?
Accepts the 4.5% monthly maximum but asks whether enough pawnshops will remain to meet demand and whether municipal pawnshops should continue to exist.
Will enough pawnshops remain to meet demand for pawn loans now that the government wants to cap the fee, gradually, at 4.5% per month?
Blijven er, nu de regering de vergoeding – zij het stapsgewijs – wil maximeren tot 4,5% per maand, voldoende pandhuizen over om aan de vraag naar pandbeleningen te voldoen?
Asks how information to pledgers will be provided and who will monitor advertising by pawnshops, and whether the form of the pledge agreement is clear to consumers.
These members also want to know who will carry out the monitoring of pawnshops' advertising.
Ook willen deze leden graag weten wie de controle zal verzorgen op de reclame-uitingen van de pandhuizen.
Supports ending monthly rates of 20% and asks whether the cap could cause pawnshops to lower loan amounts, suggesting excess-profit restitution.
They support the introduction of new rules for pawn agreements and a limit on the monthly interest charged, ending 20% monthly usury rates.

Zij steunen het feit dat er nieuwe regels komen voor pandbeleningsovereenkomsten en dat hierbij een beperking wordt opgelegd aan de in rekening te brengen rente per maand waarmee er een einde komt aan woekerrentes van 20% per maand.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory opinion supports the bill modernising the 1910 Pandhuiswet but raises concerns about market regulation, the two-month minimum loan term, the non-distribution of resale profit to the pawnbroker's customer, and the undefined meaning of 'maand'. The government's nader rapport accepts clarifications on the 'maand' definition and adds explanatory text, but does not change the rate, loan term or profit rules, justifying these on consumer-protection and contract-freedom grounds.
concerns: The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to address whether the uniform maximum monthly rate of 4.5% should be differentiated, since municipal pawnshops charge about 1.33% monthly; the government adds that differentiation between product categories is permitted but keeps a single maximum.

The Afdeling is not convinced the minimum two-month loan term adequately protects pawnbrokers and asks for a reasoned justification or adjustment; the government argues it is sufficient and does not change the bill, only adding justification text.

The Afdeling advises considering a statutory obligation to pay resale profit back to the pawnbroker because of the risk that lowball purchase prices are used to inflate sale profits; the government declines and leaves the point to contractual freedom.
The term 'maand(rente)' is unclear as to whether it refers to a calendar month or a fixed period, so a definition is needed; the government adds a definition of 'maand' in article 131.

Redactional comments on article 134(2)(g) and article 136 are adopted, including clarifying that early redemption does not require paying the full-term fee and reformulating the ownership reacquisition wording.
The explanatory memorandum is amended to reflect that municipal pawnshops still voluntarily apply some provisions of the 1910 Act.

33352.s: The bill strengthens criminal law against fraud with identity documents and biometric characteristics by adding new offences in the Dutch Criminal Code (Wetboek van Strafrecht) and its Caribbean Netherlands version. It also adjusts identity-verification rules in the Code of Criminal Procedure, the juvenile detention principles act, the DNA Act and the Road Traffic Act, and empowers ministerial bodies to set accreditation requirements and retention rules by general administrative order (AMvB).
33352.j: The memorandum justifies the new offences and identity checks by the need to prevent identity fraud, protect victims and the reliability of the DNA database, and cites proportionality under Article 8 ECHR and Article 11 of the Constitution.
q: Without carrying out such a check there is a risk that the DNA profile of the wrong person, or of the right person under an alias, is entered into the DNA database.
Zonder de uitvoering van een dergelijke controle bestaat het risico dat het DNA-profiel van de verkeerde persoon of van de juiste persoon maar onder een alias in de DNA-databank wordt opgenomen
d: Artikel I, onder E/F (Sv art. 55c, vijfde lid; art. 61a, derde lid)
accreditation requirements for fingerprint and palm-print examining bodies; processing and retention of palm-print and other examination results
p: Creates a new criminal offence for falsifying or misusing biometric characteristics used for identity checks, expanding state penal reach over the body, justified as proportionate under Article 8 ECHR.
Artikel III, onder A (Sv art. 27b, derde lid)
Mandates use of the citizen service number (BSN) by criminal-justice organisations and non-government partners when exchanging data on suspects or convicts, limited to ensuring correct identity.
Removes the distinction so identity of juveniles in all youth detention facilities is verified at more moments, extending executive identity checks to juveniles in treatment facilities.
Artikel V (Wet DNA-onderzoek bij veroordeelden art. 4)
Requires identity verification, including fingerprints, of convicts who report voluntarily for DNA sampling, not only those arrested for non-appearance.

parties: Worries that victims of identity fraud face a burdensome burden of proof and asks whether privacy of victims and innocent citizens and biometric data will be adequately protected.
The VVD members are concerned that victims of identity fraud often face great difficulty proving the fraud and are effectively put in a disadvantaged evidentiary position by the perpetrator.

Het baart de leden van de VVD-fractie zorgen dat slachtoffers van identiteitsfraude veelal zeer grote moeilijkheden ondervinden om de fraude aan te tonen en door de dader feitelijk in een nadelige bewijspositie worden gemanoeuvreerd.

Questions whether criminalising changes to one's own biometric features is proportionate to the fundamental rights to bodily integrity and privacy under the Constitution and ECHR, and asks for empirical justification.
In the view of these members, such a limitation is only desirable if the criminalisation and its purpose are proportionate to those fundamental rights.
Naar de mening van deze leden is een dergelijke begrenzing alleen wenselijk indien de strafbaarstelling en het doel daarvan proportioneel zijn ten opzichte van die grondrechten.
Welcomes criminalising fraud with identity documents beyond travel documents and the improved identification regime, asking mainly whether investigators are trained and equipped.
They consider it a good development that, in addition to fraud with travel documents, fraud with other identity documents is also made punishable.
Zij vinden het een goede ontwikkeling dat naast fraude met reisdocumenten ook fraude met andere identiteitsbewijzen strafbaar wordt gesteld.
Asks whether the vague notion of organisations of vital or national interest is sufficiently precise and whether an innocent citizen who reuses a found ID could be punished under a six-year maximum.
Does the proposed wording protect this unwitting citizen, and do the words 'intentionally and unlawfully' ensure no punishment follows?
Is met de voorgestelde formulering deze onwetende burger beschermd, zorgen de woorden «opzettelijk en wederrechtelijk» er voor dat hier geen straf voor zal volgen?
Stresses the need to act firmly against identity fraud given digitalisation and asks how more quantitative data on the phenomenon can be obtained.
In what way does the government believe more insight into this can be obtained?
Op welke wijze meent de regering dat hier meer zicht op verkregen kan worden?

Questions whether the six-year maximum penalty for travel-document offences is consistent with the existing forgery provision and whether biometric and personal-data offences warrant a different maximum.
Would a different maximum penalty not be more appropriate in this case as well?
Zou ook in dit geval een ander strafmaximum niet meer voor de hand liggen?

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering supports the bill extending criminal liability for document fraud to identity cards issued by services of vital or national importance, and to biometric data fraud, but objects that several offences are formulated too broadly and need narrowing or better motivation. The government's reply accepts some points (adding 'wederrechtelijk' to the offence of using a reported-missing or third-party identity document, and clarifying biometric terminology) while rejecting the main objection to a limitative list of vital services and retaining the broad scope of articles 440 and 447b Sr.
concerns: The definition of 'service or organisation of vital or national importance' is insufficiently specified; the Afdeling advised a limitative list by general administrative order, which the government rejected in favour of an abstract formulation.
Criminalising use of a reported-missing or third-party identity document is too broad; the government added the element 'wederrechtelijk' to narrow it.
Extending article 440 Sr and article 447b Sr to identity documents of vital services is unclear in scope and of doubtful practical use; the government kept the extension.

The biometric fraud offence touches the right to self-determination over one's body and private life (art. 11 Grondwet, art. 8 EVRM) and is not limited to identification purposes; the government added a limiting element and explained the justification.

The necessity of the broad biometric fraud offence and of the offence of using another's biometric features to divert suspicion is insufficiently motivated; the government explained the necessity and practical use, partly accepting the point.
The necessity of using the BSN in the criminal justice chain by non-governmental organisations is only generally motivated; the government gave a fuller justification for the mandatory use.

The terms 'vervalsen' and 'valselijk opmaken' and the notions of biometric characteristics and personal data are insufficiently clear in the biometric context; the explanatory memorandum was clarified accordingly.
Several redactional comments on titles, cross-references and terminology in the annex were adopted, except for the retention of 'aangehouden veroordeelde' instead of 'aangehouden persoon'.
The draft decree amending the Besluit toepassing maatregelen in het belang van het onderzoek on retention periods for palm prints will be submitted for advice separately; no assessment was made now.

33406.s: The bill moves registration of notarial deeds to electronic submission through the Royal Dutch Notarial Professional Organisation (KNB), which keeps the electronic register and forwards copies to the Tax Administration, and removes the requirement for physical submission and paper repertories. It also partially abolishes registration of private deeds and adjusts related provisions in the Friese taal law and the Notary Act.
33406.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to set technical details of the registration process by ministerial regulation, and states that ministerial and parliamentary control over the KNB remains adequate.
q: It is important that adequate ministerial and parliamentary control over the performance of this task remains possible.
Het is van belang dat er adequate ministeriële en parlementaire controle mogelijk blijft op de uitvoering van deze taak.
d: Artikel I C (Registratiewet 1970, art. 3, derde lid)
registration procedure, register structure, proof of registration, retention period
manner of showing inspector's demand for translation
manner of registration, structure and upkeep of notary repertorium
manner in which KNB sends electronic copies to tax official
rules on KNB costs charged to the Minister
p: Assigns registration tasks to the KNB, a public body outside ministerial responsibility, with supervisory provisions of the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen applied, while the Minister retains oversight.
Gives Tax Administration officials inspection rights over the KNB register and repertories to supervise registration.</description_en>

parties: Welcomes reduced administrative burden for the Tax Authority and notaries and the end of sending documents back and forth.
The VVD members are positive about the intention to reduce the administrative burden of the Tax Authority and notaries.
De leden van de VVD-fractie staan positief tegenover het voornemen de administratieve last van de Belastingdienst en notarissen te verminderen.
Asks whether savings on Tax Authority execution costs stay within the Tax Authority rather than go to other public spending.
Is it correct that the savings on execution costs the Tax Authority achieves stay within the Tax Authority itself and are not used for other government spending?
Klopt het dat de besparing op de uitvoeringskosten die de Belastingdienst hiermee bereikt binnen de Belastingdienst zelf blijven en niet voor andere overheidsuitgaven worden aangewend?
Praises digitalisation but questions the basis for free registration, the role of the KNB, and whether registration tasks could move away from the Tax Authority, and asks about costs for citizens.
The question is therefore whether this bill is not the occasion to also place registration of the aforementioned deeds with the KNB.
De vraag is dan ook of dit wetsvoorstel niet de gelegenheid is om ook de registratie van voormelde akten bij de KNB onder te brengen.
Asks for Bureau Financieel Toezicht to get access to the register, questions the added KNB intermediary layer, and raises concerns about IT delivery, privacy and hacking risks.
Within the renewed supervision of the notariat it is important that Bureau Financieel Toezicht gets access to the register.
In het kader van het vernieuwde toezicht op het notariaat is het van belang dat Bureau Financieel Toezicht inzage krijgt in het register.
Asks how supervision of KNB registration will work and whether the KNB has the staff and legal tasks to perform it.
If so, the members are curious whether the KNB is equipped for this in terms of staff and statutory task package?
Zo ja, dan zijn de leden benieuwd of de KNB hiervoor toegerust is qua personeel en wettelijk takenpakket?
Asks whether abolishing registration of private gifts removes an important need of private individuals and requests data on current registration volumes.
The said members ask whether an important need of private individuals is not thereby taken away?
Genoemde leden vragen of hiermee niet een belangrijke behoefte van particulieren wordt weggenomen?

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering supports the bill introducing electronic registration of notarial deeds and limiting registration of private deeds, but raised remarks on the phased introduction (facultative versus imperative inspector decisions) and on designating private deeds by ministerial regulation. The government's reply accepts both points, clarifies the phased rollout and amends the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly, and adopts the redactional remarks.
concerns: The bill made the inspector's decision on transition per notary facultative while the explanatory memorandum said imperative, and the timing of the phased introduction was unclear; the government aligned the text and memorandum and clarified the timing.
It was unclear why designating private deeds requiring registration needed a ministerial regulation rather than a statutory description; the government amended the bill and memorandum accordingly.
Redactional remarks on cross-references in article I, G and J were adopted.

33424.s: The bill bans manipulating or tampering with the odometer readings of registered motor vehicles, and makes the reading a criminal offence with imprisonment of up to one year or a fine. It also requires RDW-recognised companies to report odometer readings to the RDW, with the conditions set by general administrative order and the reporting method by ministerial regulation.
33424.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by saying the AMvB will set when the reporting duty applies and how reporting takes place, and that the RDW will check reporting by sampling.
q: The bill provides the basis for setting by general administrative order the moments at which the reporting duty applies and the manner in which reporting takes place.
Het wetsvoorstel voorziet in de grondslag om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur te regelen op welke momenten de verplichting tot verstrekking geldt en op welke wijze de verstrekking geschiedt.
d: categories of motor vehicles covered by the odometer ban
cases in which recognised companies must report odometer readings
manner in which odometer readings are reported
p: Lets the executive by general administrative order determine in which cases recognised companies must pass odometer readings to the RDW, which creates a state registration obligation for private firms.

parties: Asks how the government will prove the 'active and deliberate act' of tampering and whether the burden of proof can be reversed for illogical readings.
These members believe that an 'active and deliberate act' is exceptionally difficult to prove.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat een «actieve en bewuste handeling» buitengewoon lastig te bewijzen is.
Welcomes the bill, has no substantive comments and hopes it enters into force soon.
The members are pleased that the government is now submitting the bill so that a PvdA initiative bill is no longer necessary.
De leden zijn verheugd dat de regering de wet nu indient zodat een initiatiefwet van de zijde van de PvdA niet meer noodzakelijk is.
Asks why motorcycles are excluded, asks about enforcement and whether an import procedure should be included.
The SP members state that a successful approach must be combined with strict enforcement.
De leden van de SP-fractie stellen dat een succesvolle aanpak hiervan moet samengaan met een strenge handhaving.
Asks about the timing of registration for imported cars, a European approach, and why sellers are not obliged to report readings at private transfers.
Can the government explain why it does not oblige citizens to report the odometer reading at registration of ownership?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom zij burgers niet verplicht om bij de tenaamstelling de tellerstand van de auto door te geven?
Asks about data use by public bodies such as the Belastingdienst, whether the purposes should be set in the bill, and costs and thresholds for consumers.
These members ask for what purposes the odometer database can and may be used.
Genoemde leden vragen waarvoor het kilometertellerbestand gebruikt kan en mag worden.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill to ban tampering with odometers and to create a public registration of odometer readings by the RDW, questioning necessity, effectiveness, the choice of public registration, authenticity of data, the statutory purpose, EU harmonisation of permanent vehicle requirements, and delegation. The minister's nader rapport accepted or rebutted most points, adopting changes on the delegation, EU vehicle requirement, penalty maximum and redactional remarks while defending the criminal ban and public registration.
concerns: The Afdeling doubted that the criminal ban on tampering with odometers and the public registration are necessary and effective, and asked for reconsideration; the minister defended both but supplemented the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling advised that the mandatory registration moments be set by algemene maatregel van bestuur rather than ministerial regulation.
The Afdeling held that a permanent requirement for a functioning odometer conflicts with full EU harmonisation of vehicle requirements and advised dropping it.
The Afdeling noted that the statutory purpose of the vehicle registry does not cover disclosure of odometer readings to third parties, advising extension of that purpose.
The Afdeling questioned whether registered odometer data can meet the high reliability requirements for authentic data, asking for justification; the minister supplemented the memorandum.
The Afdeling noted the six-month penalty maximum deviates from German and Belgian maxima of one year, and the minister raised it to one year.
The Afdeling made several redactional remarks, all of which the government incorporated.

33442.s: The bill amends the Dutch Seafarers Act (Wet zeevarenden) to implement the 2010 Manila amendments to the STCW Convention on seafarer training, certification and watchkeeping. It adjusts competency certificates, crew planning, disciplinary procedure for the maritime disciplinary board, alcohol rules and transitional rules, and makes minor consequential changes to the Inland Navigation Act and the Economic Offences Act.
33442.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to implement the Manila amendments, to allow flexibility for special vessels and to make seafarers interchangeable across sectors, and it cites consultation with social partners and the disciplinary board.
d: STCW code and security tasks definitions
exemption from crew plan requirement for special vessels
restrictions and additions to certificates of competency
additional professional requirements and training recognition criteria
verification of authenticity of documents and data collection
professional requirements for certificates of proficiency
content of alcohol misuse prevention policy
p: The minister may exempt special vessels from the crew plan requirement and set alternative crew requirements, subject to an evaluation within twelve months and a duty on the operator to supply information.
The pre-investigator of the maritime disciplinary board gains power to request all information on a case, strengthening the disciplinary body's investigative reach.
The disciplinary board loses its power to initiate cases on its own motion, removed to align with the impartiality requirement of Article 6 ECHR.
Prohibits sailing a vessel after detention by the Inspectorate, a compliance-enforcing provision with no discretion shift.
Creates offences for seafarers performing security or environmental tasks outside Dutch territorial waters while under influence of substances or alcohol above set thresholds.
Replaces the reference to binding treaties with a specific reference to the Revised Rhine Navigation Convention, a narrow technical change.

parties: Asks about the effects on the fishing sector, the reasons for the kntechnically early implementation, and the regulatory-burden and competitiveness impacts.
The VVD members ask why this amendment is being implemented now and why the government did not first wait for the planned amendment of the crew directive (2008/106/EC).
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen waarom deze wetswijziging nu reeds wordt doorgevoerd en waarom niet eerst is gewacht op de voorgenomen wijziging van de bemanningsrichtlijn (2008/106/EG).
Welcomes the bill as a step toward international standardisation of seafarer quality, safety and training requirements and raises no substantive questions.
These members see the legislation as a good start toward greater international standardisation of crew quality, safety and training requirements.
Deze leden zien de wetgeving als een goed begin om te komen tot meer internationale standaardisatie van de eisen aan kwaliteit, veiligheid en opleidingsniveau van de bemanning.
Has no questions on the bill.
and currently have no need to ask questions.
en hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen.
Has no questions on the bill.
and currently have no need to ask questions.
en hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen.
Asks why no comparable international-standards legislation exists for seafarers on fishing vessels and why the STCW-F Convention has not been ratified.
The CDA members ask why the Standards of Training Certification and Watchkeeping for Fishing Vessel Personnel (STCW-F) Convention has not yet been ratified by the Netherlands.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen waarom het eerder genoemde Standards of Training Certification and Watchkeeping for Fishing Vessel Personnel (STCW-F) Verdrag nog niet is geratificeerd door Nederland.
Asks how the bill relates to the EU Port State Control directive under which the ILT can inspect and sanction foreign ships, and asks about monitoring and capacity for enforcement.
How does this amendment relate to the provisions of the EU Port State Control Directive (2009/16/EC)?
Hoe verhoudt deze wijziging zich tot de bepalingen uit de EU-richtlijn Post State Control (2009/16/EG)?
Has no questions on the bill.
and currently have no need to ask questions.

33451.s: The bill splits the existing Oost-Nederland judicial district into two new districts, Gelderland and Overijssel, amending the Wet op de rechterlijke indeling, the Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie and several other laws together with transitional provisions. It transfers courts, staff, boards, archives and pending cases to the new districts and requires the Minister of Justice and Security to report on effects within three years.
33451.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as implementing a parliamentary motion and as a technical consequence of creating the new arrondissementen, and it explains the transitional rules as keeping officials' legal position intact.
q: This bill aims to split the Oost-Nederland arrondissement into the Gelderland and Overijssel arrondissements.
Dit wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe het arrondissement Oost-Nederland te splitsen in de arrondissementen Gelderland en Overijssel.
d: rules on judicial board members' allowances and remuneration matters
p: Transitional rules transfer appointment, procedural and complaint-handling powers from the old Oost-Nederland board to the new boards by operation of law, with limited discretion involved.

parties: Asks whether splitting the court district will lower the quality and specialisation of justice in Oost-Nederland, and wants an early evaluation that could reverse the split.
Can the government assure these members that the split will not lower the quality of the judiciary in Oost-Nederland?
Kan de regering deze leden verzekeren dat de opdeling er niet toe zal leiden dat de kwaliteit van de rechtspraak in Oost-Nederland wordt verlaagd?
Asks why the government now implements the split it previously opposed and why Noord-Nederland, covering three provinces, is not split as well.
Why is that not done in the case of arrondissement Noord-Nederland, which consists of three provinces?
Waarom wordt dat in het geval van arrondissement Noord-Nederland, welke uit drie provincies bestaat, dan niet gedaan?
Welcomes the split of the large district to reduce the gap between citizens, judges and court administration, and urges quick submission of the government's response.
Of the greatest importance is that this split be incorporated directly into the revision of the judicial map on 1 January 2013.
Van het grootste belang is nu dat deze splitsing op 1 januari 2013 direct meegenomen wordt bij de herziening van de gerechtelijke kaart.
Has no questions at this stage.
They have no questions on this at the moment.
Zij hebben daarover op dit moment geen vragen.

Supports the split if workability, manageability and accessibility are guaranteed, and asks for a review three years after entry into force of the Wet herziening gerechtelijke kaart together with the prosecution and police.

request the government to review the Wet herziening gerechtelijke kaart three years after entry into force, both separately and in conjunction with the Public Prosecution Service and the national police.
verzoeken de regering om over drie jaar na inwerkingtreding de Wet herziening gerechtelijke kaart zowel afzonderlijk als in samenhang met Openbaar Ministerie en nationale politie te bezien.
Questions the decision not to split the prosecution and police regions, asking for quantitative justification and consultation of the affected organisations.
Welcomes the split but questions the lack of evaluation for the police and prosecution regions and asks why the college of deputies is abolished only after five years.
Why is it not chosen to fully suspend this entry into force or else to evaluate after three years?
Waarom wordt er niet gekozen voor een geheel opschorten van deze inwerkingtreding dan wel een evaluatie na drie jaar?

33541.s: The bill reorganises the Dutch national public broadcasting system by allowing broadcasting associations to merge into cooperative broadcasters, tightening recognition and supervision rules, and restructuring funding, governance and the NTR. It also adds a Commissariaat power to issue binding directions (aanwijzing) to public media institutions in cases of mismanagement by board or supervisory members.
33541.j: The memorandum justifies stronger central steering by the raad van bestuur and new supervisory tools by efficiency gains and the need to prevent governance problems at broadcasters.
d: Artikel 2.51 (vierde lid, nieuw; ministeriële regeling and algemene maatregel van bestuur on urenverdeling)
adjusting allocation of broadcasting hours among associations
indexing contribution amounts for cooperative broadcasters
fixing reserve amounts for association activities
rules on notification, scope and duration of experimental ancillary activities
Artikel 2.51 (eerste lid, onderdeel a, ministeriële regeling on reference moment)
determining reference moment for counting associations
p: Gives the Commissariaat voor de Media power to issue binding directions to public media institutions and require replacement of board or supervisory members in cases of mismanagement.
Minister must consent to transfer of recognition to a merged broadcaster, with conditions the minister may attach.
Artikel 2.23 (erkenningen, eens in de vijf jaar)
Minister decides every five years on up to six recognitions, with recognition criteria extended to governance and financial administration.
Minister may refuse or withdraw recognition on broader grounds including insufficient cooperation and governance deficiencies.

parties: Asks how pluriformity, independence and quality will be safeguarded and measured under the new NPO-led model, and whether the system will be evaluated.
Welcomes consolidation but argues the bill does not strengthen broadcaster independence from political influence, questioning the minister's appointment powers and the financing guarantee.
These members note that the government makes no proposals in this bill to strengthen the independence of public broadcasting.
Deze leden merken op dat de regering met het voorliggende wetsvoorstel geen voorstellen doet om de onafhankelijkheid van de publieke omroep te versterken.
Opposes the additional 100 million euro cut on top of earlier cuts, arguing it harms programming quality and undermines support for the mergers.
They are concerned about the quality of public broadcasting, now that the government wants to cut 300 million euro in total.
Zij maken zich zorgen over de kwaliteit van de publieke omroep, nu de regering in totaal 300 miljoen euro wil bezuinigen.
Criticises the sequencing: cutting first and presenting a future vision afterwards, arguing a vision should be debated in parliament before the cuts; questions legal basis for forced mergers.
According to these members this is the reverse order. You cannot cut first and then come with a future exploration, can you?
Volgens deze leden is dit de omgekeerde volgorde. Je kunt toch niet eerst bezuinigen en dan met een toekomstverkenning komen?
Asks the government to elaborate substantive content choices, programming criteria and the exact position of the NPO board, which the bill leaves unspecified.
The D66 members ask the government to explain and justify this further, since the bill sets out no substantive outlines.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering dit nader toe te lichten en te beargumenteren, aangezien er in het wetsvoorstel geen inhoudelijke contouren worden geschetst.
Objects to losing the 2.42 religious broadcasters and centralising programming and finance powers, questioning whether this serves quality and pluriformity.
Members of this faction have great difficulty with the thinning of pluriformity in the broadcasting system and hence the disappearance of the 2.42 broadcasters.
De leden van deze fractie hebben grote moeite met verschralen van de pluriformiteit binnen het omroepstelsel en daarmee het verdwijnen van de 2.42 omroepen.
Questions whether forced cooperation between broadcasters is compatible with the Constitution and the freedom of association and of content of broadcasters, asking for procedural safeguards.
This leads to a far-reaching intrusion into the legal person, which may also put the content freedom of the broadcaster under pressure.
Dat leidt tot een ingrijpende inbreuk in de rechtspersoon, die ook de inhoudelijke vrijheid van de omroep onder druk kan zetten.
Notes the Council of State is not yet convinced the model maximises efficiency, and questions whether the chosen six-organisation structure and EU compliance are justified.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the bill reorganising the national public broadcasting system (forced mergers, outsourcing of production to NTR) needed reconsideration, citing insufficient justification for efficiency choices, unclear NTR role, EU DAEB transparency and free-movement concerns, and unequal membership thresholds. The government's reply accepted several remarks, amended the bill (e.g. outsourcing limited to new aspirant broadcasters, membership threshold of 50,000 kept), but rejected the call to reconsider the bill as a whole.
concerns: The Council questioned whether the chosen merger model is justified and whether alternatives were considered; the government added motivation but rejected reconsidering the bill.

Lack of selection criteria and transparency/non-discrimination safeguards under EU DAEB rules and free movement of services; the government argued the existing framework suffices and added explanation.
Mandatory outsourcing of production to NTR may restrict freedom of services; government limited the obligation to new aspirant broadcasters.
Decision-making structures of public broadcasting were not simplified; the government pointed to earlier reforms and left it to the broadcasters.
Several redactional remarks on definitions, transitional provisions and cross-references were largely adopted.

33622.s: The bill consolidates and harmonises enforcement powers, procedures, sanctions, openness rules and appeal routes across the markets regulated by the merged Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM), adding ACM-wide powers to enter dwellings without consent, seal premises, impose binding instructions and commitments, and publish decisions. It also abolishes the dual civil/administrative consumer enforcement regime, makes administrative enforcement uniform, and limits suspensive effect and appeal stages for fines.
33622.j: The memorandum justifies the harmonisation as needed for effective, efficient market supervision after the merger and cites cost savings and the need for uniform procedures rather than new substantive rules.
q: To give the merger optimal effect, a second step is necessary.
Om de samenvoeging optimaal effect te geven, is een tweede stap noodzakelijk.
d: other costs excluded from charging to market organisations
rules on cost calculation and charging systematics for market organisations
transitional deviating charge amounts for up to three years
fixing amounts charged to market organisations for costs
further rules on extending the time limit for enforcement
p: ACM officials may enter homes without the occupant's consent, subject to prior authorisation by a rechter-commissaris and a written report afterwards.
ACM-wide powers to seal premises and objects and call in police assistance to execute information-gathering powers.
Authority may make commitments binding in place of fines or penalty payments on request of the market organisation.
Binding instructions for any violation, expanded inspection of accounts and administrative fines up to EUR 450,000 or a percentage of turnover, with penalties for obstructing investigations.
Authority decides itself whether to publish decisions, other decisions and documents, with limited exceptions and a short wait before publication.
Suspensive effect of fine decisions is limited to the period for objection and, if an objection is filed, 24 weeks, weakening the default protection against enforcement during appeal.
ARTIKEL I, Z (Mededingingswet hoofdstuk 7 paragrafen 2 en 4) and ARTIKEL VIII/IX (Elektriciteitswet, Gaswet)
Criminal-law enforcement route for consumer protection is abolished in favour of administrative enforcement only, removing a separate criminal and civil track.
Court of Appeal The Hague can order cessation of violations and changes to codes of conduct on the basis of a foundation's request, shifting some consumer enforcement to a specific court.

Removal of several sector-specific ex-ante and procedural provisions, and removal of the Minister's annulment and related powers over ACM decisions in the energy, telecom, transport and postal sectors.
Minister may instruct the Authority on competition tasks and on its standpoint in advisory committees, although instructions may not concern individual cases.

parties: Asks for judicial safeguards, such as a rechter-commissaris present during home entry, given the intrusive power and weak authorisation guarantees.

The bill requires prior authorisation from the investigating judge, but given the possibility of a precautionary authorisation, it is not always checked whether entering the home is actually necessary in the case at hand.

Het wetsvoorstel bepaalt dat er een voorafgaande machtiging is vereist van de rechter-commissaris, maar er wordt blijkens de mogelijkheid van een voorzorgsmachtiging niet altijd getoetst of in het voorliggende geval betreding van de woning daadwerkelijk nodig is.
Asks why the objection phase for fines is not skipped and questions the usefulness of the objection advisory committee and risk of duplicated work.
Would it not then be more logical to choose to abolish the objection phase after all, for example with the consent of both parties?
Ligt het dan toch niet voor de hand om toch te kiezen voor het schrappen van de bezwaarfase, bijvoorbeeld met instemming van beide partijen?
Worries that privacy protections for home entry and limits on publication could shield offenders and fail consumers, while also questioning sector exceptions and the minister's lost powers.

In the view of these members, the right to privacy should lapse if the supervisor has such strong suspicions of illegal practices that it feels compelled to search a home; does the government agree with these members?

Wat deze leden betreft komt het recht op privacy te vervallen, indien de toezichthouder dermate grote verdenkingen heeft van illegale praktijken dat deze zich genoodzaakt ziet tot huiszoeking, is de regering dat met deze leden eens?

Notes the bill expands powers mainly upward, asks for examples of narrowing, and questions the lack of judicial supervision of home entry and the presumption of innocence when fines are paid before final ruling.

They ask the government to respond to the Dutch Bar Association's criticism that, unlike in criminal law, this bill does not provide for actual supervision by the investigating judge over entry and search.

Tot slot vragen de leden van de D66-fractie de regering in te gaan op de kritiek van de Nederlandse Orde van Advocaten dat (in tegenstelling tot in het strafrecht) er in onderhavig wetsvoorstel niet voorzien is in daadwerkelijk toezicht van de rechter-commissaris op het binnen treden en doorzoeken.
Asks about internal and external information-sharing safeguards, the scope of the right to silence, and whether the procedure meets European rights standards.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft bill integrating supervisory tasks of the ACM, criticising the abolition of the objection phase for fines, mandatory publication of sanctions, recovery of fines from association members, and the cost-recharging scheme as insufficiently justified or regulated in law. The government's nader rapport reports it amended the bill on most points, restoring the objection phase with a limited suspensive effect, a differentiated publication regime, narrowed recovery rules, and statutory cost-recharging principles.
concerns: Abolition of the objection phase for fines was insufficiently justified and weakened legal protection; the government restored the objection procedure with limited suspensive effect.
Mandatory publication of sanctions lacked a case-by-case proportionality assessment; the government introduced a differentiated publication regime with exceptions for business and personal data.
Recovery of fines from non-involved association members went beyond existing law; the government narrowed the recovery rule to the earlier criterion.
Cost-recharging to market organisations was left largely to a general administrative order; the government added main principles in the statute itself.
Numerous redactional remarks were mostly adopted, with a few rejected with reasons.

33640-IIA.s: The bill amends the 2013 budget statute of the Staten-Generaal (States General), reallocating funds across parliamentary budget articles and adding a net increase of about 2.2 million euros in expenditure commitments in the 1e suppletoire begroting. It also sets the amendment's effective date and retroactive application to 1 June 2013.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statute of the States General (IIA) for the year 2013;
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de Staten Generaal (IIA), voor het jaar 2013;

33802.s: The bill sets out statutory government duties for meteorology and seismology, including public weather forecasts and warnings, support to public bodies, scientific research, and cost recovery, with detailed implementation left to ministerial regulation. It also repeals the KNMI law, transfers aviation meteorological functions to the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment, and requires a periodic evaluation report to parliament.
33802.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying that flexibility in organising the tasks is needed while public interests are secured in the statute, and that details can be left to ministerial regulation.
q: By choosing a new framework act with statutory duties and a supplementary ministerial regulation, important public interests and tasks are secured, while the organisation of those tasks can be arranged as flexibly as possible.

Door te kiezen voor een nieuwe kaderwet met zorgplichten en een aanvullende ministeriële regeling, worden belangrijke publieke belangen en taken geborgd, maar kan de organisatie van die taken zo flexibel mogelijk worden ingericht.
d: content and dissemination of weather forecasts and warnings, support rules, research and data availability
international obligations on meteorology and seismology
preparation, structure and content of the four-year programme
composition, tasks and remuneration of the supervisory council
p: The Minister is given authority to designate and assign aviation meteorological service providers and decide how functions are organised, with the organisational arrangement fixed by ministerial decision rather than statute.
Ministerial regulation sets the content, timing and public release of general weather forecasts and warnings, with a programme adopted every four years.

parties: Asks which safety aspects justify KNMI exclusivity for aviation meteorology and whether the five-year evaluation will consider handing further tasks to the market.
The VVD members therefore ask which safety aspects are exactly at issue and why market parties cannot provide this information through contracting.
De leden van deze fractie vragen dan ook om welke veiligheidsaspecten het hier precies gaat en waarom door middel van contractvorming marktpartijen deze inlichtingen niet kunnen verstrekken.
Worries that restricting KNMI services to subnational governments to exceptional cases harms public safety and asks for statutory conditions as the Raad van State advised.

The PvdA members agree with the Council of State, which advises that the conditions under which weather-related services may be offered to subnational governments and public enterprises be included in the statute, and ask the government to do so too.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie sluiten zich aan bij de Raad van State, die adviseert om de voorwaarden op grond waarvan weergerelateerde diensten kunnen worden aangeboden aan decentrale overheden en overheidsbedrijven in de wet op te nemen, en verzoeken de regering dit ook te doen.
Objects that rules are shifted to ministerial regulations, sidelining parliament, and wants the weather tasks fixed in the Act or in a general administrative order subject to prior submission.

These members prefer that the weather-related government tasks be fixed in the Act or at least in a general administrative order subject to prior submission, so that the representative body has the last word.

Deze leden zien de weergerelateerde overheidstaken bij voorkeur in de wet vast gelegd of op zijn minst in een algemene maatregel van bestuur met voorhang zodat de volksvertegenwoordiging hierover het laatste woord heeft.
Questions whether the KNMI's scientific independence is secured, given past criticism, and whether it is a case of the butcher inspecting his own meat since KNMI advice shapes government policy.
These members ask whether this is not a case of the butcher inspecting his own meat, since KNMI advice may be important for government policy.
Deze leden vragen zich af of hierbij geen sprake is van de slager die zijn eigen vlees keurt, aangezien de adviezen van het KNMI van belang kunnen zijn voor het beleid van de regering.
Asks how full cost recharging to subnational governments and the narrow exception for KNMI-only expertise affect administrative burden and whether public knowledge is used.
The CDA members ask whether this exception will be given a broad interpretation.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of er aan deze uitzondering een ruime invulling gegeven gaat worden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill on meteorology and seismology duties but raises concerns about abandoning the link between KNMI organisation and tasks, broad delegation to the minister, and not charging full costs to the Caribbean public bodies, advising revision. The government's nader rapport accepts most points, adds clarifications, moves the advisory council's composition into the law, and explains the BES cost exception.
concerns: Advised that key elements of the conditions for services to decentralised authorities be set in the law rather than delegated to ministerial regulation; the government added these principles to the bill.
Advised that the composition, appointment and tasks of the supervisory council be regulated in the law itself rather than by ministerial regulation; the government agreed and will do so.

Found insufficient motivation for abandoning the link between KNMI organisation and tasks; the government gave further justification (harmonisation, flexibility, market ordering) while denying intent to remove tasks from KNMI.

Asked how ministerial responsibility and service quality are secured if tasks go to outside organisations and how the council's role and KNMI implications are affected; the government supplemented the explanatory memorandum but disputed the need for a rigid statutory allocation.

Raised whether not charging full integral costs to the Caribbean public bodies is justified; the government explained the existing arrangements and clarified the position in the memorandum without changing the article.
Redactional comments on wording in several articles were adopted by the government.

33910.s: The bill abolishes the statutory system of product and trade boards (bedrijfslichamen) under the Wet op de bedrijfsorganisatie and transfers their remaining public tasks to the central government, with the Minister of Economic Affairs as liquidator. It also repeals or amends many sectoral statutes and transitional rules for liquidation, debts, disciplinary cases and pending appeals.
33910.j: The memorandum justifies the abolition by citing principled objections to binding levies and weak democratic legitimacy, and says the public tasks are taken over by the central government and standing statutory rules.
q: In the cabinet's view, the powers of the product and trade boards to adopt binding regulations and impose levies, together with limited opportunities for participation, constitute a significant restriction on entrepreneurship.

Naar het oordeel van het kabinet vormen de bevoegdheden van de product- en bedrijfschappen om bindende verordeningen op te stellen en heffingen op te leggen, alsook de beperkte inspraakmogelijkheden, een belangrijke beperking van ondernemerschap
d: rules on crop cultivation and use of seed material and land
detailed rules for CO2 cost apportionment and ministerial regulation for levies
levy on enterprises if board assets are insufficient to pay debts
tuchtrechtspraak procedure rules for control bodies
p: Abolishes sectoral self-governing bodies and their binding levy and regulatory powers, transferring their public tasks and liquidation to the Minister of Economic Affairs with limited sectoral consultation.
Allows the Minister to impose levies on former enterprises to cover shortfalls during liquidation, with the liquidation period as a limit.
The Minister sets the final liquidation accounts and decharge, which are submitted to both chambers of parliament and subject to creditor objections.
The Minister takes over pending legal procedures and appeals in place of the abolished boards.

parties: Asks whether sanctions under the new regime are proportionate and whether regulatory burden reduction was properly examined, and questions why assets go to the state rather than the business sector.
The VVD members note that the sanctions in the present bill are heavier than under the structure of the trade and product boards.
De leden van de VVD-fractie merken op dat de sancties in voorliggend wetsvoorstel zwaarder zijn dan onder de structuur van bedrijfs- en productschappen.
Asks whether the existing disciplinary sanction of enhanced controls at the cost of the party concerned can still be imposed after the change.
The SP members note that regarding disciplinary law the government chooses enforcement through administrative or criminal law rules.
De leden van de SP-fractie constateren dat de regering ten aanzien van het tuchtrecht kiest voor de handhaving van de bestuurs- of strafrechtelijke regels.
Opposes abolition as throwing out the baby with the bathwater, asks for the promised blueprint for new organisational forms, and questions NVWA capacity and the financial consequences for the SER.
They maintain that the abolition throws the baby out with the bathwater.
Zij blijven erbij dat de opheffing het kind met het badwater weggooien is.
Worries about export position, crisis management and continuity of innovation and sustainability projects co-financed by the product boards.
These members have concerns about the consequences of the proposed abolition for the Netherlands' export position, crisis management and the continuation of innovation and sustainability projects.

Deze leden hebben zorgen over de gevolgen van de voorgestelde opheffing voor de exportpositie van Nederland, de aanpak van crisis en het voortbestaan van projecten gericht op innovatie en duurzaamheid.
Asks whether provinces agreed to the government's promise on the Bosschap provisions and whether municipalities lose their powers to impose felling bans in forests.
The GroenLinks members want to know whether the provinces agreed to the government's promise to find a solution for the amendment of the provisions concerning the Bosschap.

De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie willen graag weten of de provincies akkoord zijn gegaan met de belofte van de regering om met een oplossing te komen voor de wijziging van de bepalingen ten aanzien van het Bosschap.
Opposes abolition, questions why product boards and investment zones are treated differently, and asks for the blueprint on new producer organisations and what happens if the bill is rejected.
They do not support the abolition of the product and trade boards and emphasise the added value of the product and trade boards.
Zij steunen de afschaffing van de product- en bedrijfschappen niet en benadrukken de toegevoegde waarde van de product- en bedrijfschappen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the bill abolishing the publiekrechtelijke bedrijfslichamen (product and industry boards), recommending a stronger motivation of necessity, bringing the bill in line with the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 on off-budget accounts, and adding procedural safeguards for tuchtrecht appeals and a publication sanction. The minister's nader rapport accepts most remarks, adds motivation and amendments, but maintains the abolition and rejects the advice on the principle of off-budget booking only partly, explaining it as a lex specialis.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a stronger motivation of the necessity of abolishing the boards given recent reforms and sector support, and the government supplemented the general explanation accordingly.
The Afdeling advised aligning the bill with the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 on booking funds outside the budget; the government defended a lex specialis and added a clarifying provision.
The Afdeling advised adding a provision on publication of the judgment at the offender's cost to the bill, and the government did so.
The Afdeling advised placing procedural rules for tuchtrecht appeals in the statute rather than an AMvB, and the government adopted this.
The Afdeling flagged a potential gap in rules on sustainable forest management after abolition of the Bosschap, and the government clarified it in the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling made numerous redactional comments on cross-references, article structure and wording, which the government largely adopted.

34018.s: The bill amends the Dutch blood supply act to give the Minister of Defence a statutory basis for running military blood supply, including processing, storage, export and import of blood products. It also exempts legal persons that do not use blood products for human administration from the designation and import licensing requirements, and lets the Minister of Health exempt the Military Blood Bank from EU directive obligations by ministerial regulation.
34018.j: The memorandum justifies removing designation requirements by arguing that supervision is unnecessary when blood products are not used for human administration, and justifies the military powers by the need to run the military blood bank.
q: Since these institutions and companies do not use blood for administration to humans, supervision in the form of a designation is not necessary in these cases.
Aangezien deze instellingen en bedrijven bloed niet gebruiken voor toediening aan de mens is toezicht, in de vorm van een aanwijzing, in deze gevallen niet noodzakelijk.
d: rules the Military Blood Bank must follow implementing EU directives and international decisions
rules on structure and submission date of budget and policy plan of Sanquin
p: Gives the Minister of Defence statutory powers to obtain, process, store and export blood products for military use, expanding executive discretion over blood supply outside the civilian designation regime.
Removes the requirement for ministerial designation and import licensing for legal persons not using blood products for human administration, reducing ministerial supervisory control over them.

parties: Asks about quality standards, financing and supervision of the Military Blood Bank, the scope of exempted recipients, and the choice of suppliers other than Sanquin, without challenging executive discretion directly.
Said members ask whether the same quality requirements apply to the MBB as to Sanquin.
Genoemde leden vragen of voor de MBB dezelfde kwaliteitseisen gelden als voor Sanquin.

Welcomes reduced red tape and the legal basis for the Military Blood Bank, but asks how risks of supply leaking into direct patient care are excluded and how concerns are addressed between plan cycles.
However, the said members ask the government about possible risks of this measure that could lead to blood and intermediate products (via a detour) still ending up in direct patient care.

Wel vragen genoemde leden de regering naar eventuele risico's van deze maatregel die er mogelijk toe leiden dat bloed- en tussenproducten (via een omweg) toch terechtkomen in de directe patiëntenzorg.

Opposes easing ministerial designation for commercial parties, asks for a response on keeping the ministerial designation, and asks whether parties or the House can still steer the plan between cycles.

Asks when the minister will adopt the ministerial regulation, which topics it will cover, and why a ministerial regulation was chosen as the instrument given legislative drafting guidelines, since the bill delegates rule-making powers.
These members also want to know why the form of a ministerial regulation was chosen.
Ook willen deze leden graag weten waarom voor de vorm van een ministeriële regeling is gekozen.
Asks why a three-year plan cycle rather than two years, given transition, budget cuts and EU changes, and requests a clearer account of past problems in overseas blood supply.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft bill amending the Blood Supply Act to regulate the Military Blood Bank's position and procedural requirements, endorsing its purpose but asking the explanatory memorandum to address its relation to EU Directive 2002/98/EG, in particular whether the Military Blood Bank is a blood establishment or hospital blood bank and who supervises it. The minister's reply states the Military Blood Bank's activities fall under the directive and it has always complied, and that a new paragraph in article 11a provides a basis to formalise this in a ministerial regulation.
concerns: The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to address the relation to Directive 2002/98/EG, especially whether the Military Blood Bank is a blood establishment or hospital blood bank and which body supervises it; the reply states the activities fall within the directive and that a basis is added to article 11a, without fully resolving the classification and supervision questions.
The Afdeling proposes a redactional change to article I, part D, rephrasing the phrase on a manner qualitatively corresponding to Dutch practice, which the government adopted.

34027.s: The bill inserts a new article 19a into the Wiv 2002 requiring prior authorisation from the Hague District Court before intelligence services may use special powers against journalists aimed at identifying their sources. For MIVD requests, consent of the Minister of the Interior or the AIVD head is also required.
34027.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as necessary to meet the European Court of Human Rights requirement of independent prior review before special powers are used against journalists.
q: There is namely no provision for an independent review prior to the use of special powers against journalists in order to identify their journalistic sources.

Er is namelijk niet voorzien in de aanwezigheid van een onafhankelijke toets voorafgaand aan de inzet van bijzondere bevoegdheden jegens journalisten ten einde hun journalistieke bronnen te achterhalen.
d: MIVD requests require consent of Interior Minister or AIVD head where prescribed
p: Requires prior court authorisation before special powers may be used against journalists to identify their sources, reducing unilateral executive discretion.

parties: Asks whether the bill fully meets the ECtHR's quality requirements for protecting journalistic sources, given the importance of an independent and binding prior review.
These members endorse the importance of an independent and binding review prior to the use of the special power against journalists.
Deze leden onderschrijven het belang van een onafhankelijke en bindende toets voorafgaand aan de inzet van de bijzondere bevoegdheid jegens journalisten.

Questions how journalistic good faith and ethics, set by the profession itself, can be assessed by the legislature and the AIVD, and whether journalists not adhering to all ethical norms lose protection.
In the view of these members, the government rightly notes that it is not for the legislature to set such rules.
Naar de mening van de aan het woord zijnde leden stelt de regering terecht vast dat het niet aan de wetgever is om dergelijke regels vast te stellen.
Objects that the services themselves decide whether someone is a protected journalist before judicial review, giving them wide discretion, and asks why the CTIVD is not involved in advance.
These members note that the services effectively decide for themselves whether someone is protected and whether independent judicial review is necessary.
Deze leden constateren dat de diensten hiermee feitelijk zelf uitmaken of iemand wel of niet beschermingsgerechtigd is en of onafhankelijke toetsing door een rechter noodzakelijk is.
Asks why the bill does not allow the judge to attach modalities to investigative methods or limits on material obtained, as recommended by the study commission and the Sanoma judgment.
The CDA members ask why the bill does not provide that the judge can attach modalities to investigative methods or limits on the material to be handed over.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen, waarom in het voorliggende wetsvoorstel niet wordt vastgelegd, dat de rechter modaliteiten kan aanbrengen in de opsporingsmethoden, of beperkingen kan aanbrengen in het af te geven materiaal.

Stresses that the CTIVD must be able to supervise lawful use of the new power, notes past AIVD over-strict application of legal definitions, and asks about safeguards against misuse and about appeal procedures.
For them it is of great importance that the CTIVD can properly supervise the lawful exercise of the power to be included in article 19a.
Voor hen is het van groot belang dat de CTIVD goed kan toezien op de rechtmatige uitoefening van de in artikel 19a op te nemen bevoegdheid.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division endorses the bill restricting judicial prior review before intelligence services use special powers against journalists to uncover sources, but asks for alignment of the scope with the criminal-procedure bill and a broader definition of remuneration, and a source definition. The government reply accepts the source definition, broadens remuneration beyond financial payment, and declines a statutory definition of journalist, leaving the scope otherwise unchanged.
concerns: Scope of source protection must be restricted to journalists under article 10 ECHR, excluding broader categories of publicists, and the bill must align with the criminal-procedure bill.
The financial-remuneration criterion for journalists is too narrow and should include other forms of remuneration; the government broadened it in the explanatory memorandum.
The bill should define the term 'source' in line with the criminal-procedure bill to ensure legal certainty; the government adopted this definition.
The Council asked whether a statutory definition of journalist is desirable; the government declined, relying on the explanatory memorandum and case law.
The explanatory memorandum should address the journalistic ethics requirements that journalists must meet to qualify for protection; the government states this is for the profession itself to define.

34036.s: The bill abolishes the VAR-based exemption framework in the income tax act and replaces it with a 'Beschikking geen loonheffingen' (BGL) granted by the tax inspector, which exempts a client from wage withholding only if the work and conditions match those stated in the decision. It also adds shared liability for clients to verify the BGL, with the tax authority empowered to impose correction obligations or back-assessments on clients where actual conditions diverge.
34036.j: The memorandum justifies the new system by the need to restore a balance of responsibility between clients and workers and to improve enforcement against bogus self-employment.
q: With this bill, the responsibilities of the contractor and the client in assessing their working relationship are better balanced, thereby improving enforcement possibilities.

Met dit wetsvoorstel worden de verantwoordelijkheden van de opdrachtnemer en de opdrachtgever bij het beoordelen van hun arbeidsrelatie beter in balans gebracht, waardoor de mogelijkheden om te handhaven worden verbeterd.
d: rules on how the request and decision are made, possibly electronically only
further specification of the content and validity period of the decision
p: The inspector gets discretionary power to grant or refuse binding exemption decisions and the tax authority can later reclassify work relations and impose back-assessments on clients, with the burden of proof resting on the tax authority.

Replaces the old statutory exemption article with a decision-based regime and redirects social insurance eligibility references to the new article, extending the tax authority's role in determining insurance obligations.

parties: Asks whether the bill is proportionate, whether the BGL and webmodule reduce or increase administrative burden, and why it precedes the IBO on zzp'ers.
Can it be indicated to what extent the bill is proportionate for all self-employed persons, ask the VVD members?
Kan worden aangegeven in hoeverre voorliggend wetsvoorstel proportioneel is voor alle zelfstandigen, vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie?
Supports tackling sham self-employment and the better balance of responsibilities, but asks for concrete enforcement examples and clear legal limits on the anti-abuse clause in article 6a.
However, these members still have several pressing questions about the bill.
Wel hebben deze leden over voor liggend wetsvoorstel nog enkele prangende vragen.
Questions the low chance of control for zzp'ers, the workings of risk-based enforcement, and the position of intermediaries.
Is it correct that the chance of a check is only 0.2%?
Klopt het, dat de kans op controle slechts 0,2% bedraagt?
Argues the bill burdens the market with bureaucracy, is premature before the IBO, lacks an Actal advice, and asks for reconsideration.
The CDA members ask the government to reconsider this bill.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering dit wetsvoorstel te heroverwegen.
Doubts the problem the bill addresses is clear and that the webmodule can deliver certainty for individual cases.
For these members it is unclear which problem the bill intends to solve.
Voor deze leden is onduidelijk welk probleem het voorstel wil oplossen.

Asks for a justification of the bill's necessity, a clear list of criteria, transparency of the webmodule's logic, and an explanation of the inspector's discretion; fears the bill cuts bonafide clients' willingness to hire zzp'ers.
The D66 members ask the government to explain to what extent the theoretical false certainty of the current VAR system leads to actual practical problems.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering ook om toe te lichten in welke mate de theoretische schijnzekerheid van de huidige VAR-systematiek ook tot daadwerkelijke praktische problemen leidt.
Supports tackling the VAR system's uncertainty but asks how the bill relates to the IBO Zzp and how flexible the BGL system is in light of its outcome.
In addition, these members believe the approach to the VAR system should be part of a broader discussion on the position of the zzp'er in the social and fiscal system.
Daarnaast zijn deze leden van mening dat de aanpak van de VAR-syste matiek onderdeel moet zijn van een bredere gedachtewisseling over de positie van de zzp'er in het sociale en fiscale stelsel.
Asks why the previous VAR law failed, whether it was evaluated, and whether the webmodule may have an attracting effect on self-employment.
Has there been an evaluation of the Wet uitbreiding rechtsgevolgen VAR?
Is er sprake geweest van een evaluatie van de Wet uitbreiding rechtsgevolgen VAR?
Asks whether the new system creates back-tax liability for employers, whether intermediaries can keep working, and whether assessments may apply stricter criteria than the law.
Can the government confirm that in all cases the law governs Belastingdienst review, and not the underlying contract.
Kan de regering bevestigen dat in alle gevallen de wet leidend is voor toetsing door de Belastingdienst, en niet onderliggende overeenkomst.
Asks who is responsible for which aspects of a model contract and whether summary model contracts shift responsibility away from the client.
Does the government agree that if summary model contracts are approved, the balance of responsibilities between contractor and client shifts against the contractor.

Deelt de regering de mening dat indien summiere modelovereenkomsten goedgekeurd worden, de balans tussen de verantwoordelijkheden van de opdrachtnemer en de opdrachtgever richting de opdrachtnemer verschuift.
Worries that model contracts in care sector legitimise disguised employment and asks about sector minimum wages as an automatic employee test.
How does the amendment prevent the same kinds of constructions from being approved again, with no obligation to withhold payroll taxes.
Hoe voorkomt de nota van wijziging dat de zelfde soort constructies nu weer worden goedgekeurd en er geen verplichting bestaat tot het inhouden van loonheffingen.
Asks whether the Belastingdienst will publish approved contracts, whether 40 model contracts per year is workable, and how contract deviations are treated.
Does the government consider it workable, especially in the initial period, that only 40 model contracts per year can be assessed.
Acht de regering het werkbaar, vooral in de beginperiode, dat slechts 40 voorbeeldovereenkomsten per jaar beoordeeld kunnen worden.
Asks for proportionality in contract clauses and whether standard-term references must be recorded in writing.
Can the government elaborate on that, asks the PVV fractie (on proportionality of the list of contract clauses).
Kan de regering daar nog eens nader op ingaan, vragen de leden van de fractie van de PVV.

Asks who bears the burden of proof that work follows the model contract, whether back-tax covers prior years, and whether self-employed people lose entrepreneurial facilities through another contractor's status.

The D66 fractie would find it extremely undesirable if self-employed people working under a model contract lost their tax entrepreneurial facilities because another contractor was in fact an employee.

De leden van de D66-fractie zouden het uiterst onwenselijk vinden als zelfstandigen die conform een modelovereenkomst voor een bepaalde opdrachtgever werken, hun fiscale ondernemersfaciliteiten verliezen.
Asks how contractors and clients can object to an assessment of a model contract and how withdrawal of contracts is communicated.
asks for an explanation of what options clients and contractors have to object if they disagree with the assessment of a (model) contract.
vragen om een toelichting welke mogelijkheden opdrachtgevers en opdrachtnemers hebben om bezwaar te maken als zij het niet eens zijn met de beoordeling van een (voorbeeld)overeenkomst.
Asks about retroactive effects of withdrawn approvals, the Raad van State's view on the problem definition, and enforcement costs.
In its advice the Council of State stated that it is insufficiently clear which problem the bill must solve.
In haar advies gaf de Raad van State aan dat onvoldoende duidelijk is welk probleem door het wetsvoorstel moet worden opgelost.
Welcomes deregulation but asks whether the Belastingdienst can realistically check incidental deviations and whether physical controls will be intensified.
But greater freedom also brings greater responsibility, and it is for the Belastingdienst to check whether clients and contractors observe the rules.
Maar bij meer vrijheid hoort ook meer verantwoordelijkheid en het is aan de Belastingdienst om te controleren of de opdrachtgevers én opdrachtnemers hier volgens de spelregels mee omgaan.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft law replacing the VAR with a Beschikking geen loonheffingen (BGL) and making clients co-responsible, concluding the problem is unclear, the webmodule may not give advance certainty, and the bill is premature pending the zzp interdepartmental study. The government's nader rapport rejects most objections, adjusts transitional law and wording, and keeps the bill largely unchanged.
concerns: The Afdeling said it is unclear which problem the bill addresses and that the attractive effect of entrepreneurial benefits remains, which the government disputes, arguing the bill targets enforcement and balance of responsibilities.

The Afdeling said the size of the problem of sham self-employment is unclear and may be much smaller than assumed; the government accepts it cannot be precisely measured but says it is substantial enough to act.

The Afdeling doubted the webmodule can provide advance legal certainty in individual cases; the government explains the module's design and that it will be adjusted to case law, while adding a note on how it works.

The Afdeling argued removing the client's exemption from back-payment is not justified and the interdepartmental study should be awaited; the government argues certainty is preserved and enforcement needs strengthening.

The Afdeling advised that the transitional provision should avoid issuing decisions based on a not-yet-in-force provision; the government kept the transitional rule but clarified its reasoning and adjusted the cost estimate.
