The Afdeling gave several drafting suggestions on cross-references in the Wet LB 1964; the government adopted some corrections but kept the reference to article 8b(1) where it was deemed correct.

34045.s: The bill requires childcare centres, childminder agencies and playgroups to set up an internal complaints procedure, join an approved complaints committee, and strengthens parental committees' advisory rights and public reporting. It also adds a publication duty for enforcement sanctions in the childcare register.
34045.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly by the need for detailed implementation rules on complaints committees and reporting, and it stresses that the courts remain open to all parties.
q: Parents and providers always have the right to go to the civil court.
Ouders en houders hebben altijd het recht naar de burgerlijke rechter te stappen.
d: rules on dispute settlement obligations for providers, parents and parental committees
first calendar year in which the complaints report must be made
further rules on dispute resolution and the committee's regulations
further rules implementing publication of enforcement measures in the register
treating alternative parental involvement forms as a parental committee
financial grant to the complaints committee by ministerial decision
p: Enforcement sanctions against providers must be published in the public register once final, with personal data anonymised except for home addresses where care takes place there.

Providers must join an approved complaints committee whose binding advice may be reviewed by civil courts, so disputes are routed through a mandatory intermediary body before court access is preserved.

parties: Asks how the GGD will assess alternative parent consultation and how parent involvement fits with the new supervision approach, raising oversight questions without taking a clear position.
These members assume this will be assessed by the GGD, is that correct?
Deze leden gaan er vanuit dat dit door de GGD beoordeeld wordt, klopt dat?
Supports the bill's aim but questions the regulator's reliance on general CBS price data and the practical limits of switching childcare providers.
Can the government elaborate on this?
Kan de regering hier nader op in gaan?
Questions the removal of parents' advisory right on price changes and asks for detailed enforcement data, sanctions and the composition of the dispute committee.
Welcomes stronger quality advice rights but argues price advice should be kept, questions the 50-place threshold for alternative consultation and asks for a right to discuss inspection reports.
Would retaining the price advisory right not be sensible, precisely now that the advisory right on quality is being expanded?
Zou het handhaven van het adviesrecht met betrekking tot prijs niet in de rede liggen, juist nu het adviesrecht in relatie tot kwaliteit wordt uitgebreid?

Welcomes the strengthening of parents' role and the GGD inspection link, asks how annual complaint reports reach parents and whether they must be published online, and questions dropping price advice.
These members ask how this annual report reaches the parents.
Deze leden vragen hoe dit jaarverslag de ouders bereikt.
Asks for criteria for assessing alternative parent consultation and whether reduced complaint reporting weakens parents' ability to check how complaints are handled.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill strengthening parents' position in childcare but raises objections on the single complaints-and-disputes procedure before the GCK, the ADR directive, abolition of the price advisory right, and alternative parent consultation. The minister's reply largely adopts the remarks: it adds a distinction on binding advice, justifies mandatory membership, explains the price decision, and extends alternative consultation to larger facilities.
concerns: The single procedure for complaints and disputes ignores the differences between them, and the Afdeling asked why no distinction was made between non-binding recommendations and binding advice.
Mandatory affiliation with the GCK goes beyond the ADR directive and must be justified under the EU free movement and competition rules.
Mandatory GCK procedure restricts the operator's access to the courts under Article 47 of the Charter, which the explanatory memorandum did not justify.
Abolishing the parent committee's advisory right on price is insufficiently motivated, since price and quality are linked and parents have few alternatives.
Alternative parent consultation is limited to small facilities, leaving medium-sized facilities without a solution, so the scope should be reconsidered.
Redactional remarks, including a cross-reference clause with the Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg, are incorporated, except the cross-reference clause, which was handled differently.

34072.s: The bill approves the 2014 Westereems Treaty between the Netherlands and Germany on use and management of the territorial sea between 3 and 12 nautical miles, which divides competences over renewable energy installations, cables, pipelines and non-living resources along an agreed line. The explanatory memorandum says the treaty clarifies geographic competences and sets out arrangements for shipping lanes and a joint commission, without delimiting a formal sea border.
34072.j: The memorandum justifies the treaty by the need for clarity on the geographic scope of Dutch and German competences and by practical shipping and permit concerns, not by any new executive power.
q: The Westereems Treaty is important for the Netherlands. The Treaty provides clarity on the geographic scope of Dutch and German competences in the areas it covers.

Het Westereemsverdrag is voor Nederland van belang. Zo biedt het Verdrag ten aanzien van de verdeling van bevoegdheden op de in het Verdrag genoemde terreinen duidelijkheid over de geografische reikwijdte van de Nederlandse en Duitse bevoegdheden.
d: entry into force by royal decree/publication timing

parties: Asks whether the treaty is only an interim solution pending a full border treaty with Germany, given the diverging claims over the border.

The VVD members wonder whether the Westereems Treaty should therefore be seen as merely an interim solution that temporarily delimits powers until further agreements with Germany can be made on fixing the state borders in this area.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen zich af of het Westereemsverdrag daarmee moet worden gezien als slechts een tussenoplossing die tijdelijk bevoegdheden afbakent tot het moment waarop verdergaande afspraken met Duitsland kunnen worden gemaakt over het vastleggen van de staatsgrenzen in dit gebied.
Asks about financial and economic consequences for Dutch shipping and whether the border question will go to a dispute body such as the Permanent Court of Arbitration.
Will the question, for example, be submitted to the Permanent Court of Arbitration?
Zal het vraagstuk bij voorbeeld voorgelegd worden aan het Permanent Hof van Arbitrage?

34081.s: The bill raises the maximum prison term in article 210 of the Dutch Criminal Code for counterfeiting of euro and other currency from four to five years, implementing EU Directive 2014/62/EU. It enters into force on a date set by royal decree.
34081.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as implementing a mandatory EU directive, and it does not justify the entry-into-force delegation.
q: This act enters into force on a date to be determined by royal decree.
Deze wet treedt in werking op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip.
d: setting entry-into-force date by royal decree

parties: Accepts EU-prescribed minimum maximum sentences only, insisting that the Member States keep primacy over criminalisation and setting maximum penalties.
The VVD members will never accept that maximum penalties are proposed or imposed at European level.
De leden van de VVD-fractie zullen nooit accepteren dat in Europees verband maximale straffen worden voorgesteld of opgelegd.
Asks about the scale of counterfeiting in the Netherlands, police and prosecution priorities, online offers, and whether investigative powers are adequate and fully used.
According to the government, does the statutory criminal procedure framework provide enough powers for adequate investigation, and are these powers also being used to the maximum?
Biedt het wettelijk strafvorderlijk kader volgens de regering genoeg bevoegdheden voor adequate opsporing en worden deze bevoegdheden ook maximaal benut?

34090.s: The bill amends the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure and the Economic Offences Act to allow electronic submission of complaints, requests, notices of appeal, briefs, declarations of attorney and crime reports, and to permit electronic signatures and verification of document integrity for criminal case files. It delegates the detailed rules for the electronic facilities and signature requirements to general administrative orders (AMvB).
34090.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB delegations by the need for flexibility to keep pace with technological and European developments in electronic signatures and facilities.
q: Because it cannot now be predicted which further developments will occur, it is preferable to regulate the electronic signature in lower regulation.
Omdat thans niet is te voorspellen welke nadere ontwikkelingen zich in de toekomst zullen voordoen, verdient het de voorkeur de elektronische handtekening in lagere regelgeving te regelen.
d: designation of electronic facility for submitting complaints
designation of electronic facility for requests by suspect
requirements for electronic signatures and authentication reliability level
designation of electronic facility for crime reports
designation of electronic facility for written opposition to penal orders and further rules
designation of electronic facility for appeal briefs and further rules
designation of electronic facility for transfer of power of attorney and further rules
designation of electronic facility for complaints by interested parties
I-Q (art. 552ab(2) Sv) and art. 51b(5) Sv (via explanatory memorandum)
rules on manner in which access to case files is granted
designation of electronic facility for requests under the Economic Offences Act
p: Removes the statutory basis for specific requirements on the electronic police report, shifting such detail to general rules.
Requires only that integrity of electronic case files can be checked, leaving method and technique open and to later rules.

parties: Asks about the relation to the eID scheme and to parallel civil and administrative digitisation bills, and about cost overruns.
Should the introduction of the eID scheme encounter hurdles, what would be the consequences for this bill?
Mocht inwerkingtreding van het eID Stelsel hobbels ondervinden, wat zijn dan de gevolgen voor onderhavig wetsvoorstel?
Supports digitisation but asks who monitors technical developments and security, and whether officials and courts can detect technical problems.
Who is responsible for monitoring those technical developments and decides that changes to the previously established security must be renewed or adapted?
Wie is verantwoordelijk voor het in de gaten houden van die technische ontwikkelingen en bepaalt dat wijziging van de eerder vastgestelde beveiliging vernieuwd of aangepast moet worden?
Raises concerns about implementation readiness, lack of a fallback channel if the system fails, data protection, security controls and access for detainees and suspects.
Why is there no emergency channel if the system unexpectedly fails?
Waarom is er geen noodkanaal als het systeem onverhoopt faalt?
Questions the 2016 timeline, government steering of the programme, the optional rather than mandatory digital procedure for professionals, and the handling of paper documents and archiving.

These members refer to their earlier objections to the proposed coexistence of digital and paper documents and request that the government formulate as the legal starting point that criminal case files are made available digitally.

Deze leden verwijzen op dit punt naar hun eerdere bezwaren over de voorgestelde nevenschikking van digitale en papieren stukken en verzoeken de regering om als wettelijk uitgangspunt te formuleren dat strafdossiers digitaal ter beschikking worden gesteld.
Asks about citizens who will continue to use paper, the realism of the timeline, and measures against fraud and privacy breaches.
Which concrete measures are taken to prevent possible fraud with personal data and criminal case files?
Voorts vragen deze leden welke concrete maatregelen worden genomen om mogelijke fraude met persoonsgegevens en strafrechtdossiers te voorkomen.
Asks how people without DigiD can still report crimes, how the integrity duty will be checked, and whether a fallback to paper exists during prolonged failures.
How does the government ensure sufficient options for persons without DigiD to file a report?
Op welke wijze zorgt de regering voor voldoende mogelijkheden voor personen die niet over DigiD beschikken om aangifte te doen?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the digital court documents bill but raises doubts about implementing it by 2016, the financial analysis, electronic reporting for all offences, and termination-of-time-limit rules. The minister's reply largely accepts the points on phased entry into force, cost explanation and time-limit rules, and explains why other points are not followed.
concerns: The Council doubts the feasibility of implementing digital exchange of court documents by 2016 and asks for justification or a later date; the government keeps 2016 but adds phased entry into force.
The Council asks for a substantiated cost estimate and savings analysis; the government argues the bill itself has little direct cost and explains where costs will fall.

The Council asks that the desirability of electronic reporting for all offences, including complaint offences, be justified and that capacity effects for police and justice be considered; the government addresses both in the explanatory memorandum.
The Council asks that the rule on excusable time-limit overruns caused by system failures be reconsidered; the government reinstates a rule by general administrative order.

The Council asks for clarity on responsibilities between the prosecution service and the judiciary for digital case files; the government declines a statutory change but commits to further arrangements.
Redactional comments on the draft text are largely adopted, with one exception on the delegation wording in article 138f.

34108.s: The bill tightens enforcement against sham constructions by employers: it requires giro payment and transparent payslips for minimum wage, bans most deductions from the minimum wage, extends chain liability for unpaid wages to principals and clients, and makes the labour inspectorate's findings public with naming. It also lets collectively agreed rules be extended, adds information sharing with social partners, and strengthens identity checks for foreign workers.
34108.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to set detailed technical rules on publication and payment designations, with consultation of the Raad van State noted.
q: By general administrative order, further rules are set on the data to be made public, including the affected party's possible reaction, the timing and the manner of publication.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur worden nadere regels gesteld met betrekking tot de openbaar te maken gegevens
d: designating payment obligations for which workers may authorise employer payments from wages
designating worker payment obligations eligible for employer-paid deductions by written power of attorney
rules on publication of inspection data, including reaction of affected parties and timing
Artikel V A (art. 29b lid 3) / VI (art. 8:8 lid 3) / VII (art. 15b lid 3)
rules on publication of inspection findings under Arbowet, Arbeidstijdenwet and Waadi
rules on publication of inspection findings under the Wet arbeid vreemdelingen
p: Inspectors are empowered to publicly name employers found in violation, subject to reaction period, suspension during interim relief, and privacy exceptions.
Employers must establish identities of suspected workers within 48 hours of an inspector's demand, replacing an inspanningsverplichting with a result obligation.
Chain liability extends unpaid-wage claims to principals, with a non-attributability defence and limited information duties; this shifts protection toward workers rather than the executive.
Extensions of collective agreement declarations are limited to one year and require all parties to request them.

parties: Questions whether naming companies before appeal is proportionate and asks what safeguards exist against reputational harm.
Publication is a heavy instrument because it leads to a reputational problem for a company with all possible consequences, such as falling turnover and in the extreme bankruptcy.
Openbaarmaking is een zwaar middel want het leidt tot een imagoprobleem van een bedrijf met alle mogelijke gevolgen van dien zoals omzetdaling met in het uiterste geval faillissement.
Welcomes the bill as a way to curb exploitation and unfair competition, asking mainly for clarification on publication and minimum holiday allowance payment.
Too often foreign workers are exploited, bona fide companies are undercut by unfair competition on working conditions, and Dutch workers are crowded out of the labour market.
Te vaak worden buitenlandse arbeidskrachten uitgebuit, bonafide bedrijven door oneerlijke concurrentie op arbeidsvoorwaarden weggeconcurreerd en Nederlandse werknemers van de arbeidsmarkt verdrongen.
Asks why delegation to general administrative orders allows exceptions to the ban on deductions and requests a prior-consultation procedure for any such decree.
The members note that the bill contains a delegation provision whereby deductions and withholdings may be permitted by general administrative order.
De leden constateren dat het wetsvoorstel een delegatiebepaling bevat waardoor bij algemene maatregel van bestuur verrekeningen en inhoudingen wel toegestaan worden.
Supports the aim but questions effectiveness and administrative burden, asks why Actal was not consulted, and raises doubts about enforcement capacity.
What does the government think of the Council of State's expressed doubts about the effectiveness of this bill and its advice to seek alternative solutions?
Wat vindt de regering van de geuite twijfels van de Raad van State over de effectiviteit van dit wetsvoorstel en van het advies om te zoeken naar alternatieve oplossingen?
Stresses proportionality and administrative burden, asks whether Actal advice was sought, and questions whether enforcement capacity is adequate.
That said, the members speaking are of the view that the proposed measures must be proportionate.
Dit neemt niet weg, dat de aan het woord zijnde leden van mening zijn dat de voorgestelde maatregelen proportioneel moeten zijn.
Asks for evidence of effectiveness of chain liability abroad and how the position of migrant workers unfamiliar with their rights is protected.
The members want to know how account is taken of the position of migrant workers, who are less familiar with their rights regarding, among other things, the minimum wage and complaint procedures.
De genoemde leden willen weten op welke wijze rekening gehouden wordt met de positie van arbeidsmigranten, die minder goed bekend zijn met hun rechten over o.a. het minimumloon en klachtenprocedures.
Worries about rising burdens and uncertainty for employers from chain liability and asks for guarantees for employers who have acted responsibly.
They ask for additional guarantees for employers, given that it is regularly found that culpability is stretched in enforcement so that employers are blamed when this cannot reasonably be sustained.

Zij vragen om aanvullende waarborgen die werkgevers tegemoet kunnen komen, gelet op het feit dat met enige regelmaat wordt geconstateerd dat verwijtbaarheid in de handhaving dusdanig wordt opgerekt dat werkgevers verwijtbaarheid wordt verweten terwijl dat redelijkerwijs niet is vol te houden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion of 16 October 2014 on the Wet aanpak schijnconstructies advises against the proposed chain liability for unpaid wages, citing doubts about effectiveness, complexity, and the treatment of migrant workers, and raises objections on publication of inspection sanctions. The government's nader rapport of 11 December 2014 largely accepts the criticisms by adding a joint liability for the employer and its direct client, clarifying the non-attributability defence, and expanding information on migrant workers, while retaining the core chain-liability design and the binding publication regime.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the effectiveness and necessity of chain liability for unpaid wages and advises considering alternatives; the government keeps the scheme but strengthens it with joint liability for the direct client.

The Afdeling finds the chain-liability scheme with its sequential procedures and exceptions complex and costly for workers and unions to use; the government simplifies it somewhat but keeps sequential liability above the direct client.

The vague non-attributability (niet-verwijtbaarheid) defence for clients is likely to cause disputes; the government clarifies it in the explanatory memorandum with a non-exhaustive list of circumstances.
The choice of law provision duplicates the Rome I Regulation; the government accepts removing the conflict rule and instead adding a mandatory-application clause.

The Afdeling argues the binding obligation to publish sanction decisions must allow individual balancing and review under the Wob exceptions and Article 8 ECHR; the government refuses, arguing transparency must prevail.

Publication of inspection data where no violation was found is worded too broadly compared with the explanatory memorandum; the government commits to align the text and address the scope of data published.
Points on minimum wage for AOW recipients, verification of worker identity under the Wet arbeid vreemdelingen, and publication of the employer's reaction are raised in remaining sections.

34117.s: The bill introduces a new type of pension fund, the algemeen pensioenfonds, which may run multiple pension schemes for different employers, sectors or professions, each in a separate ring-fenced asset pool. It requires a DNB licence before operation, sets governance rules per collectiviteitkring, and phases out the existing multi-opf within five years.
34117.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated rules by the need for standardisation and a workable licence procedure, and says the rules will be elaborated with the supervisory authorities involved.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative order, further rules are set regarding this article, including on the application, the procedure, the circumstances that may lead to amendment or revocation of the licence, and working capital.

Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur worden nadere regels gesteld met betrekking tot dit artikel die onder meer betrekking hebben op de aanvraag, de procedure, de omstandigheden die kunnen leiden tot het wijzigen of intrekken van de vergunning en het werkkapitaal.
d: rules on costs and quality-of-service agreements of general pension funds
licence application, procedure, grounds for amending or revoking licence, working capital
II, onderdeel B (art. 4a, lid 2 and 6 Wvb)
rules on costs and quality-of-service agreements for general funds running occupational pension schemes
DNB may attach conditions and restrictions to the licence
p: DNB is given discretion to attach conditions to, amend or revoke the general pension fund licence in light of the interests the Act protects.
Detailed rules on costs charged to pension savers are left to a general administrative order.

parties: Asks why existing funds were not adapted or merged, the scope of licensing, and how representation in governance bodies per collectivity would work.
Why was it not chosen to adapt the existing ones, ask these members.
Waarom is er niet voor gekozen om de reeds bestaande aan te passen, zo vragen deze leden.
Supports the Apf's potential but asks for clarity on cost-reimbursement limits, working capital and governance safeguards, and opposes profit-making legal forms.
These members strongly favour that the Apf can only take the form of a foundation.
Deze leden zijn er groot voorstander van dat het Apf alleen de rechtsvorm van een stichting kan hebben.
Asks what the AMvB on licensing and cost recovery will contain and whether the new rules add administrative burden.
The members ask the government about the content of the AMvB setting rules on the information to be provided with the licence application.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering naar de inhoud van de AMvB waarin regels worden gesteld over de gegevens die moeten worden verstrekt bij de aanvraag van de verplicht gestelde vergunning.
Says the multi-client model is insufficiently elaborated and that the government's argument against independent governance models is ideological rather than substantive.
That argument seems to these members ideologically charged rather than substantively grounded.
Dat argument komt de hier aan het woord zijnde leden voor als ideologisch geladen in plaats van inhoudelijk onderbouwd.
Asks how supervision of multiple schemes within one Apf will work, whether member consent is needed, and whether foreign-founded Apfs are desirable.
How does supervision work for the different schemes within an Apf, for example regarding balanced representation of interests?
Hoe gaat het toezicht in z'n werk, op de verschillende regelingen binnen een Apf, bijvoorbeeld op het punt van evenwichtige belangenbehartiging?
Asks how the relationship among multiple governance bodies is organised, how DNB's role in merging collectivities works, and whether profit-making forms risk member interests.
These members ask whether the government can elaborate on the relationship between the various stakeholder or accountability bodies within one Apf.
Deze leden vragen of de regering nader kan ingaan op de verhouding tussen de verschillende belanghebbendenorganen of verantwoordingsorganen bij één Apf.
Supports the Apf but asks whether an accountability body suffices or whether members and pensioners need consent rights over their contributions, and warns against extra licensing burden.
Would it not be logical to give all stakeholders, participants and pensioners, consent rights over how the pension money they contributed is handled?
Ligt het niet in de rede, om alle belanghebbenden, deelnemers en gepensioneerden, instemmingsrechten te geven over de wijze waarop met de door hen ingebrachte pensioengelden wordt omgegaan?

Asks about perverse incentives from transfers during coverage deficits, the possibility for mandatory sector funds to combine, the fiscal treatment of CDC schemes, and the basis of the license cost estimate.
The VVD members ask whether, where there is a coverage shortfall and a fund moves to an existing collectivity group, this should lead to an immediate reduction in benefits.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of wanneer er een dekkingstekort is en een fonds naar een bestaande collectiviteitkring gaat, zou dit tot onmiddellijke korting moeten leiden.

Urges swift introduction, asks about the timing of DNB's future analysis, conditions for mandatory sector fund mergers, and wants monitoring of the governance model choice that supervisors advised against.
Nevertheless the members consider it important to keep this situation under observation, also because both supervisors advised choosing only between two independent models.

Desalniettemin vinden de leden het belangrijk dat deze situatie in de gaten wordt gehouden, ook omdat beide toezichthouders in hun advies hebben aangegeven om alleen te kiezen voor twee onafhankelijke modellen.

Finds the pension system too complex and wants a full overview of all pension types, vehicles and governance models; questions the usefulness and necessity of the new vehicle and the VAT treatment reasoning.
The CDA members generally believe the pension system has become far too complicated and grows more complex with each bill.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn over het algemeen van mening dat het pensioenstelsel veel, maar dan ook veel te ingewikkeld geworden is en met ieder wetsvoorstel ingewikkelder wordt.

Asks whether a paritair board can be retained when new groups join, how an independent board interacts with employer representation, how the government will handle expansion of statutory scope, and about administrative burden.
Can the government explain how these sector signals relate to its expectation that the administrative burden will be limited and one-off?
Kan de regering toelichten hoe deze signalen van de sector zich verhouden tot háár verwachting dat de administratieve lastendruk beperkt en slechts eenmalig zal zijn?
Asks about the risk of further postponement, the mandatory employer representation for closed funds, separate rings for voluntary schemes, and alternatives for mandatory sector funds.
These members ask for an explanation of whether the government sees short-term options to offer alternatives for mandatory sector pension funds.
Deze leden vragen om een toelichting of de regering voor verplichtgestelde bedrijfstakpensioenfondsen op korte termijn mogelijkheden ziet om andere alternatieven aan te bieden.

34126.s: The bill amends the Criminal Code's rules on concurrence of offences (Article 57, 58, 60, 63): it raises the maximum combined sentence for multiple offences from one third to one half above the highest maximum, and limits the deduction for earlier convictions in later sentencing to the first final conviction. It also lets judges impose a combined sentence absorbing earlier sentences and adds a provision to the Code of Criminal Procedure on execution of such sentences.
34126.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by arguing that judges need more room to impose a passende straf in multiple-offence cases, following research by Leiden University and the government coalition agreement.
q: The judge may, if this is desirable in the interest of proper administration of justice, impose a combined sentence in which the earlier imposed sentence is absorbed.
De rechter kan, indien dat in het belang van een goede rechtspleging wenselijk is, een gezamenlijke straf opleggen waarin de eerder opgelegde straf oplost.
p: Sentencing discretion of judges is widened by counting only the first final earlier conviction, which shifts sentencing power toward the courts rather than the executive.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the bill revising the rules on concurrence of offences (meerdaadse samenloop) but objects to the per-offence sentencing provision and to the treatment of earlier convictions under article 63 Sr, advising revision. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts the advice: the per-offence provision is dropped, the explanatory memorandum is aligned with the bill text, and it clarifies how a joint sentence absorbs earlier sentences.
concerns: The Afdeling objects that the per-offence sentencing provision would create a shadow effect pressing judges to justify not using it, and that no need to change current practice was shown, so it advises dropping it.
The Afdeling warns that per-offence sentencing would lengthen requisitoirs, pleadings and hearings and increase workload, undermining balanced criminal procedure.

The explanatory memorandum says judges may consider all earlier sentences, which conflicts with the bill text limiting regard to the first irrevocable conviction; the memorandum is to be brought into line with the text.
The memorandum is unclear whether earlier sentences are reconsidered when a joint sentence absorbs them, and the Afdeling asks for clarification, which the government adds.
Redactional remarks on wording and structure of articles I, 57, 60 and 63 are adopted.

34144.s: The bill removes the regional early-school-leaver reporting and coordination function (RMC) from the Dutch Caribbean education laws, keeping only the reporting obligation, and redirects early school leavers into the Social Opportunity Trajectories Act (WSKJ BES) with a revised definition, age limit raised to 25, and a clearer intake procedure. It also makes technical and redactional amendments, including changes to the civil service law references, the use of the personal number by public bodies, and supervision by the Inspectorate.
34144.j: The memorandum justifies removing duplicate RMC provisions and the mandatory control protocol as unnecessary, since municipal boards can shape accountability themselves.
q: On reflection, it is not necessary for the central government to give rules on the financial accountability between the municipal board and the implementing body.
Bij nader inzien is het niet nodig dat er vanuit het Rijk voorschriften worden gegeven ten aanzien van de financiële verantwoording tussen het bestuurscollege en de uitvoeringsinstantie.
d: Artikel III, onderdeel I (artikel 13 WSKJ BES)
maximum costs of social opportunity trajectories
Artikel III, onderdeel B (artikel 4 WSKJ BES, via artikel 3.4 WEB BES reference)
agreement between person and implementing body on trajectory content
p: Artikel III, onderdeel K (artikel 15 WSKJ BES)

The bill removes the imperative requirement for a national control protocol on financial accountability between the municipal board and the implementing body, leaving accountability to the local board, while the Minister keeps the right to inspect control reports on request.

parties: Asks what a social chance trajectory involves, whether it leads to a starting qualification, and whether participants receive a benefit as well as the allowance.
The VVD members would like to know exactly what a social chance trajectory entails.
De leden van de VVD-fractie willen graag weten wat een sociaal kanstraject precies inhoudt.

Supports the Caribbean-focused approach but asks about effectiveness and adequacy of allowances, and asks whether a maximum on trajectory costs will be set by ministerial regulation within five years.
They do ask the government to address the effectiveness of the chance trajectories and the options to further improve them.
Wel vragen zij de regering in te gaan op de effectiviteit van de kanstrajecten en de mogelijkheden om de trajecten verder te verbeteren.

Asks how the WSKJ BES functions, how many participants succeed, and asks the government to explain why no national rules on financial accountability between the bestuurscollege and implementing bodies are needed.
Said members ask the government to further explain why this is not necessary and why the bestuurscollege can give form to that accountability.
Genoemde leden vragen de regering nader toe te lichten waarom dat niet noodzakelijk is en waarom het bestuurscollege die verantwoording vorm kan geven.
Supports removing duplicate provision, but asks whether early school leavers could fall between the BES social chance act and the education laws.

However, these members ask the government for further explanation on whether it is possible that early school leavers could fall between two stools because they would fall under the Wet sociale kanstrajecten BES instead of the education laws.

Wel vragen deze leden nog een extra toelichting aan de regering of het mogelijk is dat vsv-ers 3 tussen wal en schip kunnen vallen doordat zij onder de Wet sociale kanstrajecten BES gaan vallen in plaats van onder de onderwijswetten.

Asks the government to explain the effectiveness of the trajectories and how notification of early school leavers by schools and parents will work in the new situation, and when the amendment takes effect.
They ask the government to explain in more detail how the reporting of early school leavers by schools and parents will work exactly in the new situation.
Zij vragen de regering nader toe te lichten hoe het melden van voortijdig schoolverlaters voor scholen en voor ouders precies verloopt in de nieuwe situatie.

34162.s: The bill abolishes the separate status of rechter in opleiding and officier in opleiding in the Wet rechtspositie rechterlijke ambtenaren and related laws, treating all trainee judges and prosecutors as rechterlijk ambtenaar employed by a court or prosecution office for the duration of training. It introduces a new salary category 9a, transfers employer and functional authority roles from the rector and Raad voor de rechtspraak to the court board or prosecutor, and leaves detailed training rules to an algemene maatregel van bestuur.
34162.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the wish of the Raad voor de rechtspraak and College van procureurs-generaal to modernise training and by the budget cut to the raio programme, and states that the content was agreed with the sector commission.
q: This bill amends the Wet rechtspositie rechterlijke ambtenaren (Wrra) and several related laws.
Dit wetsvoorstel behelst een wijziging van de Wet rechtspositie rechterlijke ambtenaren (Wrra) alsmede van enige aanverwante wetten
d: professional requirements for judicial officials via general administrative order
further rules on appointment of judicial officials
appointment of trainee judges and officers by ministerial decision
p: Removes the Raad voor de rechtspraak's role over trainee judges and shifts pay and related powers for trainee prosecutors to the Minister of Justice and Security, who is budget-responsible.
Artikel I, onderdeel J/K (art. 13 and 14 Wrra)
Minister may depart from salary rules for judicial officials only on proposal of or after advice from the functional authority, a limited safeguard.

parties: Asks whether the Tweede Kamer can still amend the bill after the binding consultation agreement under article 51 of the Wet rechtspositie rechterlijke ambtenaren, and how that relates to the right of amendment.
Are the members of the VVD fractie entitled to submit an amendment to a bill on which an agreement has already been reached under article 51 of the Wet rechtspositie rechterlijke ambtenaren?

Zijn de leden van de VVD-fractie gerechtigd om een amendement in te dienen op een wetsvoorstel waarover al een akkoord is bereikt op grond van artikel 51 van de Wet rechtspositie rechterlijke ambtenaren?
Shares the bill's starting points, notes it was agreed with the Rvdr, the NVvR and the OM, and asks mainly about the separated training and internships.

They share the starting points of the bill and note that it was drawn up in consultation with and with the approval of the Rvdr, the Dutch Association of Judges and the public prosecution service (OM).

Zij delen de uitgangspunten van het wetsvoorstel en constateren dat het in overleg en met instemming van de Rvdr, de Nederlandse Vereniging van Rechters en het openbaar ministerie (OM) tot stand is gekomen.
Asks how trainee judges appointed as rechter-plaatsvervanger after months will be supervised, and raises the unresolved dismissal-for-underperformance procedure that the Raad van State flagged.

Both the Raad van State advisory division and the Rvdr point to this and, where necessary, want a specific dismissal ground in the Wet rechtspositie rechterlijke ambtenaren for the rechter-plaatsvervanger who is also a trainee judge and has achieved insufficient training results.

Zowel de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State als de Rvdr wijzen hierop en willen zo nodig een specifieke ontslaggrond in de Wet rechtspositie rechterlijke ambtenaren voor de rechter-plaatsvervanger die tevens rechter in opleiding is en die onvoldoende opleidingsresultaten behaald heeft.
Asks whether a specific dismissal ground should be added as the Raad van State advised, and asks for data on intake and training places before and after the 2011 shortening.

The CDA members also ask the government what is against adding, as the Raad van State advisory division recommended, a specific dismissal ground in the Wet rechtspositie rechterlijke ambtenaren for the rechter-plaatsvervanger who is also a trainee judge and has achieved insufficient training results.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering ook wat er op tegen is om zoals de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State heeft geadviseerd een specifieke ontslaggrond in de Wet rechtspositie rechterlijke ambtenaren op te nemen voor de rechter-plaatsvervanger die tevens rechter in opleiding is en die onvoldoende opleidingsresultaten behaald heeft.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill reforming judicial training for judges and public prosecutors but objects that the explanatory memorandum does not adequately address dismissal of a trainee judge who is also a substitute judge after insufficient training results, and advises clarifying this or adding a specific dismissal ground. The government's reply accepts the objection, clarifies that dismissal for objective unsuitability applies, adds motivation requirements for dismissal after two years of non-appointment, and adds conflict clauses and a redactional fix.
concerns: Dismissal of a substitute judge for the mere fact of two years of non-appointment is insufficient grounds and was removed from the bill's logic, with the government stating motivation is required.
Discretionary control by the functional authority over appointments could undermine judicial independence without reviewable motivation, which the government accepted.

The advisory division noted that the ground of unsuitability is strictly interpreted, so a separate dismissal ground for insufficient training results may be needed; the government clarified rather than created a new ground.
The bill should be drafted as an amendment to the current Wrra with a conflict clause, since it textually depends on another pending bill.

34207.s: The bill amends Book 7 of the Dutch Civil Code on double agency (dubbele lastgeving) in brokerage contracts, so that the mandatory no-fee rule for consumer buyers and tenants also applies when the intermediary is not entitled to remuneration, and extends the rule to brokerage agreements. It also removes the carve-out wording in the rule's second sentence.
34207.j: The memorandum justifies the amendment as clarifying the existing double-agency rules and protecting consumer buyers and tenants, without delegating new powers.
q: So it is that We, having heard the Advisory Division of the Council of State and in joint consultation with the States General, have resolved and decreed as follows.
Zo is het, dat Wij, de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State gehoord, en met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan

parties: Asks for estimates of the problem's size, the ACM's enforcement record, and whether the rules on permitted fees are sufficiently transparent and clear.
How often has the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) intervened in recent years in such violations and in particular in the mentioned excessive fees?
Hoe vaak heeft de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (hierna: ACM) de afgelopen jaren opgetreden bij dergelijke overtredingen en in het bijzonder bij de genoemde excessieve vergoedingen?

Doubts that the clarified prohibition will be effective and argues violations should be treated as unfair trading practices so consumers can obtain refunds via a complaint to the ACM rather than through court.
In the view of these members, especially after the clarification of the law, violations of the said prohibition should be characterised as unfair trading practices.
Naar de mening van deze leden zouden – zeker na de verduidelijking van de wet – overtredingen van het genoemde verbod gekenmerkt dienen te worden als oneerlijke handelspraktijken.
Asks how often the ACM has enforced and fined, how many tenants and buyers have recovered fees, and what concrete steps will inform victims of their right to reclaim unlawfully paid fees.
Asks whether the government knows the extent of violations, how often the ACM has enforced, and whether the rules on the mandate agreement are now fully clarified.
These members ask whether the government has insight into the extent to which the ban on double brokerage fees is being violated.
Deze leden vragen of de regering zicht heeft op de mate waarin het verbod op dubbele bemiddelingskosten wordt overtreden.

34216.s: The bill approves the 2015 headquarters agreement between the Netherlands and the United Nations for the International Residual Mechanism for Criminal Tribunals seated in The Hague. It takes effect on the first day of the third calendar month after publication in the Staatsblad.

parties: The VVD asks the government to respond to an article claiming thousands of Dutch nationals who pay premiums are excluded from Dutch social security, and what measures have been taken to change this.
What measures have been taken since this article appeared to change this undesirable situation for Dutch nationals who pay premiums but are excluded from social security in the Netherlands?

Welke maatregelen zijn er genomen sinds het verschijnen van dit artikel om deze onwenselijke situatie te veranderen voor Nederlanders die wel premies betalen, maar uitgesloten zijn van sociale zekerheid in Nederland?

34234.s: The bill amends the Tobacco Act to implement EU Directive 2014/40/EU on tobacco and related products, extending rules on product composition, packaging, advertising, sales and online sales to electronic cigarettes and refill containers. It adds delegation powers allowing detailed rules, including emission limits, data submission, advertising restrictions and online sales conditions, to be set by general administrative order (AMvB) or ministerial regulation, and creates a ministerial power to prohibit products that comply with the law.
34234.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to set technical rules and policy choices that cannot yet be fixed, and to keep implementation of the directive from being delayed.
q: In addition, this bill creates delegation bases so that the rules can be elaborated by general administrative order and by ministerial regulation.
Daarnaast worden met dit wetsvoorstel delegatiegrondslagen gecreëerd, zodat bij algemene maatregel van bestuur en bij ministeriële regeling de regels kunnen worden uitgewerkt.
d: product emission limits, ingredients and technical requirements
requirements for packaging and external packaging
rules on images on packaging aimed at EEA consumers
content of leaflet in packaging of e-cigarettes and refills
content, timing and method of data submission and required studies
exemption of small and medium enterprises from studies
publication of submitted documents and data
rules for system collecting information on health effects of e-cigarettes
designation of goods and services aimed at minors restricted in specialist shops
rules on use of brand names and symbols across tobacco and e-cigarette products
Artikel 5, vierde lid (ministerial regulation for shop-display advertising)
requirements for advertising at point of sale in specialist shops
ban on vending machine sales of tobacco, e-cigarettes and refills
prohibition or conditions on cross-border and domestic distance selling
temporary measures against specific e-cigarettes posing serious health risk
ban on categories of compliant tobacco or related products to protect public health
levying of fees for inspections, checks and assessments
p: The minister may by ministerial regulation ban specific products that comply with the act when a serious health risk is suspected, on a reasonable-grounds standard, without parliamentary involvement.
Supervisors may impose enforcement orders under administrative coercion to enforce the new product and online-sale rules.
A general administrative order may prohibit or condition cross-border and domestic distance selling, with the choice on a prohibition deferred to later executive decision.

parties: Asks how the government will apply Directive exemptions and handle e-cigarette rules and the scientific findings, and questions the discretion in delegated maximum emission and method rules.
The VVD members ask what scope the Tobacco Products Directive offers for innovative products such as e-cigarettes that can help smokers quit smoking.</evidence_en>
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen welke ruimte de Tabaksproductenrichtlijn biedt voor innovatieve producten – zoals elektronische sigaretten – die rokers kunnen helpen bij het stoppen met roken.
Wants stronger tobacco-deterrence measures, questions the lack of statutory rules for non-nicotine e-cigarettes, and doubts that industry self-monitoring and enforcement are adequate.

These members find the absence of statutory provisions for non-nicotine e-cigarettes very worrying, especially since research shows non-nicotine substances also contain ingredients and chemical impurities.</evidence_en>

Deze leden vinden het ontbreken van wettelijke bepalingen voor niet-nicotinehoudende e-sigaretten heel zorgelijk, zeker nu uit onderzoek blijkt dat ook niet-nicotinehoudende stoffen ingrediënten en chemische onzuiverheden bevatten.
Argues the bill does not go far enough (plain packaging, display ban, retail restrictions) and objects that the Raad van State noted a broad use of delegation to lower-level rules.

The bill departs from the European directive on some points in this respect. The reason given, that it is not obligatory to implement all the directive's provisions, these members find weak.</evidence_en>

Het wetsvoorstel wijkt in dit opzicht op enkele onderdelen af van de Europese richtlijn. De reden die hiervoor gegeven wordt, namelijk dat het niet verplicht is alle voorschriften uit de richtlijn uit te voeren, vinden deze leden zwak.
Asks about enforcement by the NVWA and RIVM, the choice between administrative and criminal enforcement, and whether the consultation omission was justified.
The CDA members ask how many full-time staff are currently engaged in supervision and enforcement.</evidence_en>
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen hoeveel fte’s zich nu bezig houden met het toezicht en de handhaving.
Asks about the intended implementation date, approaches to e-cigarette health risks and youth, and which sanctions Dutch law will provide.
These members would like to hear from the government which implementation date is specifically intended here in the Netherlands.</evidence_en>
Deze leden horen graag van de regering welke implementatiedatum, hier in Nederland, specifiek beoogd is.
Asks why a sales ban was not chosen over registration for cross-border distance sales, how delegated rules will be made, and how the Chamber will be informed of ministerial-regulation provisions.
In what way will the Chamber be kept informed of all articles that will still be further implemented through ministerial regulation?</evidence_en>
Op welke wijze zal de Kamer op de hoogte gehouden worden van alle artikelen die nog nader via ministeriële regeling zullen worden geïmplementeerd?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised proceeding with the bill implementing the EU Tobacco Products Directive but asked for better justification of broader delegation powers, a fuller EU-law (free movement) justification for the national e-cigarette age limit and advertising ban, and clarification of the definition of cigar. The Staatssecretaris's nader rapport largely accepted these points by adding justifications, aligning definitions, and making drafting changes.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that broader discretionary delegation powers in articles 2(1) and 3b(1) be justified, since the directive requires them in a narrower way; the government explained the discretion in the explanatory memorandum but kept the broad formulation.

The Afdeling asked for a fuller assessment against EU free-movement rules and the proportionality of the national age limit for e-cigarettes and the advertising ban; the government added justification referring to health risks and case law.
The Afdeling asked that the cigar definition follow Directive 2011/64/EU literally for consistency with the Excise Act, and the government made the drafting adjustments.
The Afdeling asked for various redactional changes, including uniform use of policy-terms and a definition of distributor, which the government incorporated.
The Afdeling asked for clarity on enforcement of the e-cigarette age limit given cross-border purchases; the government explained risk-based enforcement and supplemented the memorandum.

34243.s: The bill amends the Dutch collective rights management supervision act to transpose EU Directive 2014/26/EU on collective management of copyright and multi-territorial music licensing. It sets governance, transparency, revenue distribution and cross-border licensing duties for collective management organisations, and revises the supervisory and dispute-resolution framework run by the College van Toezicht.
34243.j: The memorandum justifies delegation as necessary for faithful transposition of the directive while keeping the existing Dutch supervisory model intact.
q: The starting point for implementation is a faithful transposition of the directive.
Uitgangspunt bij implementatie is een getrouwe omzetting van de richtlijn.
d: detailed rules on governance, reporting, deductions, unclaimed funds and representativeness
supervision by College van Toezicht of organisational adequacy
Artikel I, D (Artikel 3, eerste lid, onderdeel d)
format and deadlines for user information on rights use
composition, procedures and funding of dispute committee
p: Broad power for AMvB rules on collective management organisations, subject to a parliamentary pre-consultation period.
Removes the earlier investment ban and relies on directive standards for prudent investment instead.
Minister appoints the dispute committee and sets its rules; arbitration results become binding if not taken to court within three months.

parties: Asks whether the bill strengthens members' democratic control over collecting societies and whether transparency reports and the AMvB will be submitted to parliament.
This bill places them in a better position to democratically control the collecting societies and also strengthens the governance structure.
Dit wetsvoorstel stelt hen beter in staat de cbo's democratisch te controleren en versterkt daarnaast de governancestructuur.
Wants broader and stronger public supervision of collecting societies, and insists rights holders have the final say on undistributed funds and that the College's enforcement tools are adequate.
Above all, these members believe that the rightsholders, for whom management and distribution exist, should have the final say in this regard.
Bovenal zijn deze leden van mening dat de rechthebbenden, om wie beheer en uitkering draaien, het laatste woord dienen te hebben in dit verband.
Asks why fixing purposes for undistributed funds is justified by faster spending, and why independent managers face different transparency and accountability requirements.
They ask the government to justify why fixing the purposes for undistributed funds is warranted by the time saved in spending them.
Zij vragen de regering te motiveren waarom het vastleggen van de doelen waaraan de onverdeelde gelden moeten worden besteed wordt gerechtvaardigd door de tijdwinst bij de besteding van deze gelden.
Asks why the government does not follow Platform Makers and VOICE on restricting undistributed funds to rightsholders, and about the investment ban and the WNT pay regime for collecting societies.
Why does the government not share this position?
Waarom deelt de regering dit standpunt niet?

Asks why provisions going beyond the directive, such as the management cost threshold and ex-ante approval of tariffs, were not removed, and about possible unfair competition from the lighter regime for independent managers.
Furthermore, these members ask the government to clarify to what extent the lighter regime for independent collecting organisations may lead to unfair competition.
Zij vragen de regering nader toe te lichten in hoeverre het lichtere regime voor onafhankelijke beheersorganisaties kan leiden tot oneerlijke concurrentie.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, in its opinion of 29 May 2015, that the bill implementing Directive 2014/26/EU on collective management of copyright should be accompanied by a reasoned justification for dropping the stricter investment restrictions in article 2(4) of the Wet toezicht, and that the broad general delegation in article 2(3) should be narrowed. The Staatssecretaris's nader rapport of 26 June 2015 accepted the advice, giving three reasons for removing the investment restriction and clarifying the delegation basis, while integrating the editorial suggestions.
concerns: The Afdeling found no reasoned justification for dropping the stricter investment restriction in article 2(4), which the government then supplied with three reasons.
The general delegation in article 2(3) was insufficiently limited; the government clarified its scope and purposes.
Multiple editorial and terminological suggestions were adopted in full.

34306.s: The bill amends the Corporate Income Tax Act 1969 and the Dividend Tax Act 1965 to implement EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive amendments, excluding certain deductible payments from the participation exemption and adding an anti-abuse rule for cooperatives. It takes effect on 1 January 2016 and contains no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
34306.j: The memorandum explanation is absent, so no justification is given for the new powers.
p: Anti-abuse rule widens the tax authority's ability to recharacterise artificial arrangements as taxable, with a defined test of artificiality and business reasons.

parties: Asks whether the anti-abuse provision goes further than necessary and whether it will hold up in court against EU case law.
Supports the implementation and the worldwide scope against mismatches, but asks about unintended effects of the substance requirements and about revenue.
The PvdA members support the government's choice of worldwide application of the mismatch provision of the Parent-Subsidiary Directive.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie steunen de keuze van de regering voor een wereldwijde toepassing van de bepaling tegen mismatches uit de Moeder-dochterrichtlijn.
Asks whether the measures will in practice end double non-taxation and how transfer pricing mismatches are addressed.
The SP members ask the government to state whether combating mismatches, as it is now done on paper, will in practice lead to taxation of profits deductible in other countries.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering aan te geven of het tegengaan van mismatches, zoals nu op papier wordt gedaan, ook in de praktijk zal leiden tot heffing op winsten die in andere landen aftrekbaar is.
Criticises the broad, unclear anti-abuse rule and the risk of double taxation and harm to the investment climate; demands clarity for businesses and examples of valid business reasons.
Since the government is implementing unclear legislation, the CDA members expect the government to give businesses as much clarity as possible on the scope of the anti-abuse provision.

Nu de regering onduidelijke wetgeving aan het implementeren is, verwachten de leden van de CDA-fractie dat de regering bedrijven zoveel mogelijk duidelijkheid verschaft over de reikwijdte van de antimisbruikbepaling.
Asks whether the directive could address abuse, whether it conforms to EU primary law, and whether confirming non-applicability to appealable decisions would raise legal certainty.
Why is there no confirmation that the anti-abuse provision does not apply to an appealable decision?
Waarom vindt er geen bevestiging plaats dat de antimisbruikbepaling niet van toepassing is bij een voor bezwaar vatbare beschikking?
Asks detailed questions on scope, the substance and cooperative structure, and whether EU Court of Justice anti-abuse case law should guide the tax authority's interpretation.
Points to possible double taxation under the draft text, legal uncertainty from open norms such as direct or indirect deductibility, and a possible redaction omission in the dividend tax provision.
On the basis of the text of the proposed Article 13(17), it cannot be ruled out that the fees and payments included in a purchase price are taxed twice.
Op basis van de tekst van het voorgestelde art. 13, lid 17 kan niet worden uitgesloten dat de in een koopsom begrepen vergoedingen en betalingen dubbel in de heffing worden betrokken.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises sending the bill implementing the 2015 amendments to the Parent-Subsidiary Directive to Parliament, but asks for better justification and alignment of the general anti-abuse provision's wording and scope, and for explanation of the hybrid loan mismatch rules. The Staatssecretaris's reply states that the wording was brought closer to the directive, the memorie van toelichting was expanded on scope and BEPS alignment, and the bill is sent on with these changes.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the bill's anti-abuse wording be aligned with the directive (reeks van constructies, ondermijnen, verscheidene stappen); the government aligned some terms but kept 'ontgaan' instead of 'ondermijnen' and explained the choice.

The Afdeling found the scope of the general anti-abuse provision insufficiently explained and asked for interpretation of its general terms and its relation to fraus legis and the freedom to choose the most advantageous route; the government expanded the explanation on the hoofddoel terminology but said little more on scope.

The Afdeling asked the explanation to address alignment with the OECD BEPS project and possible future amendment of the directive; the government responded that it will revisit this during its Council presidency.
The Afdeling asked that the memorie van toelichting on the hybrid loan mismatch rules be supplemented; the government did so.

34333.s: The bill limits cross-border healthcare entitlements under the Zorgverzekeringswet to Europe with narrow exceptions, legally anchors the national contact point for cross-border care at the Zorginstituut, and specifies contribution calculation and administration for foreign-resident entitlement holders. It also extends Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit supervision to the Dutch 'organen van de woonplaats en verblijfplaats' implementing international social security rules, with power to issue binding instructions and enforce them by administrative coercion.
34333.j: The memorandum justifies the regulatory delegations as enabling simplification, faster contribution setting and more efficient collection, and the NZa supervision as filling a gap in existing oversight.
q: This bill therefore supplements the Wmg on this point. The bill provides that the NZa will supervise both implementing bodies.
Met dit wetsvoorstel wordt de Wmg daarom op dit punt aangevuld. Het wetsvoorstel voorziet erin dat de NZa toezicht gaat houden op beide uitvoeringsorganen.
d: contribution amount and income base for entitlement holders
rules on performing national contact point tasks
rules on compensation to organen van de woonplaats
administration rules set by NZa for fraud prevention and proper implementation
inspection, reporting and audit rules set by NZa and ministerial regulation
p: The NZa may issue binding instructions to the organen van de woonplaats and verblijfplaats and enforce them by administrative coercion, extending executive supervisory power over these bodies.
Entitlement to care outside Europe is restricted to enumerated categories, narrowing insured persons' rights through statutory limitation rather than executive discretion.

parties: Asks how self-employed and others can prove temporary stays abroad, how fraud and double claims can be prevented, and whether the planned savings will be achieved given the treaty delays.
It has since emerged that the Netherlands has not reached agreement with Morocco on amending the bilateral social security treaty, and that the concluded agreement is not being implemented.
Inmiddels is gebleken dat Nederland geen overeenstemming heeft bereikt met Marokko over aanpassing van het bilaterale sociale zekerheidsverdrag, en dat het gesloten akkoord niet wordt uitgevoerd.

Wants a distinction for chronically ill patients with existing indications and submits an amendment to keep worldwide coverage for basic-package care they need abroad; asks about palliative care and insurer acceptance duties.

They are of the opinion that for chronically ill people who, on the basis of an existing medical indication, must undergo treatment abroad that they would otherwise also be reimbursed for in the Netherlands, worldwide coverage for basic-package care must be retained.`

De leden van de fractie van de PvdA zijn van mening dat voor chronisch zieken die op grond van een bestaande medische indicatie in het buitenland een behandeling moeten ondergaan die zij anders ook in Nederland vergoed zouden krijgen, de werelddekking behouden moet blijven voor de zorg uit het basispakket.

Opposes the bill as bureaucratic and unclear, doubts the 60 million savings, asks for the research basis, a fallback scenario, and warns that leaving risk selection to anti-discrimination law via the courts is insufficient; questions the reasonable-term exception being judged by insurers.
They ask whether the government really believes that people with a disability or chronic illness should have to obtain justice through the courts when they are disadvantaged.`
Zij vragen of de regering nu werkelijk meent dat mensen met een handicap of een chronische ziekte maar via de rechter hun gelijk moeten halen wanneer zij benadeelt worden.

Asks detailed questions on financial consequences, uncertainty about premiums, whether indirect discrimination should be assessed in advance by the College voor de Rechten van de Mens, and on oversight of the origin checks being moved to the NZa.

Shares Raad van State doubts about whether benefits outweigh drawbacks; asks for a two-year evaluation to verify the savings and whether abolishing worldwide coverage is desirable, and for a public information campaign.
Is the government willing to evaluate the changes after a period of two years to see whether the intended cost savings underlying this change are indeed achieved?
Is de regering bereid de wijzigingen na een periode van twee jaar te evalueren om te zien of de beoogde kostenbesparing, die ten grondslag ligt aan deze wijziging, inderdaad behaald wordt?

Asks whether there are care-content arguments for the change, how the 60 million saving is achieved, consequences for the BES islands and the basic premium, and whether chronically ill people were considered.
Are there care-related arguments underlying the change?
Liggen er zorginhoudelijke argumenten ten grondslag aan de wijziging?
Wants the Morocco and Mediterranean association treaties terminated unilaterally, asks about access to supplementary insurance and emergency care for Dutch travellers without cover.
These members find it undesirable that the entitlement to medical care during temporary stay in Morocco continues after 2017.`
Deze leden vinden het onwenselijk dat de aanspraak op medische zorg bij tijdelijk verblijf in Marokko na 2017 blijft bestaan.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill restricting health insurance coverage under the Zvw to the EU, EEA and Switzerland, recommending reconsideration of the restriction given uncertain savings and implementation burdens, plus a justification for the Caribbean/Kingdom imbalance and a transposition table for the Patient Rights Directive. The government's nader rapport rejected the reconsideration on the coverage restriction, explained the territoriality principle and implementation status, and only supplemented the memorandum on Morocco and the Kingdom point.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts that the uncertain cost savings of restricting coverage outweigh implementation burdens and disputes, and advises reconsidering article 11(6) Zvw; the government keeps the provision, citing cost control and affordability.

The Afdeling warns of demarcation problems, conflicts and procedures for insurers and insured; the government acknowledges the risks, promises better information, but sees no reason to change the bill.

The Afdeling sees an imbalance in that EU Dutch residents receiving care in other parts of the Kingdom or the Caribbean Netherlands are not covered, and asks for justification; the government denies imbalance, citing territoriality and EU law obligations.

The Afdeling finds it unclear whether the Patient Rights Directive is fully and correctly implemented and asks for a transposition table; the government explains its prior notification and adds clarification on Morocco but does not add a table.
The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to be supplemented on criteria for 'reasonable term' and care availability; the government clarified the explanation.

34342.s: The bill amends the Notaries Act to merge the notaries' pension fund into a sector pension fund governed by the Pensioenwet, and removes the Minister of Justice and Security's prior approval of the fund's statutes and rules, which is replaced by DNB oversight after the fact. It also makes consequential changes to the Pensioenwet and the Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling.
34342.j: The memorandum justifies removing prior approval by noting the approval power was never used and that DNB already supervises such changes under the Pensioenwet.
q: It is proposed to abolish the Minister of Justice and Security's prior approval of the pension fund's statutes and rules, and of amendments to them.

Voorgesteld wordt de voorafgaande goedkeuring van de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie ten aanzien van de statuten en reglementen van het pensioenfonds, alsmede de wijzigingen daarin, te laten vervallen.
d: designation of the pension fund by the Minister
p: Artikel I, B (Artikel 113a, lid 1 en 3, and removal of prior approval of statutes)
The Minister's prior approval of the pension fund's statutes and rules is removed, with DNB supervising changes after the fact, and the Minister may designate the fund.

parties: Broadly agrees with the merger for lower costs but asks about risks to one party's members from combining funds with differing incomes and whether DNB supervises this.
They therefore broadly agree with the amendment proposal.
Zij zijn het dan ook op hoofdlijnen eens met het wijzigingsvoorstel.
Asks about the petition's concerns, the mandatory participation without a representativeness survey, and possible incompatibility with European competition law.
They state that compulsory participation, according to case law, in principle constitutes a breach of competition law.
Zij stellen dat een verplichte deelname volgens jurisprudentie in beginsel een schending oplevert van het mededingingsrecht.
Asks why no representativeness test among notaries was held on continuing compulsory pension fund membership and whether the test should precede the merger.
These members further ask the government to check with SNPF and KNB whether the costs of such a test will be modest and could be completed within weeks.
Deze leden vragen de regering voorts bij het SNPF en KNB na te gaan of de kosten van een dergelijke toets bescheiden zullen zijn en binnen enkele weken al gereed kan zijn.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill merging the notaries' mandatory pension fund (SNP) with the notarial staff sector pension fund (SBN), asking for a fuller explanation of the governance of the joint fund and of the financial effects on participants. The government's nader rapport states that the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on governance (notary members treated as employer representatives, staff as employee representatives) and on the statutory framework for equalising funding ratios under the Pensioenwet and DNB supervision.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for further explanation of how the paritair board would be composed given that notaries are both employers and employees, to avoid an imbalance between employer and employee representation.
The Afdeling asked for clarity on how the difference in funding ratios between the two funds would be eliminated in practice and on the risk of a shift of value from SBN to SNP participants.

34360.s: This bill amends the Belastingplan 2016 (tax plan) by adjusting income tax brackets and rates for work and home income and wage income, reducing certain percentage points and amounts, and adding a new amount to article 5.5. It also sets the entry-into-force timing linked to the underlying tax plan and the Wet raadgevend referendum.
q: The advice of the Council of State's advisory division is not made public, because it is unreservedly in agreement or contains only editorial comments.
Het advies van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State wordt niet openbaar gemaakt, omdat het zonder meer instemmend luidt/uitsluitend opmerkingen van redactionele aard bevat.

parties: Welcomes the novelle as creating sufficient support in both chambers for a substantial tax cut for working people.
The VVD members have noted this novelle with satisfaction, since it has created sufficient support in both chambers to make a substantial tax cut for working Netherlands possible.

De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met tevredenheid kennisgenomen van deze novelle, nu daarmee voldoende draagvlak in de beide Kamers is gecreëerd, om een forse belastingverlaging voor werkend Nederland mogelijk te maken.

Has mixed feelings about the Senate's political involvement and says late changes hit tax administration and citizens with back-payments; questions whether tariffs being fixed in systems conflicts with the Tweede Kamer's amendment right.

These members have mixed feelings about the political involvement of the Senate that this reflects, and regret that the very late timing of the changes increases implementation burdens for the Tax Authority and will confront citizens with back-payments.

Deze leden hebben evenwel gemengde gevoelens bij de politiek- inhoudelijke bemoeienis van de Senaat die hieruit spreekt en betreuren dat het zeer late tijdstip van de wijzigingen tot gevolg heeft dat de uitvoeringslasten voor de Belastingdienst groter worden en dat de burger zal worden geconfronteerd met naheffingen.
Asks for distributional effects (purchasing power, Gini coefficient, social minima), job effects of the municipal tax shift, and the budgetary impact of the MIA/VAMIL overlap.
Since large sums of money are being shifted, these members ask the government to again provide the purchasing-power effects of the policy.
Aangezien er met grote sommen geld wordt geschoven, vragen deze leden de regering de koopkrachteffecten van het beleid opnieuw te verstrekken.

Objects that the novelle was agreed outside open parliamentary debate, weakening voters' ability to see which parties took which positions, and asks for detailed calculations and information on errors in tables and rent allowance letters.
Now it appears that with this tax plan there were two parallel tracks: one in the Tweede and Eerste Kamer in public, and one elsewhere.
Nu lijkt er bij dit belastingplan sprake te zijn geweest van twee parallelle trajecten: eentje in de Tweede en Eerste Kamer in de openbaarheid en eentje elders.
Welcomes the novelle and the planned coal-plant scenarios and municipal tax-base widening, asking that CPB model the variants.
The D66 members have noted with approval the novelle to the Belastingplan 2016 and the accompanying letter of 8 December 2015.
De leden van de D66-fractie hebben met instemming kennisgenomen van de novelle Belastingplan 2016 en de begeleidende brief d.d. 8 december 2015.

Asks about employment and climate effects, the remaining rate cut, back-payments from late implementation, confusing box 3 communication, and the reconciliation of coal-plant tax exemption with planned closure.
The GroenLinks members are curious about the expected employment effects of the measures taken and announced in the novelle, both jointly and separately.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie zijn benieuwd naar de verwachte werkgelegenheidseffecten van de in de novelle genomen en aangekondigde maatregelen, zowel gezamenlijk als afzonderlijk.
Argues pensioners are not receiving a proportionate share of structural tax relief and asks whether the cumulative package remains a structural burden on older people.

Does the government share the view that, taking the whole period 1990–2015 into account, it cannot be justified that pensioners still do not receive even approximately a proportionate share of the planned structural tax relief?

Deelt de regering de mening, dat als de gehele periode 1990–2015 in ogenschouw wordt genomen niet te rechtvaardigen is dat gepensioneerden nog niet bij benadering een evenredig deel krijgen van de voorziene structurele lastenverlichting?
Welcomes the higher box 3 exemption but notes the absence of wider reform and urges abolition of the precario levy on utilities.
Member Klein has noted the intended changes to the Belastingplan 2016 and observed that no reform whatsoever is taking place.
Het lid Klein heeft kennisgenomen van de beoogde wijzigingen op het Belastingplan 2016 en geconstateerd dat er geen enkele hervorming plaats vindt.

34432.s: The bill tightens the licensing of firearms possession under the Dutch Weapons and Ammunition Act, the Flora and Fauna Act and the Nature Conservation Act by introducing enhanced screening of applicants and holders, including mandatory cooperation with a psychological assessment, referee lists, in-person application and inspection, and sharing of involuntary psychiatric admission data from prosecutors with the police chief. It also restricts data-protection rights for the data collected and makes the screening apply to existing holders over time, with an evaluation report due within five years.
34432.j: The memorandum justifies the enhanced screening and new information powers by the security risks of firearm possession and the recommendations of the Dutch Safety Board, arguing that the privacy intrusion is necessary, proportionate and subsidiary.
q: This gives effect to the Dutch Safety Board's recommendation to move to a reversal of the burden of proof.
Dit geeft invulling aan de aanbeveling van de Onderzoeksraad om te komen tot een omkering van de bewijslast.
d: minister may authorize police chief to implement exemption procedures
rules on investigation, referee selection and application place
manner of transmitting psychiatric admission data
p: Applicants must undergo mandatory psychological screening, provide referees and attend inspections, with the burden of showing suitability shifted to the applicant and the police chief given broad discretion to refuse licences.
Public prosecutors must pass on data on involuntary psychiatric admissions of applicants and holders to the police chief, including continuing notification of changes for existing holders.
Articles 8 to 12, 16 and 17a to 20 of the Police Data Act are disapplied to the screening data, limiting data-subject rights and access restrictions.
