Hunting certificate applicants are subject to the same mandatory screening, with administrative appeal channelled to the Minister of Justice and Security for security-based refusals.
Parallel mandatory screening applies to hunting certificates under the Nature Conservation Act.

parties: Asks how foreign licence holders' firearms are controlled under the stricter regime and how the korpschef weighs the screening, and whether the police workload increase is manageable.
The police anticipate that the proposed new requirements and the possibility of providing 'counter-evidence' will lead to an increase in workload.
De politie voorziet dat de voorgestelde nieuwe eisen en de mogelijkheid van het leveren van «tegenbewijs» tot een verhoging van de werklast zal leiden.

Supports the stricter screening as necessary but asks how the korpschef, a non-medic, should weigh medical test results and whether medical advice should be obtained, and whether the applicant can object.
Argues the bill is too lenient: no absolute ban for psychiatric admission, no physician statement, unannounced home checks are not provided for, and past convictions should bar permits permanently.
The biggest shortcomings in the bill are the government's choice to leave open the possibility that someone admitted to a psychiatric institution can still be granted a firearm permit.

Grootste manco's in het wetsvoorstel vormen de keuze van de regering de mogelijkheid open te laten dat iemand die is opgenomen in een psychiatrische instelling, alsnog een wapenvergunning te verlenen.
Asks how police control has been improved since 2011, whether the police can execute the screening, why the korpschef rather than a commission decides, and how reliable the e-screener is.
The D66 members note that the korpschef ultimately decides on granting a firearm permit.
De leden van de D66-fractie stellen daarbij vast dat de korpschef uiteindelijk beslist over de toekenning van een wapenvergunning.

Asks about the practical operation of the duty to report compulsory admissions, the proportionality of excluding applicants with unrelated recent convictions, and whether there is room for tailored judgement.
Does it not matter which offence it is? To what extent is this proportionate if the offence has nothing to do with, for example, firearm possession or public order and safety?
Maakt het dan niet uit om welk misdrijf het gaat? In hoeverre is dit proportioneel, als het misdrijf niets te maken heeft met bijvoorbeeld wapenbezit of openbare orde en veiligheid?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised proceeding with the bill on strengthened screening of legal firearm holders, but asked for better justification of the further processing of personal data (including the power to share screening data with third parties under the Police Data Act), an EU-law discussion, and clarification of a delegation provision. The government's reply accepted most points, excluding third-party sharing except where justified and removing the delegation reference to the second paragraph.
concerns: Further processing and third-party disclosure of sensitive psychological data required better justification under the proportionality and privacy requirements of Article 8 ECHR; the government largely excluded third-party disclosure except via individual balancing.
The explanatory memorandum should address the relationship with Directive 91/477/EEG, its proposed amendment, the EU Charter, and notification duties; the government added this discussion.
The delegation to lay down rules on the second paragraph of Article 6a was unexplained; the government removed the reference to the second paragraph.
Redactional comments were adopted, and an omission regarding the reporting duty of the public prosecutor was corrected by adding Articles 15 and 35 BOPZ.

34531.s: The bill restructures the Dutch research organisation NWO by replacing its general board with a board of directors, creating a supervisory board that advises the board and proposes its members, and turning nine area boards into four domain boards. It sets out appointment procedures, budget and annual account approval by the Minister, and transitional rules for first appointments.
34531.j: The memorandum justifies the new structure by the lack of internal countervailing power and the need for a central sparring partner for the board, rather than by new executive discretion.
d: rules for granting funds including subsidy ceilings
scientific scope of each research domain
detailed domain board tasks and structure in governance rules
p: The Minister appoints board members on nomination by the supervisory board, with only a marginal review of the nomination.

parties: Asks whether strengthening central leadership will also strengthen internal counterweight, and why a supervisory board rather than an advisory board was chosen.
How is it prevented that this only strengthens the central leadership's striking power but not internal counter-argument, the members ask.
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat dit alleen de slagkracht van de centrale leiding verstevigt, maar niet de interne tegenspraak, zo vragen de leden.
Argues the proposed supervisory board functions more as an advisory council without real toezicht, and asks whether it needs a stronger mandate.
The members of the ChristenUnie faction point out that the new supervisory board appears to be more of an advisory board than a supervisory board.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie wijzen erop dat de nieuwe raad van toezicht meer een raad van advies blijkt te zijn dan een raad van toezicht.

34620-IIB.s: The bill amends the 2016 budget of the other High Colleges of State and the Governors' cabinets (IIB) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting spending and receipts for the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman and the governors' offices. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect on 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The budget statement for the other High Colleges of State and the Governors' cabinets for the year 2016 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De begrotingsstaat inzake de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat en de Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs voor het jaar 2016 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34621.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the 2012 Strasbourg Convention limiting liability in inland navigation (CLNI 2012) and the intended denunciation of the 1988 CLNI, with a reservation excluding water-quality damage claims. It also states that liability-limit changes under Article 20 of the convention need no further parliamentary approval.
34621.j: The memorandum states that the liability amounts will be raised by general administrative order (AMvB) without further detail on parliamentary involvement.
q: Amendments to the liability limits of the Convention in Article 1, made under Article 20 of the Convention, do not require approval by the States General.
Wijzigingen van de aansprakelijkheidsgrenzen van het in artikel 1 genoemde Verdrag, tot stand gekomen overeenkomstig artikel 20 van het Verdrag, behoeven niet de goedkeuring van de Staten-Generaal.
d: changes to liability limits under convention Article 20
p: Amendments to the convention's liability limits take effect without requiring approval by the Staten-Generaal.

34630.s: The bill amends the Wet BIG to add physician assistants to the registered professions, grants them and certain nurse specialists permanent independent competence for listed reserved acts, and allows a temporary register and disciplinary jurisdiction for experimental professions. It also extends disciplinary law to all conduct of experimental practitioners and lets ministerial regulations designate nurse categories and deviate from statutory conditions.
34630.j: The memorandum justifies the temporary register and experimental powers by the evaluation showing the experiment was effective and by the need to make disciplinary law reach all conduct of experimental practitioners.
q: To assess whether it is effective and efficient to grant the powers assigned during the experiment permanently to PAs and VSs, the experiment was evaluated.
Om te beoordelen in hoeverre het doelmatig en doeltreffend is in het kader van het experiment toegekende bevoegdheden definitief aan de PA's en VS-en toe te kennen, is het experiment geëvalueerd.
d: acts within physician assistant competence and their limits
Artikel I, onderdeel D (artikel 36, eerste en vijfde lid, sub e)
designation of nurse categories allowed to perform reserved acts
Artikel I, onderdeel D (artikel 36, veertiende lid, sub e)
designation of nurse categories for further reserved acts
Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 36b, eerste lid)
establishment and management of temporary register for experimental professions
p: Temporary register provisions exempt experimental professions from several registration rules and let the minister and ministerial regulation set the scope of experimental practice, with disciplinary coverage preserved after the experiment ends.
Ministerial regulation may designate additional nurse categories as independently competent for reserved acts, within limits set by that regulation.

parties: Supports independent competence for PAs and VS but asks how the government will inform stakeholders about temporary registration and why lighter sanctions are not kept after a temporary register lapses.
They therefore also support the proposal to definitively include independent competence of PAs and VS for a number of reserved acts in the BIG Act.

Zij steunen daarom ook het voorstel om de zelfstandige bevoegdheid van de PA en VS voor een aantal voorbehouden handelingen definitief op te nemen in de Wet op de beroepen in de individuele gezondheidszorg (Wet BIG).
Worries that the strict experiment conditions are dropped, that the evaluation did not assess patient safety effects, and that the KNMG's objections are not answered.
Research was done on the effectiveness and efficiency of introducing independent competence. However, it did not examine the effects of dropping quality conditions and guaranteeing patient safety.

Er is onderzoek gedaan naar de effectiviteit en doelmatigheid van het introduceren van een zelfstandige bevoegdheid. Hierbij is echter niet gekeken naar de effecten van het loslaten van kwaliteitsvoorwaarden en de garantie van patiëntveiligheid.

Welcomes disciplinary law applying to experimental professions but asks about complaint numbers, the six-month deadline for reporting after a temporary register lapses, and whether quality safeguards are being reduced.
On what basis was this timeframe chosen? Could a period of two years not be chosen instead, since that time should be sufficient for initial processing of medical injury?

Op basis waarvan is dit tijdspad gekozen? Kan bijvoorbeeld niet worden gekozen voor een termijn van twee jaar, omdat deze tijd voldoende moet worden geacht voor de primaire verwerking van een medisch letsel.

Asks whether quality safeguards remain, why some cardioversion and endoscopy acts were excluded, how disciplinary complaints were handled, and whether NZa's decision undermines PA roles in mental health.
The CDA members ask whether all quality safeguards applied during the experimental phase of PAs and VS will also remain with this bill.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of alle kwaliteitswaarborgen die tijdens de experimenteerfase van de PA en de VS werden gehanteerd, ook met dit wetsvoorstel blijven bestaan.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill creating a temporary register for experimental professions and granting physician assistants and specialist nurses independent competence for reserved acts, asking for a fuller explanation of feasibility and for tuchtrecht to remain possible after the temporary register lapses. The government's nader rapport accepts both points and amends the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to explain whether the CIBG can set up the temporary register in time and at what cost, and how it will be converted into a definitive register; the government added this explanation.

Without a transitional provision, professionals would escape disciplinary jurisdiction for conduct during the temporary registration once the register lapses; the Afdeling advised a legal basis for continued tuchtrechtspraak and the government adopted it in article 36b.
The Afdeling made redactional remarks, including a cross-reference correction in article 36b and alignment with other pending bills; these were incorporated.

34702.s: The bill amends the Dutch Constitution to create a constitutional basis for new territorial public bodies in the Caribbean Netherlands other than provinces and municipalities, and to provide for an electoral college for the Senate elected in those bodies. It also removes the second paragraph and numbering of article 1 of the Statute for the Kingdom.
34702.j: The explanatory memorandum notes only that the bill is the second reading of a constitutional amendment following the prior procedural steps, without substantively justifying the new delegation.
q: Rules may be set and other specific measures taken for these public bodies in view of special circumstances distinguishing them from the European part of the Netherlands.
Voor deze openbare lichamen kunnen regels worden gesteld en andere specifieke maatregelen worden getroffen met het oog op bijzondere omstandigheden
d: special rules and measures for Caribbean public bodies
p: Establishment and abolition of Caribbean territorial public bodies is left to ordinary legislation rather than being fixed in the Constitution.

Rules and specific measures may be set for Caribbean bodies on the basis of special circumstances, potentially departing from the regime applying in the European part of the Netherlands, with no explicit limits stated in the text.

parties: Insists the Eerste Kamer franchise stays limited to Dutch nationals and asks about the views of Bonaire and Sint Eustatius and the implementation law for the electoral college.
The VVD members reiterate that they believe the right to vote for the Eerste Kamer must remain reserved for persons with Dutch nationality.
De leden van de VVD-fractie benadrukken nog eens dat zij van mening zijn dat het kiesrecht voor de Eerste Kamer voorbehouden moet blijven aan personen met de Nederlandse nationaliteit.
Asks what safeguards the constitutional article offers for the islands given the possibility of rules deviating from the European Netherlands, beyond the duty to motivate such deviations.
What safeguards does the constitutional article offer for the islands, other than the requirement to justify why a deviating regime was chosen?
Welke waarborgen biedt het grondwetsartikel voor de eilanden, anders dan dat gemotiveerd moet worden waarom voor een afwijkende regeling is gekozen?

Asks the government to confirm that deviating rules do not affect the fundamental rights guaranteed in Article 1, demands clear criteria for deviating legislation, and raises concern about poverty and equal living standards on the islands.

These members believe that the possibility of deviating legislation on the islands must not lead to a distinction between Dutch citizens in the European Netherlands and those in the Caribbean Netherlands regarding the right to an equivalent standard of living.

Deze leden zijn van mening dat de mogelijkheid tot afwijkende wetgeving op de eilanden niet mag leiden tot een onderscheid tussen Nederlanders in Europees Nederland en Nederlanders in Caribisch Nederland ten aanzien van het recht op een gelijkwaardige levensstandaard.

34720.s: The bill amends the Code of Criminal Procedure and the Economic Offences Act to let BOD investigators and the Royal Marechaussee exercise infiltration and systematic information gathering independently, regulates prosecution competence of the CVOM prosecutors' office, and allows withholding notification of special investigative powers in the case file under strict conditions. It also lets government bodies and citizens assist in identity changes for protected witnesses and delegates further rules on investigator qualifications and domains by ministerial regulation.
34720.j: The memorandum justifies the expanded powers by the growing workload of the Marechaussee and BOD's, their need to act without police capacity delays, and the complexity of fraud and corruption investigations.
d: competence requirements and manner of exercising infiltration and systematic information gathering
requirements for officials of a foreign state's public service
domains of competence of special investigating officers
qualification and other rules for investigating officers
Minister designates officials who may request assistance from private parties and order cooperation for witness protection
p: Extends infiltration and systematic information gathering powers to BOD and Marechaussee officers acting independently, subject to prosecutor's order and the Samenwerkingsbesluit rules.
Allows the prosecutor, with rechter-commissaris authorization, to withhold notice of use of special powers from the case file, reducing defence and judicial visibility.
Lets the Minister designate officials who may approach any person to request witness-protection assistance and lets the prosecutor compel it, setting aside legal rules that stand in the way.
Transfers ministerial competence for economic offence investigators to the Minister of Security and Justice and applies the domain rules to them.

parties: Asks how officers will be trained in the new powers and their limits so that evidence is not excluded as unlawfully obtained in later prosecutions.
These members consider it very important that the fruits of the investigative powers do not fail because of unlawfully obtained evidence in a subsequent criminal case.
Deze leden vinden het van groot belang dat de vruchten die kunnen worden geplukt van de opsporingsbevoegdheden niet stranden wegens onrechtmatig verkregen bewijs in een strafzaak die volgt.
Supports the bill but asks what protection will be offered to citizens and organisations who cooperate in shielding identities and may face pressure from the underworld.
What measures are foreseen to actually protect citizens and organisations that cooperate in this, in cases where this arises?
Welke maatregelen zijn voorzien om burgers en organisaties die hier aan meewerken in voorkomende gevallen daadwerkelijk bescherming te bieden?
Asks how quality of execution of the special powers will be guaranteed, including whether officers may only use the powers after the cooperation decree rules are set and met.

Can the government clarify whether this means that officers of the KMar and BOD's may only actually exercise the intended investigative powers once these rules have been formulated and it has been established that they meet them?

Kan de regering toelichten of dit betekent dat opsporingsambtenaren van de KMar en BOD’en pas nadat deze regels zijn geformuleerd en is vastgesteld dat zij daaraan voldoen daadwerkelijk de bedoelde opsporingsbevoegdheden mogen uitoefenen?

34775-I.s: This bill sets the 2018 state budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Crown (the King's household), fixing expenditure at €42.284 million with no revenue. The explanatory memorandum details the constitutional allowances for royal family members and functional expenditure of the King, without delegating rule-making power.
q: The budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2018 is established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2018 wordt vastgesteld.

34775-XVIII.s: This bill (Begrotingswet 2018) fixes the 2018 budget statements for the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations' housing and civil service portfolio and for the associated baten-lastenagentschappen. It does not itself create or delegate any new rule-making power to the executive.
q: The budget statement for the year 2018 annexed to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2018 wordt vastgesteld.

34801.s: The bill amends the Pensioenwet and the Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling so that pension funds, including mandatory sector pension funds, need prior approval from the supervisor (DNB) for mergers or splits. It allows merged mandatory sector pension funds to temporarily keep separate asset pools for up to five years, subject to conditions and detailed rules set by general administrative order.
34801.j: The memorandum justifies the new approval and separate-asset powers by pointing to risks identified by the Raad van State and the need for DNB to have statutory powers over mergers similar to liquidation and value transfer powers.
q: It is therefore desirable that DNB receives statutory powers, also where this concerns a merger or split of company pension funds, professional pension funds, general pension funds, voluntary sector pension funds and mandatory sector pension funds without separate asset pools.

Het is daarom wenselijk dat DNB wettelijke bevoegdheden krijgt, ook waar dit een fusie of splitsing van ondernemingspensioenfondsen, beroepspensioenfondsen, algemene pensioenfondsen, vrijwillige bedrijfstakpensioenfondsen en verplichtgestelde bedrijfstakpensioenfondsen zonder afgescheiden vermogens betreft.
d: procedure and merger plan rules for pension fund mergers
rules on extension request and merger assets for separate asset pools
further rules on pension fund collective value transfer provision
procedural rules for professional pension fund mergers and splits
rules on costs of professional pension schemes
p: Allows merged mandatory sector pension funds to keep separate asset pools for up to five years, with a single possible extension, under supervisor oversight and detailed conditions.
Gives DNB a statutory power to approve or refuse pension fund mergers and splits, a supervisory power that strengthens checks.}],

parties: Asks whether DNB's supervisory powers are justified and whether the bill blocks mergers that would benefit participants.
Does the government have signals that DNB's current powers fall short in such mergers?
Heeft de regering signalen dat de huidige bevoegdheden van DNB bij dergelijke fusies tekortschieten?
Questions the rationale for the EUR 25 billion cap and the 13-week decision period for DNB approval.
Why was a 13-week decision period chosen; a licence for an APF is not a comparable application, the PVV asks.
Waarom is voor een beslistermijn van 13 weken gekozen, een vergunningverlening voor een APF is toch geen vergelijkbare aanvraag, zo vragen de leden van de PVV-fractie ?
Very critical of the bill and the net-pension shop right; asks the government to reconsider or withdraw the bill.
These members are very critical of both parts of the act and ask the government to reconsider both parts and consider withdrawing the bill.
Deze leden zijn zeer kritisch over beide onderdelen van de wet en vragen de regering om beide onderdelen van dit wetsvoorstel te heroverwegen en te overwegen het wetsvoorstel in te trekken.
Asks how far funds can steer funding ratios and whether participants will get input on the measures used.
Will stakeholders get a say in which means are used to achieve equal funding ratios?
Krijgen belanghebbenden inspraak in welke middelen ingezet worden om tot gelijke dekkingsgraden te komen?
Supports consolidation goal but fears stacked conditions undermine the law; objects to the net-pension shop right being added outside a broader reform.
Is the government willing to remove the net-pension shop right from the bill and address it in the system reform?
Is de regering bereid om het shoprecht nettopensioen uit het wetsvoorstel te halen en deze discussie te betrekken bij de stelselherziening?
Mixed feelings; questions the necessity of so many safeguards, the value of the merger asset, and the procedural handling of the amendment note without consultation.
The SP members have noted the amendment note with disapproval.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben met afkeuring kennisgenomen van de nota van wijziging.
Asks whether the bill still yields cost benefits, whether the conditions are arbitrary, and questions the open-ended DNB powers.
Why were unqualified powers given to the supervisor for mergers and splits?
Waarom wordt ervoor gekozen om ongeclausuleerde bevoegdheden te geven aan de toezichthouder bij fusie en splitsing?
Supports the goal but doubts the bill will be workable; asks why DNB powers are formulated so openly and whether supervision is proportionate.
Does the supervisor not thereby get a kind of carte blanche in assessing mergers and splits of pension funds?
Krijgt de toezichthouder zo niet een soort «carte blanche» bij de beoordeling van fusies en splitsing van pensioenfondsen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises that the bill allowing merging industry-wide pension funds to temporarily ring-fence assets is acceptable given the strict conditions, but notes these conditions make mergers conditional and questions the bill's practical significance, suggesting the explanatory memorandum address this and that alternatives be explored. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts the need for strict adherence to the safeguards, agrees to strengthen domain demarcation and considers regulation of mandatory participation in the middle term an interesting option.
concerns: The conditional nature of mergers and doubts about the bill's practical effect on scale problems of small and medium pension funds; government acknowledges the tension but does not fully resolve it.

Advice to explain the practical implications of the bill in the explanatory memorandum and consider further research into the solidarity-at-scheme-level alternative; government responds in general terms.
Strict conditions and time limits on ring-fencing are necessary and must be applied strictly to protect the mandatory character of the schemes.

34810.s: The bill amends the Dutch Notaries Act so that the notary manages his protocol for his own account and risk, makes an interim replacement responsible for the protocol of a replaced notary, and requires the KNB to set up a guarantee fund covering unrecoverable costs of protocol management and deficits on third-party accounts. It also lets the KNB board set member contributions by decision rather than by regulation, and lets the fund cover supervision and disciplinary costs.
34810.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to the KNB board by arguing that the profession has collective responsibility and that the sector did not set up the fund voluntarily, so a statutory obligation was needed.
q: The board of the KNB establishes a fund for reimbursing costs related to a takeover under Article 15 or an interim management under Article 29a.
Het bestuur van de KNB richt een fonds in voor de vergoeding van kosten die verband houden met een overname als bedoeld in artikel 15 of waarneming als bedoeld in artikel 29a.
d: fund working procedures and conditions for payouts
member contributions to finance the fund
setting member contributions for supervision and disciplinary costs
p: Member contributions for supervision and disciplinary costs are set by KNB board decision instead of by regulation, a shift from regulatory to board-level decision-making within the profession.
The KNB board is tasked with establishing the fund, its procedures, and payout conditions, with the requirement that the fund's workings be controllable for members.

parties: Asks why the fund and supervision cost pass-through were not regulated in the already-adopted Wet doorberekening kosten toezicht en tuchtrecht, and what the financial consequences are for bailiffs.
These members ask why this subject was not directly regulated in the bill on passing on supervision and disciplinary costs for legal professions, which the House has already adopted?
Deze leden vragen waarom dit onderwerp niet direct is geregeld bij het wetsvoorstel Wet doorberekening kosten toezicht en tuchtrecht juridische beroepen, die reeds door de Kamer is aangenomen?

Asks about the scale of notarial failures, third-party account shortfalls, the fund's maximum size, and whether the KNB can break an impasse in drafting its conditions, given members' business interests.
Does the government not expect problems after all in drawing up the conditions and filling the fund, given the notaries' individual business interests?
Verwacht men niet alsnog problemen bij het opstellen van de voorwaarden en vulling van het fonds gezien het (individuele) ondernemersbelang van de notaris?

Notes the Raad van State advised that the contribution benchmark and conditions for payout be set in the bill itself; asks the government to add the contribution benchmark and questions the pass-through of costs to clients.
However, these members miss the benchmark for determining the contribution notaries must make in the amended bill.
Echter, deze leden missen de maatstaf tot vaststelling van de bijdrage die notarissen moeten geven in het gewijzigde wetsvoorstel.

Asks what the costs of the fund, supervision and disciplinary law will be, how far they will be passed on to clients, and the effect on citizens' willingness to arrange private legal affairs properly.

Asks how often notaries refuse floating protocols, whether the fund will encourage notaries to rely on it, how bad-faith notaries are held liable, the conditions before payout, and the cost to clients.
Will this not lead notaries to think more quickly that their financial problems will be solved by the quality fund?
Zal dit er niet toe leiden dat notarissen sneller denken dat hun financiële problematiek wel zal worden opgelost door het kwaliteitsfonds?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises proceeding with a bill amending the Notaries Act to create a fund for unrecoverable costs of notarial protocols and for supervision and disciplinary costs, but asks for two changes: tighter statutory limits on the KNB's power to levy and manage contributions, and keeping supervision/disciplinary costs out of the guarantee fund. The minister's reply largely adopts the limits on the KNB's powers, partly accepts the separation of supervision costs into a broader quality fund, and leaves the redactional remark unaddressed in part.
concerns: The KNB's discretionary power to levy contributions and manage the fund without member influence must be more precisely bounded in law, which the government adopted by adding criteria and a duty to allow sufficient member supervision.

Managing funds for supervision and disciplinary costs in a guarantee fund is inappropriate since these are certain annual costs; the government kept them in a broader quality fund, with separate ring-fenced accounts, rather than following the advice fully.
The redactional remark to delete 'in ieder geval' in the proposed article 88a was not followed, the government arguing it would otherwise unduly restrict the fund's uses.

35000-III.s: This is the 2019 budget bill that formally adopts the departmental budget statements for the Ministry of General Affairs (including the agency Dienst Publiek en Communicatie), the Cabinet of the King, and the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services. It sets appropriations in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force on 1 January 2019, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA) attached to this law is established for the year 2019.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken (IIIA) voor het jaar 2019 wordt vastgesteld.

35026.s: The bill (Belastingplan 2019) amends the income tax, wage tax, VAT, collection and other tax laws for 2019 onward, mainly lowering labour taxes, raising VAT on sports and other services and the reduced rate, and adjusting brackets, allowances and box 2 rates. It also adds transitional and indexation provisions and authorises ministerial regulations to set indexed amounts and to designate groups for extraterritorial cost rules.
35026.j: The memorandum justifies the indexation and ministerial amendment provisions as aligning with the assumptions behind the coalition agreement's budgetary effects.
q: This ensures that the amendment instructions align with the assumptions used in calculating the budgetary effects under the coalition agreement.
Hiermee wordt bewerkstelligd dat de wijzigingsopdrachten aansluiten bij de uitgangspunten die zijn gehanteerd bij de in het kader van het regeerakkoord berekende budgettaire gevolgen.
d: groups of workers and conditions for extraterritorial cost reimbursement
recalculated bracket amounts in column III after indexation
amend bracket and box amounts at start of 2020 by ministerial regulation
correct conflicting or erroneous cross-references caused by overlapping laws
p: Narrows the VAT exemption for sports services and gives the tax authority broader grounds to deny it, using profit-intent and cost-reimbursement tests.

parties: Supports lower labour taxes and asks about progressivity and the effect of the two-bracket system.
They stress the importance of this tax cut.
Zij benadrukken het belang van deze belastingverlaging.
Opposes the VAT increase and the abolition of dividend tax, arguing the package favours multinationals and low incomes lose out.
The SP members are also very critical of the decision to raise VAT from 6 to 9 percent.
Zeer kritisch zijn de leden van de SP-fractie ook op het besluit om de btw te verhogen van 6 naar 9 procent.
Criticises the late reconsideration of dividend tax abolition and the parliamentary handling of the package, questioning the timing of decisions on 1.9 billion euro.
The PvdA members note that the parliamentary handling of the Belastingplan 2019 package is proceeding very messily.
De leden van PvdA-fractie merken op dat de parlementaire behandeling van het pakket Belastingplan 2019 zeer rommelig verloopt.
Welcomes the flat-rate tax but flags the dilemma of bundling measures in one bill, which limits Eerste Kamer voting options.
These members consider it important not to bundle measures unnecessarily in one bill, partly because the Eerste Kamer can only vote on the bill as a whole.

Deze leden achten het van belang om maatregelen niet onnodig in eenzelfde wetsvoorstel in te passen, mede omdat de Eerste Kamer alleen nog over het geheel aan maatregelen in het wetsvoorstel kan stemmen.
Welcomes steps toward a simpler, greener tax system and asks which measures most simplify taxes for citizens.
These members are pleased that the government proposes measures contributing to a green, simple and fair tax system.
Deze leden zijn verheugd dat de regering maatregelen voorstelt die bijdragen aan een groen, eenvoudig en eerlijk belastingstelsel.
Cites Raad van State warnings about frequent changes to tax law and lack of citizen perspective, and asks why no structural reform is undertaken.
The GroenLinks members point out that the Raad van State notes that tax legislation changes on important points at sometimes far too high a frequency.
De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks brengen onder de aandacht dat de Raad van State opmerkt dat de fiscale wetgeving op belangrijke punten met een soms veel te hoge frequentie wijzigt.
Warns that instrumental use of tax tools undermines the ability-to-pay principle, echoing the Raad van State, and asks for a more precise government response.
It states that the ability-to-pay principle is under pressure.
Zij stelt dat het draagkrachtbeginsel onder druk staat.
Regrets the instrumental use of tax credits, which makes the system more complex and arbitrary, and sees a missed chance for simplicity.
The SGP deeply regrets this and sees the tax relief given as a missed opportunity to make the system simpler and fairer.
De SGP betreurt dit zeer en ziet de lastenverlichting die wordt gegeven als een gemiste kans om het stelsel eenvoudiger en eerlijker te maken.
Asks whether the Raad van State criticised the package size and why the dividend tax abolition was not a separate bill despite a unanimous motion.
The DENK members ask why the abolition of dividend tax was not submitted as a separate bill.
De leden van de DENK-fractie vragen waarom de afschaffing van de dividendbelasting niet als afzonderlijk wetsvoorstel is aangeboden.
Objects to misleading terminology of labour tax relief and questions the principled breach of the ability-to-pay principle in capping deductions at the lowest rate.
The 50PLUS members object to the terminology used in the introduction of the explanatory memorandum.
De leden van de fractie van 50PLUS maken bezwaar tegen de gebruikte terminologie in de inleiding van de memorie van toelichting.
Asks how the box 2 rate increase relates to the corporate tax cut and how existing reserves are treated.
How does this increase relate to the path of reducing corporate income tax (Vpb)?
Hoe verhoudt deze verhoging zich tot het pad van verlaging van de Vennootschapsbelasting (Vpb).
Questions the justification for applying the box 2 increase to old profits taxed at higher corporate rates and asks why compartmentalisation was not chosen.
Can the government justify why the box 2 rate increase is also justified for these profits?
Kan de regering motiveren waarom ook voor deze winsten de tariefsverhoging in box 2 te rechtvaardigen is?
Requests examples and data on directors' loans, tax burden comparisons and EU coordination.
These members ask how the tax burden for SMEs and larger companies in the Netherlands compares to each other.</br>
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen hoe de belastingdruk voor het mkb en voor grotere bedrijven in Nederland zich tot elkaar verhouden.
Asks for examples of how box 2 changes affect entrepreneurs and whether the rate affects the investment climate.
These members ask the government whether the box 2 rate affects the investment climate.
Deze leden vragen de regering of het box 2-tarief van invloed is op het vestigingsklimaat.
Asks about the expected shift toward incorporation and the historical development of tax burdens.
Cites VNO-NCW and the Raad van State criticism that the government's comparison of tax burdens is misleading and asks the government to rebut it.
The Council of State also indicates that the cabinet's argumentation is too simplistic a presentation of affairs.</br>
Ook de Raad van State geeft aan dat de argumentatie van het kabinet een te simpele voorstelling van zaken is.
Agrees with shortening the 30% ruling but argues for a two-year transitional arrangement for legal certainty.
The CDA members therefore consider it justified that, for legal certainty, a two-year transitional arrangement nonetheless comes into effect.</br>
De leden van de CDA-fractie achten het daarom gerechtvaardigd dat in het kader van de rechtszekerheid er toch een overgangsregeling van twee jaar komt.
Considers the 30% ruling unnecessary, citing ministry evaluation findings that benefits flow to employers and high earners.
The SP members consider the 30% ruling unnecessary.</br>
De leden van de SP-fractie achten de 30%-regeling onnodig.
Accepts the delayed introduction but asks about housing effects and whether the ruling should be capped for top incomes.
The PvdA members ask why it was not chosen to cap the use of the 30% ruling.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen waarom er niet voor is gekozen het gebruik van de 30%-regeling te maximeren.
Asks about behavioural effects of the 30% ruling limitation and about VAT and water tax effects.
Asks how the transitional arrangement for the 30% ruling is designed and why it yields structural revenue.
What is the cause of the transitional arrangement yielding structural revenue?
Wat is de oorzaak dat de overgangsregeling structureel geld oplevert?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises proceeding with the Belastingplan 2019 but criticises frequent tax changes that undermine predictability, the rushed incomplete package, lack of citizen perspective, the rising top-rate changes for owner-directors, the expanded reduced VAT rate, and calls for a broader tax and benefits reform. The government's reply largely accepts the remarks on timing and citizen perspective, defends the reduced VAT increase and the owner-director rate as part of the coalition agreement, and promises an independent labour market commission and a broader inventory of tax improvements.
concerns: Frequent tax changes undermine predictability and increase complexity, especially for the owner-occupied home regime and the 30%-ruling without transitional law; the government says it will evaluate the home regime but keeps the 30%-ruling change.

Incomplete bills were submitted due to late August budget decisions and the package is too large for careful parliamentary scrutiny; the government agrees and commits to timely complete submissions and more spreading over the year.
Insufficient attention to the citizen perspective; the government commits to a feasibility check in the integrated assessment framework and considers citizens' capacity in its service interaction.

The tariff change for the self-employed deduction and SME profit exemption is insufficient to reduce the gap with employees and does not address progressivity of owner-manager earnings; the government acknowledges only a modest contribution and refers the issue to an independent commission.

Raising the box 2 rate for substantial shareholders has retroactive effect and undermines the rationale for the corporate tax cut; the government maintains it preserves the overall balance and notes shareholders' deferral options.

Raising the reduced VAT rate from 6 to 9 percent should be assessed against full uniformisation of VAT rates or less far-reaching options; the government responds that the rise funds income tax cuts and that the OECD advice is not adopted in the coalition agreement.
The Council calls for a broader review of the tax system and the benefits system in this cabinet period; the government commits to an inventory of research and to informing parliament in early 2019.

35044.s: The bill lets the Sociale verzekeringsbank cross-check insurance registers to identify people who hold health insurance without an insurance obligation, and lets the Minister, Zorginstituut and RIVM process pseudonymised health data for their statutory tasks. It also adds ministerial-regulation delegations to set detailed rules on verifying insurance obligations and address matching.
35044.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by noting that insurers struggle to verify insurance obligations in practice and that the ministerial regulation will concretise rules so the NZa can enforce them.
q: The bill therefore creates the basis to set further rules by ministerial regulation on how the health insurer establishes the insurance obligation.
Het wetsvoorstel creëert daarom de grondslag om bij ministeriële regeling nadere regels te stellen over de vaststelling van de verzekeringsplicht door de zorgverzekeraar
d: rules on establishing insurance obligation and data needed
facts and circumstances ending insurance obligation and how insurer reaches conclusion
designation of registers to be compared by SVB
p: Authorises periodic integral cross-matching of registers by the SVB to identify insured persons without an insurance obligation, with registers set by ministerial regulation.
Allows the Minister to process health data for risk-equalisation criteria, limited to pseudonymised data and with the GDPR Art. 21 objection right disapplied.
Disapplies the GDPR Article 21 objection right for processing by the Zorginstituut, subject to pseudonymisation.
Grants RIVM health-data processing powers for infectious disease control and disapplies the GDPR Article 21 objection right.

parties: Asks how the estimate of 79,000 uninsured-but-insured persons was made and how wrongful cancellation of insurance can be prevented and appealed.
What consequences does it have for the policyholder if he or she does not (timely) provide the information?
Welke consequenties heeft het voor de verzekeringnemer als hij of zij de informatie niet (tijdig) verstrekt?
Questions how the pseudonymisation safeguards work, whether the mechanism can be reversed, and how insurers can be required to apply the Richtlijn gerede twijfel criteria.
Health insurers are not obliged to carry out the actions included in that guideline.
Zorgverzekeraars zijn niet gehouden de in die richtlijn opgenomen handelingen uit te voeren.
Worries about privacy and data-breach risks from many parties holding personal health data, and asks for a new privacy impact assessment after one year.
The more parties hold personal (health) data, for whatever reason or law, the greater the chance of errors or data leaks.
Hoe meer partijen persoonlijke (gezondheids-)gegevens tot hun beschikking hebben (om welke reden/wet dan ook), hoe groter de kans op bijvoorbeeld fouten of datalekken.

35062.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the Enhanced Partnership and Cooperation Agreement between the EU, its member states and Kazakhstan, signed in Astana on 21 December 2015, which the Constitution requires the States General to approve. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
35062.j: The memorandum justifies the agreement by its mixed character, the EU's competences, and the goal of a framework for political dialogue, democratisation and trade; it does not justify any new executive power.
q: The aim of this Agreement is to provide a framework for political dialogue, to support efforts in democratisation and development, and to facilitate trade and investment between the EU and Kazakhstan.

Het doel van deze Overeenkomst is het bieden van een raamwerk voor politieke dialoog, het ondersteunen van inspanningen op het gebied van democratisering en ontwikkeling en het versoepelen van handel en investeringen tussen de EU en Kazachstan.

parties: Asks how the agreement's commitments relate to Kazakhstan's Eurasian Economic Union obligations and whether they have been revised under pressure from other members.
Are these fully compatible? And have the agreements since been revised under pressure from (other) members of the Eurasian Union?
Zijn deze volledig compatibel? En zijn afspraken tussentijds nog herzien onder druk van (andere) leden van de Euraziatische Unie?

Raises serious human rights concerns in Kazakhstan, including political prosecutions, detention of bloggers, torture allegations, and religious freedom restrictions, and asks the government to comment and raise these with Kazakhstan.
On this, the members of the CDA group are concerned.although the sentence is about human rights situation concern.)
Daarover maken de leden van de CDA-fractie zich zorgen.
Has no further questions on the bill.
They have no further questions about the proposal.
Zij hebben over het voorstel geen verdere vragen.

Doubts that Kazakhstan respects the essential elements of democracy, human rights and the rule of law, citing presidential veto power, political prisoners, torture, NGO and journalist persecution, and asks how suspension would be applied.
The members of the SP group have serious doubts about respect for these essential elements and therefore ask for a response to the following information.)
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben ernstige twijfels over eerbiediging van deze essentiële elementen en vragen daarom een reactie op de volgende gegevens

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the bill approving the enhanced Partnership and Cooperation Agreement between the EU and Kazakhstan, asking for clarification of differences from the earlier 1995 agreement and of which parts are provisionally applied as exclusive EU competence. The government's nader rapport reports that the explanatory memorandum was supplemented with an explanation of the mixed nature of the agreement, the provisional application, and the entry-into-force provision.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum was too vague about the concrete differences from the earlier partnership agreement and needed to be made more specific.
The memorandum failed to clarify which parts of the mixed agreement fall under exclusive EU competence and are provisionally applied, which matters for parliament's role in approving mixed treaties.

35080.s: The bill raises several Dutch criminal penalties and adds new offences, including sexual image misuse (art. 139h Sr), stronger penalties for incitement to hatred and discrimination online, and higher sentences for mistreatment of minors and for trafficking in fully automatic firearms. It also extends limitation periods and pre-trial detention options for these offences.
35080.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by pointing to new societal developments such as sexting and the need for a stronger criminal approach to ondermijning and liquidation violence, without delegating new powers.
q: Thus it is that We, having heard the Advisory Division of the Council of State, and in common consultation with the States General, have resolved and decreed as follows
Zo is het, dat Wij, de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State gehoord, en met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan

parties: Asks why diverse offences are bundled in one bill, what the shared rationale is, and what sentences have actually been imposed under the existing provisions.
They ask whether this could not have been handled better in separate bills.
Zij vragen of dit niet beter in verschillende wetsvoorstellen kon worden behandeld.
Questions prioritising higher penalties for speech offences over sexual violence offences and asks whether the wording of the incitement offence meets legal certainty requirements.
Why is priority given to restricting freedom of expression (given the low number of violations of Article 137d) rather than raising the maximum penalty for an offence such as rape?

Waarom wordt prioriteit gegevenn aan het inperken van de vrijheid van meningsuiting (gelet op het lage aantal overtredingen op grond van artikel 137d Sr) in plaats van het verhogen van het strafmaximum van een delict als verkrachting?
Welcomes the broader package, including the new offences and the expanded liability for criminal organisations, as part of an effective approach to organised crime.
They are very positive about the expansion of criminal liability for participation in a seriously undermining criminal organisation and liquidation violence.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn zeer positief over de verruiming van de strafrechtelijke aansprakelijkheid voor deelneming aan een ernstig ondermijnende criminele organisatie en liquidatiegeweld.

Raises a possible evidentiary problem for prosecutors from the chosen intent standard, and asks how the scope of the provisions on misuse of sexual images and the wording on possession will work in practice.
The members, together with the Council for the Judiciary, believe this may create an enormous evidentiary problem for the Public Prosecution Service.
De aan het woord zijnde leden menen samen met de Raad voor de Rechtspraak dat hierdoor mogelijk een enorm bewijsprobleem voor het Openbaar Ministerie wordt gecreëerd.
Supports tougher treatment of discriminatory offences and asks whether penalty aggravation should extend to a wider group of hate crimes and who counts as an emergency worker under the new provision.
The members ask whether provision should not also be made for penalty aggravation for a broader group of offences, better known as hate crimes.
De leden vragen of niet daarnaast voorzien moet worden in strafverzwaring voor een bredere groep delicten, die beter bekend staan als «hate crimes».

Questions the evidential basis for the penalty increases and whether they will deter, prefers more police capacity, and warns that omitting the word 'rechtmatig' in the emergency workers provision could criminalise resistance to lawful medical care.
Can the government confirm that this is not the intention of the bill?
Kan de regering bevestigen dat dit niet de bedoeling van het wetsvoorstel is?
Accepts the proposed tightening of the Criminal Code and asks only a few questions, including why other discrimination offences were not also raised.
These members can agree with the proposed tightening of the Criminal Code.
Deze leden kunnen zich vinden in de voorgestelde aanscherpingen van het Wetboek van Strafrecht.
Supports the new offences but asks how the sexting offence relates to child pornography provisions and whether the bill covers possession of material promoting child abuse.
The aforementioned members request the government to further explain how the criminalisation in Article 136h of the Criminal Code relates to prosecution of sexting involving a minor.
Voornoemde leden verzoeken de regering nader toe te lichten hoe de strafbaarstelling in artikel 136h Sr zich verhoudt tot vervolging van sexting in het geval van een minderjarige.
Asks what sentences are currently imposed for these offences and whether the new provisions on sexual images and emergency workers could lead to disputes about definitions.
Is there not a risk that a discussion will arise in court about whether the images are really 'of a sexual nature'?
Is het risico niet aanwezig dat er in de rechtszaal een discussie gevoerd zal worden over de vraag of de afbeeldingen wel echt «van seksuele aard» zijn?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill redrafting several criminal offences, raising points on the intent wording and explanatory memorandum for the offence of misuse of sexual images and the wording of the offence of obstructing emergency workers. The government's reply accepts both points, amending the explanatory memorandum and the wording of the obstruction offence.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum on the intent element 'opzettelijk en wederrechtelijk' should be brought in line with the statutory text, which does not require intent as to unlawfulness.
The explanatory memorandum's interpretation of 'seksuele aard' is broader or inconsistent with the statutory wording and should be aligned, adapting the text if needed.
The obstruction offence lacks the word 'rechtmatige' used in comparable provisions, and the explanatory memorandum should justify this omission.

35116.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2016/800 on procedural safeguards for children suspected or accused in criminal proceedings by amending the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure and the Surrender Act, adding rights notifications, parental/guardian and trusted-person presence, medical examinations, individual assessments by the child protection board, and limits on pre-trial detention. It also amends Article 491 and 496 rules on appointment of counsel and attendance of parents, and makes conforming changes to the Surrender Act.
35116.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as required to implement the EU directive and notes that existing practice and safeguards such as judicial review under Article 359a Sv apply.
q: They concern, among other things, the appointment of counsel (Articles 489 and 491 CCP) and counsel's representative role for suspects under 16.
Zij hebben onder meer betrekking op de toevoeging van een raadsman (artikelen 489 en 491 Sv) en diens vertegenwoordigende rol voor verdachten tot 16 jaar
p: Allows the duty officer to refuse a child's accompanying person in limited cases, subject to prosecutor approval and the child's interest.
Gives the duty officer discretion to order a medical examination, which is to be non-invasive and recorded in the official report.
Allows the child protection board's advice to be waived in some cases and requires the judgment or penalty order to explain how the advice was taken into account.
Lets the judge refuse parental presence at trial on defined grounds, with a trusted person or child protection representative substituting.

parties: Asks why the implementation bill was sent so late before the deadline, and asks how the Netherlands' subsidiarity and proportionality objections were addressed.
They ask the government whether this could not have been done faster.
Zij vragen de regering of dit niet sneller had gekund?
Asks why the Raad voor de rechtspraak advice on a special curator was not adopted and what safeguards exist for children without a parent or suitable adult.
Can the government explain what safeguards now exist for children in criminal proceedings without a parent or other suitable adult?
Kan de regering uiteenzetten welke waarborgen er nu zijn voor kinderen in het strafproces zonder ouder of andere geschikte volwassene?

Argues that a child without a suitable adult is better served by a special curator, questions the sequencing of ZSM decisions before individual assessment, and doubts adequate protection when no legal counsel is provided for minor offences.
These members doubt whether adequate protection exists if children in the aforementioned cases do not have a legal counsel.
Zij betwijfelen of van een afdoende bescherming sprake is als kinderen in de hiervoor genoemde gevallen niet beschikken over een raadsman.
Asks whether legal aid should be provided to minors in all cases, since a criminal record from an OM penalty order has lasting consequences and some such orders did not meet rule-of-law standards.
It has recently become clear that a large number of OM penalty orders did not meet the rule-of-law standards that may be applied to them.
Recent is duidelijk geworden dat een groot aantal OM-strafbeschikkingen niet voldeden aan de rechtstatelijke eisen die daaraan gesteld mogen worden.

Asks why minors are denied legal aid in several situations, why legal aid is not free, why the right to legal aid is absent before the kantonrechter, and what effective legal remedy exists when children's rights are breached.
Effective legal remedy: the SP members ask what effective legal remedy the government thinks must exist for children whose rights under this directive have been breached.

Voorziening in rechte De leden van de SP-fractie vragen welke doeltreffende voorziening in rechte er volgens de regering moet zijn voor kinderen in die gevallen waarin hun in deze richtlijn gegeven rechten zijn geschonden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised revisions to the bill implementing Directive 2016/800 on procedural safeguards for child suspects, concerning legal aid for minors in minor cases and the medical examination provision naming only nurses. The Minister's reply accepted the medical examination change and clarified legal aid in juvenile procedures, and incorporated the drafting suggestions.
concerns: Legal aid may be withheld for minors in minor cases, but the Afdeling doubts minors can effectively exercise defence rights when convicted without counsel and only assisted at conversion to detention.

The medical examination provision mentions only a nurse, not the directive's broader qualified professional, so the wording should be adjusted; the reply removed the nurse reference and specified doctor or doctor-supervised examination.
Several redactional improvements, transposition table detail and explanatory memorandum additions were requested and incorporated.

35125.s: The bill adds a new article 134b to the Dutch Criminal Code making it a crime for Dutch nationals and long-term residents to knowingly stay, without ministerial permission, in an area designated by general administrative order as controlled by a terrorist organisation. It also extends Dutch jurisdiction over this offence and allows pre-trial detention powers to apply, with a five-year evaluation report to parliament.
35125.j: The memorandum justifies the new offence by the difficulty of proving terrorist activities in closed conflict areas and the need for a safety net, and it argues the designation by AMvB ensures careful preparation and Council of State advice.
q: However, there is no view of what exactly happens in areas controlled by terrorist organisations.
Het zicht ontbreekt evenwel op hetgeen precies gebeurt in gebieden die onder controle staan van terroristische organisaties.
d: Artikel I, B (art. 134b, eerste lid Sr)
designation of areas controlled by terrorist organisations
p: Criminal liability depends on an area designated by general administrative order and on ministerial permission, giving the executive discretion to determine who may lawfully be present in certain areas.
Adds the new offence to the list in article 67 Sv, allowing pre-trial detention for this offence.
Requires the minister to report to parliament within five years on the effectiveness and effects of the law.

parties: Asks why a one-year maximum was chosen and whether the permission procedure and aid-worker exemption are weighed appropriately.
They see this criminalisation as a desirable addition to the existing criminal law instruments.
Zij zien deze strafbaarstelling als een wenselijke aanvulling op het bestaande strafrechtelijke instrumentarium
Supports the bill as a necessary addition to prosecute returning fighters and asks about clarity of the norm and the area designation process.
They therefore consider this bill a necessary addition to what is already possible.
Zij achten onderhavig wetsvoorstel dan ook een noodzakelijke aanvulling op wat nu al mogelijk is
Asks how areas are designated, how parliament is involved, and how the bill fits international law and the lex certa principle.
In what way will the House be involved in this?
Op welke wijze wordt de Kamer hierbij betrokken?
Doubts necessity and constitutional and human-rights compatibility; questions the permission requirement's threat to independent aid and journalism and the vagueness of 'controlled area'.
These members have considerable doubts and questions about this bill.
Deze leden hebben de nodige twijfels en vragen bij dit wetsvoorstel.
Asks about effectiveness and a possible chilling effect of the permission requirement on journalists and aid workers.
Can the government explain why this does not lead to a chilling effect?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom dit niet leidt tot een «chilling effect»
Notes the Council of State advised against the bill and that consultation objections were not adequately answered; questions necessity and political influence over permissions.
A bill, these members would note, of which the Council of State's advisory division sees neither use nor necessity.
Een wetsvoorstel, zo zouden deze leden willen opmerken, waarvan de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State nut noch noodzaak inziet.
Supports the need but asks for clarification on area determination, notification of residents, and safety of aid workers and journalists; requests a thorough evaluation.
The aforementioned members request the government to further explain how the situation on the ground will be established.
Voornoemde leden verzoeken de regering nader toe te lichten op welke wijze gaat worden vastgesteld wat de situatie ter plaatse is
Asks whether parliament will be involved in designating areas by AMvB, how shifting borders will be handled, and where the permission procedure is legally grounded.
These members ask in what way this is guaranteed.
Deze leden vragen op welke wijze dit is gewaarborgd.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a draft bill criminalising unauthorised presence in areas controlled by terrorist organisations, finding the necessity of the measure not demonstrated given existing criminal and administrative tools and the difficulty of proving presence. The government's nader rapport, dated 16 January 2019, largely maintains the proposal, adding justification, clarifications on the travel ban relationship, a permit procedure, and carve-outs for those present against their will, while not accepting the necessity objection.
concerns: The Afdeling found the necessity of criminalising presence in controlled areas not demonstrated, since existing criminal and administrative instruments suffice, and the government only partly accepted this by adding justification while maintaining the future added value argument.

The Afdeling considered that the offence reaches persons without any link to the terrorist organisation, such as women, children, missionaries and aid workers, and the government responded by adding a permit procedure and clarifying the intent requirement.
The restriction on freedom of movement under the ECHR and ICCPR needed justification, and the government added a passage on necessity under the ECHR and on the balancing when designating areas.

The Afdeling doubted that an area could be designated as controlled by a terrorist organisation earlier than prosecution of Dutch nationals could proceed, and the government only partly responded by distinguishing control of an area from mapping individual roles.

The overlap with the existing travel ban under the Temporary Act on administrative counter-terrorism measures was noted, and the government clarified the differing purposes and scope of the two instruments.

35152.s: The bill amends the Dutch Bibob integrity-screening act to broaden its application to all public procurement, real-estate transactions including reduction or termination of participation and consent to sell leasehold, and public subsidies including education and research funding. It also lets administrative bodies conduct their own integrity investigations, extends data sources and retention periods, and adds new refusal and revocation grounds for permits and subsidies.
35152.j: The memorandum justifies the broader powers by the need to protect public-sector integrity against organised crime, arguing the existing scope is no longer needed and that proportionality and restraint apply.
q: I no longer consider the current limitation of Bibob investigations for public contracts to the construction, ICT and environment sectors necessary.
Ik acht de geldende beperking van Bibob-onderzoeken tot overheidsopdrachten in de sectoren bouw, ict en milieu daarom niet langer nodig.
d: permits and decisions that may be refused or revoked under Bibob
applying Bibob to customs prohibitions and restrictions decisions
Artikel I, onderdeel H / Artikel 7a, lid 5 (ministerial forms)
forms for data supplied to administrative bodies' own investigation
p: Artikel I, onderdeel I (artikel 7a, eigen onderzoek)
Administrative bodies may conduct their own integrity investigations into persons, using wide-ranging data, before referring to the Bureau.
Prosecution decisions not to pursue a case no longer bind administrators; discontinued or unproven offences can still ground a finding of danger.
Artikel I, onderdeel C (artikel 3, zesde en zevende lid)
Permits may be refused or revoked on grounds of danger of offences committed to keep a permit, not only to obtain it.
Expands the government bodies and officials that may receive Bureau information, including for reporting offences and filing complaints.
Artikel I, onderdeel T and O (artikel 19, 29)
Extends the period during which Bibob data and advice may be retained and reused from two to five years.
Extends the right to be heard to third parties named in a proposed decision and to public-law-body procurement decisions.

parties: Supports strengthening the Bibob Act against organised crime but asks whether the act can be sharpened, consistency of terms, and how jurisprudence on criminal data use is shifting.
They are strong supporters of the Bibob Act and support any extension of this act that can strengthen the approach to undermining crime.

Zij zijn groot voorstander van de Wet bevordering integriteitsbeoordelingen door het openbaar bestuur (hierna: Wet Bibob) en steunen iedere uitbreiding van deze wet die de aanpak van ondermijnende criminaliteit kan versterken.
Welcomes the Bibob extensions but worries about reliance on the GVA and asks about appeal routes against refusals of lease transfers and timing of further measures.
These members welcome the necessary extensions to the Bibob Act.
Deze leden verwelkomen de nodige uitbreidingen aan de Wet Bibob.

Asks how expanded third-party data processing fits the GDPR, how personal data is protected, whether case-by-case discretion may lead to arbitrariness, and how uniformity and data currency are safeguarded.
However, the members ask how this expansion of data processing has been tested against, and brought into line with, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
Wel stellen de aan het woord zijnde leden de vraag hoe deze uitbreiding van verwerking van gegevens is getoetst aan, en in lijn gebracht is met de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG).

Asks how a balance is secured between administrative integrity measures and criminal law enforcement, the role of mayors versus police and justice, and capacity and quality differences among small and large municipalities.
These members therefore ask the government to explain how a balanced equilibrium between promoting integrity on the one hand and tackling crime on the other is safeguarded within the Bibob Act.

Deze leden vragen de regering dan ook toe te lichten hoe een evenwichtige balans tussen integriteitbevordering aan de ene kant en de aanpak van criminaliteit aan de andere kant wordt geborgd binnen de Wet Bibob.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill amending the Wet Bibob (administrative integrity screening), raising concerns about extending it to all sectors, the weight of own investigations by administrative bodies, use of criminal-prosecution data, and an express exception for parliamentary information duties. The government reply accepted the advice on sectors (with added justification), defended the own-investigation changes, adopted the advice to clarify criminal-data use, and deleted the parliamentary exception.
concerns: Extension of Bibob to all sectors needs fuller justification showing integrity risks beyond milieu, bouw and ICT; the government added justification but kept the broad extension.

Shifting screening to administrative bodies' own investigations may weaken quality and uniformity compared to the Landelijk Bureau Bibob; the government argued safeguards suffice but did not add evidence from past experience.
Whether criminal investigations dropped for lack of evidence can be weighed in Bibob decisions needs explanation; the government expanded the explanatory memorandum.
The express exception to confidentiality for information duties toward parliament is unusual and creates a risk of a contrario reasoning; the government deleted it.

35161.s: The bill gives the Gezondheidsraad's circulatory-death determination protocols a statutory basis to be set by general administrative order subject to a nahang procedure, and allows donation questions and consent to be raised before death is declared. It also removes the requirement that the donor form be set by AMvB, lets the NTS set the form, and adds four-week waiting periods before certain AMvBs are submitted to Parliament.
35161.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to preserve organ quality after death and the practical problem of asking the donation question only after death is declared.
q: For the avoidance of doubt, it is emphasised that the present proposal makes no changes regarding the determination of brain death.
Voor de goede orde wordt benadrukt dat het onderhavige voorstel geen wijzigingen behelst ten aanzien van het vaststellen van de hersendood.
d: rules on providing donor data to the organ centre
donation form set by the organ centre (NTS)
p: Consent to organ donation may be obtained before death is declared when circulatory death is expected, reducing the time and protection available to the patient and relatives.
Medical staff may ask the donation question before death is declared, allowing the donation decision to be raised earlier in the dying process.
Removes the earlier conditions on the donor form and deletes the requirement that the patient be ventilated, widening when organ removal may proceed.

parties: Asks how relatives' objections and consent are safeguarded before organs are removed, including when no relatives can be reached or the patient lacks capacity.
These members ask how this procedure guarantees that no organs are removed if there are no relatives or they cannot be reached.](as translated)
Genoemde leden vragen op welke wijze in deze procedure gewaarborgd is dat er geen organen worden uitgenomen als er geen nabestaanden zijn of bereikt kunnen worden
Supports the bill but asks whether the government fully adopts the Health Council advice or departs from it, and when the protocols will be fixed by AMvB.
These members ask the government whether with this amendment it adopts the advice in full or departs from it on some points.
Genoemde leden vragen de regering of zij met deze wetswijziging het advies in zijn geheel overneemt of dat er ook op punten wordt afgeweken van het advies.
Stresses that the donor shortage must not compromise care, and questions why the protocols were used before having a statutory basis in the Wod.
This shortage of donor organs, however, must not play a role when it comes to care in organ and tissue donation.](as translated)
Dit tekort aan donororganen mag echter geen rol spelen als het gaat om zorgvuldigheid bij orgaan- en weefseldonaties

35170.s: The bill amends the Politiewet 2012 to require integrity screening (betrouwbaarheidsonderzoek) for police officers and for external persons working for the police, the rijksrecherche or the Politieacademie, including broader data sources, household-member checks, continuous monitoring of criminal records, a reporting duty and periodic re-screening. It sets procedural rules, makes screening decisions appealable administrative decisions, and leaves many details to lower-level regulation.
35170.j: The memorandum justifies the new screening powers and the delegations by the need to safeguard police integrity given access to confidential information and police powers, and cites research on criminal family ties and corruption.
q: The bill proposes requiring a certificate of conduct for certain work, departing from the competent authority's reliability screening, and requiring a new certificate periodically.

Het voorliggende wetsvoorstel stelt voor bepaalde werkzaamheden als eis dat een VOG wordt overgelegd, in afwijking van het betrouwbaarheidsonderzoek door het bevoegd gezag, alsmede dat periodiek een nieuwe VOG wordt overgelegd.
d: designation of technical, administrative and other police support work exempt from screening
designation of external work posing integrity risk requiring screening
designation of offences that imply an objection to appointment
designation of work carrying heightened integrity risk
procedure before, during and after screening
facts and periods triggering renewed screening
period for resubmitting certificate of conduct
rules on reporting changes in circumstances
p: Artikel I D (art. 47b, lid 3 sub c and d; art. 47c)

Allows police authorities to examine health signals of addiction and open-source and other personal data, and data on partners and relatives, expanding discretionary investigation into citizens' private lives for integrity screening.
Artikel I D (art. 47a, lid 5 and 6; art. 47e)

Authorities judge whether sufficient guarantees of reliability exist, with conviction creating a presumed objection that the authority may set aside; decisions are appealable administrative decisions.
Introduces continuous monitoring of criminal records via the Justitiële informatiedienst, reporting duties and periodic re-screening of officers and externals without a case-specific trigger.
Designates the competent authority as controller for screening data, with retention capped at five years and a data protection officer overseeing processing.

parties: Asks how medical and other personal data can be collected without breaching medical confidentiality, how hearing and counter-hearing applies, and whether household members must cooperate.
How does this relate to a possible (medical) professional secrecy? How is it prevented that unjustly incriminating data is provided?
Hoe verhoudt dit zich tot een eventueel (medisch) beroepsgeheim? Hoe wordt voorkomen dat onterecht belastende gegevens worden verstrekt?
Asks for guarantees that stress-related conditions such as PTSS will not lead to a finding of unreliability and for clear, binding assessment criteria applied by the bureau VIK.

What guarantees are there, the CDA members ask, that addictions arising to a greater or lesser extent from stressful police work, or related to occupational conditions such as PTSS, do not directly lead to a finding of unreliability?

Welke garanties zijn er, zo vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie, dat verslavingen die in meerdere of mindere mate voortkomen uit het (soms) stressvolle politiewerk, of die bijvoorbeeld te relateren zijn aan bepaalde beroeps-ziektebeelden zoals PTSS, niet direct leiden tot een oordeel van geen-betrouwbaarheid?

Questions whether the burden of proof between the competent authority and the person screened is in balance and asks how the independence of the screening is guaranteed when the authority itself is screened.
These members have doubts whether the burden of proof between the competent authority and the person concerned is sufficiently in balance in this way and ask the government to reflect on this.
Deze leden hebben twijfels of op deze wijze de bewijslast tussen bevoegd gezag en betrokkene wel voldoende in balans is en vragen de regering hierop te reflecteren.

Questions whether the scrutiny of financial situation and the extended household investigation is a disproportionate infringement of privacy and asks who sets the indications for investigating persons in the environment and under what strict conditions.

The aforementioned members ask whether submitting so many documents on financial situation, for example regarding maintenance obligations and mortgage debts, is not a disproportionate infringement of privacy.

Voornoemde leden vragen of het overleggen van zoveel stukken over de financiële situatie, bijvoorbeeld als het gaat om alimentatieverplichtingen en hypotheekschulden, niet een onevenredige inbreuk is op de privacy.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a government bill extending background screening of police officers and police externals, objecting to a hard bar for certain criminal convictions, insufficient legal protection against negative screening outcomes, and an understated administrative burden. The government's reply accepted the main points, making the bar discretionary, treating screening decisions as appealable beschikkingen, and adding detail on implementation costs.
concerns: The hard bar on convictions for designated offences leaves no room for individual weighing, so the law must allow some discretion for case-specific assessment.
Local bodies need a common assessment framework to avoid unequal treatment in screening decisions on criminal records.
Insufficient avenues for legal protection exist: candidates and serving officers cannot challenge a negative screening outcome as such, so the bill must provide effective remedies.
The explanatory memorandum understates the structural administrative costs of continuous screening, change reporting and repeat investigations, which must be addressed more explicitly.
