35210-X.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2019 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence, raising expenditure and revenue appropriations by thousands of euros. It contains no delegation of rule-making power or changes to the institutions that check the executive.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2019
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2019

35224.s: The bill amends the Dutch Surrender Act (Overleveringswet) so that an investigating judge (rechter-commissaris) rather than a public prosecutor issues European arrest warrants, following a 2019 CJEU ruling that prosecutors do not qualify as independent judicial authorities. It also updates related provisions so the investigating judge handles contacts, seizure requests, hearings and temporary transfers, while the prosecutor provides information and carries out some steps.
35224.j: The memorandum justifies the change by the CJEU ruling that prosecutors cannot be treated as issuing judicial authorities because of possible ministerial instructions, and by the investigating judge's suitability as an independent judge.
q: Any investigating judge can act as the issuing judicial authority.
Elke rechter-commissaris kan fungeren als uitvaardigende justitiële autoriteit.
p: Artikel I B, C, D, E (artikelen 44, 45, 46, 56)

Competence to issue European arrest warrants moves from the public prosecutor, who is under ministerial instruction power, to the investigating judge, a judicial officer, strengthening independence of the issuing authority.

35233.s: The bill amends the Meststoffenwet to implement the sixth Nitrates Directive action programme, replacing statutory phosphate-use norms with a delegated framework and adding production ceilings for manure from dairy, pig and poultry farming. It enables general administrative orders to impose across-the-board reductions of production rights when ceilings are exceeded or treaty obligations require it.
35233.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to implement the sixth action programme in time and to allow soil classification to be settled later as research on the combined indicator proceeds.
q: To still make full implementation of the sixth Nitrates Directive action programme possible in 2020 and 2021, this bill proposes to remove the parts on the indicator and soil phosphate classification from the bill.

Om de volledige implementatie van het zesde actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn per 2020 en 2021 toch mogelijk te maken wordt in dit wetsvoorstel voorgesteld om de onderdelen inzake de indicator en klasse-indeling van de fosfaattoestand van de bodem te laten vervallen in dit wetsvoorstel.
d: higher phosphate-use norms by soil condition, crops and area
conditions and limits on higher phosphate norms
percentage reduction of dairy phosphate rights
percentage reduction of pig and poultry rights when production ceilings exceeded
reduction of pig or poultry rights to meet binding international obligations
reduction of pig or poultry rights on transfer when ceilings threatened
p: Allows the executive by general administrative order to reduce pig and poultry production rights, a property-related burden, without parliamentary involvement, with a percentage fixed by the order.
Removes the prior parliamentary pre-consultation (voorhang) requirement for the order reducing animal rights on transfer.
Moves variation of phosphate-use norms below the statutory level into ministerial regulation, with conditions set by ministerial order.

parties: Questions why generic reduction of animal rights needs to be laid down in statute and objects to farmers being forced to surrender rights without clear safeguards.
The VVD members cannot accept including in this law the possible generic reduction of animal rights.
De leden van de VVD-fractie kunnen zich niet vinden in het opnemen in deze wet van het mogelijk generiek korten op dierrechten.
Opposes the power to generically reduce poultry and pig farmers' rights without compensation and argues other measures are available before such a drastic step.
The CDA members are opposed to creating the possibility to generically reduce poultry and pig farmers' quotas.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn tegen het creëren van de mogelijkheid om pluimvee- en varkenshouders generiek te kunnen korten.
Supports the Nitrates Directive and national law but asks whether enforcement is strong enough, how the derogation will be secured, and how production forecasts and class assignments are determined.
Can the government explain on the basis of which data and criteria it is determined when there is an imminent exceedance of the ceilings?
Kan de regering vertellen op basis van welke gegevens en op basis van welke criteria wordt bepaald wanneer er sprake is van een dreigende overschrijding van de plafonds?

Questions the generic reduction power, argues it is one-sided, and asks for a prior parliamentary consultation (voorhang) procedure for the delegated AMvB because the reductions could have large impacts.
The SGP members place large question marks next to the proposed possibility of generic reduction when a sectoral ceiling is exceeded.
De leden van de SGP-fractie zetten grote vraagtekens bij de voorgestelde mogelijkheid om generiek te korten bij overschrijding van een sectorplafond.
Argues the ceilings ignore the recent nitrogen court rulings and asks how generic reductions will be applied humanely and under which conditions, requesting statutory ceilings for other species.

The Partij voor de Dieren members ask whether the government can confirm that the production ceilings to be legally fixed by this amendment take no account of recent developments in the nitrogen file.

De leden van de Partij voor de Dieren-fractie vragen of de regering kan bevestigen dat bij de productieplafonds zoals deze, die met de voorliggende wijziging wettelijk worden vastgelegd, geen rekening is gehouden met de recente ontwikkelingen op het stikstofdossier.

35242.s: The bill amends the Dutch Intelligence and Security Services Act 2017 to require that the use of special powers be as targeted as possible, to shorten the deadline for weighing cooperation with foreign services, and to expand reporting duties to the review body CTIVD on sharing unevaluated data with foreign services. It also adjusts the interaction with the Open Government Act and allows deputy members of the Investigation Powers Review Committee to be appointed.
35242.j: The memorandum justifies the new sharing powers by the need to act in urgent situations and to keep intelligence cooperation effective, while adding oversight notification to the CTIVD.
q: The provision of data may relate to both evaluated and unevaluated data.
De verstrekking van gegevens kan betrekking hebben op zowel geëvalueerde als ongeëvalueerde gegevens.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel F (art. 43, achtste lid)
rules on DNA research, DNA profiles and handling of cell material
Artikel I, onderdeel I (art. 52, eerste lid)
categories of data that a tasking order may cover
p: Services may share data with foreign services without a cooperation relationship, or where the weighing finds regular sharing impossible, on a pressing and weighty ground with ministerial consent and notice to the CTIVD.
Deputy members may be appointed to the Investigation Powers Review Committee and the committee's members are appointed for six years by royal decree on joint ministerial nomination.
Artikel I, onderdeel B en C (art. 26 en 29)
Use of powers must be as targeted as possible, with requests for special powers required to justify targeting, proportionality and subsidiarity.

parties: Asks whether the codified targeting criterion is proportionate and whether expanding the CTIVD notification duty makes the services unworkable and shifts too much power to the CTIVD.
This gives these members the impression that the CTIVD is increasingly drawing power to itself.
Dit wekt bij deze leden de indruk dat de CTIVD steeds meer macht naar zichzelf toetrekt.
Asks about the experience with the 2018 policy rules, the scope of the targeting criterion for open-source data collection, and how the bill serves service effectiveness.
These members ask what the experiences in practice are with the policy rules that entered into force on 1 May 2018.
Deze leden vragen wat de ervaringen in de uitvoeringspraktijk zijn met de beleidsregels die op 1 mei 2018 in werking zijn getreden.
Supports the amendments but asks why the TIB does not authorise sharing of unevaluated data with foreign services and requests an earlier evaluation of the Wiv 2017.
Although the D66 members welcome this development, the choice was made not to apply an independent ex-ante TIB authorisation to the exchange of unevaluated data.
Alhoewel de leden van de D66-fractie deze ontwikkeling verwelkomen, is gekozen een onafhankelijke ex-ante TIB-autorisatie niet toe te passen op de uitwisseling van ongeëvalueerde gegevens.

Argues the powers need formal-law safeguards, objects to sharing unevaluated data with foreign services, questions the lack of journalist and medical-secrecy protections, and wants bulk data analysis safeguards for all data.
In light of public accountability and historical research, however, it is important that historians should at some point be able to gain access to (parts of) the services' archives.

Het is in het licht van publieke verantwoording en historisch onderzoek evenwel van belang dat historici op enig moment toegang zouden moeten kunnen krijgen tot (delen) van de archieven van de diensten.
Questions why the amendment came so late after the referendum, how the criticism is addressed, and how persons outside investigations are protected against automated bulk data analysis.
How does the government safeguard the interests of people who are not part of the investigation?
Hoe waarborgt de regering de belangen van mensen die geen onderdeel zijn van het onderzoek?
Supports codifying the targeting criterion for legal certainty and privacy, but questions financial and urgency-based exceptions and the sharing of unevaluated data in emergency situations.
They do, however, raise questions about some limitations of this criterion put forward by the TIB in the explanatory memorandum.
Wel stellen zij vragen bij enkele door de TIB in de MvT naar voren gebrachte beperkingen van dit criterium.

Opposes mass surveillance and sharing of unevaluated data with foreign services, criticises the TIB's conditional approvals and rejection rates, and asks for prior review rather than after-the-fact notification.
For the Partij voor de Dieren it is unacceptable that collected data are shared unseen with third parties.
Voor de Partij voor de Dieren is het onbestaanbaar dat verzamelde gegevens ongezien gedeeld worden met derden.
Views the amendments as mainly clarifications of what was already implicit in the law and asks technical drafting questions about the appointment of deputy TIB members.
They have the impression that the proposed amendments are generally a specification and clarification of matters already implicit in the law.
Zij hebben de indruk dat de voorgestelde wijzigingen in het algemeen een precisering en verduidelijking zijn van zaken die impliciet al in de wet stonden.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wiv 2017 (intelligence and security services act), raising concerns about sharing unevaluated data with foreign services, the overlap with the Woo, and thin treatment of consultation responses. The government's nader rapport accepts most remarks, clarifies the data-sharing regime and aligns the Woo exception, and expands the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling found unclear whether article 2 of the policy rules forbids sharing unevaluated data with foreign services lacking a cooperation relationship under article 64; the government clarified the relationship and agreed to restate the policy rules.
The Afdeling asked for consultation with the Woo initiators because the bill and the Woo proposal contain conflicting samenloop provisions; the government consulted and aligned the provisions.
The Afdeling noted that the explanatory memorandum did not adequately address consultation responses; the government supplemented the memorandum.

35251.s: The bill amends the Dutch Wet handhaving consumentenbescherming to implement EU Regulation 2017/2394 on consumer protection cooperation. It adds new enforcement powers for authorities: test purchases under a fictitious identity, and orders to remove online content, block hosting services, or delete domain names, with prior judicial authorization.
35251.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as required by the EU regulation and argues that proportionality safeguards, including prior judicial authorisation and a reporting duty, are sufficient.
d: designation of competent authorities by general administrative order
p: Authorises supervisory officials to act under a fictitious identity and provide false information when test-purchasing from traders, exempting them from the identification duty, where urgently necessary.

Lets the ACM impose independent orders on online platforms, hosting providers and domain registries to remove content or block access, subject to prior authorisation by a judge-commissioner and a ban on internet traffic blocking.

parties: Asks whether the report on use of a fictitious identity should instead document how the supervisor used its power, so that courts can review it afterwards.
This report must be drawn up so that the judge can afterwards review how the supervisor has used its power.
Dit verslag dient te worden gemaakt zodat voor de rechter achteraf toetsbaar is hoe de toezichthouder van haar bevoegdheid gebruik heeft gemaakt.
Asks why prior review by an independent official, as the Raad van State advised, was not chosen, and whether the government will add it; also questions the safeguards for the new powers.
The Council of State's advisory division considers prior review necessary, which could be assigned to an official at the supervisor who is not engaged in exercising supervision.

De Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State (hierna: de Afdeling) vindt een voorafgaande toetsing noodzakelijk, die zou kunnen worden belegd bij een functionaris bij de toezichthouder die niet is belast bij de uitoefening van het toezicht.
Concerned the bill is far-reaching for businesses and citizens' fundamental rights; questions DNS-level intervention against WRR advice and asks about alternative legal protection.
The bill is far-reaching for businesses and the fundamental rights of citizens.
Het wetsvoorstel is ingrijpend voor ondernemingen en de grondrechten van burgers.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the bill amending the Consumer Protection Enforcement Act, implementing EU Regulation 2017/2394, lacks adequate safeguards for the new power to use a fictitious identity for test purchases, which should be subject to prior internal or external review and a uniform assessment framework. In its reply, the State Secretary accepted the need for a uniform framework coordinated by the ACM, added written justification requirements, and explained why prior authorisation by a judge is used for the other powers but not for the fictitious identity power.
concerns: The Afdeling argues the fictitious-identity power needs prior review to ensure proportionate use, while the government maintains that proportionality assessment by the authority itself, with later judicial review, suffices for this milder power.
The Afdeling notes that the exercise of supervisory powers can affect citizens' and businesses' rights and that adequate safeguards must accompany them, including the fictitious-identity power.
The Afdeling advises a uniform assessment framework across the various supervisory authorities to ensure consistent, effective and proportionate deployment of the new power.

35300-X.s: This bill fixes the 2020 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (expenditure of about 11.035 billion euros and receipts of about 264.6 million euros) and the 2020 budget statement of the Paresto agency. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and provides that the act enters into force on 1 January 2020 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2020 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2020 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the 2020 budget bills (begrotingsstaten) for Defence and the other ministries and advises submitting them to the Tweede Kamer, and it advises that the advice be made public. The Minister of Finance replies in a nader rapport that some budgets need amendments, which are set out in annexes to the reply.

35305.s: The bill introduces a withholding tax on interest and royalty payments to affiliated recipients in low-tax jurisdictions and in abusive situations, with the Dutch tax authority empowered to set rules via ministerial regulation. It also amends anti-abuse provisions in the corporate income tax (CFC and related rules) and dividend tax to align them with EU case law.
35305.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulations as needed to specify technical conditions such as the low-tax jurisdiction list and substance requirements, and the discretionary powers as needed for effective anti-abuse enforcement.
q: In exercising this discretionary power the inspector must of course observe the general principles of proper administration.
Bij de uitoefening van deze discretionaire bevoegdheid dient de inspecteur uiteraard de algemene beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur in acht te nemen.
d: 2.1 (ministeriële regeling on conditions for presumption of no abuse)
conditions for presumption that structure is not abusive
conditions for substantive economic activity of controlled entity
conditions for presumption regarding substantial interest and abuse
conditions for presumption regarding dividend tax exemption abuse
p: 3.2 and 6.2 (correction to arm's length; discretionary power of inspector)
The inspector may determine benefits as if arm's-length terms applied and may choose which group entity to assess, with duties of proper administration as the only stated limit.
The inspector may issue information orders and may burden withholding agents and related parties with information duties, with appeal available.
Directors become jointly and severally liable for withholding tax unless they show the non-payment was not their fault.

parties: Asks why there is no exemption for companies with real presence, whether budgetary effects are expected, and asks for explicit information to parliament before the Belastingplan 2021 debate.
They ask the government to explicitly and separately inform the House (well before the debate on the Belastingplan 2021) if the bill nonetheless has budgetary consequences.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering de Kamer expliciet en apart te informeren (ruim voor de behandeling van het Belastingplan 2021) wanneer het wetsvoorstel toch budgettaire gevolgen heeft.

Supports the withholding tax as a necessary instrument but asks about the discretionary powers of the inspector to choose the party for the additional assessment and about the scope of anti-abuse rules.
Asks technical questions on definitions, EU tax rates, international coordination, budgetary effects and monitoring, without raising checks on the executive.
The D66 members see this act as an important measure in tackling tax avoidance and evasion.
Deze leden zien deze wet als een belangrijke maatregel in de aanpak van belastingontwijking en -ontduiking.
Questions the legal coherence of the low-tax definition against EU state-aid rules, raises the CPB's critique of effectiveness, and asks whether broader measures were considered.

Argues the measure is too limited to close the Netherlands as a tax haven, asks how the discretionary powers of the Belastingdienst will be publicly accounted for, and questions how abuse is identified.
How is it publicly accounted for to what extent the Belastingdienst will use its discretionary power?
Hoe wordt publiekelijk verantwoord in hoeverre de Belastingdienst gebruik gaat maken van haar discretionaire bevoegdheid?
Welcomes the withholding tax but warns that too many exceptions and a narrow scope risk making it toothless, and asks about the expected effect on conduit flows and the 22 billion euro in scope.
If there are too many exceptions or too narrow a scope, the levy threatens to become a toothless monster, and that seems to be exactly what has happened.
Bij te veel uitzonderingen of een te beperkt toepassingsgebied dreigt de heffing een tandeloos monster te worden, en dat lijkt precies te zijn gebeurd.
Welcomes the bill as an important step and asks how it relates to international efforts on uniform tax bases and minimum rates.
The ChristenUnie members have noted the Wet Bronbelasting 2021 with approval.
De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie hebben met instemming kennisgenomen van de Wet Bronbelasting 2021.
Criticises that the measure excludes European countries not on the EU blacklist, leaving aggressive structures possible, and asks why a nominal rather than effective tax rate was chosen.
Furthermore, these members ask why the government chose a nominal rather than an effective tax rate.
Voorts vragen deze leden waarom de regering voor een nominaal in plaats van een effectief tarief heeft gekozen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Wet bronbelasting 2021 introducing a withholding tax on interest and royalties and raised no remarks, advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Staatssecretaris van Financiën replied in a nader rapport, noting only minor redactional and technical improvements made to the bill and explanatory memorandum.

35332.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands a treaty between Switzerland and Austria establishing and governing the International Centre for Migration Policy Development (ICMPD), as amended and supplemented. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.

parties: Doubts Dutch added value of membership and fears binding harmonisation of admission procedures and loss of national control over migration policy, including whether Dutch veto exists over ICMPD agreements.
Can the government guarantee that this will not be legally binding to any degree?
Kan de regering garanderen dat dit in geen enkele mate juridisch bindend zal zijn?
Views ICMPD as a useless meddling body likely to worsen the asylum and migration crisis.
a new meddling body that, like all those other worthless institutions, will more likely worsen the asylum and migration crisis than reduce it
een nieuw bemoei-orgaan is, dat net als al die andere waardeloze instellingen eerder zal zorgen voor een verergering van de asiel- en migratiecrisis
Asks what concrete added value membership brings, the legal status of ICMPD proposals, whether harmonisation is a national matter, and the rising costs of contributions.
What (legal) status do these proposals have?
Welcomes membership as a way to unblock the European migration dialogue and asks which topics and partners the government expects ICMPD to help with.
The D66 members are positive about the government's intention to join the ICMPD.
De leden van de D66-fractie zijn positief over het voornemen van de regering om zich aan te sluiten bij het ICMPD

Asks how binding ICMPD proposals are, how often decisions by (qualified) majority are taken, which third parties donate, and whether ICMPD could bind the Netherlands through agreements with other states.

Opposes the ICMPD as another unnecessary body likely to worsen the migration crisis and asks whether the minister will reconsider membership given its recommendation to influence public perception on immigration.
Given these worrying recommendations, is the Minister willing to reconsider membership of the ICMPD?
Is de Minister, gelet op deze zorgwekkende aanbevelingen, bereid om lidmaatschap van het ICMPD te heroverwegen?

Notes that member states have no veto over strategic choices and decisions are taken by (qualified) majority, so asks how much real influence the Netherlands would have and why membership is necessary when non-members can join dialogues.

The CDA members therefore wonder – especially given the geographic position of most contracting states at the ICMPD – how much influence the Netherlands can actually exert over the ICMPD's work programme and policy developments.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen zich daarom af – zeker gezien de geografische positie van de meeste verdragsluitende staten bij het ICMPD – hoeveel invloed Nederland nu daadwerkelijk kan uitoefenen op het werkprogramma en de beleidsmatige ontwikkelingen van het ICMPD.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a treaty between Switzerland and Austria on the International Centre for Migration Policy Development (ICMPD), raising no substantive remarks and recommending submission to both chambers of parliament. The government's reply (nader rapport) states the treaty gives no reason for substantive comments and requests authorization to submit it for tacit approval.

35350-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2019 departmental budget statement of the Dutch Staten-Generaal (the two chambers of parliament) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting appropriations for the Eerste Kamer, the Tweede Kamer, and unallocated items. It is a purely budgetary adjustment that sets amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective the day after publication, retroactive to 1 December 2019.
35350-IIA.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to loon- and prijsbijstelling and project delays, not by any delegation or new powers.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Staten-Generaal for the year 2019 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal voor het jaar 2019 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35413.s: This incidental supplementary budget amends the 2020 budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate by adding 1,611 million euros in spending commitments and 609 million euros in expenditure, mainly for the Corona emergency package for business innovation and entrepreneurship. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect on 18 March 2020, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.

35422.s: The bill extends the temporary intervention on Sint Eustatius by keeping a government commissioner in place of the executive board and governor, while phasing in the restoration of the island council and executive. It sets out staged transition steps by royal decree, interim approval powers, and an expiry date of 1 September 2024 with a possible one-year extension.
35422.j: The memorandum justifies the extension and phased restoration by the continued gross neglect of duties and the need to secure durable improvements before normal governance resumes.
q: Given the current situation on Sint Eustatius and the pace at which lasting improvement is being achieved, extending the intervention is necessary.
Gezien de huidige situatie op Sint Eustatius en gelet op het tempo waarmee duurzame verbetering bewerkstelligd wordt, is verlenging van de ingreep noodzakelijk.
d: appointment of government commissioner by royal decree
restoration of executive board powers by royal decree
restoration of administrative organisation powers by royal decree
restoration of financial management powers by royal decree
appointment of governor by royal decree and transition
entry into force by royal decree, differing per article
one-year extension of the law by royal decree
p: The government commissioner replaces the island council, executive board and governor in executive, financial and administrative functions, extending a temporary intervention on the island.
The island council's power to conduct inquiries into the executive board's administration is excluded during the intervention.
The government commissioner must approve island ordinances and board decisions, and may refuse approval on broad grounds including future functioning of the island government.
The Rijksvertegenwoordiger's powers over the island are disapplied during the intervention, with approval requirements suspended.
In the final phase the Rijksvertegenwoordiger gains a right to attend closed meetings and access all records of the island government.

parties: Asks about the progress of the reforms, the timing of phased transition, and whether extension requires a koninklijk besluit or a new bill.
It is not clear to the VVD members whether extension takes place by royal decree or whether a bill will be submitted.
Het is de leden van de VVD-fractie niet duidelijk of verlenging bij koninklijk besluit geschiedt of dat er een wetsvoorstel wordt ingediend.
Notes the island council receives limited powers with the regeringscommissaris keeping most, questions whether parties will run, and asks about the role of the Rijksvertegenwoordiger.
The CDA members note that the island council receives limited powers.
De leden van de CDA-fractie constateren dat de eilandsraad beperkte bevoegdheden krijgt.
Asks how the government could intervene again without a new legislative process if the prior situation recurs, and asks for parliamentary information before phase transitions.
What options does the government have under this bill to intervene if the earlier situation recurs, without having to go through a new legislative process?

Welke mogelijkheden heeft de regering op grond van dit wetsvoorstel om in te grijpen als de eerder ontstane situatie zich toch weer voordoet, dus zonder dat daarvoor een nieuw wetstraject hoeft te worden doorlopen.
Asks how oversight of the regeringscommissaris works, how conflicts between the island council and the commissioner are resolved, and how the council is protected from excessive restriction.
How exactly is supervision exercised over how the regeringscommissaris performs their task, and how is it prevented that the island council is too heavily restricted in its functioning?
Hoe wordt precies toezicht gehouden op de wijze waarop de regeringscommissaris zijn/haar taak uitoefent en hoe wordt voorkomen dat de eilandsraad al te zeer in zijn functioneren wordt beperkt?
Supports a gradual model but questions keeping the regeringscommissaris alongside an elected council and new gedeputeerden, proposing an advisory council with growing powers instead.
These members foresee problems if the regeringscommissaris remains alongside an elected island council.
Deze leden voorzien problemen als de regeringscommissaris blijft bestaan naast een gekozen eilandsraad.
Questions whether the criteria for restoring democracy are met and whether the planned autumn 2020 elections are too ambitious, and asks about the regeringscommissaris's continuing powers.
How does this relate to the premise that the public body Sint Eustatius's administration is durably able to perform its tasks properly itself?
Hoe verhoudt dit zich met het uitgangspunt dat het bestuur van het openbaar lichaam Sint Eustatius duurzaam in staat is zijn taken zelf naar behoren te kunnen vervullen?
Asks why the council has limited powers and what democratic control the reduced powers offer, and wants phase progress to be objectively reviewable.
The ChristenUnie members attach importance to decision-making on progress across the various phases being objectifiable and reviewed.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie hechten eraan dat besluitvorming over de voortgang in de verschillende fasen objectiveerbaar is en wordt getoetst.
Asks about safeguards against destruction of records, the scope of the council's advisory powers, and how government can act if a body fails to function.
They ask what the precise options are if one of the administrative bodies were not to function properly.
Zij vragen zich af wat dan nu de precieze mogelijkheden zijn indien een van de bestuursorganen niet naar behoren zou gaan functioneren.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Sint Eustatius restoration bill, raising concerns about the readiness for phasing out the intervention, the feasibility of the 2020 election timeline, the abolition of the advisory council, the lack of power to reverse transferred competences, and structural reforms. The government's nader rapport accepts most points, adding criteria, goedkeuringsbevoegdheden and communication plans, but declines to add a power to withdraw competences, citing the constitutional role of the legislator.
concerns: Advice to concretely substantiate the achieved results and remaining improvements needed before winding down the intervention, which the government addressed by updating section 2.3 of the explanatory memorandum.
Advice that the feasibility and justification of the chosen election date be explained, with the government explaining its criteria but keeping the 2020 aim and stating no fixed date is specified.
Advice to postpone abolition of the maatschappelijke adviesraad, which the government did not adopt, pointing instead to a communication plan and a participation bill.

Advice to include a provision allowing competences granted to regular bodies to be withdrawn or limited in exceptional situations, which the government rejected as undesirable because dissolving an elected council requires the legislator under the Constitution.

Advice on the structural changes needed in the relationship between the Netherlands and Sint Eustatius after the intervention ends, which the government addressed in the explanatory memorandum while deferring detailed measures.

35431.s: The bill temporarily allows tenancy agreements for a fixed term expiring between 31 March and 1 July 2020 to be extended by one to three months, up to 1 September 2020, at the request of the tenant or with the landlord's consent, without converting them into open-ended leases. Where the landlord refuses on listed grounds, the court decides, and the act expires on 1 September 2020 with a power for the minister to postpone the deadline by general administrative order.
35431.j: The memorandum justifies the temporary regime and the power to extend it by the ongoing coronavirus restrictions that shortened tenants' ability to find alternative housing.
q: If the landlord sends no or no timely written notice, the tenancy is extended indefinitely and the tenant has tenancy protection.
Stuurt de verhuurder geen of niet tijdig een schriftelijke kennisgeving dan wordt de huur verlengd voor onbepaalde tijd en heeft de huurder huurbescherming.
d: postponing the act's deadline and extending the extension period to 1 October, 1 November or 1 December 2020
p: The executive may by general administrative order, without parliamentary approval, extend the temporary regime to later dates, changing the scope of tenant protection set by the act.
Refusal decisions by the court under this article are not open to appeal (no hogere voorziening), limiting judicial review of the court's own decisions in these cases.

parties: Asks how the damages moderation under article 6:98 BW works, how far judges are bound, and how the refusal grounds and the effect of extensions on notified tenancies operate.
Specifically, they ask for an explanation of the degree of moderation that applies and the extent to which the judge is bound to apply this moderation.
Specifiek vragen zij om een toelichting op de mate van matiging die hierbij geldt en in hoeverre de rechter gebonden is aan het toepassen van deze matiging.
Questions why the burden of requesting extension lies with the tenant rather than a default extension, why the end date is 1 September, and what the effect of landlord non-notification is.
The PVV members note that the burden of proof for the written sending of the extension request lies with the tenant.
De leden van de PVV-fractie lezen dat de bewijslast van de schriftelijke verzending van het verzoek tot verlenging bij de huurder ligt.
Asks whether the landlord can also initiate extension, whether the government will publicise the option, and asks for the government's view on the Dutch Bar's critical advice.
The CDA members note that the tenant can submit a request for extension of the temporary tenancy and therefore ask whether the initiative can also come from the landlord.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zien dat de huurder een verzoek kan indienen tot verlenging van de tijdelijke huurovereenkomst en vragen daarom of het initiatief ook van de verhuurder kan komen.

Asks whether extensions are enforceable, what happens if the landlord misses the one-week deadline, why the burden of initiating court proceedings lies with the tenant, and how landlord refusal grounds like re-letting and good-tenant conduct are policed.
The D66 members ask the government why it was chosen that if a tenant requests an extension and the landlord refuses, the initiative to start proceedings lies with the tenant.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering waarom ervoor is gekozen dat als een verzoek tot verlenging is gedaan door de huurder en de verhuurder dit weigert, het procesinitiatief bij de huurder lig.

Doubts the bill gives sufficient safeguards given landlord refusal grounds, the tenant bearing the initiative to go to court, exclusion of other tenancy types, and no protection against eviction for arrears or the 1 July rent increase.
Why the bill places the initiative to go to court with the tenant rather than with the often stronger party, the landlord?
Waarom in het wetsvoorstel het initiatief voor een gang naar de rechter bij de huurder is gelegd en niet bij de vaak sterkere partij, de verhuurder?

Calls for a blanket statutory ban on evictions during the crisis or automatic extension of all contracts, criticises the landlord exceptions allowing evictions, and questions why the initiative lies with tenants.
These members ask the Minister why a general statutory ban on evictions during the Corona crisis was not chosen.
Deze leden vragen de Minister waarom niet is gekozen voor een algeheel wettelijk verbod op huisuitzettingen gedurende de Coronacrisis.

Asks whether landlords should be pushed to convert temporary contracts into permanent ones, why student and target-group contracts are excluded, why only one week is given to tenants, and questions rent increases and the burden of proof on tenants.
These members ask whether the government can ensure that tenants are aware of the possibility, after notice, to request an extension from the landlord.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen of de regering kan waarborgen dat huurders op de hoogte zijn van de mogelijkheden om na aanzegging een verzoek te kunnen doen aan de verhuurder voor verlenging.

Worries the shortened one-week response period may not give tenants enough time, asks about the consequence of landlords not informing tenants, and asks how the bill relates to other temporary COVID laws.
The ChristenUnie members read in the supplementary report that the period was shortened from two weeks to one week.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie lezen in het nader rapport dat is gekozen voor een inkorting van de termijn van twee weken naar één week.
Supports the need for the bill but asks about the rights and duties of heirs and co-tenants if a tenant dies during a fixed-term tenancy.
The 50PLUS members support the need for this temporary law extending temporary tenancy agreements.
De leden van de fractie van 50PLUS steunen de noodzaak van deze tijdelijke wet verlenging tijdelijke huurovereenkomsten.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the temporary bill extending fixed-term tenancies during the COVID-19 crisis but advises several adjustments: motivating the 1 September 2020 end date, a fallback for the two-week request term, adding a good-tenant refusal ground, and fixing the sunset clause of article 8. The government reply reports that most points were followed, including shortening the tenant's term to one week, adding the good-tenant ground, and amending the sunset date.
concerns: The sunset clause could leave extended tenancies in unclear legal limbo after 1 July 2020, so the expiry date was changed to 1 September 2020.
The two-week tenant request term may be unworkable for tenants already past the deadline when the law enters into force; the term was shortened to one week with a transitional provision.
The open-ended landlord refusal ground does not fit the systematics of tenancy law; a good-tenant refusal ground was added, while the court-application route was kept.
The 1 September 2020 end date leaves June-expiring tenancies with only one or two months of extension; the explanatory memorandum now motivates the choice as deliberate.
Redactional remarks in the annex were followed, including added attention to informing landlords and tenants in the explanatory memorandum.

35440.s: The bill amends the Wft, Wwft, Wtt 2018, Burgerlijk Wetboek Book 7 and Faillissementswet to fix omissions in earlier EU implementation, mainly by adding fit-and-proper (reputation and reliability) requirements for ultimate beneficial owners of trust offices, exchange institutions and crypto service providers, plus technical corrections on insurance, transparency and netting rules. It largely adds supervisory checks and tightens existing rules rather than granting the executive new discretionary powers.
35440.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to a general administrative order mainly by reference to the technical detail of implementing EU requirements on reliability assessment and notification.
q: Rules shall be laid down by or pursuant to a general administrative order on how it is determined whether the reliability of a person referred to in the first paragraph is beyond doubt

Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur worden regels gesteld met betrekking tot de wijze waarop wordt vastgesteld of de betrouwbaarheid van een persoon als bedoeld in het eerste lid buiten twijfel staat
d: manner of notification for insurance intermediaries (algemene maatregel van bestuur)
rules on assessing reliability of ultimate beneficial owners and relevant offences (algemene maatregel van bestuur)
p: Supervisor gains a fit-and-proper test for ultimate beneficial owners with broad discretion over relevant facts, partly to be set by general administrative order.
Adds whistleblower reporting channels and a complaint route for persons facing retaliation, strengthening checks on supervised institutions.

parties: Asks whether justice documentation or information from ongoing criminal investigations can be used in the reputation test of beneficial owners.
These members ask the government whether justice documentation or information from ongoing criminal investigations can also be used in that assessment.
Deze leden vragen de regering of daarbij ook gebruik kan worden gemaakt van justitiële documentatie of informatie uit lopende strafonderzoeken.
Asks how the reliability, competence and good-reputation criteria are concretely defined and assessed by the supervisor.

Furthermore, the PVV members note that the suitability assessment of beneficial owners of trust offices, crypto service providers, custodian wallet providers and exchanges differs from the suitability assessment of (co)policymakers.

Voorts merken de leden van de PVV-fractie op dat de toetsing van de geschiktheid van uiteindelijk belanghebbenden van trustkantoren, aanbieders van diensten voor het wisselen tussen virtuele valuta en fiduciaire valuta, aanbieders van bewaarportemonnees en wisselinstellingen een andere beoordeling dan de geschiktheidstoetsing van (mede)beleidsbepalers behelst.
Asks how supervisors gain insight into the crypto sector and whether a sound competence test is feasible in this new market.
The CDA members ask the government how a sound competence test can be carried out in this relatively new sector.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering hoe er bij deze, relatief nieuwe, sector een gedegen bekwaamheidstoets kan worden uitgevoerd.
Questions why omissions in implementation occurred and asks when parliament can weigh in on member-state options.
Furthermore, the PvdA members ask what member-state options exist regarding this regulation.
Voorts vragen de leden van de PvdA-fractie welke lidstaatopties er zijn met betrekking tot deze regelgeving.
Asks for clarification of the 87,599.25 euro additional supervisory costs and whether they are passed on to the sector.
The SP members ask the government for clarification regarding the 87,599.25 euro in additional costs.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering om verduidelijking met betrekking tot de 87.599,25 euro aan extra kosten.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on 11 March 2020 that it had no remarks on the draft Herstelwet financiële markten 2020 and advised submitting it to the House of Representatives. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport of 14 April 2020 accompanies the advice and notes that two implementation points (AML/CFT role of the European Banking Authority and correct implementation of the fourth anti-money-laundering directive) were added to the bill.

35512.s: The bill replaces the Justice subsidies act with a framework law allowing the Minister of Justice and Security or the Minister for Legal Protection to grant subsidies across a broad list of JenV policy areas. It lets the minister or a general administrative order further define subsidised activities, set conditions and budget ceilings, and supervise recipients.
35512.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed for flexibility, since subsidy rules change frequently, and to standardise subsidy practice across ministries.
q: Only in those cases where circumstances change regularly, creating a great need for flexibility, will the subsidy be granted on the basis of a ministerial regulation.

Alleen in die gevallen waarin sprake is van zich regelmatig wijzigende omstandigheden waardoor een grote behoefte aan flexibiliteit bestaat zal de subsidie verstrekt worden op basis van een ministeriële regeling.
d: defining subsidised activities and rules for granting subsidies
defining subsidised activities and rules for granting subsidies
conditions, payment, repayment, and misuse prevention for subsidies
conditions, payment, repayment, and misuse prevention for subsidies
designation of supervisors by ministerial decision
p: Gives the justice ministers a general statutory power to grant subsidies across a broad list of policy areas, including by reference to the budget annex.
Allows the minister to refuse, reduce, withdraw or retroactively change subsidies where treaty obligations conflict, with the general Awb protections for recipients disapplied.
Denies subsidy supervisors the Awb powers to inspect objects and vehicles and requires recipients to cooperate with supervisors.

parties: The VVD asks whether the broad general subsidy power is bounded by a defined policy field, how often the Awb exception to the statutory-basis requirement has been used, and why supervisory powers under Awb 5:18 and 5:19 are deemed unnecessary, raising concerns about delegation, discretion and oversight.
Can the government explain why this is not considered necessary for JenV subsidies?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom dit niet noodzakelijk wordt geacht bij JenV-subsidies?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft bill on subsidies by the Ministers of Justice and Security and for Legal Protection, repealing the Wet Justitie-subsidies. The Afdeling had no remarks and advised submitting the bill to the House of Representatives; no separate government reply on substance was needed.

35521.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (second incidental supplementary budget on urgent funds), shifting appropriations across policy articles, including an extra 22 million euro for the energy transition in buildings. It sets the amended statement's effective date as 1 August 2020, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2020

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2020

35530.s: The bill establishes a permanent independent advisory college (Adviescollege rechtspositie politieke ambtsdragers) of at least five members to advise the government on pay levels, pay relationships and other financial entitlements of national and subnational political office holders. It sets independence rules for members and provides that pay adjustments resulting from its advice take effect only after a newly elected chamber convenes or new ministers and state secretaries are sworn in.
35530.j: The memorandum justifies the college by the need for an independent, depoliticised judgement on pay of political office holders, with the Australian Remuneration Tribunal as a model.
q: an independent, depoliticised judgement on the pay level of political office holders
een onafhankelijk, gedepolitiseerd oordeel over het aansprakenniveau van politieke ambtsdragers
d: entry into force set by royal decree
p: The government receives advice from a new college on pay and entitlements of parliamentarians and other political office holders, a matter that is otherwise decided by the government and legislature themselves.

parties: Asks whether advice should cover the full legal position rather than only financial aspects, and how the college's composition and cooling-off after political office will ensure independence and regional expertise.
How is it ensured that persons familiar with the decentralised level, not only the national level, are also appointed?
Hoe wordt geborgd dat er ook personen worden benoemd die bekend zijn met het decentrale niveau, dus niet alleen met het nationale niveau?

Supports an independent college for expertise and depoliticised judgement, and asks whether it should advise on financial support for members of parliament to preserve balance among democratic powers.
Precisely because politicians themselves will also be reluctant on this subject, the advisory college should also be able to advise on it to safeguard the balance among the democratic powers.
Juist omdat politici zelf ook terughoudend zullen zijn op dit onderwerp, dient het adviescollege ook hierover adviezen te kunnen uitbrengen om het evenwicht in de democratische machten te waarborgen.

Stresses independence and transparency of the college, questions whether solicited and unsolicited advice depoliticises it, asks why advisory channels are only in the explanatory memorandum, and calls for open, checked appointment procedures.
These members agree that the importance of independence and transparency should be reflected especially in independent appointments of the college's members.
Deze leden onderschrijven dat het belang van onafhankelijkheid en transparantie met name tot uiting moet komen in onafhankelijke benoemingen van de leden van het adviescollege.
Questions why an independent advisory college is needed at all, whether former politicians may sit on it, and whether political independence is guaranteed when it includes lobby representatives.
Why does the government think political independence is guaranteed when the college's composition includes, for example, representatives of employee and employer lobby associations?

Waarom denkt de regering dat politieke onafhankelijkheid gegarandeerd is als de samenstelling van het adviescollege bestaat uit bijvoorbeeld de vertegenwoordigers van lobbyverenigingen van werknemers en werkgevers?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports creating an independent advisory college on remuneration of political office holders, but advises clarifying the scope of its advisory task, considering a periodic re-evaluation, and excluding college members from the WNT pay norm. The government's reply accepts the scope clarification and the WNT exclusion (added as a new paragraph), but declines a fixed periodic review obligation, citing the independence of the college and the unpredictability of cabinet terms.
concerns: The scope of the college's advisory task ('geldelijke aanspraken', 'majeure, structurele wijzigingen') is unclear and should be clarified in the explanatory memorandum and possibly the bill.
The Afdeling suggests codifying a periodic re-evaluation of political office holders' remuneration, as in Canada, to avoid debate on whether and when the college should advise.
College members should be excluded from the WNT top-official pay norm, which is not currently provided for in the bill text.

35611.s: This bill (Wet voortgezet onderwijs 2020 amendment) consolidates transitional provisions from the old WVO and WVO BES into the new Wet voortgezet onderwijs 2020, adds implementation and transitional rules for the new act, and updates cross-references in other laws. It also tightens and reshapes school-establishment rules, admission and absence rules, and the procedures for new schools, with mostly technical changes and some ministerial powers.
35611.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as technical consolidation of transitional law and the need for implementation rules for the new act.
q: various transitional provisions in amending laws to the WVO and WVO BES have been substantively implemented and can therefore lapse
diverse overgangsbepalingen in wetten tot wijziging van de Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs en de Wet voortgezet onderwijs BES materieel zijn uitgewerkt en dus kunnen komen te vervallen
d: detailed rules for new school splitting and enrolment verification
manner of application and model form for new school requests
correction factors, residence years and rules for market research in demand measurement
framework for inspectorate advice on new school applications
further rules for schools and codes on participation in extra activities
annual lump-sum amount and transition rules for Caribbean Netherlands school funding
p: The minister may refuse a new school application from providers with prior sanctions, a discretionary power limited by a five-year window and general administrative law.
Defines valid reasons for absence and lets the school board extend the maternity-related absence period, specifying grounds for pupil protection.

parties: Asks how the bill reduces perceived regulatory burden and whether it changes substance or only replaces the implementation law.
They also ask whether it is correct that the bill mainly aims to make the transitional law clearer.
Tevens vragen zij of het klopt dat het wetsvoorstel vooral als doel heeft om de wetgeving met betrekking tot het overgangsrecht overzichtelijker te maken.
Has no questions and supports the content of the bill.
These members have no questions and support the content of the bill.
Deze leden hebben geen vragen en steunen de inhoud van het wetvoorstel.
Asks whether the bill only makes technical changes and, if not, requests a list of substantive changes.
The SP members ask whether it is correct that this bill only makes technical changes and that nothing substantive is changed in the Wet voortgezet onderwijs.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of het klopt dat met dit wetsvoorstel enkel technische wijzigingen worden gedaan en er inhoudelijk niks aan de Wet voortgezet onderwijs wordt veranderd.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division raised no remarks on the draft Invoerings- en aanpassingswet WVO 20xx, a technical bill on transitional and implementation law for secondary education, and advised submitting it to parliament. The minister's reply (nader rapport) explains that the bill was updated to coordinate with several education laws enacted since, and removes a now-obsolete coordination provision.

35620.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Boxmeer, Cuijk, Mill en Sint Hubert and Sint Anthonis into a new municipality called Land van Cuijk, effective on a date set by royal decree. It makes conforming amendments to several laws (fertiliser, housing market, judicial districts, safety regions) and transfers the listed obligations to the new municipality.
q: With effect from the date of reorganisation, the municipalities of Boxmeer, Cuijk, Mill en Sint Hubert and Sint Anthonis are dissolved.
Met ingang van de datum van herindeling worden de gemeenten Boxmeer, Cuijk, Mill en Sint Hubert en Sint Anthonis opgeheven.
d: date of entry into force of the merger

parties: Asks the government to assess whether Grave can remain independent given its administrative capacity and financial situation, and whether delay for a referendum would be preferable.
The VVD members ask the government to address the administrative capacity of the municipality of Grave.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering in te gaan op de bestuurskracht van de gemeente Grave.
Requests that the herindelingsadvies and the province's positive opinion be attached as annexes, since the explanatory memorandum repeatedly refers to them.
These members request that the government add the herindelingsadvies with its documents and the province's opinion as annexes to the memorandum in reply to the report.
Deze leden verzoeken de regering het herindelings-advies met de bijbehorende documenten en de zienswijze van de provincie alsnog als bijlagen op te nemen bij de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag.
Asks what adverse consequences the merger could have for Grave and requests a response to the opposition letter from Grave's council highlighting its vulnerable position.
What adverse consequences could the planned merger have for the municipality of Grave?
Welke nadelige gevolgen kan de voorgenomen herindeling voor de gemeente Grave hebben?
Asks why no referendum was held in the participating municipalities and why municipalities that could previously perform their tasks now need more administrative capacity.
The SP members ask whether the government can elaborate on why no referendum was held in the participating municipalities.
De leden van de fractie van de SP vragen of er nader kan worden ingegaan op de vraag waarom er geen referendum in de deelnemende gemeenten is gehouden.
Welcomes the merger as a well-prepared process with local support and asks when Grave could join, stressing that service continuity is primarily Grave's responsibility.
These members are convinced by the clear justification that this is a good and careful process with local administrative, social and regional administrative support.

Genoemde leden zijn door de heldere motivering ervan overtuigd dat sprake is van een goed en zorg-vuldig proces waarbij sprake is van lokaal bestuurlijk, maatschappelijk en regionaal bestuurlijk draagvlak.
Asks whether postponing Grave's participation is desirable and what future prospects exist for an independent Grave, given recent budget disapproval and difficult cooperation talks.
The SGP members ask whether it is desirable and sensible, from the perspective of both Grave and the new municipality Land van Cuijk, to postpone Grave's decision to participate.

De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen of het, zowel vanuit het perspectief van de gemeente Grave als van de nieuwe gemeente Land van Cuijk, wenselijk en verstandig is om het besluit tot deelname van Grave uit te stellen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises that the explanatory memorandum to the bill merging Boxmeer, Cuijk, Mill en Sint Hubert and Sint Anthonis into Land van Cuijk needs a sounder justification of the 'regionale samenhang' criterion, given that Grave is excluded and the postponed referendum is not explained. The minister's reply defends the merger as a good solution, explains the bottom-up principle and the lack of local support, and states that the explanatory memorandum has been adjusted accordingly.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum lacks a sufficient justification for the regional coherence criterion, given that Grave does not join the merger and the referendum timing is unexplained; the minister adjusted the text in paragraphs 2, 3.1 and 3.4 accordingly.

35800.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security through a third supplementary budget, adding funds for the implementation costs of writing off public debts of people harmed by the childcare benefits affair. It sets the effective date as 12 April 2021 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The write-off of public debts leads to the above implementation costs at the organisations CJIB and LBIO of the Ministry of Justice and Security.
De kwijtschelding van de publieke schulden leidt tot bovenstaande uitvoeringskosten bij de organisaties CJIB en LBIO van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid.

35925-K.s: This bill sets the 2022 budget statement for the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (DMF), showing expenditure, commitments and receipts of about 5.07 billion euros in thousands. The explanatory memorandum describes IT and materiel budget gaps, a cash-flow shift, and project reprogramming, without delegating rule-making powers.
q: Adopted departmental budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) for the year 2022
Vastgestelde departementale begrotingsstaat van het Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds (K) voor het jaar 2022

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2022 budget bill for the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) and raised no remarks, recommending that the bill be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport only transmits the opinion and states that some budgets require amendments, referred to annexes, without addressing any substantive points.

36025.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport through a fourth supplementary budget, covering COVID-19 measures and transferring the Maatschappelijke diensttijd budget to the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science. The memorandum also extends a state guarantee covering board and supervisory board members of the Stichting Open Nederland against personal liability claims.
36025.j: The memorandum justifies the state guarantee as necessary to give the foundation's board and supervisory board comfort against personal liability arising from the state-commissioned task.
q: VWS considers issuing this guarantee necessary – and the most suitable instrument – to give the board and supervisory board the comfort needed to carry out their work.

Het afgeven van deze garantie ziet VWS als noodzakelijk – en meest geschikte instrument – om het bestuur en de Raad van Toezicht het benodigde comfort te bieden voor het uitvoeren van haar werkzaamheden.

36034.s: The bill transposes EU Directive 2020/1828 on representative actions for consumer collective interests into Dutch civil law, amending Books 3 and 6 of the Civil Code and the Code of Civil Procedure. It lets the Minister for Legal Protection designate Dutch foundations as cross-border representative bodies and adjusts the collective action rules, including third-party litigation funding and the handling of foreign consumers.
36034.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the designation power and the general administrative measure as needed to implement the Directive's requirement that member states designate and list qualifying organisations.
q: On application by a foundation or association with full legal capacity seated in the Netherlands, the Minister for Legal Protection designates it as a competent body.
Onze Minister voor Rechtsbescherming wijst op aanvraag van een stichting of vereniging met volledige rechtsbevoegdheid met zetel in Nederland deze stichting of vereniging aan als bevoegde instantie
d: ARTIKEL I, C (nieuw art. 3:305e BW, lid 4)
detailed rules on designation, revocation and duration of cross-border representative body status
ARTIKEL I, C (nieuw art. 3:305e BW, lid 4)
rules on fees for designation application
p: The Minister for Legal Protection acquires discretion to designate, revoke and set the duration of designation of consumer organisations as cross-border representative bodies, with a five-year sunset on each designation.

parties: Asks how judges can assess litigation funding and whether the WAMCA's unclear points and added complexity can be managed.
Can the government explain to what extent this will lead to complexity in legal practice?
Kan de regering toelichten in hoeverre dit zal leiden tot complexiteit in de rechtspraktijk?
Questions whether judges can adequately test third-party funding and whether the judiciary has the capacity to handle the extra work.
Can the government explain to what extent the judge can reasonably be expected to carry out such a test adequately?
Kan de regering uiteenzetten in hoeverre van de rechter mag worden verwacht dat zij een dergelijke toets adequaat uit kan voeren?
Worries about transparency of litigation funding capital flows, possible abuse against consumers, and the extra workload on the judiciary.
How is it prevented that capital flows are not transparent to the judge and as a result consumer interests come under pressure?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat de kapitaalstromen niet inzichtelijk zijn voor de rechter en daardoor alsnog de belangen van consumenten onder druk komen te staan?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the Implementation Act for the Representative Actions Directive for consumers, raising points on foreign-entity standing and the Dutch courts' review of doubts raised by traders, the delegation basis for designating collective representatives, and the terminology of the two Rv versions. The government's reply accepted most points, adding clarifications, narrowing the delegation, changing 'afschrift' to 'uittreksel', and fixing technical cross-references.
concerns: The Council asked for clarification of how far the Dutch judge may review foreign representative entities' standing and what follow-up procedure applies when a trader raises justified doubts; the government added explanation to the explanatory memorandum but did not require the judge to contact the national contact point.

The Council found the delegation basis for designating Dutch representative organisations insufficiently concrete and precise, and the government narrowed it and clarified the relation between the AMvB and a ministerial regulation.
The Council asked for clearer terminology for the two parallel versions of the Rv, and the government explained the choice and added explanation, aligning with the terminology of another bill.
The Council noted a technical mismatch between article 1018c(5)(a) Rv and article 3:305a(6) BW, which the government corrected.
The Council's redactional remark on 'Commissie' versus 'Europese Commissie' was followed.

36061.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) through a fifth supplementary budget for additional corona support measures. It makes a net change of EUR 500 thousand in expenditure obligations and expenditures on policy article 2 and entry into force is set at 23 March 2022.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) for the year 2022

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) voor het jaar 2022

36106.s: The bill allows schools to set up temporary education facilities for displaced children arriving in mass numbers, outside normal rules on curriculum, teacher qualifications and school structure. Ministerial regulations can set further rules, the regulations must be pre-submitted to parliament, and the temporary provisions lapse after two years.
36106.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation and departures from statute by the need to scale up education capacity quickly in a crisis, and says a formal evaluation is difficult to reconcile with that urgency.
q: it is desirable to make it possible to urgently set up temporary education facilities
het wenselijk is om het mogelijk te maken om met spoed tijdelijke onderwijsvoorzieningen in te richten
d: rules on notification and school setup plan for temporary facilities
content of temporary education programme, may deviate from articles 8 and 9
further rules on teaching staff qualifications
rules on final test, school plan, school guide, placement, may deviate from statute
rules on closing temporary facilities after lapse
royal decree to end or alter the temporary provisions earlier or later
rules on notification and setup plan for temporary facilities in secondary education
rules on distance education in secondary schools
rules on school plan, school guide, placement, may deviate from statute
further rules on content of secondary education programme
rules on school plan, school guide, placement, may deviate from statute
rules on closing temporary facilities after lapse
royal decree to end or alter the temporary provisions earlier or later
p: Artikel I WPO, art. 180c; Artikel II WVO, art. 118tc; Artikel III WVO 2020, art. 9.6
Schools may depart from statutory curriculum rules and ministerial regulations can further set content, with only minimum norms retained and pre-submission to parliament required.
Artikel I WPO, art. 180d; Artikel II WVO, art. 118te; Artikel III WVO 2020, art. 9.8
Unqualified persons, including students and staff from other tracks, may teach for up to two years when qualified teachers are unavailable, subject to written agreements.
Artikel I WPO, art. 215 en 215a; Artikel III WVO 2020, art. 14.3 en 14.4
The temporary provisions lapse after two years, though a royal decree can change that date, subject to a two-week pre-submission to both chambers.

parties: No further questions or remarks on the bill at this stage.
The members of the VVD faction have taken note of the bill with interest and at this time have no further questions or remarks on it.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben daarover op dit moment geen nadere vragen of opmerkingen.
Praises the education sector's rapid response and has no questions for the government.
In response to the bill they have no questions they wish to put to the government.
Zij hebben naar aanleiding van het wetsvoorstel geen vragen die zij willen voorleggen aan de regering.
Sees the urgency of guaranteeing education for Ukrainian minors and asks about EU support and distance learning.
These members have a few more questions.
Deze leden hebben nog enkele vragen.
Asks who supervises adequate access to education and who must intervene if schools fail, since the government dropped an intervention instrument.
The members also ask who must intervene if there is no adequate accessible education for displaced children and young people.
Tevens vragen de leden wie er moet ingrijpen indien er geen sprake is van voldoende toegankelijk onderwijs voor ontheemde kinderen en jongeren.
Asks whether the government is confident schools can act decisively, and about monitoring whether temporary arrangements last longer than intended.
Can the government explain how it will keep a close watch to prevent this temporary solution from lasting longer than desired?
Kan de regering toelichten hoe er vinger aan de pols gehouden zal worden om te voorkomen dat deze tijdelijke oplossing langer dan gewenst voortduurt?
Supports the bill but calls for an evaluation clause so lessons from this crisis can inform future refugee education.
The members endorse this advice from the ATR for an evaluation clause and call on the government to include it.
De leden onderschrijven dit advies van het ATR voor een evaluatiebepaling en roepen de regering op om dit op te nemen.

Questions whether the bill is flexible enough, why the municipality is not explicitly empowered, why an AMvB is not used instead of a ministerial regulation, and the unclear applicability of regular education law.
These members ask why an AMvB would not in this situation be the more suitable level after all.
Deze leden vragen waarom een AMvB 3 in deze situatie toch niet het meer geschikte niveau zou zijn.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, on a draft law enabling temporary education provisions for displaced Ukrainian minors, that the derogations be set at least at AMvB level rather than by ministerial regulation, and raised serious objections to the minister's intervention power over municipalities, which it considered ineffective, insufficiently clausulated and inconsistent with interbestuurlijk toezicht. The government replied that the delegation was narrowed and the intervention power was dropped entirely, while adding a note on the longer-term perspective.
concerns: Derogations from the law by ministerial regulation go too far against the norm of equal rank and should be set at least at AMvB level; the government narrowed the delegation and included the main elements in the law itself.

The minister's intervention power over municipalities is ineffective, lacks sufficient justification and clausulation, and should be limited to specific cases; the government dropped the power entirely.
The intervention power does not fit the system of generic interbestuurlijk toezicht, which targets the conduct of the college rather than schools; the government removed the power.
Inconsistency between the wording of the bill and the explanatory memorandum on the college's obligation should be removed, and several redactional points were raised, partly adopted.

The long-term perspective on integration, school choice and a structural legal framework for displaced pupils needs attention; the government committed to exploring this in 2023 and supplemented the explanatory memorandum.

36115.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security, adding a third supplementary budget for reception of displaced persons from Ukraine. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 26 April 2022, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security for the year 2022
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid voor het jaar 2022

36151.s: The bill consolidates and extends the childcare-benefit (kinderopvangtoeslag) recovery repair measures into a single Wet hersteloperatie toeslagen, providing compensation, supplementary allowances, a moratorium, debt write-offs and municipal broad support for affected parents. It also gives the Minister of Finance, the Belastingdienst/Toeslagen and several social-security bodies discretionary write-off and payment powers, many to be fixed in general administrative orders (AMvB) or ministerial regulations.
36151.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to allow flexible, quick implementation of a politically urgent repair operation, subject to a voorhang procedure for the hardship AMvBs.
q: It is proposed that from the moment of transfer to the Wet hersteloperatie toeslagen, the compensation scheme be regulated in its entirety at the level of formal legislation.
Voorgesteld wordt om de compensatieregeling vanaf het moment van verplaatsing naar de Wet hersteloperatie toeslagen in zijn geheel te regelen op het niveau van wetgeving in formele zin.
d: conditions for special allowance in hardship cases (childcare benefit)
conditions for special allowance in hardship cases (rent, care, child budget)
further rules for municipal broad support
rules for write-off execution by Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen
rules for write-off execution by CAK
p: A statutory moratorium temporarily blocks creditors from enforcing claims against affected parents, limiting creditor and enforcement recourse for a year.
Authorises recovery of the lump-sum payment if the parent acted intentionally or knew or should have known of no entitlement, placing the burden of proof on the Belastingdienst/Toeslagen.
Mandatory write-off of recoverable childcare-benefit debts for eligible parents, with exclusions for serious culpable conduct, reducing collection by executive agencies.

parties: Worries about implementation delays and asks how equal treatment of similar cases is safeguarded given the flexibility the bill allows.
For these members, quick help for harmed parents comes first. However, they are concerned about implementation.
Wat deze leden betreft staat de snelle hulp aan gedupeerde ouders voorop. Echter, deze leden maken zich zorgen over de uitvoering.
Asks for a full overview of delegation provisions and whether each has a voorhang or nahang procedure.
Can the government provide the PVV members with an exhaustive overview of where it intends to use delegation provisions.
Kan de regering aan de leden van de PVV-fractie een uitputtend overzicht verstrekken van waar de regering van plan is om met delegatiebepalingen te werken.
Passes on critical signals from the parent panel and asks the government to respond point by point, including on the burden of proof for parents.
The CDA members still receive many signals that the line between making plausible and proving tips over into proving.
De leden van de CDA-fractie ontvangen nog veel signalen dat de grens tussen aannemelijk maken en bewijzen doorslaat naar bewijzen.
Doubts the bill will improve the recovery in practice and asks whether it came too late and lags behind events.
The SP members share these serious doubts and also ask whether this bill was submitted far too late.
De leden van de SP-fractie delen deze ernstige twijfels en vragen bovendien of deze wet niet veel te laat is ingediend.
Asks how the recovery would have been designed from scratch and how delegation provisions and pilots relate to the bill.
These members ask the government how, with today's knowledge, it would have designed the recovery operation from the start.
Deze leden vragen de regering hoe zij, met de kennis van nu, de hersteloperatie vanaf begin af aan had vormgegeven.
Worries that the mass procedure fails to give individual justice and that relatively mildly harmed parents may be overcompensated.
Stresses care alongside generosity and questions whether the balance is right and whether treatment varies unfairly.
These members endorse that, but also attach great value to the principle of carefulness.
Deze leden onderschrijven dat, maar hechten ook veel waarde aan het uitgangspunt van zorgvuldigheid.
Questions the legal certainty and the exact amounts of compensation, which the statute leaves to administrators and courts.
So is it correct that affected parents cannot derive legal certainty from this proposed law?
Klopt het dus dat toeslagengedupeerden geen rechtszekerheid kunnen ontlenen aan deze voorgestelde wet?
Argues the scheme is unequal, legally uncertain and gives inadequate legal protection, and that the Tax Authority acted unlawfully.
