a scheme is being created which in this member's view leads to legal inequality, legal uncertainty, in some cases enormous overcompensation and a lack of legal protection.

wordt een regeling tot stand gebracht die naar het oordeel van dit lid leidt tot rechtsongelijkheid, rechtsonzekerheid, in bepaalde gevallen enorme overcompensatie en een gebrek aan rechtsbescherming.
Welcomes one integrated law and asks about timelines, pension of exemptions and implementation details without contesting checks.
These members are glad with one law in which the entire recovery operation comes together.
Deze leden zijn blij met één wet waarin de hele hersteloperatie samenkomt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion on the Wet hersteloperatie toeslagen supports the codification and reorganisation of the childcare-benefit restoration rules but flags concerns on equal treatment, the usefulness of the hardship clause, workforce and implementation risks, the broad basis for processing special-category and criminal data under the GDPR, and the retroactive replacement of legal bases. The government's nader rapport largely accepts these points: it justifies the distinction between gedupeerden and non-gedupeerden, adds transitional provisions, sharpens the data-processing grounds, and adjusts several articles, though it does not drop the hardship clause.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for a fuller justification of the difference in treatment between gedupeerden and non-gedupeerden under the equality principle; the government justifies the distinction by the nature of the state-inflicted wrong but does not change the criteria.

The Afdeling is not convinced the hardship clause (artikel 9.1) adds value given existing flexibility and advises deleting it; the government keeps the hardship clause, explaining that unforeseen cases cannot be specified in advance.

The Afdeling stresses that scarce staff should be focused on carrying out the restoration and that changes to ongoing processes carry operational risk; the government commits to involving implementation bodies and phasing in new schemes.

The Afdeling notes the broad basis for processing special-category and criminal personal data under the GDPR lacks justification and safeguards; the government adds GDPR principle explanations and purpose limitation but does not fully specify who sets the safeguards.

The Afdeling finds retroactive repeal and re-enactment of legal bases leaves decisions already taken in limbo and asks why ordinary transitional rules were not used; the government explains the Algemene Rekenkamer's objection and adds transitional provisions in artikel 8.6.
Redactional remarks of the Afdeling were adopted and further technical corrections were made in the bill and explanatory memorandum.

36200-X.s: The bill formally adopts the 2023 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Defence (expenditure, commitments and receipts in thousands of euros) and the 2023 budget statement for the agency Paresto, with entry into force on 1 January of the budget year. The explanatory memorandum describes defence priorities such as personnel, Caribbean border surveillance and the temporary cyber operations law, but the bill itself contains no delegation or power shift.
q: Article 1: The departmental budget statement for the year 2023 attached to this law is hereby adopted.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2023 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering issued a blanket opinion on the 2023 budget bill for the Ministry of Defence, raising no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance, on behalf of the Minister of Defence, replied in a nader rapport that the Afdeling's blanket advice stands, while proposing some amendments to the budget appendices.

36205.s: The bill amends the Wet milieubeheer to designate the Dutch Emissions Authority (NEa) as the competent authority for the EU carbon border adjustment mechanism (CBAM) during its transitional period. It adds a new chapter requiring importers to submit reports on time and allowing the NEa to exchange information, with enforcement via penalty payments and administrative fines.
36205.j: The memorandum justifies the new enforcement powers by the need to operationalise the EU regulation's transitional period by designating a competent authority and giving it sanctioning power to compel CBAM reports.
q: The competent authority must be designated and must be given a sanctioning power to enforce the submission of the so-called CBAM report.
De bevoegde autoriteit moet worden aangewezen en de bevoegde autoriteit moet een sanctionerende bevoegdheid krijgen om het aanleveren van het zogenoemde CBAM-rapport te kunnen afdwingen.
p: Artikel I, onderdeel C (artikel 16c.1 Wet milieubeheer)
The NEa gains power to enforce CBAM reporting through penalty payments and administrative fines against importers who fail to report.

parties: Asks about the division of tasks between Customs and the NEa, personnel and IT consequences, and EU compensation for Dutch implementation costs.
How will the division of roles be between Customs and the NEa in connection with the CBAM measures?
Hoe zal de rolverdeling zijn tussen de Douane en de NEa in samenhang met de CBAM-maatregelen?
Asks about the distribution of incoming CBAM trade volume among member states and how CBAM levies are split between member states and the EU.
The D66 members ask how the CBAM levy is divided between the collecting member state and the EU.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen hoe de CBAM-heffing verdeeld wordt tussen innende lidstaat en de EU.
Asks for an evaluation of the transitional period with a role for the Chamber, and questions the late phase-out of free allowances and the government's claimed leadership role.
Can the government explain how and when an evaluation is planned and how the Chamber will be involved?
Kan de regering toelichten hoe en wanneer een evaluatie gepland staat en hoe de Kamer hierbij betrokken zal worden?
Shares GroenLinks' concerns about evaluation, the timing of entry into force, and the 2035 phase-out of free allowances, asking for government positions on EU amendments.
Does the government agree that this is rather late and that the goal of the CBAM is thereby undermined?
Is de regering het ermee eens dat dit rijkelijk laat is en dat daarmee het doel van de CBAM ondermijnd wordt?
Raises the risk of disputes and penalties over the amount of levies, as in past import duty cases, and asks how such risks are limited through upfront agreements and enforcement safeguards.
These members ask the government to what extent there is a risk that similar conflicts will arise around CBAM revenue.
Deze leden vragen de regering in welke mate het risico bestaat dat dergelijke conflicten zich ook voordoen rond de CBAM-opbrengst
Has taken note of the bill and has no further questions.
The Volt members have taken note of the bill and have no further questions.
De leden van de Volt-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben geen verdere vragen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft amendment to the Wet Milieubeheer on the transitional period for introducing a carbon border adjustment mechanism, as part of the Belastingplan 2023 package, and found no remarks. The government's nader rapport thanks the Afdeling and presents the advice without any substantive reply because none was required.

36241.s: The bill extends childcare allowance (kinderopvangtoeslag) to Ukrainian displaced persons under temporary protection and to parents whose partner lives outside the EU, EEA or Switzerland. It removes the partner residence requirement from several paragraphs of article 1.6 and adds a transitional provision giving retroactive entitlement from 4 March 2022.
36241.j: The memorandum justifies the new entitlement by the right of displaced persons to access the labour market and the need to combine work with childcare; the royal decree timing is justified by the need for a publicly known expiry date.
q: It is proposed to grant the entitlement to KOT to Ukrainian displaced persons through this amendment so that they can actually combine work and care for young children.
Voorgesteld wordt de aanspraak op KOT door deze wijziging toe te kennen aan Oekraïense ontheemden zodat zij arbeid en zorg voor jonge kinderen ook daadwerkelijk kunnen combineren.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel D / Artikel II
entry into force of the Ukrainian displaced persons provision by royal decree

parties: Asks about the rationale for distinguishing Ukrainian displaced persons from other asylum seekers, the funding source, and how monitoring and evaluation will be carried out.
Therefore these members ask for the justification of the distinction between Ukrainian displaced persons and asylum seekers regarding access to the labour market.
Daarom vragen deze leden naar de onderbouwing van het onderscheid tussen Oekraïense ontheemden en asielzoekers rond de toegang tot de arbeidsmarkt.
Supports the aim of the bill but asks how the work requirement can be enforced and what the consequences are if it cannot.
Can the government elaborate on this claim? How large does the government consider the chance that the work requirement cannot be enforced and what are the consequences?
Kan de regering nader ingaan op deze stelling? Hoe groot acht de regering de kans dat de arbeidseis niet handhaafbaar is en wat zijn hiervan de consequenties?
Worries that dropping the work requirement may increase the risk of repeats of the childcare benefits scandal and asks which conditions are hard to verify.
Shares concerns about enforceability of the work requirement and the risk of practices like the childcare benefits scandal.
The PvdA and GroenLinks members ask the government whether these adjustments increase the chance of practices such as in the childcare benefits scandal.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie en de leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vragen de regering of deze aanpassingen de kans op de praktijken zoals in het schandaal van de toeslagenaffaire vergroot.
Objects to not always enforcing the work requirement, calls it unfair to Dutch parents, and asks for a sunset clause or quick evaluation.
The VVD members have difficulty accepting that the work requirement will not always be enforced if this bill is chosen.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben er moeite mee om te accepteren dat de arbeidseis niet altijd zal worden gehandhaafd als voor dit wetsvoorstel gekozen zal worden.
Asks how the equality principle is respected given retroactive entitlement only from 4 March 2022, and about enforcement difficulties due to the war.
How does this relate, according to the Minister, to the equality principle?
Hoe verhoudt dit zich volgens de Minister tot het gelijkheidsbeginsel?
Criticises that the measure is implemented before parliament has approved the bill and asks what happens if eligibility cannot be verified.
Now the House of Representatives appears to be faced with a fait accompli.
Nu lijkt de Tweede Kamer zich geplaatst te zien voor een voldongen feit.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill extending childcare allowance to Ukrainian displaced persons and to parents with a partner outside the EU/EEA/Switzerland, raising no remarks and advising submission to the House. The government's reply merely notes the advice was taken and the financial section was supplemented.

36250-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Dutch States General (second supplementary budget), raising spending and receipts across parliamentary articles for wage and price adjustments, building and information-system works, and other items. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 December 2022.
q: The budget statement of the States General for the year 2022 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal voor het jaar 2022 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36304.s: The bill amends the 2023 budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate by adding a second supplementary budget of 65 million euros as a loan to Invest-NL related to SIF, and shifts budget between policy articles, with effects in 2023 and later. It makes the amended budget statute effective from 13 February 2023, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) for the year 2023
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) voor het jaar 2023

36313.s: The bill amends the 2023 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate by means of a third supplementary budget, adding €240 million in obligations and expenditure under the energy policy article to fund gas storage filling at Bergermeer. The adjustment takes effect from 21 April 2023 and is partly conditional on the summer-winter spread, with the subsidy lapsing if that spread is positive.
q: Up to €240 million in subsidy is needed for this.
Hiervoor is maximaal € 240 mln aan subsidie nodig.

36331.s: The bill implements the 1996 HNS Convention as amended by the 2010 Protocol in Dutch law, covering liability limitation proceedings in the Rotterdam court, a compulsory insurance or financial security regime with certificates issued by the Minister, reporting duties for receivers of hazardous substances, and enforcement including criminal sanctions. It also amends several existing laws and extends application to Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba.
36331.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as allowing rules to be changed more quickly than amending the statute, and states the bill follows the convention's structure.
q: It was chosen to regulate the fees by ministerial regulation, so that changes can be made more quickly.
Gekozen is voor nadere regelgeving van de verschuldigde vergoedingen bij ministeriële regeling, waardoor wijzigingen sneller kunnen worden doorgevoerd.
d: detailed rules on timing and manner of reporting and exempting small receivers
fees payable for issuing or certifying insurance certificates
p: The Minister, after consulting the Finance Minister, may withdraw an insurance certificate if conditions are no longer met, subject to appeal with suspensive effect.
Designated officials may enforce compliance and board ships under the general administrative law powers of inspection.

parties: D66 has read the bill with interest and raises no further questions.

The D66 members have taken note with interest of the Implementation Act for the HNS Convention on liability and compensation for damage in connection with the carriage of hazardous and noxious substances by sea (hereinafter: Implementation Act) and have no further questions about it.

De leden van de D66-fractie hebben met interesse kennisgenomen van de Uitvoeringswet voor het HNS-Verdrag inzake aansprakelijkheid en vergoeding voor schade in verband met het vervoer over zee van gevaarlijke stoffen (hierna: Uitvoeringswet) en hebben hierover geen verdere vragen.
PVV asks what happens if Belgium and/or Germany do not ratify, why an insurance certificate costs 300 euros, and what the HNS fund levy does to fuel prices.
The PVV members ask the government about the consequences if Belgium and/or Germany do not accept the convention, or do not do so simultaneously.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen de regering naar de gevolgen indien België en/of Duitsland het verdrag niet of niet gelijktijdig aanvaardt.
CDA asks how implementation will proceed in Belgium and Germany, what effects this has for the Netherlands, and how progress will be monitored.
The CDA members are curious how the introduction of the convention will proceed in other countries, particularly Belgium and Germany.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn benieuwd naar hoe de invoering van het verdrag in andere landen zal verlopen, met name in België en Duitsland.
GroenLinks welcomes the bill's victim-protection aims but criticises the 25-year ratification delay caused by industry lobbying and asks for a report on other long-pending treaties.
These members ask the government to report to the House soon on which other international treaties have long been awaiting ratification and what the background to this is.
Deze leden vragen de regering om binnenkort aan de Kamer te rapporteren welke andere internationale verdragen reeds lang op ratificatie wachten en wat hiervan de achtergrond is.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the HNS Convention implementation bill and raised no remarks, recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply (nader rapport) notes that it used the opportunity to clarify that article 17 does not apply to Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, and sends the amended bill and explanatory memorandum.

36403.s: The bill amends the Tobacco and Smoking Products Act to regulate nicotine products without tobacco and nicotine devices, adding definitions, product and device requirements, and extending existing bans, advertising limits, sales restrictions and enforcement powers to these products. It creates new delegation bases allowing product, packaging and research-method rules to be set by general administrative order (AMvB), and extends the ban on oral nicotine pouches.
36403.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by public health risks, especially youth attraction and nicotine addiction, and by the need to enforce bans effectively, noting that delegation is optional so the government need not issue the rules.
q: Under the proposed article 2, paragraph 8, of the Act, product requirements may be set for nicotine products without tobacco placed on the market, in the interest of public health, by or pursuant to a general administrative order.

Door het voorgestelde artikel 2, achtste lid, van de wet kunnen in het belang van de volksgezondheid bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur producteisen worden gesteld aan NZT die op de markt worden gebracht.
d: ingredient, technical and emission requirements for nicotine products without tobacco
designation of research methods decisive for compliance with product requirements
p: Open-ended power for the government to set product, device and exclusive research-method requirements by general administrative order, with the explanatory memorandum noting that these rules are optional rather than mandatory.
Research methods designated by administrative order would be exclusively decisive for whether a product complies, which limits other forms of evidence available in enforcement and review.
Extends existing advertising limits, sales restrictions, reporting obligations and inspector powers, including seizure, to nicotine products and devices.

parties: Asks whether beer and business owners are unfairly burdened by the smoking ban extension to nicotine pouches, given difficulty of enforcement.
Although the VVD members can agree with including nicotine pouches under the smoking ban, they ask the government whether, given the above, owners or operators will be disadvantaged as a result.

Hoewel de leden van de VVD zich kunnen vinden in het betrekken van nicotinezakjes onder het rookverbod vragen zij de regering wel of, gezien het voorgenoemde, de beheerders of eigenaren hierdoor nadelig worden geraakt.
Supports the regulation but questions enforcement of the oral nicotine ban and asks about a blanket ban for all ages versus age-limited ban, and about EU law compatibility.
As the explanatory memorandum also notes, supervision of the smoking ban for these products is more complicated than for some tobacco products, simply because use escapes sight.

Zoals ook in de memorie van toelichting naar voren komt, is het toezicht op het rookverbod van deze producten ingewikkelder dan bij sommige rookwaren, simpelweg omdat het gebruik zich aan het zicht onttrekt.
Doubts the effectiveness of the measures and argues bans on less harmful alternatives harm adult smokers, especially low socio-economic groups.
Alternatives to quit smoking, such as e-cigarettes and nicotine pouches, are denied to this group of adult smokers.
Alternatieven om van het roken af te komen, zoals e-sigaretten en nicotinezakjes, worden deze groep volwassen rokers ontnomen.
Asks how enforcement of the advertising ban will be monitored and whether sales should be limited to specialist shops or a full ban adopted.
The CDA members ask whether the government is willing to limit sales of these products to specialist shops so they cannot be sold online, in supermarkets, petrol stations or convenience stores.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de regering bereid is de verkoop van deze producten te limiteren tot speciaalzaken, zodat deze bijvoorbeeld niet online, in supermarkten, in benzinestations of in gemakswinkels verkocht mogen worden.
Worried about youth uptake of alternatives, criticises delayed entry into force as a tobacco industry tactic, and asks about NVWA enforcement capacity.
Moreover, such a delaying tactic is a well-known strategy of the tobacco industry.
Daarnaast is zo'n vertragingstactiek een bekende strategie van de tabaksindustrie.
Asks why entry into force is set for 1 July 2024 given urgency, and asks for clarity on lower-level regulation and enforcement by the NVWA.
Every week hundreds of children become addicted to nicotine.
Wekelijks raken er honderden kinderen verslaafd aan nicotine.
Asks how the NVWA can assess enforcement consequences before lower-level rules exist, and about risks of illegal trade and the reliability of the EU-CEG ingredient list.
How great is the risk that, as legislation in this area becomes ever more refined, implementation and enforcement become ever harder?
Hoe groot is het risico dat naarmate wetgeving op dit vlak steeds verfijnder wordt, de uitvoering en handhaving steeds lastiger worden?
Asks whether the flavour ban achieves its aim given youth still obtain vapes and adult ex-smokers lose less harmful alternatives, and whether ex-smokers will return to cigarettes.
Finally, the PVV members ask the government whether the flavour ban does not miss its target if young people keep vaping and ex-smokers return to smoking.
Tot slot vragen de leden van de PVV-fractie de regering of de maatregel van het smaakjesverbod zijn doel niet voorbij gaat als de jongeren blijven vapen en de ex-rokers weer gaan roken.
Asks about the reach and cost of school prevention material, enforcement of the motion on vape sales location, and whether additional measures are needed to meet 2040 smoking targets.
The GroenLinks-PvdA members ask the government whether the current amendment sufficiently contributes to the ambition of at most five percent smokers and zero smoking youth by 2040.
De leden van de GroenLinks-PvdA-fractie vragen de regering of de huidige wetswijziging wel voldoende bijdraagt aan de ambitie van maximaal vijf procent rokers en nul rokende jongeren in 2040.
Thanks the government for its answers and has no further questions.
They thank the government for its answers and have no further questions.
Zij danken de regering voor de beantwoording en hebben geen verdere vragen.
Supports the smoke-free generation goal and welcomes bringing these products under the Tobacco Act for better regulation.
They are therefore positive about placing these products under the Tobacco and Smoking Products Act so they can be better regulated.
Daarom zijn genoemde leden positief over het laten vallen van deze producten onder de Tabaks- en rookwarenwet, zodat ze beter gereguleerd kunnen worden.
Asks about the enforceability of the smoking ban on nicotine pouches, since use is hard to observe, and what enforcement and prevention currently exist.
Can a consumer only be fined if they clearly open a nicotine pouch packaging?
Kan een consument alleen beboet worden als diegene «overduidelijk» een nicotinezakje verpakking opent?
Argues that a blanket ban including adults is disproportionate compared with strictly regulated adult sales, citing Sweden and other EU states, and asks for evidence-based answers.
They do not understand why the government therefore chooses a blanket ban, including for adults.
Zij begrijpen niet waarom de regering daarom kiest voor een algeheel verbod, ook voor volwassenen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the draft bill amending the Tobacco and Smoking Products Act (regulating nicotine products without tobacco and nicotine devices) may be submitted to the House of Representatives without remarks. The government's reply states that a statutory basis for technical requirements for nicotine devices was added to article 2(9) and that the explanatory memorandum was clarified on some points.

36412.s: The bill amends the Waterschapswet and Waterwet to strengthen the user-pays principle in water board levies, give water boards more room for climate adaptation, energy transition and circular economy measures, and fix problems in the wastewater and pollution levy calculation. It also changes the bezwaar decision deadline and adds delegations to general administrative orders (AMvB) and ministerial regulations for levy parameters.
36412.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying the formulas are technical and detailed, and that cost-share adjustments should keep pace with social and technological change while still providing legal certainty via the AMvB ceiling.
q: In that case, the necessary further rules can be provided through the regulatory competence of the water boards.
Wel kan in dat geval door de verordenende bevoegdheid van de waterschappen in de benodigde nadere regelgeving worden voorzien.
d: rules on determining primary energy use
rules on determining primary energy use for wastewater
percentages for raising or lowering cost shares per area characteristic
conditions for reduced measurement frequency for levy
further rules on ratio of COD to organic carbon for pollution levy
agreements with parties disposing of separate wastewater streams
p: Allows the water board general board to raise or lower cost shares by up to 30 or 50 percent based on area characteristics, and sets a formula, with the exact percentages left to an AMvB.
Allows the water board's levy official to determine the pollution value of a business premise by a fixed formula where the taxpayer or official shows another class applies.
Sets a calendar-year decision deadline for objections against levy assessments instead of the standard six-week period, which lengthens the wait for taxpayers.
Requires a ministerial evaluation within ten years of the new levy provisions and a transitional period of up to ten years for the old wastewater coefficient system.

parties: Asks whether the mandatory building tariff differentiation can become an optional provision and questions the feasibility and fairness of the shift in burden between homes and non-residential properties.
Is the government willing to include a "may-provision" in the bill?
Is de regering bereid om een «kan-bepaling» op te nemen in het wetsvoorstel?
Asks whether the bill sufficiently strengthens polluter-pays and how the water boards' administrative freedom to adjust levies is used.
Argues the levy system should be overhauled so heavy water users and polluters, especially industry and agriculture, pay the most, and questions whether a visible shift toward citizens has occurred.
Therefore these members call on the government to come up with a fairer levy: progressive and just, whereby the polluter actually pays the most.
Daarom willen deze leden de regering oproepen om met een eerlijkere belasting te komen: progressief en rechtvaardig, waarbij de vervuiler ook echt het meeste betaalt.

Asks why the tariff differentiation is mandatory rather than optional, why a 25% deviation bandwidth was chosen, whether the AMvB will be submitted to parliament, and how the potential taxpayer group and referendum-like approval thresholds are defined.

These members ask whether the characteristics or conditions water boards must meet to widen the administrative bandwidth up to a maximum of 50% will be laid down in the mentioned general administrative order (AMvB) and, if so, whether it will be submitted to the House.

Deze leden vragen of de kenmerken of voorwaarden waaraan waterschappen moeten voldoen om de bestuurlijke bandbreedte te kunnen verruimen tot maximaal 50%, worden vastgelegd in de genoemde algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB) en zo ja, of deze aan de Kamer wordt voorgehangen.
Asks why the new cost allocation method is not optional so water boards keep discretion, and why a structural 25% deviation rather than 30% is chosen.

would like to know why the government did not choose to make the proposed new cost allocation method for the "built" category optional, so that water boards have administrative freedom to make choices suited to their area.

horen graag waarom de regering er niet voor gekozen heeft het voorstel voor een nieuwe kostentoedelingsmethode voor de categorie «gebouwd» facultatief te maken, zodat waterschappen de bestuurlijke vrijheid hebben om bij het gebied passende keuzes te maken.
Questions the fairness of combining the rainwater discharge limit with area-based cost allocation, which may burden rural residents and farmers more than urban residents.
This proposal shows that citizens and farmers in rural areas with much nature management will have to pay more water board levy than citizens from the cities.
In dit voorstel komt naar voren dat burgers en boeren in landelijke gebieden met veel natuurbeheer meer zullen moeten betalen aan waterschapsbelasting dan burgers uit de steden.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a draft bill amending the Water Boards Act, Water Act and General Administrative Law Act to strengthen the polluter/benefit principle in water system levies, raising concerns about the frozen 2009 base year for building-value distribution, the representativeness of a support poll for water supply projects, and missing EU competition/state aid discussion. The minister's reply accepts the poll thresholds and the added competition and state aid section, but rejects correcting for past shifts in the burden between homes and non-residential property.
concerns: The bill takes the reference year for the building category's value shift as a starting point without explaining why the past burden shift toward homes is not corrected, and the explanatory memorandum should be supplemented.
The support poll for water supply projects lacks safeguards for representativeness; the minister added a turnout threshold and an outcome threshold in line with the Wet BIZ.
The explanatory memorandum lacks discussion of competition and EU state aid rules for water boards' economic activities, and the minister added a section covering these.

36421.s: The bill amends the income tax act and the inheritance tax act to narrow business-succession exemptions, excluding rented-out real estate and certain assets from business property, removing the efficiency margin, and adding age and value conditions. It mainly tightens tax relief rather than shifting power to or from the executive.
36421.j: The memorandum justifies the changes mainly by reducing Tax Authority workload and litigation and by budgetary effects, with no justification for new executive powers.
q: By explicitly classifying real estate rented to third parties as investment assets, the BOR and DSR ab become simpler to implement.
Door aan derden verhuurde onroerende zaken expliciet als beleggingsvermogen aan te merken, worden de BOR en de DSR ab eenvoudiger in de uitvoering.

parties: Asks whether the bill fully addresses constraints from ownership and continuity requirements and the timing of the five-year term change.
These members consider it a missed opportunity that this revision of the fiscal facilities has not already decided on adjustments to this term.
Voorgenoemde leden menen dat het een gemiste kans is dat bij deze herziening van de fiscale faciliteiten niet al is besloten tot aanpassingen van deze termijn.
Supports the aim and anti-abuse measures but questions whether the relief remains proportionate and why the threshold is set so high.
A BOR that offers tax advantages where these are not needed to secure a company's continuity contributes to great wealth inequality.
Een BOR die belastingvoordelen biedt waar deze niet nodig zijn om de continuïteit te borgen van een bedrijf, draagt bij aan een grote vermogensongelijkheid.
Asks the government for detailed impact estimates on family businesses, jobs and competitiveness before the bill proceeds.
The PVV members request the government to map the effects of the six individual measures.
De leden van de PVV-fractie verzoeken de regering om de effecten van de zes individuele maatregelen in kaart te brengen.
Supports tackling abuse but asks for concrete effect analysis and examples so that good-faith family businesses are not harmed.
If measures mean that well-intentioned family businesses can no longer stay afloat, they want to work with the government to find solutions.
Als maatregelen ertoe leiden dat goedwillende familiebedrijven het hoofd niet meer boven water kunnen houden, dan willen zij met de regering zoeken naar oplossingen.
Says the BOR is ineffective and complex and asks why stricter requirements are not imposed on firms that do not need the relief.
These members ask the government why stricter requirements have not been included so that companies do not unnecessarily use the BOR.
Deze leden vragen de regering waarom er geen verscherpte eisen zijn opgenomen zodat bedrijven geen onnodig gebruik maken van de BOR.
Criticises the half-hearted changes given the CPB finding that the BOR is inefficient, and cites the Council of State's call for justification; asks for economic justification of the relief.
The main conclusion is that the BOR is not efficient and in by far most cases not necessary to achieve its objective.
De voornaamste conclusie is namelijk dat de BOR niet doelmatig is, en in verreweg de meeste gevallen niet noodzakelijk om de doelstelling te bereiken.
Welcomes curbing abuse constructions but worries about the consequences of the stricter regime for family business continuity.
Argues the bill mainly burdens entrepreneurs without real improvements and asks whether an alternative 25% family-interest proposal was considered.
These members therefore fully agree with the Dutch Order of Tax Advisers that the proposed plans are mainly a burden increase for entrepreneurs.
Deze leden zijn het dan ook van harte eens met de Nederlandse Orde van Belastingadviseurs die stelt dat voorgestelde plannen vooral een lastenverzwaring voor ondernemers zijn.
Critical of the higher tax burden from the lowered exemption rate and the omission of easing measures; asks about cross-border comparison and competitiveness.
They understand the government's wish to make the BOR more targeted and efficient, but are critical of the proposed measures.
Zij begrijpen de wens van de regering om de BOR gerichter en doelmatiger te maken, maar zijn kritisch op de voorgestelde maatregelen.
Asks the government to follow up on a motion about flexible payment arrangements and to examine more thoroughly whether liquidity risks require adjusting deferral facilities.
Is the government willing to examine this issue more thoroughly, so that a firmer conclusion can be drawn?
Is de regering bereid deze kwestie diepgravender te onderzoeken, zodat steviger geconcludeerd kan worden?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the business succession facilities (BOR and DSR ab) are not justified for genuine business transfers and urged a fuller justification, a vision for further reform, consultation, and reconsidering inclusion in the Belastingplan package. The government's reply largely rejected these objections, defending the partial tightening as a first step and explaining the choices on consultation and packaging.
concerns: The Council questions the continuity rationale and the efficiency of the BOR, finding it effective but not efficient, and argues further tightening is warranted.

The Council states that a justificatory basis for the succession facilities is still lacking and asks for a vision and roadmap for phasing them out; the government disagrees and gives only a partial answer.

The Council asks the explanatory memorandum to weigh family interests against societal interests and to address competing policy goals on inequality, competition and the investment climate; the government added some text.
The Council asks for reasoned justification for including the bill in the Belastingplan 2024 package; the government defends the timing and packaging choice.
The Council asks for reasoned justification for omitting internet consultation; the government says prior consultation and time constraints justified not consulting online.

36430.s: The bill postpones the phase-out of the double general tax credit (dubbele algemene heffingskorting) in the reference minimum wage, extending the transitional date in the General Surviving Dependants Act and the Participation Act from 1 January 2023 to 1 January 2025. It takes effect on 1 January 2024 and is motivated by income support for households.
36430.j: The memorandum justifies the postponement as purchasing-power support, with no structural budget effect and a cumulative cost of 1.102 billion through 2028.
q: This is done by phasing out the double AHK in the calculation of the reference minimum wage down to a single AHK.
Dit gebeurt door de dubbele AHK in de berekening van het referentieminimumloon af te bouwen tot eenmaal de AHK.

parties: Asks for the percentage income gain from taking work out of welfare and for alternatives to reduce the poverty trap.
What percentage income gain from accepting work out of a welfare benefit would apply if the double general tax credit in the reference minimum wage for welfare were phased out?

Welk percentage inkomensvooruitgang bij aanvaarden werk vanuit een bijstandsuitkering zou gelden indien de dubbele algemene heffingskorting in het referentieminimumloon voor de bijstand afgebouwd zou zijn?
Welcomes the aim of improving purchasing power for some households and has no further questions for now.
These members are positive about that goal.
Deze leden zijn positief over dat doel.
Disappointed by the choice of this specific instrument, asks why alternatives were not chosen and whether the 2028 solution is certain and legally sound.
They therefore ask the government to reflect on the choice made and explain which other options were considered to raise the social minimum and prevent households from falling into poverty.

Zij vragen de regering dan ook te reflecteren op de gemaakte keuze en toe te lichten welke andere opties overwogen zijn om het sociaal minimum te verhogen en te voorkomen dat huishoudens in armoede vervallen.
Questions whether the 2028 timeline is certain and whether the measure may prolong the problem of cumulated benefits, and asks about simplifying the system.
Is the government certain that the problem is really solvable by 2028?
Weet de regering zeker dat het probleem per 2028 echt mogelijk is?
Supports the poverty goal but asks for the net income effect, numerical effect on poverty, and the alternatives considered.
Can the government explain why this instrument was chosen?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom voor dit instrument gekozen is?

Argues the one-year freeze creates recurring problems and asks the government to reconsider the phase-out and reintroduce the double credit, given the tax gap between single- and dual-earner families.
Is the government willing to reconsider this phase-out and/or reintroduce the double general tax credit?
Is de regering bereid deze afbouw te heroverwegen en/of de dubbele AHK te herintroduceren?
Asks for an explanation of the limited negative effect on work incentives and for budget breakdowns across the five affected laws and the cumulative amount after 2028.
The VVD members ask whether the government can break down the budgetary effects of the proposal by the five laws the measure affects.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de regering de budgettaire gevolgen van het voorstel kan uitsplitsen naar de vijf wetten waarop de maatregel effect heeft.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the General Surviving Dependants Act and the Participation Act to keep the double general tax credit in the reference minimum wage in 2024, and raised no substantive remarks. The Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions replied that the advice gave no reason for changes and forwarded the bill to parliament.

36511.s: The bill extends the rent increase cap for liberalised leases, adjusts how the maximum percentage is calculated, and brings the cap under municipal enforcement via the Wet goed verhuurderschap while shortening the limitation period for rent increase claims. It also sets commencement dates and removes the explicit sunset mechanics in favour of a fixed date of 1 May 2027.
36511.j: The memorandum justifies the new municipal enforcement and rent cap as serving the constitutional duty to promote adequate housing under Article 22 of the Constitution and as meeting ECHR proportionality conditions.
q: Municipalities are given the power to enforce this.
Gemeenten krijgen de bevoegdheid hierop te handhaven.
d: calculation of maximum annual rent increase percentage
p: ARTIKEL IV (Wet goed verhuurderschap, art. 2b and related enforcement articles)
Municipalities gain enforcement powers, including administrative fines, over the maximum rent increase for liberalised leases, extending their supervisory role into private rental contracts.

parties: Asks how the bill relates to the pending Amsterdam court case on prejudicial questions about unlawful rent increases and to other rent-regulation bills.

The PVV asks the government how the bill on capping rent increases in liberalised rental contracts relates to the pending case on unlawful rent increases on which the Amsterdam district court has asked preliminary questions.

De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen de regering hoe het wetsvoorstel maximering huurprijsverhogingen geliberaliseerde huurovereenkomsten zich verhoudt tot de lopende zaak over onterechte huurverhogingen waarover de rechtbank Amsterdam prejudiciële vragen heeft gesteld.
Questions why the measure is temporary rather than permanent and why the cap is not set annually by the minister, as in the regulated sector.
Why does the government not choose to make the amendment permanent?
Waarom kiest de regering er niet voor om de wijziging permanent te maken?
Asks about the cumulative effect of this bill and the Wet betaalbare huur on landlords and the private rental stock, and whether the infringement on property rights is limited.
Can the government elaborate on this?
Kan de regering hier nader op in gaan?

Asks what happens if the Wet betaalbare huur is not adopted, why a three-year extension was chosen, and whether private landlords bear disproportionate burdens; also asks how the bill was tested against EU law.
Can the government make clear what the consequences for this bill are if the Wet betaalbare huur does not come?
Kan de regering inzichtelijk maken wat de gevolgen zijn voor dit wetsvoorstel wanneer de Wet betaalbare huur er niet komt?
Asks how enforcement by municipalities and other measures will ensure landlords comply, and what the consequences are for tenants not covered by a cao.
These members also ask whether the Minister can reflect on how making the WWS system binding and the Wet goed Verhuurderschap will play a role in this.
Deze leden vragen zich daarnaast af of de Minister kan reflecteren op hoe het dwingend maken van het WWS-stelstel en de Wet goed Verhuurderschap hierbij een rol gaan spelen.
Asks whether municipalities have the capacity and information to enforce the cap and whether a simple inflation-based cap would be less intrusive on property rights.
Supports tenant protection but asks for detail on how the expanded enforcement role of municipalities affects their powers, and whether they have sufficient capacity and funding.
These members ask the government to address more explicitly how this expansion precisely affects municipal powers.
Deze leden vragen de regering nadrukkelijker in te gaan op hoe deze uitbreiding precies ingrijpt op gemeentelijke bevoegdheden.

Criticises dropping the lower-of-two system and adding one percentage point, arguing tenants lose out; asks why rent freezes are not chosen and how compliance and collective assistance by the rent commission can be improved.
Does the government share the view of these members that it would be more effective and desirable for tenants to be able to be helped as a group by the rent commission?
Deelt de regering de mening van deze leden, dat het effectiever en wenselijker is dat het mogelijk wordt voor huurders om als groep bij de huurcommissie geholpen te worden?
Asks for longer-term inflation and cao data and lessons from the period since 2005, and about the timing of an evaluation.
When will this evaluation be carried out?
Welcomes the extension but asks whether the plus-one-point margin risks raising tenants' housing quota and what happens if the Wet betaalbare huur is not adopted.
These members ask the government to reflect on how setting the maximum rent increase at cao wage index plus one percentage point relates to the aim of moderating housing cost increases.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen de regering te reflecteren op de vraag hoe het vaststellen van de maximale huurverhoging op cao-loonindex plus één procentpunt zich verhoudt tot de wens om tot matiging van woonlastenstijging te komen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill extending the cap on rent increases in liberalised rental housing by three years, making municipalities enforce it, and shortening the limitation period for rent-increase claims from five years to one, raising concerns about cumulative effects, the wage-based indexation basis, EU law compliance, and the one-year limitation period. The government's nader rapport replies to each point, largely defending the extension and wage-based indexation, adding EU-law justification and a fuller discussion of cumulative effects, and arguing the limitation-period change is proportionate and needs no separate bill.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a fuller explanation of the cumulative effect of this bill with other housing measures, which the government addressed in the explanatory memorandum without changing the bill.
The Afdeling asked for a better justification of wage development rather than inflation as the indexation basis, and the government defended wage development as the more appropriate basis.

The Afdeling asked for the cap to be tested against EU law, notably the Services Directive and free movement of capital, and the government added a reference to the earlier EU-law assessment and a supplement to the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling doubted the proportionality and need for shortening the limitation period from five years to one year and advised removing it for separate handling, and the government narrowed the measure so it applies only where the landlord did not inform the tenant.

36600-IIB.s: This bill formally establishes the 2025 budget statement for the other High Colleges of State, the governors' cabinets of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, and the Electoral Council (IIB), in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes the budget lines, the institutional tasks of the Council of State, Audit Office, Ombudsman and Electoral Council, and their expenditure and revenue projections.
q: The Advisory Division of the Council of State advises government and parliament on legislation and administration.
De Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State is adviseur van regering en parlement voor wetgeving en bestuur.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering has no remarks on the draft 2025 budget bill for the other High Councils of State, Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council (IIB), and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport, sent with the Koning's authorisation, states that some budgets need amendments and refers to annexes setting these out.

36610.s: The bill amends the Income Tax Act 2001 and the Inheritance and Gift Tax Act 1956 to tighten the business succession exemptions (BOR and DSR ab), limiting them to ordinary shares, shortening the continuity period from five to three years, and adding ministerial delegation powers to define situations deemed to satisfy the holding and continuity requirements, including government intervention cases. It also amends the Collection Act and the Wet aanpassing fiscale bedrijfsopvolgingsfaciliteiten 2024 with effect from 2025 and 2026.
36610.j: The memorandum justifies the separate delegation grounds by saying the existing general delegation may not be broad enough to cover designated situations that serve the purpose of the requirements.
q: Article 35e, paragraphs 1 to 4, of the Inheritance and Gift Tax Act 1956 sets out the main rule on when the continuity requirement is met.
In artikel 35e, eerste tot en met vierde lid, SW 1956 staat de hoofdregel van wanneer voldaan wordt aan het voortzettingsvereiste.
d: Artikel IV, onderdeel B (artikel 35d, vijfde lid, SW 1956)
treating persons as erflater or schenker in designated government intervention situations
Artikel IV, onderdeel B (artikel 35d, vierde lid, SW 1956)
designated circumstances in which holding requirement is deemed met
Artikel IV, onderdeel C (artikel 35e, zesde lid, SW 1956)
circumstances in which continuity requirement is deemed met
Artikel IV, onderdeel C (artikel 35e, zevende lid, SW 1956)
government intervention situations and conditions for meeting continuity requirement
p: Artikel IV, onderdeel B (artikel 35d, vierde en vijfde lid, SW 1956)
Allows the minister by regulation to designate situations and conditions under which heirs or donors are treated as meeting the holding requirement, including government intervention cases.
Artikel IV, onderdeel C (artikel 35e, vijfde tot zevende lid, SW 1956)
Allows the minister by regulation to specify circumstances and conditions under which the continuity requirement is deemed met, including in government intervention situations.

parties: Questions whether the BOR is justified at all, asks for proof that succession taxes endanger continuity, and presses the government to explain why an inefficient scheme is kept and loosened.

These members ask the government to reflect on the inefficiency of the scheme and on the tension between wanting to reduce that inefficiency and making the scheme available to a larger group of heirs.

Deze leden vragen de regering dan ook om te reflecteren op de ondoelmatigheid van de regeling en de wens die ondoelmatigheid te verminderen, en de combinatie van deze wens met het beschikbaar maken van de regeling voor een grotere groep erfgenamen.

Asks many detailed technical questions about transitional law, preferred shares, tracking stocks and disproportionate effects, and wonders whether the CPB evaluation was properly used before cutting the DSR.
Is the government willing to first examine this properly?
Is de regering bereid dit eerst goed te onderzoeken?

Strongly values family businesses and supports anti-misuse measures, but questions the Commission-based conclusions, the direct/indirect distinction and the impact on continuity, and asks for more analysis.
These members ask whether the government has studied the impact of the measure on businesses and the economy.
Deze leden vragen of de regering onderzoek heeft gedaan naar de impact van de maatregel op ondernemingen en op de economie.
Raises a tension between the five-percent threshold and forced withdrawal of business capital to pay succession tax, and asks about the rationale and effects of shortening the holding period.
These members ask the government to reflect on this point of tension and ask what the decisive reason was for choosing the five percent threshold.
Deze leden vragen de regering om een reflectie op dit punt van spanning, en vragen wat de doorslaggevende reden is geweest om voor het percentage van vijf procent te kiezen.
Asks whether the scheme is now efficient, what further improvements are possible, and whether the counterpart 'baby-bv' construction is being addressed.
Is the government convinced that the scheme is now efficient?
Is de regering ervan overtuigd dat de regeling nu wel doelmatig is?

Supports tightening misuse at very high ages but worries about legal inequality and whether the measures go too far, and asks why the threshold change is not introduced together with the dilution relaxation.
They ask whether the proposed adjustments do not go too far.
Zij vragen of de voorgestelde aanpassingen niet te ver gaan.
Questions the legal justification for age-based distinctions in the holding rule and how the government will verify genuine intent in succession carousel cases.
Can the government indicate which legal arguments it has to justify this distinction based on age?
En kan de regering daarbij tevens aangeven welke – juridische – argumenten zij hebben om dit onderscheid op basis leeftijd te rechtvaardigen?

Argues the BOR should be loosened rather than broadened, questions the shortening of the continuity period as encouraging misuse, and asks for a judgement on lobbying and for response to the NOB advice.
The NOB also holds that the BOR scheme was set up too generously.
Ook de NOB is van mening dat de BOR-regeling te ruimhartig is opgezet.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a nota van wijziging to the Wet aanpassing fiscale bedrijfsopvolgingsfaciliteiten 2025 and raised no remarks, advising that the bill be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The Staatssecretaris van Financiën accepted the advice and forwarded the nota van wijziging for submission.

The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft bill amending tax business succession facilities (Wet aanpassing fiscale bedrijfsopvolgingsfaciliteiten 2025) and made no remarks, advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Staatssecretaris van Financiën forwarded the advice and noted the Afdeling's promptness, with no substantive reply needed.

36700.s: The bill approves the air services agreement between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the Republic of Ivory Coast, signed in Abidjan on 23 May 2024, for the European part of the Netherlands. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.

parties: Asks the government to estimate how many additional flights the agreement could lead to, while welcoming market access independent of Schiphol capacity limits.
These members ask the government to estimate how many additional flights to and from the Republic of Ivory Coast this agreement could lead to.
Deze leden vragen de regering in te schatten tot hoeveel extra vluchten van en naar de Republiek Ivoorkust dit verdrag kan gaan leiden.
Has read the bill and has no further questions.
The CDA members have taken note of the bill and have no further questions.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben geen verdere vragen.
The BBB members have no further follow-up questions.
De leden van de BBB-fractie hebben geen verdere vervolgvragen.

Argues the agreement is purely commercial and operational, with climate and environment left as an empty clause, and asks the government to include binding climate and environmental goals and to share environmental data and to weigh residents' interests.
However, they find it outdated that the bill is solely aimed at commercial and operational wishes, with climate and environmental problems being an afterthought without concrete goals.
Wel vinden zij het juist ouderwets dat het wetsvoorstel enkel gericht is op commerciële en operationele wensen en de milieu- en klimaatproblematiek een sluitpost zijn zonder concrete doelen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State raised no substantive remarks on the air services agreement between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and Ivory Coast (Abidjan, 23 May 2024) and advised submitting it to the States General. The Minister of Foreign Affairs, on behalf of the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, requests authority to submit the treaty for tacit approval to parliament.

36725-L.s: The bill amends the 2025 budget statement of the Nationaal Groeifonds (National Growth Fund) through a first supplementary budget, reducing commitments, expenditure and receipts by EUR 393,158 thousand in the knowledge development and research and innovation policy articles to nil. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the act effective retroactively from 1 June 2025.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the National Growth Fund (L) for the year 2025 (First supplementary budget)
Wijziging begrotingsstaat van het Nationaal Groeifonds (L) voor het jaar 2025 (Eerste suppletoire begroting)

36915-K.s: The bill amends the 2026 departmental budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (DMF) through a first supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across materiel and infrastructure categories in thousands of euros. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and is retroactive to 1 June 2026.
q: So it is that We, in common consultation with the States General, have deemed and resolved as follows
Zo is het, dat Wij, met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan

36915-XXIII.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2026 departmental budget of the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth and the budget for its agencies, changing appropriations and commitments for energy supply and climate policy. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law retroactive to 1 June 2026.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget of the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth (XXIII) and of the budget for the agencies of this ministry, all for the year 2026
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Klimaat en Groene Groei (XXIII) en van de begrotingsstaat inzake de agentschappen van dit ministerie, alle voor het jaar 2026
